长弦与弦环产生的引力波

Gravitational Waves from Long Strings and Loops

Christos Litos, Sarunas Verner, Wei Xue, Fengwei Yang · hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：我们计算了处于标度区间的整体宇宙弦网络产生的引力波谱。该谱在弦关联长度处自然分为红外和紫外两部分。在红外部分，我们在非连通段模型中，由弦应力-能量张量的非等时关联函数解析地推导出该谱，并首次将该模型推广至弦环。弦环贡献可与长弦贡献相当，具体取决于弦环演化参数。在紫外部分，关联长度以下的结构主导源，我们发展了一种数据驱动方法，将这种关联函数形式与现有格点模拟中测得的瞬时辐射功率谱联系起来。预测的谱在红外部分随频率按 Ω_GW ∝ k 和 k^3 上升，在紫外部分则变平为一个带有轻微对数倾斜的平台。两者之间的转折频率由 Goldstone 玻色子即轴子的质量决定。将预测谱与当前数据和预期灵敏度进行对比，我们在对称性破缺能标 f_a 与轴子质量 m_a 的平面上给出了当前限制和未来探测前景。

English: We compute the gravitational wave spectrum produced by a global cosmic string network in the scaling regime. The spectrum naturally divides at the string correlation length into infrared and ultraviolet parts. In the infrared, we derive the spectrum analytically from the unequal-time correlator of the string stress-energy tensor within the unconnected segment model, which we generalize for the first time to string loops. The loop contribution can be comparable to that of long strings, depending on the loop evolution parameters. In the ultraviolet, where structure below the correlation length dominates the source, we develop a data-driven method that connects this correlator formalism to the instantaneous radiation power spectrum measured in existing lattice simulations. The predicted spectrum rises with frequency as $\Omega_{\rm GW}\propto k$ and $k^{3}$ in the infrared, and flattens into a plateau with a mild logarithmic tilt in the ultraviolet. The turnover frequency between the two is set by the mass of the Goldstone boson, the axion. Confronting the predicted spectrum with current data and projected sensitivities, we map out current constraints and future probes in the plane of the symmetry-breaking scale~$f_a$ and the axion mass~$m_a$.

一句话导读：在标度区间计算整体宇宙弦网络的引力波谱，区分长弦与弦环贡献，并给出轴子参数空间的限制与探测前景。

体-边界局域拓扑序的全息

Holography for bulk-boundary local topological order

Corey Jones, Pieter Naaijkens, David Penneys · math-ph, cond-mat.str-el, math.MP, math.OA, math.QA, quant-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：在我们之前的文章 [arXiv:2307.12552] 中，我们为量子自旋系统引入了局域拓扑序（LTO）公理，使我们能够定义一个物理边界（与格点切割相关），它由低一维的边界代数网来体现。这为拓扑全息提供了一个形式化框架，其中物理边界代数的 DHR 双模的编织张量范畴捕获了体拓扑序。在本文中，我们将 LTO 公理推广到配备拓扑边界（与平凡相的畴壁）的量子自旋系统，再次为体-边界系统产生一个物理边界代数，其（拓扑）边界 DHR 双模范畴恢复拓扑边界序。我们对 Levin-Wen 和 Walker-Wang 体-边界系统进行了显式详细分析。在此过程中，我们引入了一个由幺正编织融合范畴（UBFC）构造的二维编织范畴代数网。这类网作为 Walker-Wang 模型的边界代数出现。我们考虑该编织范畴代数网上对应于 Walker-Wang 模型标准拓扑边界的正则态。有趣的是，在此态中，锥 von Neumann 代数是 I 型且具有有限维中心，这与 [arXiv:2307.12552] 中研究的 Levin-Wen 模型的 II 型和 III 型锥 von Neumann 代数形成对比。超选择扇区恢复了我们 UBFC 的底层幺正范畴，并且最近在 [arXiv:2609.20725] 中证明，超选择范畴也捕获了融合与编织。

English: In our previous article [arXiv:2307.12552], we introduced local topological order (LTO) axioms for quantum spin systems which allowed us to define a physical boundary (associated to a cut of the lattice) manifested by a net of boundary algebras in one dimension lower. This gives a formal setting for topological holography, where the braided tensor category of DHR bimodules of the physical boundary algebra captures the bulk topological order. In this article, we extend the LTO axioms to quantum spin systems equipped with a topological boundary (domain wall with the trivial phase), again producing a physical boundary algebra for the bulk-boundary system, whose category of (topological) boundary DHR bimodules recovers the topological boundary order. We perform this analysis in explicit detail for Levin-Wen and Walker-Wang bulk-boundary systems. Along the way, we introduce a 2D braided categorical net of algebras built from a unitary braided fusion category (UBFC). Such nets arise as boundary algebras of Walker-Wang models. We consider the canonical state on this braided categorical net corresponding to the standard topological boundary for the Walker-Wang model. Interestingly, in this state, the cone von Neumann algebras are type I with finite dimensional centers, in contrast with the type II and III cone von Neumann algebras from the Levin-Wen models studied in [arXiv:2307.12552]. The superselection sectors recover the underlying unitary category of our UBFC, and it was recently proven in [arXiv:2609.20725] that the superselection category also captures the fusion and braiding.

一句话导读：将局域拓扑序公理推广到带拓扑边界的量子自旋系统，为 Levin-Wen/Walker-Wang 体-边界系统建立拓扑全息框架。

全纯共形嘉当几何：共形引力、扭量理论与双扭量理论

Holomorphic Conformal Cartan Geometry: Conformal Gravity, Twistors, and Ambitwistors

Chen-Hsu Chien · math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：本文在全纯共形嘉当几何的统一框架下回顾四维共形引力、扭量理论与双扭量理论。从该几何的旋量表示出发，系统表述了取值于 sl(4,C) 的正规嘉当联络、其曲率 2-形式以及相关的 tractor 丛。在实 Lorentzian 切片上，取定 Weyl 规范后，二次曲率作用量可重现四维 Weyl--Bach 共形引力。局域扭量丛与对偶扭量丛被构造为相关的旋量 tractor 丛，说明平行输运如何给出平直空间中的经典关联关系，以及弯曲背景中的手征可积性约束：α-曲面的反自对偶性与 β-曲面的自对偶性。进一步，通过不变正则配对将局域扭量与对偶扭量配对，双扭量空间被表明可参数化复零测地线，并对称地容纳左手与右手 Weyl 曲率。该框架建立了直接连接共形嘉当几何与扭量、双扭量理论的规范论桥梁。

English: Four-dimensional conformal gravity, twistor theory, and ambitwistor theory are reviewed within the unified framework of holomorphic conformal Cartan geometry. Starting from the spinorial representation of the geometry, the normal $\mathfrak{sl}(4,\mathbb{C})$-valued Cartan connection, its curvature $2$-form, and the associated tractor bundles are systematically formulated. Evaluated on the real Lorentzian slice, the quadratic curvature action is shown to reproduce four-dimensional Weyl--Bach conformal gravity upon fixing a Weyl gauge. Local twistor and dual twistor bundles are constructed as associated spin tractor bundles, illustrating how parallel transport yields the classical incidence relations in flat space and chiral integrability constraints in curved backgrounds: anti-self-duality for $\alpha$-surfaces and self-duality for $\beta$-surfaces. Furthermore, by pairing local twistors and dual twistors via an invariant canonical pairing, ambitwistor space is shown to parameterize complex null geodesics and symmetrically accommodate both left- and right-handed Weyl curvatures. This framework establishes a direct gauge-theoretic bridge linking conformal Cartan geometry to twistor and ambitwistor theories.

一句话导读：在全纯共形嘉当几何框架下，统一构造四维共形引力、扭量丛与双扭量空间，并连接 Weyl--Bach 作用量与手征可积性。

Kerr 时空中的对偶模与 Whiting 变换：模式稳定性再探讨

Dual modes in Kerr spacetimes and the Whiting transform: Mode stability revisited

Oliver Petersen, Andr\'as Vasy · math.AP, gr-qc, math.DG · v2 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：本文旨在将 Whiting 经典的增长模稳定性论证——由 Shlapentokh-Rothman 对标量波动方程推广到实频率，并由 Andersson、Ma、Paganini 和 Whiting 作一般化推广——置于经典 PDE 理论框架中。关键步骤包括：描述对偶模或伴随模，通过 Fourier 变换技术上执行一个奇异相空间配对论证，随后使用标准的唯一延拓结果。我们对对偶模描述的一部分将它们直接联系到在事件视界上光滑的标准模解。在零自旋情形，这有一个几何解释：跨未来事件视界光滑的准正规模（对非零实频率）可以通过在过去事件视界上置零而延拓为分布意义下的 QNM 解。我们还描述了模解在分叉球面上的行为。

English: The purpose of the paper is to place Whiting's classical growing mode stability argument, extended to real frequencies by Shlapentokh-Rothman for the scalar wave equation and by Andersson, Ma, Paganini and Whiting in general, in the framework of classical PDE theory. The key steps are: a description of the dual or adjoint modes, a singular phase space pairing argument which is technically executed via the Fourier transform, followed by a standard unique continuation result. One part of our description of the dual modes connects them directly to the standard mode solutions which are smooth over the event horizon. In the zero spin case, there is a geometric interpretation of this: quasinormal modes (for non-zero real frequencies) which are smooth across the future event horizon can be extended as distributional QNM solutions by 0 through the past event horizon. We also describe the behavior of mode solutions at the bifurcate sphere.

一句话导读：用经典 PDE 框架重新表述 Kerr 时空中的 Whiting 模式稳定性论证，并刻画对偶模及其与视界光滑模、QNM 分布延拓和分叉球面行为的关系。

相关度：high — 该文直接研究 Kerr 时空中的模式稳定性与准正规模，属于经典引力/广义相对论及 QNM 支线，与用户重点标签高度相关。

被星场衍射的透镜化引力波的有效描述

Effective description of lensed gravitational waves diffracted by stellar fields

Miguel Zumalac\'arregui, Xikai Shan · astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.GA, gr-qc, hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：作为天然望远镜，引力透镜使得观测原本过于遥远和暗淡的源成为可能。恒星质量天体，或微透镜，作为透镜中的杂质，对源产生细微畸变。这些效应对于正确解释观测是必要的，并且在某些情况下本身可能是引力放大效应的证据。地面探测器观测到的、被星系和星系团放大的引力波将经历恒星和遗迹场造成的微透镜效应：描述这些系统不仅需要考虑大量小尺度透镜（微透镜），还需要包括波动光学效应，从而导致信号随频率变化的调制。在这里，我们提出了用于约化阶随机衍射（ROSD）的新模型，这些模型在寻找引力波透镜特征时克服了这些挑战：通过奇异值分解，从星场波动光学透镜的数值模拟中合成一种有效描述。该过程产生一个优化的正交归一基来描述微透镜畸变——捕捉星场的主导“音调”，或恒星音色——以及系数的概率密度函数，可用作先验或验证与星场透镜的一致性。我们提出 SVD-stellar-I5-aLIGO 作为此类模型的一个例子，讨论截断阶数的角色，并展示如何通过注入和恢复在贝叶斯参数估计中将其应用于引力波数据。ROSD 可以针对探测器灵敏度和所分析源的类型进行定制，并可扩展到不同的微透镜族群和外部势。ROSD 模型为探测小尺度天体（恒星、遗迹，以及可能暗物质）开辟新窗口，并促进发现最遥远的致密双星并合。

English: As natural telescopes, Gravitational lenses enable the observation of sources that would otherwise be too distant and faint. Stellar-mass objects, or microlenses, act as impurities in the lens, producing subtle distortions of the source. These effects are necessary to correctly interpret observations, and may in some cases be themselves evidence of gravitational magnification. Gravitational waves (GWs) observed by ground detectors and magnified by galaxies and clusters will undergo microlensing by fields of stars and remnants: describing these systems requires not only considering a large number of small-scale lenses (microlenses), but also including wave-optics effects, leading to frequency-dependent modulations of the signal. Here we present novel models for Reduced-Order Stochastic Diffraction (ROSD), which overcome these challenges in the search for GW lensing signatures: an effective description is synthesized from numerical simulations of wave-optics lensing by stellar fields via a singular value decomposition. The procedure yields an optimized orthonormal basis to describe microlensing distortions -- capturing the dominant "tones" of the stellar field, or stellar timbre -- and a probability density function for the coefficients, which can be used as priors or to verify the consistency with stellar-field lensing. We present SVD-stellar-I5-aLIGO as an example of this model category, discuss the role of truncation order and demonstrate how it can be applied to GW data via injection and recovery in Bayesian parameter estimation. ROSD can be tailored to account for detector sensitivity and the type of source under analysis, and extended to different microlens populations and external potentials. ROSD models open a new window to probe small-scale objects (stars, remnants and potentially dark matter) and facilitate the discovery of the most distant compact binary mergers.

一句话导读：提出基于SVD的约化阶随机衍射有效模型，用于描述星场微透镜对引力波的波动光学畸变，并应用于贝叶斯参数估计。

相关度：high — 论文主要研究广义相对论框架下的引力波引力透镜与星场微透镜波动光学效应，直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线。

腔多模作为高频引力波探测的阵列

Cavity Multimodes as an Array for High-Frequency Gravitational Waves

Yanfei Shang, Yuxin Liu, Diego Blas, Yifan Chen, Jing Shu · hep-ph, astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM, gr-qc, hep-ex · v4 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：在存在背景磁场的条件下运行的微波腔，为探测高频引力波（HFGWs）提供了一条有前景的途径。我们首次证明，单个腔中多个电磁模式各自不同的天线方向图能够定位并重建入射 HFGW 信号的关键性质，包括其极化比和频率漂移率。以粒子加速器中常用的 9-cell 腔作为代表性例子，我们分析了 18 个近简并模式的时域响应；这些模式可被一个频率漂移的信号依次激发。灵敏度还会因可用模式数目的增加而增强，这与独立探测器网络所实现的标度十分类似，从而能够对天体物理上合理的双星源达到灵敏度。

English: Microwave cavities operated in the presence of a background magnetic field provide a promising avenue for detecting high-frequency gravitational waves (HFGWs). We demonstrate for the first time that the distinct antenna patterns of multiple electromagnetic modes within a single cavity enable localization and reconstruction of key properties of an incoming HFGW signal, including its polarization ratio and frequency drift rate. Using a 9-cell cavity commonly employed in particle accelerators as a representative example, we analyze the time-domain response of 18 nearly degenerate modes, which can be sequentially excited by a frequency-drifting signal. The sensitivity is further enhanced by the number of available modes, in close analogy to the scaling achieved by a network of independent detectors, enabling sensitivity to astrophysically plausible binary sources.

一句话导读：单腔中的多个电磁模式可像阵列一样定位并重建高频引力波信号，模式数增加还能提升灵敏度。

GW231109_235456：LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA O4a 观测运行中的一个亚阈值双中子星并合？

GW231109_235456: A Sub-threshold Binary Neutron Star Merger in the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA O4a Observing Run?

Wanting Niu, Carl-Johan Haster, Jolien D. E. Creighton, Chad Hanna, Shomik Adhicary, Pratyusava Baral, Amanda Baylor, Bryce Cousins, Heather Fong, Yun-Jing Huang, Rachael Huxford, Prathamesh Joshi, James Kennington, Alvin K. Y. Li, Ryan Magee, Duncan Meacher, Cody Messick, Soichiro Morisaki, Cort Posnansky, Surabhi Sachdev, Shio Sakon, Urja Shah, Divya Singh, Ron Tapia, Leo Tsukada, Aaron Viets, Zach Yarbrough, Noah Zhang · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：我们利用第四次 LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA 观测运行第一阶段的数据，对双中子星引力波旋近信号进行了亚阈值搜索。为增强对该目标群体的灵敏度，我们采用了由射电脉冲星巡天观测到的银河系双中子星群体以及已确认的 GW170817 事件所给出的群体先验。该搜索的灵敏度比标准 GWTC-4.0 搜索高约 60%，重新发现了此前在 GWTC-4.0 中报告为亚阈值的候选事件 GW231109_235456，其网络信噪比为 9.7，误报率改善为每 60 年一次。考虑来自此前四次搜索和本次新搜索的五重试验因子后，该候选事件的误报率约为每 12 年一次。如果该事件源自天体物理，推断的源性质表明主星质量为 1.40 至 2.24 太阳质量，次星质量为 0.97 至 1.49 太阳质量，总质量为 2.95 太阳质量，不确定度为 +0.38 和 -0.07 太阳质量。事件定位到 430 平方度（90% 概率）的区域，光度距离为 165 兆秒差距，不确定度为 +70 和 -69 兆秒差距。假设该信号来自双中子星并合，该事件将贡献的局部并合率为每年每立方吉秒差距 53 至 342 次（90% 可信区间）。

English: We present a sub-threshold search for gravitational-wave inspirals from binary neutron stars using data from the first part of the fourth LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA observing run. To enhance sensitivity to this targeted population, we adopt a population prior informed by the Galactic double neutron star population observed via radio pulsar surveys and by the confirmed GW170817 event. The search, with a sensitivity ~60% higher than standard GWTC-4.0 searches, recovers the previously sub-threshold candidate GW231109_235456 (reported in GWTC-4.0) with a network signal-to-noise ratio of 9.7 and an improved false-alarm rate of 1 per 60 years. Accounting for a trials factor of five, arising from the four previous searches and this new search, the false-alarm rate of the candidate is approximately 1 per 12 years. If the event is of astrophysical origin, the inferred source properties indicate component masses of 1.40 to 2.24 solar masses for the primary and 0.97 to 1.49 solar masses for the secondary, yielding a total mass of 2.95 solar masses with an uncertainty of plus 0.38 and minus 0.07 solar masses. The event is localized to a region of 430 square degrees (90% probability) at a luminosity distance of 165 megaparsecs with an uncertainty of plus 70 and minus 69 megaparsecs. Assuming the signal arises from a binary neutron star merger, this event would contribute a local merger rate of 53 to 342 per cubic gigaparsec per year (90% credible interval).

一句话导读：利用 O4a 数据对双中子星进行亚阈值搜索，重新发现候选事件 GW231109_235456 并给出其质量、距离与并合率推断。

GW-YOLO: Multi-transient segmentation in LIGO using computer vision

Siddharth Soni, Nikhil Mukund, Erik Katsavounidis · astro-ph.IM, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：来自引力波干涉仪的时间序列数据及其时频表示，为人工智能方法在信号与图像处理中提供了机会，尤其是在低延迟分析方面。在这项工作中，我们介绍 GW-YOLO，一种基于 YOLO（You Only Look Once）目标检测框架的信号与噪声识别工具。GW-YOLO 识别观测到的暂现源包含噪声、天体物理信号还是两者，并通过像素级分割掩膜提供检测对象的时频坐标。我们的方法在信噪比（SNR）12--15 范围内、且与瞬态噪声重叠时，对双黑洞信号的检测效率达到 53%，在 SNR 15--18 时提高到 75% 以上。对于与瞬态噪声重叠的双中子星信号，检测效率在 SNR 30--33 时达到 57%，在 SNR 39--42 时达到 87%。据我们所知，这是首次对引力波干涉仪中与真实仪器噪声重叠的天体物理信号检测能力进行定量评估。我们还提出了一条全自动、低延迟的流水线，可为单个噪声暂现源和天体物理信号生成像素级分割掩膜，从而进一步自动化事件验证和下游降噪流程。

English: Time series data and their time-frequency representations from gravitational-wave interferometers present opportunities for artificial intelligence methods in signal and image processing, particularly for low-latency analysis. In this work, we introduce GW-YOLO, a signal and noise identification tool based on the YOLO (You Only Look Once) object detection framework. GW-YOLO identifies whether an observed transient contains noise, an astrophysical signal, or both, while providing time-frequency coordinates of detected objects through pixel-level segmentation masks. Our approach achieves a 53% detection efficiency for binary black hole signals in the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) 12--15 range when they overlap with transient noise, increasing to more than 75% at SNR 15--18. For binary neutron star signals overlapping with transient noise, the detection efficiency reaches 57% at SNR 30--33 and 87% at SNR 39--42. To our knowledge, this is the first quantitative assessment of the ability to detect astrophysical signals overlapping with realistic instrumental noise in gravitational-wave interferometers. We also present a fully automated, low-latency pipeline that produces pixel-level segmentation masks for individual noise transients and astrophysical signals, enabling further automation of event validation and downstream noise-mitigation procedures.

一句话导读：基于 YOLO 的 LIGO 时频图多暂现源分割工具，可区分噪声与天体物理信号并给出像素级掩膜。

多黑洞的质量-角动量不等式

The Mass-Angular Momentum Inequality for Multiple Black Holes

Qing Han, Marcus Khuri, Gilbert Weinstein, Jingang Xiong · math.DG, gr-qc, math.AP · v3 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：这是两篇论文中的第二篇，旨在解决多黑洞的质量-角动量不等式猜想。更精确地说，我们证明：对于 Einstein 方程的一个完备、单连通、极大初始数据集，其具有多个端，且这些端要么渐近平坦要么渐近柱状，在非负能量密度和轴对称假设下，任意渐近平坦端的 ADM 质量都有一个由总角动量的平方根给出的下界。此外，该质量下界中的等号仅由极端 Kerr 时空的常时切片取得。证明基于一类以双曲平面为目标的新型奇异调和映射流，在此流下重正化调和映射能量单调不增。该流的相关性质通过调和映射方程及其线性化解的精细渐近分析获得。

English: This is the second in a series of two papers to settle the conjectured mass-angular momentum inequality for multiple black holes. More precisely, we show that for a complete, simply connected, maximal initial data set for the Einstein equations with multiple ends that are either asymptotically flat or asymptotically cylindrical, the ADM mass of any asymptotically flat end admits a lower bound given by the square root of total angular momentum, under the assumption of nonnegative energy density and axisymmetry. Moreover, equality is achieved in this mass lower bound only for a constant time slice of an extreme Kerr spacetime. The proof is based on a novel flow of singular harmonic maps with hyperbolic plane target, under which the renormalized harmonic map energy is monotonically nonincreasing. Relevant properties of the flow are achieved through a refined asymptotic analysis of solutions to the harmonic map equations and their linearization.

一句话导读：证明多端 Einstein 初始数据中 ADM 质量以总角动量的平方根为下界，等号仅由极端 Kerr 时空的常时切片取得。

双黑洞并合直接波的复频率演化

Complex frequency evolution of direct waves from binary black hole mergers

Ling Sun, Sizheng Ma, Patrick P. Chen, Andrew Laeuger, Neil Lu, Yanbei Chen · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：虽然任何起源于黑洞事件视界的信号都无法到达未来零无穷，但关于视界及其紧邻区域的信息可以编码在落入增长/形成中的视界的物质或场扰动所发射的波的渐近性质中。在响应滤波框架内，“直接波”指通过滤波黑洞响应而揭示的对源敏感的俯冲与残余形成信息。与具有固定复频率的稳态阻尼正弦不同，直接波跟随演化的源，并具有演化的瞬时复频率，在晚期与残余视界角速度 Ω_H 和表面引力 κ_H 相关。使用有理滤波器，我们从数值相对论波形中移除准正规模以研究这一演化。在数值污染之前，轨迹依赖于残余自旋：实频率对较低自旋（χ_f≲0.7）从上方趋向 2Ω_H，对较高自旋（χ_f≳0.7）从下方趋向 2Ω_H，而瞬时衰减率增加，最佳分辨情形接近预期的 3κ_H。如同粒子俯冲结果，只有在晚期才接近由视界控制的值，因为参考系拖曳控制近视界运动。对于非进动、可比质量双星的 χ_f~0.7 残余黑洞，早期实频率接近 2Ω_H，因为双星轨道频率平滑过渡到残余视界频率。因此有限时间偏差携带的是并合/坍缩动力学信息，而不是破坏视界联系。完整的直接波演化需要数值相对论校准。我们进一步表明，Kerr 响应中的近似极点-零点配对促成一个最小滤波器集，它抑制准正规模特征，同时揭示源轨迹信息。

English: While no signal originating at a black hole's event horizon can reach future null infinity, information about the horizon and its immediate vicinity can be encoded in asymptotic properties of waves emitted by matter or field perturbations falling toward a growing/forming horizon. Within a response-filtered framework, "direct wave" denotes source-sensitive plunge and remnant-formation information revealed by filtering the black-hole response. Unlike a stationary damped sinusoid with a fixed complex frequency, the direct wave follows the evolving source and has an evolving instantaneous complex frequency tied at late times to the remnant horizon angular velocity $\Omega_H$ and surface gravity $\kappa_H$. Using rational filters, we remove quasinormal modes from numerical-relativity waveforms to study this evolution. Before numerical contamination, trajectories depend on remnant spin: the real frequency evolves toward $2\Omega_H$ from above for lower spins ($\chi_f\lesssim0.7$) and from below for higher spins ($\chi_f\gtrsim0.7$), while the instantaneous decay rate increases, with best-resolved cases approaching the expected value of $3\kappa_H$. As in particle-plunge results, the horizon-controlled value is approached only at late times, as frame dragging controls near-horizon motion. For $\chi_f\sim0.7$ remnants of non-precessing, comparable-mass binaries, the early-time real frequency is close to $2\Omega_H$ because the binary orbital frequency transitions smoothly to the remnant horizon frequency. Finite-time deviations therefore carry information about merger/collapse dynamics rather than undermining the horizon connection. Full direct-wave evolution requires numerical-relativity calibration. We further show that approximate pole-zero pairing in the Kerr response motivates a minimal filter set that suppresses quasinormal-mode features while revealing source-trajectory information.

一句话导读：利用有理滤波从数值相对论波形中提取双黑洞并合直接波，揭示其瞬时复频率在晚期趋向残余视界的 Ω_H 与 κ_H。

动态 Barbero–Immirzi 引力中引力波传播的作用量层面刻画

Action-level characterization of gravitational-wave propagation in dynamical Barbero--Immirzi gravity

Zhi-Fu Gao, Hui Wang, Luiz Carlos Garcia de Andrade, Na Wang, Guo-Qiang Jin, Zhou-Jian Cao · gr-qc · v4 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：我们研究一阶动态 Barbero–Immirzi (BI) 引力中哪些算符在作用量层面控制宇宙张量传播。在玻色、两导数、曲率线性的 Einstein–Cartan 类中，消去代数洛伦兹联络后，标量部门与张量动能归一化之间出现分离。特别地，Holst 与 Palatini 之比决定标量动能结构，而横向无迹张量模式由宇称偶的 Hilbert–Palatini 系数归一化。因此，具有固定宇称偶归一化的最小动态 Holst 部门恰好保持在广义相对论张量传播面上，不会产生异常引力波摩擦。然后我们构造一个正则非最小宇称偶实现，其中张量归一化随宇宙学演化，推导相应的标准汽笛观测量，并利用当前 GWTC-3、GWTC-4.0 和 GWTC-5.0 信息作为对该作用量层面张量部门的观测检验。所得约束应被解释为对张量动能归一化演化的限制，而非对最小 BI 挠率动力学的直接约束。

English: We investigate which operators in first-order dynamical Barbero--Immirzi (BI) gravity control cosmological tensor propagation at the action level. Within a bosonic, two-derivative, curvature-linear Einstein--Cartan class, eliminating the algebraic Lorentz connection reveals a separation between the scalar sector and the tensor kinetic normalization. In particular, the Holst-to-Palatini ratio determines the scalar kinetic structure, whereas the transverse-traceless tensor mode is normalized by the parity-even Hilbert--Palatini coefficient. As a consequence, a minimal dynamical Holst sector with fixed parity-even normalization remains exactly on the general-relativistic tensor-propagation surface and does not generate anomalous gravitational-wave friction. We then construct a regular nonminimal parity-even realization in which the tensor normalization evolves cosmologically, derive the corresponding standard-siren observable, and apply current GWTC-3, GWTC-4.0, and GWTC-5.0 information as an observational test of this action-level tensor sector. The resulting constraints should therefore be interpreted as limits on the evolution of the tensor kinetic normalization rather than direct constraints on minimal BI torsion dynamics.

一句话导读：在一阶动态 Barbero–Immirzi 引力中，张量传播的归一化由宇称偶 Hilbert–Palatini 系数控制，最小 Holst 项不产生异常引力波摩擦，并用 GWTC 数据约束张量动能归一化的宇宙学演化。

广义相对论中的潮汐场与框架拖曳场

On the Tidal and Frame-Drag Fields in General Relativity

Rahulkumar Solanki · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：众所周知，在真空中，两个无限接近的、自由下落的类时观测者会因潮汐场（即 Weyl 张量的“电”部分）而感受到相对加速度；若它们携带惯性导引陀螺仪，则会因框架拖曳场（即 Weyl 张量的“磁”部分）而感受到陀螺仪之间的相对进动。因此框架拖曳场没有牛顿对应。本文针对一族携带惯性陀螺仪并构成同余的类时观测者，利用时空的 (1+3) 协变分解，在存在物质时将这两个场定义为约束方程。与牛顿引力不同，观测者围绕由其空间间隔（以及若同余非超曲面正交时闭合该回路的类时矢量）形成的闭合回路的相对速度，由于框架拖曳场和流体的动量密度而不会加和为零。此外，陀螺仪自旋围绕同一回路的相对取向一般也不会相互抵消，其原因包括潮汐场、流体变量（各向异性压强和能量密度），以及与构成回路的间隔矢量相关的相对速度的空间叉积。文中还表明，即使没有框架拖曳场，当相邻观测者的相对速度和加速度不平行时，由于微分 Thomas 进动，他们也会看到陀螺仪之间的相对进动。

English: It is known that in vacuum, two infinitesimally separated timelike observers under free fall notice a relative acceleration due to the tidal field (or the `electric' part of the Weyl tensor), and if they are carrying inertial guidance gyroscopes, they notice relative precession between these gyroscopes due to the frame-drag field (or the `magnetic' part of the Weyl tensor). The frame-drag field thus has no Newtonian analog. In this paper, for a family of timelike observers carrying inertial gyroscopes and forming a congruence, we define these fields as constraint equations in the presence of matter using (1+3) covariant splitting of spacetime. Unlike Newtonian gravity, the relative velocities of the observers around a closed contour formed by their spatial separations (and a temporal vector that closes this contour if the congruence is not hypersurface orthogonal) do not add up to zero due to the frame-drag field and momentum density of the fluid. Moreover, the relative orientations of the gyroscope spins around the same contour do not generally cancel out due to the tidal field, the fluid variables (anisotropic pressure and energy density), and the spatial cross-product of relative velocities associated with the separation vectors that form the contour. Additionally, it is shown that even in the absence of the frame-drag field, neighboring observers see relative precession between their gyroscopes when their relative velocity and acceleration are non-parallel due to differential Thomas precession.

一句话导读：用 (1+3) 协变分解将潮汐场与框架拖曳场表述为含物质约束方程，并讨论陀螺仪沿闭合回路的非牛顿行为与 Thomas 进动。

几何方法研究裸奇点时空中的圆光子轨道

Investigation of Circular Photon Orbits in Naked Singularity Spacetimes from a Geometric Method

Qing-Rong Xie, Chen-Kai Qiao · gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v2 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：圆光子轨道在引力理论和天文观测中都起着关键作用。然而，裸奇点时空中的圆光子轨道性质仍研究不足，值得深入探讨。本文全面研究裸奇点时空中圆光子轨道的特征。特别地，采用几何方法，其中光学几何框架及其内蕴曲率起重要作用。我们通过内蕴测地曲率分析圆光子轨道的存在性，然后考察稳定和不稳定圆轨道的数量，以及与圆光子轨道相关的拓扑不变量。通过考察多类裸奇点时空，我们得到一个对大多数球对称裸奇点时空成立的普遍结论：圆光子轨道总数为偶数（N=2k），由k条稳定轨道和k条不稳定轨道等比例组成。本文还给出了该结论的数学证明。此外，与其他类型时空的比较表明，裸奇点时空中圆光子轨道数量的结论与无裸奇点致密天体时空所得结论一致，表明圆光子轨道数量主要由事件视界的存在决定，而非时空奇点。关键词：圆光子轨道，裸奇点时空，光学几何，几何曲率。

English: Circular photon orbits play a pivotal role in both gravitational theories and astronomical observations. However, the properties of circular photon orbits in naked singularity spacetimes remain insufficiently explored and deserve in-depth investigation. The present work is dedicated to a comprehensive study of the features of circular photon orbits in naked singularity spacetimes. Notably, a geometric approach is employed to investigate these orbits, in which the framework of optical geometry together with its intrinsic curvatures plays a crucial role. We analyze the existence of circular photon orbits through the intrinsic geodesic curvature, and then examine the numbers of stable and unstable circular orbits, as well as the topological invariant associated with circular photon orbits. By examining various classes of naked singularity spacetimes, we obtain a general conclusion regarding circular photon orbits that holds for the most of spherically symmetric naked singularity spacetimes: the total number of circular photon orbits is an even integer ($\textit{N} = \text{2}\textit{k}$), consisting of $\textit{k}$ stable orbits and $\textit{k}$ unstable orbits in equal proportion. A mathematical proof of this conclusion is also provided in the present work. Furthermore, a comparison with other categories of spacetimes reveals that the conclusions regarding the number of circular photon orbits in naked singularity spacetimes agree with those obtained for compact object spacetimes without naked singularities, indicating that the number of circular photon orbits is primarily governed by the presence of event horizons rather than spacetime singularities. Keywords: Circular Photon Orbit, Naked Singularity Spacetime, Optical Geometry, Geometric Curvatures

一句话导读：用光学几何与内蕴曲率证明多数球对称裸奇点时空中圆光子轨道总数为偶数且稳定/不稳定各半，并指出其数量主要由视界而非奇点决定。

环铃与潮汐：暗物质晕剖面的指纹

The Ringdown and the Tide: Fingerprints of Dark Matter Halo Profiles

Arkadip Bhowmik, Avijit Chowdhury, Sayan Chakrabarti · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：天体物理黑洞并非孤立，而是嵌于宿主星系提供物质的环境中。我们研究周围暗物质晕的形状如何改变渐近平直、静态、球对称黑洞的环铃和潮汐响应。晕被建模为各向异性 Einstein cluster，径向压强为零，并采用广义 (α,β,γ) 密度剖面，在黑洞附近加入内截断，并在需要时加入外部潮汐截断。我们推导轴向引力扰动方程，并使用六阶 WKB 方法和时域演化计算 QNM 谱。晕使振荡频率和阻尼率红移，其量不仅由晕致密性决定，也由剖面参数决定：对于中心集中晕，内斜率 γ 主导，而 α 和 β 给出次领头但依赖剖面的修正。在 eikonal 极限，移动由单个红移积分控制，该积分编码光环绕外的晕质量分布，解释了 QNM 频率、光环绕频率和 Lyapunov 指数之间的密切对应。我们还表明，致密性和剖面形状的不同组合可给出几乎简并的环铃谱。时域演化证实 WKB 频率，并显示预期的晚期 Price 律衰减，其中间尾由外密度衰减控制（对缓慢衰减剖面）。最后，我们计算静态轴向潮汐 Love 数，并表明它探测晕的径向权重不同于环铃部分。因此，联合环铃和潮汐响应提供了一种可能区分环境效应与真空黑洞几何真实偏离的方法。

English: Astrophysical black holes (BH) are not isolated, but embedded in matter supplied by their host galaxies. We study how the shape of a surrounding dark matter (DM) halo modifies the ringdown and tidal response of an asymptotically flat, static, spherically symmetric BH. The halo is modelled as an anisotropic Einstein cluster with vanishing radial pressure and a generalized $(\alpha,\beta,\gamma)$ density profile, supplemented by an inner cut-off near the BH and, where required, an outer tidal truncation. We derive the axial gravitational perturbation equation and compute the quasinormal mode (QNM) spectrum using sixth-order Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin (WKB) methods and time-domain evolutions. The halo redshifts both the oscillation frequency and the damping rate, by an amount set not only by the halo compactness but also by the profile parameters: the inner slope $\gamma$ dominates for centrally concentrated halos, while $\alpha$ and $\beta$ give subleading but profile-dependent corrections. In the eikonal limit, the shift is governed by a single redshift integral encoding the halo mass distribution outside the light ring, explaining the close correspondence between the QNM frequencies, the light ring frequency, and the Lyapunov exponent. We also show that different combinations of compactness and profile shape can yield nearly degenerate ringdown spectra. Time-domain evolutions confirm the WKB frequencies and display the expected late-time Price law decay, with an intermediate tail controlled by the outer density falloff for slowly decaying profiles. Finally, we compute the static axial tidal Love number and show that it probes the halo with a radial weighting different from the ringdown sector. The combined ringdown and tidal response therefore provides a possible way to distinguish environmental effects from genuine deviations of the vacuum BH geometry.

一句话导读：研究暗物质晕剖面如何通过黑洞环铃 QNM 与潮汐 Love 数留下可观测指纹，以区分环境效应与真空黑洞几何偏离。

通过代理式AI发现可解释替代模型：应用于引力波

Discovery of Interpretable Surrogates via Agentic AI: Application to Gravitational Waves

Tousif Islam, Digvijay Wadekar, Tejaswi Venumadhav, Matias Zaldarriaga, Ajit Kumar Mehta, Javier Roulet, Barak Zackay · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, cs.AI · v2 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：昂贵的科学模拟现在需要快速替代模型，但它们通常表现为黑箱。我们提出 GWAgent，一个基于大语言模型的工作流程，可直接从模拟数据构建可解释的解析替代模型。替代建模非常适合智能体工作流，因为候选模型可在每次迭代中针对真实模拟进行定量验证。作为演示，我们为偏心双黑洞并合的引力波波形构建替代模型。我们表明，向智能体提供物理信息领域拟设可显著提高输出模型的精度。所得解析替代模型在 Advanced LIGO 上达到中位失配 6.9×10^-4，并将波形评估加速约 8.4 倍，超过符号回归和传统机器学习基线。除了产生准确模型外，该工作流还从学到的表示中识别出紧凑的物理结构。作为天体物理应用，我们使用 GWAgent 分析 GW200129 的偏心率，并推断 e_{20Hz}=0.099^{+0.063}_{-0.044}。这些结果表明，受验证约束的智能体工作流可为科学模拟和推断产生准确、快速且可解释的替代模型。

English: Fast surrogate models for expensive simulations are now essential across the sciences, yet they typically operate as black boxes. We present \texttt{GWAgent}, a large language model (LLM)-based workflow that constructs interpretable analytic surrogates directly from simulation data. Surrogate modeling is well suited to agentic workflows because candidate models can be quantitatively validated against ground-truth simulations at each iteration. As a demonstration, we build a surrogate for gravitational waveforms from eccentric binary black hole mergers. We show that providing the agent with a physics-informed domain ansatz substantially improves output model accuracy. The resulting analytic surrogate attains a median Advanced LIGO mismatch of $6.9\times10^{-4}$ together with an $\sim 8.4\times$ speedup in waveform evaluation, surpassing both symbolic regression and conventional machine learning baselines. Beyond producing an accurate model, the workflow identifies compact physical structure from the learned representation. As an astrophysical application, we use \texttt{GWAgent} to analyze the eccentricity of GW200129 and infer $e_{20\mathrm{Hz}}=0.099^{+0.063}_{-0.044}$. These results show that validation-constrained agentic workflows can produce accurate, fast, and interpretable surrogates for scientific simulations and inference.

一句话导读：GWAgent 用 LLM 智能体从模拟数据构建可解释引力波波形替代模型，并用于偏心双黑洞与 GW200129 偏心率推断。

相关度：medium — 论文直接属于经典引力/引力波方向，涉及偏心双黑洞并合波形与 GW200129 偏心率推断；但核心是代理式 AI 构建可解释替代模型的方法学，对经典引力理论本身贡献有限。

gwBenchmarks：在高精度引力波天文学中压力测试 LLM 智能体

gwBenchmarks: Stress-Testing LLM Agents on High-Precision Gravitational Wave Astronomy

Tousif Islam, Digvijay Wadekar, Zihan Zhou · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM, cs.AI · v2 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：现代引力波天文学依赖的建模任务通常需要数月研究生级别的工作，包括从昂贵的数值相对论模拟中构建快速波形代理模型、对黑洞轨道动力学建模、拟合并合余晖性质以及构建模板库。这些问题要求极高精度以支持探测和参数推断，最先进模型的相对误差达到 ≲10^-4。我们研究最先进的 LLM 编码智能体是否能够执行此类端到端科学建模，其中成功需要构建满足严格精度标准的模型并对物理系统进行推理。我们提出 gwBenchmarks，一套八个基于引力波解析计算和数值模拟的任务，合计代表超过 10^8 核心小时的计算量。这些任务涵盖插值、回归和高维时间序列建模，需要数值方法、机器学习和物理信息方法的结合。在初步实验中，智能体经常依赖代理指标、部分评估或编造结果来虚假完成任务。因此，我们实现了一个外部预定义框架来衡量智能体进展。评估十二个编码智能体，我们发现没有一致赢家。在最简单的任务上，多个智能体收敛到相同的三次样条解，其中一个重新发现了文献中广泛使用的坐标变换。在诸如解析波形建模等更难任务上，所有智能体都比领域要求差 1-2 个数量级，并表现出系统性失败，包括指标误用、约束违反和结果编造。我们的代码、数据和网站公开可用。

English: Modern gravitational wave astronomy relies on modeling tasks that often require months of graduate-level effort, including building fast waveform surrogates from expensive numerical relativity simulations, modeling orbital dynamics of black holes, fitting merger remnant properties and constructing template banks. These problems demand extreme precision to support detection and parameter inference, with state-of-the-art models achieving $\lesssim 10^{-4}$ relative error. We study whether state-of-the-art LLM coding agents can perform such end-to-end scientific modeling, where success requires constructing models with stringent accuracy criteria and reasoning about physical systems. We introduce gwBenchmarks, a suite of eight tasks grounded in gravitational wave analytic calculations and numerical simulations collectively representing over $10^8$ core-hours of compute. The tasks span interpolation, regression, and high-dimensional time-series modeling, requiring a combination of numerical methods, machine learning, and physics-informed approaches. In preliminary experiments, agents frequently relied on proxy metrics, partial evaluation, or fabricated results to spuriously complete tasks. We therefore implement an external pre-defined framework to gauge agent progress. Evaluating twelve coding agents, we find no consistent winner. On the easiest task, multiple agents converge to the same cubic spline solution, with one rediscovering a coordinate transformation widely used in the literature. On harder tasks like analytic waveform modeling, all agents fall 1-2 orders of magnitude short of domain requirements and exhibit systematic failures, including metric misuse, constraint violations, and result fabrication. Our code, data, and website are publicly available.

一句话导读：引入 gwBenchmarks，评估十二个 LLM 编码智能体在八项高精度引力波建模任务上的端到端科学建模能力，发现其远未达到领域精度要求。

相关度：medium — 论文围绕引力波波形建模与数值相对论任务，属于经典引力/引力波支线，但核心是 LLM 智能体基准测试，不含新的引力理论或全息对偶结果。

利用 LISA 极端质量比旋进探测 Kerr 对称性破缺

Probing Kerr symmetry breaking with LISA extreme-mass-ratio inspirals

Pablo F. Muguruza (Institute of Space Sciences, Institute of Space Studies of Catalonia, Autonomous University of Barcelona), Carlos F. Sopuerta (Institute of Space Sciences, Institute of Space Studies of Catalonia) · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：极端质量比旋进（EMRI）是 LISA 的主要引力波源之一。EMRI 信号中大量的引力波周期使其成为局部时空几何的精密探针，并对 Kerr 度规偏离高度敏感。本文研究围绕具有丰富多极结构的广义非 Kerr 致密天体的 EMRI。在领头后牛顿阶和线性质量比阶，我们在波形模型中同时纳入质量四极矩和八极矩的轴对称与非轴对称分量，以此参数化 Kerr 度规两个基本对称性的破缺。我们按 EMRI analytic kludge 模型的思想研究这些修改对波形的影响。在我们的情形中，轨道演化来自包含主天体多极结构的拉格朗日量，并首次纳入破坏轴对称性的非轴对称多极矩。随后，我们评估 LISA 约束多极矩偏离 Kerr 值以及探测对称性破缺效应的能力。由此，我们分析 LISA 能多有效地检验预测视界尺度修改的模型，例如 fuzzball 模型。结果表明，未来 LISA 对 EMRI 的观测将为黑洞结构和基础引力理论提供前所未有的检验。特别地，对于一颗 10 太阳质量致密天体旋进到 10^6 太阳质量旋转超大质量黑洞、信噪比为 30 的一年 LISA 数据，将可能对 Kerr 度规两个基本对称性的偏离给出严格限制：将质量多极矩扇区的赤道对称性破缺限制到 10^-1 水平，将轴对称性破缺限制到 10^-2 水平。

English: [abridged] Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) are one of the main sources of gravitational waves (GWs) for LISA. The large number of GW cycles in the EMRI signal makes them very precise probes of the local spacetime geometry that are highly sensitive to deviations from the Kerr metric. Here, we investigate EMRIs around generic, non-Kerr compact objects characterized by a rich multipolar structure. At leading post-Newtonian and linear mass-ratio orders, we incorporate in the waveform model both the axisymmetric and nonaxisymmetric components of the mass quadrupole and octupole moments, parametrizing in this way the breaking of two fundamental symmetries of the Kerr metric. We study the impact of these modifications on the waveform in the philosophy of the EMRI \emph{analytic kludge} models. In our case, the orbital evolution follows from a Lagrangian that contains of the multipolar structure of the primary, including for the first time the nonaxisymmetric multipole moments that break axial symmetry. Then, we assess the capability of LISA to constrain deviations of the multipole moments from their Kerr values and detecting symmetry-breaking effects. In this way, we analyze how effectively LISA will be able to probe models that predict horizon-scale modifications, such as the fuzzball model. Our results show that future LISA observations of EMRIs will provide unprecedented tests of the black hole structure and the underlying theory of gravity. In particular, with one year of LISA data from the inspiral of a $10\,M_{\odot}$ compact object into a rotating supermassive black hole of $10^{6}\,M_{\odot}$ and signal-to-noise ratio of 30, it will be possible to place tight bounds on deviations from the two fundamental symmetries of the Kerr metric, constraining equatorial symmetry breaking in the mass multipole sector to the $10^{-1}$ level and axial symmetry breaking to the $10^{-2}$ level.

一句话导读：LISA EMRI 波形纳入非 Kerr 多极结构，可对 Kerr 赤道与轴对称性破缺给出严格限制。

用多信使双中子星并合检验强等效原理

Testing the strong equivalence principle with multimessenger binary neutron star mergers

Jie Zhu, Hanlin Song, Zhenwei Lyu, Hao Li, Peixiang Ji, Jun-Chen Wang, Haobo Yan, Bo-Qiang Ma · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：引力常数 G 的恒定性是强等效原理和广义相对论的基石，但其可能的时间变化仍是基础物理检验的关键目标。引力波天文学，尤其是与电磁观测相结合，为在强场和动态区域探测这一原理提供了前所未有的新机遇。在本工作中，我们建立了一个具有缓慢变化引力常数的引力波波形模型，将其效应同时纳入致密双星动力学和膨胀宇宙中的引力波传播。将这一框架应用于双中子星并合 GW170817，并结合来自 GRB 170817A 对光度距离、天区定位和双星倾角的独立电磁约束，我们进行联合贝叶斯分析，将变化 G 效应与天体物理简并分离开来。我们发现没有引力常数随时间变化的证据，并将其分数时间导数限制在 \dot{G}/G ∈ [-3.36 × 10^{-9}, 5.34 × 10^{-10}] yr^{-1}，这是迄今从真实引力波观测得到的最严格限制。我们的结果展示了多信使天文学作为相对论区域强等效原理精密探针的能力。

English: The constancy of the gravitational constant $G$ is a cornerstone of the strong equivalence principle and of general relativity, yet its possible temporal variation remains a key target in tests of fundamental physics. Gravitational-wave (GW) astronomy, especially when combined with electromagnetic observations, provides an unprecedented new opportunity to probe this principle in the strong-field and dynamical regime. In this work, we develop a GW waveform model with a slowly varying gravitational constant, incorporating its effects both on compact binary dynamics and GW propagation in an expanding universe. Applying this framework to the binary neutron star merger GW170817, together with independent electromagnetic constraints on the luminosity distance, sky localization and binary inclination from GRB 170817A, we perform a joint Bayesian analysis that disentangles varying-$G$ effects from astrophysical degeneracies. We find no evidence for a temporal variation of the gravitational constant, and constrain its fractional time derivative to $\dot{G}/G \in [-3.36 \times 10^{-9}, 5.34\times10^{-10}]~{\rm yr^{-1}}$, representing the most stringent bounds obtained to date from real GW observations. Our results demonstrate the power of multi-messenger astronomy as a precision probe of the strong equivalence principle in the relativistic regime.

一句话导读：利用 GW170817/GRB 170817A 多信使观测对变化引力常数 G 进行贝叶斯限制，未发现强等效原理破缺证据。

将自旋进动误判为引力波信号中的轨道偏心率

Misinterpreting spin precession as orbital eccentricity in gravitational-wave signals

Snehal Tibrewal, Aaron Zimmerman, Jacob Lange, Deirdre Shoemaker · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：引力波探测器范围和广度的不断增加，为探索引力波天文学中的新参数提供了机会。偏心率和自旋进动是推断引力波源起源的两个关键观测量。引力波源参数的解读可能受到简并的困扰，例如众所周知的质量-自旋简并。随着该领域探索新参数，人们提出了关于偏心率和自旋进动之间可能简并的疑问。尽管一些最先进模型现在已分别包含这些效应，但同时包含自旋进动和偏心率的模型仍处于起步阶段。在模型忠实覆盖致密双星并合的完整参数空间之前，我们正确测量源参数并推断双星形成的能力会受到损害。在这里，我们研究重双黑洞系统中这两个关键参数的可区分性。我们研究并合-铃宕主导的系统，探测器系总质量范围在 200-300 M⊙，质量比范围在 1-3。我们的工作发现，偏心率和自旋进动之间确实存在简并；然而，这是一种高度局域化的效应。我们发现，随着探测器系总质量从 200 M⊙ 增加到 300 M⊙，误判的偏心率估计会变得更差，这对应于探测器频带中逐渐变短的信号。此外，这种误判对源系统的倾角高度敏感。我们提供了这种简并强度的可量化估计，并确定了这种简并存在的一些参数空间区域。

English: The increasing scope and breadth of gravitational wave detectors is providing the opportunity to explore new parameters in gravitational-wave astronomy. Eccentricity and spin-precession are two key observables to infer the origin of a gravitational wave (GW) source. The interpretation of GW source parameters can be plagued by degeneracy, such as the well-known degeneracy between mass and spin. As the field has explored new parameters, questions have been raised about possible degeneracies between eccentricity and spin-precession. Although some state-of-the-art models now include these effects individually, models that incorporate spin-precession and eccentricity are only in their infancy. Until models faithfully cover the complete parameter space of compact binary coalescence, our ability to correctly measure the source parameters and infer the formation of the binary is compromised. Here, we present a study of the distinguishability of these two key parameters in heavy binary black hole systems. We study merger-ringdown dominated systems with detector-frame total masses ranging between $200-300M_{\odot}$ and mass ratio ranging between $1-3$. Our work finds that there is indeed a degeneracy between eccentricity and spin-precession; however, it is a highly localized effect. We find that the misidentified eccentricity estimates get worse as the detector-frame total mass increases from $200M_{\odot}$ to $300M_{\odot}$, corresponding to progressively shorter signals in the detector band. Additionally, this misidentification is highly sensitive to the inclination angle of the source system. We provide quantifiable estimates of the potency of this degeneracy in addition to identifying some of the regions of parameter space where this degeneracy exists.

一句话导读：研究发现重双黑洞引力波信号中自旋进动与轨道偏心率存在局域简并，误判随总质量增大而加剧且依赖倾角。

闭FRW宇宙学中曲率驱动反弹下的协变双场扰动

Covariant Two-Field Perturbations Through a Curvature-Driven Bounce in Closed FRW Cosmology

Oleksandr Kravchenko · gr-qc · v5 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：我们研究在闭合（K=+1）FRW宇宙中，通过局部非奇异反弹的扰动，采用正则化双场sigma模型。正曲率在不违反NEC的情况下驱动广义相对论中的反弹；膨胀分支趋近Starobinsky暴胀，并在N=60给出标准领先慢滚观测量。在精确基准约化标量计算中，动能和梯度系数在声明的谐波时间网格上保持为正，张量特征为光速；无墙均匀剪切扫描仅确立了采样稳健性。我们在牛顿规范中，用共动曲率扰动的两种场空间表示积分标量扇区，并以代数Gordon-Wands投影作为第三种重构：在64个转向单元中，跨表示最大残差为5.6×10^-10，跨越H=0时Einstein约束、容差细化和DOP853-Radau诊断保持在10^-8至10^-12水平。在基准无转向轨迹上，我们推导并积分精确有限谐波闭S^3约化标量作用量，传播两个正则归一化有限时状态，但不声称唯一渐近真空。这给出早期平台张量标量比r_{ℓ=60}=1.73×10^-6（状态范围[1.62,1.73]×10^-6），区别于可观测枢轴预测r≃3.1×10^-3，以及ℓ=60处熵曲率功率比0.983（状态范围[0.896,0.983]），这是spectator功率而非转移系数或等曲率分数。在最低谐波，两个状态跨越n_s^curv∈[0.86,4.17]；状态敏感性和宇宙方差阻止似然声明。该工作建立了一个完全指定的有限网格微扰延拓穿越曲率驱动反弹，而非过去测地完备性的证明。

English: We study perturbations through a locally non-singular bounce in a closed ($K=+1$) FRW universe with a regularised two-field sigma model. Positive curvature drives the bounce in General Relativity without NEC violation; the expanding branch approaches Starobinsky inflation and yields the standard leading slow-roll observables at $N=60$. In the exact fiducial reduced-scalar calculation, kinetic and gradient coefficients remain positive on the declared harmonic-time grid and tensor characteristics are luminal; a wall-free homogeneous-shear scan establishes only sampled robustness. We integrate the scalar sector in two field-space representations of the comoving curvature perturbation, both in Newtonian gauge, with an algebraic Gordon-Wands projection as a third reconstruction: across 64 turning cells the maximum cross-representation residual is $5.6\times10^{-10}$, and across $H=0$ the Einstein-constraint, tolerance-refinement and DOP853-Radau diagnostics stay at the $10^{-8}$-$10^{-12}$ level. On the fiducial no-turn trajectory we derive and integrate the exact finite-harmonic closed-$S^3$ reduced scalar action, propagating two canonically normalised finite-time states without claiming a unique asymptotic vacuum. This gives an early-plateau tensor-to-scalar ratio $r_{\ell=60}=1.73\times10^{-6}$ (state range $[1.62,1.73]\times10^{-6}$), distinct from the observable-pivot prediction $r\simeq3.1\times10^{-3}$, and an entropy-to-curvature power ratio $0.983$ at $\ell=60$ (state range $[0.896,0.983]$), which is spectator power rather than a transfer coefficient or an isocurvature fraction. At the lowest harmonics the two states span $n_s^{\rm curv}\in[0.86,4.17]$; state sensitivity and cosmic variance preclude a likelihood claim. The work establishes a fully specified finite-grid perturbative continuation through a curvature-driven bounce, not a proof of past geodesic completeness.

无参数化偏置的快速旋转中子星普适关系

Universal relations for fast rotating neutron stars without parametrisation bias

Christian J. Kr\"uger, Mariachiara Celato · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：我们总结了过去几十年提出的若干核状态方程参数化方案，并列出了其参数的可行范围。基于这些参数化，我们使用 RNS 代码构建了一个庞大的旋转中子星模型数据库，这些模型按恒定中心能量密度序列排列。在根据宽松的天体物理约束过滤这些序列后，我们发现了任意转速的均匀旋转中子星多种体量的紧密普适关系。这些普适关系允许以极低计算成本估算均匀旋转中子星的体量，比求解完整恒星平衡方程快约三个数量级，且仅需使用相关非旋转中子星的质量、半径和转动惯量。由于在一个大型、模型无关的数据集上校准，这些关系具有鲁棒性，并在用现实状态方程测试时保持准确，且优于此前发表的关系。对大多数量而言，相对残差的第99百分位低于1.6%；转动惯量（2.8%）和 T/W（4.6%）的不确定度最大。此类关系对于未来来自电磁和引力波观测的高精度测量很重要，并可用于状态方程推断代码或引力波建模等。

English: We provide a summary of several parametrisations for the nuclear equation of state that have been proposed over the past decades and list viable ranges for their parameters. Based on these parametrisations, we construct a large database of rotating neutron star models using the \textsc{rns} code, which are arranged in sequences of constant central energy density. After filtering these sequences with respect to generous astrophysical constraints, we discover tight universal relations for various bulk quantities of uniformly rotating neutron stars of arbitrary rotation rates. These universal relations allow bulk quantities of uniformly rotating neutron stars to be estimated at minimal computational cost, approximately three orders of magnitude faster than solving the full stellar equilibrium equations, employing only mass, radius, and moment of inertia of associated non-rotating neutron stars. Calibrated on a large, model-agnostic dataset, the relations are robust and remain accurate when tested against realistic equations of state and outperform previously published ones. For most quantities the 99th percentile of the relative residuals lies below 1.6\%; the moment of inertia (2.8\%) and T/W (4.6\%) carry the largest uncertainties. Such relations are important for future, high-precision measurements coming from electromagnetic and gravitational wave observations and may be used in equation of state inference codes or gravitational wave modeling among others.

将暴胀与小尺度各向异性相协调

Reconciling Inflation with Anisotropies at Small Scales

Brett McInnes · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO · v3 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：基于若干不同数据集，一直有迹象表明我们宇宙的某些方面过去或现在并非各向同性。要为这种“统计各向异性”建立自洽的理论解释并不容易，因为在标准广义相对论中，直觉上它与非常成功的暴胀假说的预言相矛盾。我们为这一直觉提供了坚实基础，证明：若我们（a）采用一种暴胀理论，其中暴胀使空间几何各向同性化（当然包括绝大多数此类理论），并且（b）坚持假定时空具有严格度规几何（即几何完全由度规张量决定），那么“哈勃场”的所有方面都必须各向同性。反过来说，若统计各向异性得到证实，那么要么必须从一开始就把各向异性构造进暴胀，要么必须接受时空几何不是严格度规的。我们认为，通过允许时空挠率非零来实现的第二种选择，将是远为自然地容纳其中某些观测的方式。此类理论能够把暴胀结束时非各向同性的哈勃场与完全各向同性的空间几何协调起来，从而能够将暴胀与相对小宇宙尺度上某些可能可观测的各向异性相协调（尽管绝非所有）。

English: There have been persistent suggestions, based on several diverse data sets, that some aspects of our Universe were or are not isotropic. It is not easy to develop a coherent theoretical account of such a ``statistical anisotropy'', for, in standard General Relativity, intuition suggests that it contradicts the predictions of the very successful Inflationary hypothesis. We put this intuition on a firm basis, by proving that if we [a] make use of an Inflationary theory in which Inflation isotropises spatial geometry ---$\,$ this, of course, includes the great majority of such theories ---$\,$ and if [b] we insist on assuming that spacetime has a strictly metric geometry (one in which the geometry is completely determined by a metric tensor), then indeed all aspects of the ``Hubble field'' must be isotropic. Conversely, should a statistical anisotropy be confirmed, then either we must contrive to build anisotropy into Inflation from the outset, or we will have to accept that spacetime geometry is not strictly metric. We argue that the second option, implemented by allowing spacetime \emph{torsion} to be non-zero, would be by far the most natural way to accommodate \emph{some} such observations. Such theories can reconcile a non-isotropic Hubble field at the end of Inflation with a perfectly isotropic spatial geometry, and thus are able to reconcile Inflation with certain kinds of possibly observable anisotropies at relatively small cosmic scales (though by no means with all).

Zhongyou Mo · gr-qc, quant-ph · v4 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：本文基于远平行引力研究Kerr-Newman时空中带电粒子的量子干涉。我们计算了引力相位差、电磁相位差和条纹移动，发现引力相位差包含三部分：分别对应Kerr时空的结果、Kerr-Newman黑洞电荷对时空的效应，以及引力与电磁相互作用的混合贡献；电磁相位差包含两部分：纯电磁贡献以及电磁与引力的混合贡献。随后将结果推广到dyonic Kerr-Newman时空，讨论黑洞磁荷与转动效应，并提出两个思想实验检验Dirac量子化条件。还研究了引力普适性破缺的情形，表明可从条纹移动确定对弱等效原理的偏离。最后比较远平行引力与广义相对论的结果：对于一般弱引力场，两种理论的引力相位在引力规范势一阶一致，但在高阶不同。

English: The quantum interference of charged particles in Kerr-Newman spacetime is studied based on teleparallel gravity. We calculate the gravitational phase difference, electromagnetic phase difference, and fringe shifts. We find that the gravitational phase difference contains three parts, respectively corresponding to the result in Kerr spacetime, the effect of Kerr-Newman black hole's charge on spacetime, and a mixed contribution from gravity and electromagnetic interaction. As for the electromagnetic phase difference, it contains two parts, respectively representing a pure electromagnetic contribution and a contribution in which electromagnetism mixes with gravitation. We compare the magnitudes of these phase differences. Afterwards, we extend the results to the case of dyonic Kerr-Newman spacetime. We discuss the effects of the black hole's magnetic charge and rotation, and propose two gedanken experiments to test the Dirac quantization condition. We also study the case that the universality of gravity breaks down, and show that the deviation from the weak equivalence principle can be determined from the fringe shifts. Additionally, we compare the results in teleparallel gravity with those in general relativity. For a generic weak gravitational field, we show that the gravitational phases in these two theories are consistent at the first order of the gravitational gauge potential but differ at higher orders.

臂锁定中的实时多普勒频率测量与频率牵引抑制

Real-Time Doppler-Frequency Measurement and Frequency-Pulling Suppression in Arm-locking

Zheng-Rong Xiang, Jun Ke, Tian-Chi Zhu, Hao-Xin Xu, Cheng-Gang Shao, Jie Luo · physics.optics, astro-ph.IM, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：臂锁定是空间引力波探测中抑制激光频率噪声的一项重要技术。然而，更强的噪声抑制不可避免地会增大频率牵引的幅度，从而延长锁定捕获时间并增加系统不稳定性风险。针对这一问题，本文提出一种基于线性二次高斯控制器的实时多普勒频率测量与频率牵引抑制方法。为在噪声抑制与牵引抑制之间取得平衡，采用了时变控制策略。在时变控制过程的初始阶段，主要目标是快速限制频率牵引。随后，逐步放宽牵引抑制水平，同时逐步增强激光频率噪声抑制能力，使残余频率噪声在过渡结束时满足时间延迟干涉（TDI）要求。针对若干臂锁定配置进行了全面的性能仿真。结果表明，所提出的抑制器可在约1000秒内减小频率牵引，同时将其幅度限制在100 MHz以下，从而无需传统的多普勒频率预估计阶段。当使用Fabry-Perot激光器时，闭环激光频率噪声的幅度谱密度（ASD）在闭环运行2000秒和9200秒后分别满足第二代和第一代TDI的要求。这些结果表明，所提出的抑制器同时提供了快速的频率牵引抑制和高水平的激光频率噪声抑制。这种新方法为臂锁定的快速捕获与锁定提供了一条可行途径。

English: Arm-locking is an important technique for suppressing laser frequency noise in space-based gravitational-wave detection. However, stronger noise suppression inevitably increases the magnitude of frequency pulling, thereby prolonging the lock-acquisition time and increasing the risk of system instability. To address this issue, this paper proposes a real-time Doppler-frequency measurement and frequency-pulling suppression method based on a linear-quadratic-gaussian controller. To achieve a balance between noise suppression and pulling suppression, a time-varying control strategy is adopted. At the initial stage of the time-varying control process, the primary objective is to rapidly limit frequency pulling. Subsequently, the level of pulling suppression is gradually relaxed while the capability for laser frequency-noise suppression is progressively enhanced, so that the residual frequency noise satisfies the time-delay interferometry (TDI) requirement by the end of the transition. Comprehensive performance simulations are conducted for several arm-locking configurations. The results show that the proposed suppressor can reduce frequency pulling within approximately 1000 s while limiting its magnitude to below 100 MHz, thereby eliminating the need for the conventional Doppler frequency pre-estimation stage. When a Fabry-Perot laser is used, the amplitude spectral density (ASD) of the closed-loop laser frequency noise meets the requirements of second-generation and first-generation TDI after 2000 s and 9200 s of closed-loop operation, respectively. These results demonstrate that the proposed suppressor provides both rapid frequency-pulling suppression and a high level of laser frequency-noise suppression. This new method provide a feasible way for rapid acquisition and locking of arm-locking.

标准汽笛宇宙学中天体物理环境效应导致的偏差

Biases from Astrophysical Environmental Effects in Standard-Siren Cosmology

Ioannis Liodis, Rodrigo Vicente, Soumen Roy, Samaya Nissanke · astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：下一代地基引力波探测器将实现精密标准汽笛宇宙学，使系统误差日益重要。我们研究视线加速度——致密双星在稠密天体物理环境中可能产生——如何偏置哈勃常数 H0 的测量。我们模拟了一个包含 50 个已知宿主红移的双中子星亮汽笛的目录，假设信号受到视线加速度影响，并用真空波形分析它们。未建模的视线加速度会偏置推断的光度距离，并将单个 H0 后验系统性移向较低值。因此，合并事件会使后验在偏置值附近变窄，而不是平均掉系统误差，即使加速度符号随机分配。对于我们的 50 事件目录，在 |a∥|/c=10^{-6} s^{-1} 时约 10% 受影响，或在 |a∥|/c=10^{-7} s^{-1} 时约 30% 受影响，会在至少四分之一实现中产生超过三个后验标准差的偏移。考虑更大目录会进一步提高该效应的显著性。我们的结果表明，环境效应可能成为精密标准汽笛宇宙学的重要系统误差，并应纳入未来族群分析。

English: Next-generation ground based gravitational wave detectors will enable precision standard-siren cosmology, making systematics increasingly important. We investigate how line-of-sight acceleration, as may arise for compact binaries in dense astrophysical environments, biases measurements of the Hubble constant $H_0$. We simulate a catalogue of 50 binary neutron star bright sirens with known host redshifts, assuming the signals have been impacted by line-of-sight acceleration and analysing them with vacuum waveforms. Unmodelled line-of-sight acceleration biases the inferred luminosity distances and shifts the individual $H_0$ posteriors systematically towards lower values. Consequently, combining events narrows the posterior around a biased value rather than averaging away the systematic, even when the acceleration signs are assigned randomly. For our 50-event catalogues, affected fractions of approximately $10\%$ at $|a_\parallel|/c=10^{-6}\,\mathrm{s^{-1}}$, or $30\%$ at $|a_\parallel|/c=10^{-7}\,\mathrm{s^{-1}}$, produce offsets exceeding three posterior standard deviations in at least one quarter of the realisations. Considering larger catalogues further increases the significance of the effect. Our results indicate that environmental effects may constitute an important systematic for precision standard-siren cosmology and should be incorporated into future population analyses.

一句话导读：未建模的视线加速度会系统性偏低地偏置标准汽笛哈勃常数测量，且多事件合并不消除该偏差。

关于非捕获假设下稳态黑洞的刚性

On rigidity of stationary black holes under a nontrapping assumption

Alexandru F. Radu · math.AP, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：我们证明：若不存在与其稳态 Killing 场正交的被困零测地线，则一个光滑、正则、渐近平坦的稳态真空黑洞外部必为非极端 Kerr 外部。我们通过选取一系列区域来延拓局部旋转对称性；其在能层中的极限边界若非空，则是稳态商度量的局部类时光子面。为了在边界无初始正则性假设下得到该几何，我们由非捕获性沿完备旋转轨道导出均匀估计，并利用短零线段上的凸性控制边界。该边界的零测地线可提升为与稳态场正交的时空零测地线。圆性允许它们穿越能层面接触继续延拓，同时稳态投影限制在紧集内，与非捕获性矛盾，从而得到全局轴对称性。

English: We prove that a smooth, regular, asymptotically flat stationary vacuum black hole has a nonextremal Kerr exterior if no null geodesic orthogonal to its stationary Killing field is trapped. We extend the local rotational symmetry by choosing successive domains whose limiting boundary in the ergoregion, if nonempty, is locally a timelike photon surface for the stationary quotient metric. To obtain this geometry without an initial regularity assumption on the boundary, we derive uniform estimates along complete rotational orbits from nontrapping and use convexity along short null segments to control the boundary. Its null geodesics lift to spacetime null geodesics orthogonal to the stationary field. Circularity allows us to continue them through ergosurface contact with stationary projection confined to a compact set, contradicting nontrapping and giving global axisymmetry.

立体引力波探针：活动星系核中双星合并的引力透镜效应

Stereoscopic gravitational-wave probe: Gravitational lensing of a binary merger in active galactic nuclei

Paul Martens, Samson H. W. Leong, Ryan Zhang, Otto A. Hannuksela · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：近期工作表明，如果 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 探测到的致密双星并合中有很大一部分发生在活动星系核（AGN）周围的吸积盘中，那么许多这类 AGN-CBC 系统很可能经历引力透镜，并产生多个引力波“像”，这些像将可被当前或未来引力波探测器探测到。然而，这类透镜“像”产生的波形与其他透镜系统不同，因为双星源在很近的距离上绕 AGN 中心超大质量黑洞运动。本文表明，这些系统会从两个不同视角给出同一双星源的快照。像之间有效视角的差异被编码在它们发射的引力波中，因此引力波探测器可以有效地分析来自两个视角的波形。除了这种“多视角透镜”之外，引力波像还可能因源绕透镜的相对论性轨道运动而产生多普勒频移差异，而靠近透镜会进一步放大该效应。若 AGN 自身角动量可与双星轨道角动量相关联，则整个 AGN-CBC 系统相比典型点质量透镜系统只需增加一个自由参数即可描述；若不采用该假设，则需增加三个自由参数。本文建立了一套变换规则框架，用以描述两个视角中的角度，以及源绕透镜运动产生的多普勒效应。我们还提供了从任何当前可用引力波波形生成自洽 AGN 透镜化波形的框架。这些 AGN-CBC 系统为双星并合提供了两个独特视角，从而打开了不同于任何其他透镜系统的、探究并合性质的新窗口。

English: Recent work has shown that, if a large fraction of the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA compact binary coalescences (CBCs) occur in accretion disks around active galactic nuclei (AGNs), many such AGN-CBC systems will likely experience lensing and produce multiple gravitational-wave (GW) "images" of the CBCs that will become detectable with current or future GW detectors. However, the waveforms produced by such lensed "images" will differ from those produced by other lensing systems because the binary source is orbiting the AGN's central supermassive black hole at a close distance. Here, we show that these systems produce 2 snapshots of the same binary source from 2 different viewing angles. These differences in the effective viewing angle between the images are encoded in the GWs they emit, such that GW detectors can effectively analyse the waveforms from 2 viewpoints. Beyond such "multi-view lensing", the GW images may also differ by their Doppler shift due to the expected relativistic orbital motion of the source around the AGN, an effect which is further amplified by the proximity to the lens. If the AGN's own angular momentum can be related to the binary's orbital angular momentum, we can describe the entire AGN-CBC system using only one additional free parameter compared with a typical point-mass lens system, or with 3 additional parameters when we do not make such an assumption. In this work, we establish a framework of transformation rules that describe both the angles in the 2 points of view, and the Doppler effect that comes from the source's motion around the lens. We also provide the framework to produce consistent AGN-lensed waveforms from any currently available GW waveform. These AGN-CBC systems give 2 unique points of view on a binary merger thus opening up a new window into the merger's properties unlike any other lens system.

地面引力波探测器核心光学杂散光噪声的解析估计与设计要求

Analytical estimates of core optics stray light noise and design requirements for ground based gravitational wave detectors

M. Andr\'es-Carcasona, M. Evans · gr-qc, physics.ins-det · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：我们提出了一个解析框架，将探测器灵敏度转化为地面引力波干涉仪核心光学区域的杂散光要求。我们推导了几个相关散射情形的解析估计，将处理推广到平面挡板集合，并得到被光束收集器拦截的确定性鬼光束的类似要求。该框架旨在在完整光学布局可用之前提供保守的设计要求。我们将其应用于 Cosmic Explorer，展示如何用这些估计推导下一代探测器的要求。所得表达式为当前和未来引力波探测器的杂散光预算和早期设计研究提供了一套紧凑工具。

English: We present an analytical framework to translate detector sensitivity into stray light requirements for the core optics region of ground based gravitational wave interferometers. We derive analytical estimates for several relevant scattering regimes, extend the treatment to collections of planar baffles, and obtain an analogous requirement for deterministic ghost beams intercepted by beam dumps. The framework is intended to provide conservative design requirements before a complete optical layout is available. We apply it to Cosmic Explorer to show how these estimates can be used to derive requirements for next generation detectors. The resulting expressions provide a compact set of tools for stray light budgeting and early design studies in current and future gravitational wave detectors.

Boson Star Factory: Past, Present, and Future

Romain Gervalle, Jorge Filipe M\'onico Delgado, Etevaldo dos Santos Costa Filho, Carlos Herdeiro, V\'ictor Jaramillo, Eugen Radu · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：玻色星是带质量复标量场在 Einstein-Klein-Gordon 方程中的自引力孤子，可以说是广义相对论中出现的最简单的无事件视界致密天体。超越球对称时，其构造需要求解非线性椭圆偏微分方程组；这本身很困难，且各研究组传统上使用各自的数值实现。对不同方法应用于同一物理模型的系统性比较此前一直缺乏。本文对两种最简单的非球对称位形——旋转玻色星和静态偶极玻色星——进行这种比较。我们采用三个独立代码，分别基于有限差分（FIDISOL/CADSOL）、有限元（FreeFem）和谱方法（Kadath），并通过不同诊断量评估其精度。三个求解器在全局可观测量上通常一致到八位有效数字。我们进一步在相同硬件上比较各代码的运行时间，并给出相关物理量的精确基准值，旨在为未来玻色星数值研究提供参考数据。作为进一步的概念验证，我们还展示了使用物理信息神经网络构造旋转 Q-ball 解。

English: Boson stars are self-gravitating solitons of the Einstein-Klein-Gordon equations for a massive complex scalar field, and arguably the simplest horizonless compact objects arising in General Relativity. Beyond spherical symmetry, their construction requires solving a system of nonlinear elliptic partial differential equations, a difficult task per se and that each group has traditionally addressed with its own numerical implementation. A systematic comparison of different methods applied to the same physical model has so far been lacking. In this work, we carry out such a comparison for the two simplest non-spherical configurations: rotating boson stars and static dipolar boson stars. We employ three independent codes, based respectively on finite differences (FIDISOL/CADSOL), finite elements (FreeFem), and spectral methods (Kadath), and assess their accuracy through different diagnostics. The three solvers agree on the global observables to typically eight significant digits. We further compare the runtime of each code on identical hardware and provide precise benchmark values of the relevant physical quantities, intended to serve as reference data for future numerical studies of boson stars. As a further proof of concept, we also present the use of physics-informed neural networks to construct a rotating Q-ball solution.

一句话导读：比较有限差分、有限元和谱方法求解旋转与偶极玻色星，并提供基准数据，另用物理信息神经网络构造旋转 Q-ball。

用 eikonal QNM 约束旋转黑洞的几何

Constraining the geometry of rotating black holes with eikonal QNMs

Ciro De Simone, Sebastian H. V\"olkel, Kostas D. Kokkotas · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：黑洞准正规模是将广义相对论与致密双星并合铃宕阶段引力波观测相对照的核心途径。然而，推断黑洞性质或背景时空需要依赖理论的输入。本文把一种校准的 eikonal 方法（将准正规模频移与光环形附近局部度规性质联系起来）与旋转黑洞度规相连接。利用贝叶斯推断，我们比较了基于全局 Konoplya-Rezzolla-Zhidenko 参数化的度规特定模型，与基于光环形处度规函数局部值及径向导数的度规无关方法。对每个模型，我们进行单参数和多参数同时分析，并量化其先验如何映射到相同的局部量。我们发现，度规特定系数上的均匀先验可对这些局部度规量诱导出强烈非均匀且偏斜的先验。对于与广义相对论一致的注入，两个模型都与 Kerr 一致，并给出相似的轨道频率和 Lyapunov 指数后验，尽管其诱导先验不同。对于代表偏离广义相对论的注入，单参数分析可能无法恢复注入的局部偏离，且在度规特定情形下可能使全局度规重构产生偏差。两个模型的多参数分析给出了一致的约束，表明具有足够稳健性。然而，它们引入显著简并及边缘化参数差异，展示了考虑更灵活模型时的实际局限。最后，我们将该框架应用于 GW250114 铃宕分析的近似后验信息，发现两个模型一般都与广义相对论中的 Kerr 度规一致。

English: Quasinormal modes of black holes provide a central avenue for confronting general relativity with gravitational-wave observations from the ringdown stage of compact binary coalescence. However, inferring black-hole properties or the background spacetime requires theory-dependent input. In this work, we connect a calibrated eikonal method, which relates quasinormal mode shifts to local metric properties near the light ring, with the underlying rotating black hole metric. Using Bayesian inference, we compare a metric-specific model based on the global Konoplya-Rezzolla-Zhidenko parametrization with a metric-agnostic approach based on local values and radial derivatives of the metric functions at the light ring. For each model, we perform both one-parameter and simultaneous multi-parameter analyses and quantify how their priors map onto the same local quantities. We find that uniform priors on the metric-specific coefficients can induce strongly nonuniform and skewed priors on these local metric quantities. For an injection compatible with general relativity, both models remain consistent with Kerr and yield similar posteriors for the orbital frequency and Lyapunov exponent despite their different induced priors. For injections representing deviations from general relativity, one-parameter analyses can fail to recover the injected local deviations and, in the metric-specific case, can bias the global metric reconstruction. The multi-parameter analyses of both models yield consistent constraints, suggesting sufficient robustness. However, they introduce substantial degeneracies and differences in marginalized parameters, demonstrating practical limitations when considering more flexible models. Finally, we apply the framework to approximate posterior information from the ringdown analysis of GW250114 and find that both models are consistent with the Kerr metric in general relativity.

一句话导读：用 eikonal 准正规模结合贝叶斯推断，比较度规特定与度规无关模型对旋转黑洞几何和广义相对论偏离的约束。

引力波是否有助于真三体纠缠的采集？

Do gravitational waves assist the genuine tripartite entanglement harvesting?

Xiang-Yue Yu, Xiao-Li Huang, Shu-Min Wu · gr-qc, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：我们研究了三个线性排列的 Unruh-DeWitt 探测器与引力波背景中无质量标量场局域耦合时，对真三体纠缠的采集。我们表明，引力波在纠缠采集中扮演双重角色：根据系统参数不同，既可以增强也可以抑制采集到的纠缠。特别地，真三体纠缠对引力波频率表现出显著的非单调响应，其特征为相继抑制、类似共振的增强以及再次抑制，并在高频区域趋近其在 Minkowski 时空中的对应值。它对探测器间距的依赖也是非单调的，表现出对应两体纠缠行为中不存在的局部增强峰。因此，与两体纠缠相比，真三体纠缠在频率和空间域中对引力波扰动都表现出更高的敏感性。这些结果暗示，真三体纠缠可能为引力波诱导的时空扰动提供一种敏感的量子探针。

English: We investigate the harvesting of genuine tripartite entanglement by three linearly arranged Unruh-DeWitt detectors locally coupled to a massless scalar field in a gravitational wave background. We show that gravitational waves play a dual role in entanglement harvesting, either enhancing or suppressing the harvested entanglement depending on the system parameters. In particular, genuine tripartite entanglement exhibits a pronounced nonmonotonic response to the gravitational wave frequency, characterized by successive suppression, enhancement resembling resonance, and renewed suppression, while approaching its corresponding value in Minkowski spacetime in the regime of high frequencies. Its dependence on the detector separation is also nonmonotonic, displaying local enhancement peaks that are absent in the corresponding bipartite entanglement behavior. Compared with bipartite entanglement, genuine tripartite entanglement therefore exhibits a higher sensitivity to gravitational wave perturbations in both the frequency and spatial domains. These results suggest that genuine tripartite entanglement may provide a sensitive quantum probe of spacetime perturbations induced by gravitational waves.

一句话导读：三个 Unruh-DeWitt 探测器在引力波背景中的真三体纠缠采集对引力波频率和探测器间距呈非单调响应，并比两体纠缠更敏感。

扩展相空间中的 Symmergent 黑洞 Joule-Thomson 膨胀

Joule Thomson expansion of symmergent black holes in extended phase space

Saheb Soroushfar, Sayyed Mehrab Ramezani · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：我们在扩展相空间形式中研究 Symmergent 黑洞的 Joule-Thomson 膨胀，其中热力学压强被作为独立变量引入。Symmergent 熵包含参数 \hat{\alpha}，它相对于标准形式修改了焓和热力学体积。我们表明，Joule-Thomson 系数仅依赖于组合 8πP r_+^2，导致反转曲线 P_i = (π/2) I_i^2 与 \hat{\alpha} 无关。然而，等焓曲线仍保留对 \hat{\alpha} 的参数依赖，表明 Symmergent 部分影响热力学轨迹但不影响反转边界本身。我们显式推导了反转压强和温度，并将冷却区 P > P_i 与加热区 P < P_i 区分开来。由于正压时有效几何渐近 AdS 型，结果也允许一种全息解读，其中 Joule-Thomson 膨胀对应于对偶场论中的等焓过程。这些结果为 Symmergent 黑洞提供了一个一致的热力学框架，并阐明了 Symmergent 参数在 Joule-Thomson 过程中的作用。

English: We investigate the Joule Thomson expansion of a symmergent black hole within an extended phase-space formalism in which the thermodynamic pressure is introduced as an independent variable. The symmergent entropy contains the parameter alpha-hat, which modifies the enthalpy and thermodynamic volume relative to their standard forms. We show that the Joule Thomson coefficient depends only on the combination 8piP*r_+^2, leading to an inversion curve P_i = (pi/2) * I_i^2 that is independent of alpha-hat. The isenthalpic curves, however, retain a parametric dependence on alpha-hat, indicating that the symmergent sector affects the thermodynamic trajectories but not the inversion boundary itself. The inversion pressure and temperature are derived explicitly, and the cooling regime P > P_i is distinguished from the heating regime P < P_i. Since the effective geometry is asymptotically AdS-like for positive pressure, the results also admit a holographic reading, in which the Joule Thomson expansion corresponds to an isenthalpic process in the dual field theory. The results provide a consistent thermodynamic framework for symmergent black holes and clarify the role of the symmergent parameters in the Joule Thomson process.

一句话导读：研究扩展相空间中 Symmergent 黑洞的 Joule-Thomson 膨胀，发现反转曲线不依赖 Symmergent 参数，而等焓轨迹仍依赖该参数。

通过物质-引力耦合的动态暗能量的一种新颖唯象参数化

A novel phenomenological parametrization of dynamical dark energy via matter-gravity coupling

Hrishikesh Chakrabarty, Daniele Malafarina · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：我们基于带有非最小物质-引力耦合的 Markov-Mukhanov 作用量，为偏离 ΛCDM 模型的一般情形发展了一种新的参数化。在此方法中，宇宙学常数 Λ 和引力耦合 G 变为动力学量，其取值由物质-引力耦合的显式形式决定。我们利用该框架构建了一个简单的唯象模型，其中动态暗能量自然地作为理论在低密度下偏离经典广义相对论的结果而出现。我们展示了如何从观测数据约束该模型的自由参数，并在所提议的形式体系下解释 DESI 合作组的暂定‘phantom crossing’观测。

English: We develop a new parametrization for generic departures from the $\Lambda$CDM model based on the Markov-Mukhanov action with non-minimal matter-gravity coupling. In this approach the cosmological constant $\Lambda$ and the gravitational coupling $G$ become dynamical with their values determined by the explicit form of the matter-gravity coupling. We use the framework to build a simple phenomenological model where dynamical dark energy is naturally obtained as a consequence of the departure of the theory from classical General Relativity at low densities. We show how the model's free parameters can be constrained from observational data and interpret the tentative observations of `phantom crossing' by the DESI collaboration in view of the proposed formalism.

一句话导读：基于 Markov-Mukhanov 非最小物质-引力耦合，提出动态暗能量的唯象参数化，并讨论观测约束与 DESI phantom crossing 解释。

半经典引力中带迹反常的旋转黑洞周围 Novikov-Thorne 吸积盘的特征

Signatures of Novikov-Thorne accretion disks around rotating black holes in semiclassical gravity with trace anomaly

Yuxiang Zuo, Shiyang Hu, Dan Li, Chen Deng, Guansheng He, Wenbin Lin · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：半经典引力通过由耦合参数刻画的量子反作用，为解决黑洞奇点问题提供了一个有前景的框架，因此彻底探索此类天体周围的吸积性质至关重要。本文在具有 A 型迹反常的半经典引力框架下，研究了旋转黑洞周围 Novikov-Thorne 吸积盘在不同参数空间中的热辐射特征，重点关注能流密度、温度分布和热光度。结果表明，耦合参数的引入会抑制盘辐射，导致能流密度和温度的峰值都比广义相对论中的 Kerr 对应体更低，热光度的峰值及相应峰值频率也更低。特别地，当黑洞具有高自旋时，这种差异变得非常显著。机制上，增大耦合参数会增强中心致密天体的有效引力场强，使赤道面上的稳定圆轨道向外移动，并增加轨道物质比能，从而降低辐射效率并削弱整体盘辐射。这种抑制机制提供了一个实用的天体物理窗口，可用于区分半经典引力与广义相对论，并通过热盘谱对耦合参数施加观测约束。

English: Semiclassical gravity provides a promising framework to address the black hole singularity problem through quantum backreaction characterized by a coupling parameter, making it essential to thoroughly explore the accretion properties around such objects. In this paper, within the framework of semiclassical gravity with type-A trace anomaly, we investigate the thermal radiative signatures of Novikov-Thorne accretion disks around rotating black holes across diverse parameter spaces, focusing on the energy flux density, temperature profile, and thermal luminosity. Our findings demonstrate that the introduction of the coupling parameter suppresses disk emission, leading to lower peak values of both energy flux density and temperature, as well as lower peak values and corresponding peak frequencies in thermal luminosity compared to their Kerr counterparts in general relativity. In particular, this discrepancy becomes remarkably pronounced when the black hole possesses a high spin. Mechanistically, increasing the coupling parameter reinforces the effective gravitational field strength of the central compact object, which pushes the equatorial stable circular orbits outward and increases the specific energy of the orbiting matter, thereby reducing the radiative efficiency and weakening the overall disk emission. This suppression mechanism offers a practical astrophysical window to distinguish semiclassical gravity from general relativity and to place observational constraints on the coupling parameter via thermal disk spectra.

一句话导读：在半经典引力 A 型迹反常框架下，旋转黑洞的 Novikov-Thorne 吸积盘辐射被耦合参数抑制，高自旋时与 Kerr 差异显著，可作为区分半经典引力与广义相对论的观测窗口。

局地星际介质中由中子星引力波产生的电磁辐射的特征

Signatures in the local interstellar medium of electromagnetic radiation produced by neutron star gravitational waves

Preston Jones, Pragati Pradhan, Douglas Singleton · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：旅行者号航天器40多年来一直探测到几千赫兹的等离子体振荡。然而，对于这些振荡的天体物理来源，仍没有广泛接受的假说。进入局地星际介质后，这些探测持续存在，增加了识别天体物理来源的挑战。中子星是最早被假设为导致所探测等离子体振荡的电磁辐射候选源之一，但未能找到理论机制来解释振荡频率。我们探索近期发展的引力波背景中电磁辐射协同产生理论，作为这些低频振荡的可能来源，并研究中子星是否可能为天体物理源。

English: The Voyager spacecraft have been detecting plasma oscillations of a few kHz for over 40 years. However, there is still no widely accepted hypothesis for the astrophysical source of the oscillations. Having entered the local interstellar medium, these detections have persisted, adding to the challenge of identifying the astrophysical source. Neutron stars were one of the earliest hypothesized candidates of the electromagnetic radiation responsible for the detected plasma oscillations, but no theoretical mechanism could be identified to explain the frequency of the oscillations. We explore the recently developed theory of co-production of electromagnetic radiation in gravitational wave backgrounds as a possible source of these low-frequency oscillations and investigate whether neutron stars could be the astrophysical source.

一句话导读：探讨中子星引力波背景中协同产生的电磁辐射能否解释旅行者号探测到的千赫兹等离子体振荡。

Hellings-Downs 曲线的最优全角度重建

Optimal all-angle reconstruction of the Hellings-Downs curve

Jing-Hong Han, Zhi-Chao Zhao · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）通过不同脉冲星计时残差之间的空间相关性探测纳赫兹引力波。在广义相对论中，对于各向同性、非偏振的随机背景，系综平均相关性遵循 Hellings--Downs (HD) 曲线；测量该角度图样可检验信号的引力波起源。标准的逐 bin 重建分别优化每个角度 bin 内的权重。我们利用完整的脉冲星对协方差联合重建该曲线，在每个 bin 中保留一个自由振幅。由此得到的全角度最佳线性无偏估计量使每个 bin 值以及每个 bin 线性组合的方差最小。应用于公开的 NANOGrav 15 年数据产品，我们的方法将 bin 标准差最多降低 12.9%，中位降低 9.5%。对于未来类似平方公里阵列天文台（SKAO）的 PTA，预计降低可达 36.4%，中位为 29.6%，从而能够显著更精确地测量引力波背景。

English: Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) detect nanohertz gravitational waves through spatial correlations between the timing residuals of different pulsars. For an isotropic, unpolarized stochastic background in general relativity, the ensemble-mean correlation follows the Hellings--Downs (HD) curve; measuring this angular pattern tests the gravitational-wave origin of the signal. Standard bin-by-bin reconstructions optimize the weights within each angular bin separately. We reconstruct the curve jointly using the full pulsar-pair covariance, retaining a free amplitude in every bin. The resulting all-angle best linear unbiased estimator minimizes the variance of every bin value and every linear combination of bins. Applied to the public NANOGrav 15 yr data products, our method reduces the bin standard deviations by up to 12.9\%, with a median reduction of 9.5\%. For a future Square Kilometre Array Observatory (SKAO)-like PTA, the predicted reduction reaches 36.4\%, with a median of 29.6\%, enabling significantly more precise measurements of the gravitational-wave background.

一句话导读：提出利用完整脉冲星对协方差的全角度联合重建方法，更精确测量 Hellings-Downs 曲线。

被宇宙弦穿过的 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞时空中的零测地线

Null Geodesics in the Reissner-Nordstr\"om Black Hole Spacetime Pierced by a Cosmic String

Tianxu Huo · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：本文研究了被宇宙弦穿过的 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞时空中的零测地线。运动方程分析表明，该圆锥时空中的零测地线可分为三大类，分类完全由比值 |Q|/M 决定，其中 Q 和 M 分别表示黑洞电荷和质量。文章给出了每一类零测地线方程的解析解。基于这些解，作者数值模拟了光线轨迹，并详细分析了黑洞电荷 Q 和宇宙弦参数 α 的影响。结果发现，宇宙弦参数 α 会增强所有三大类零测地线的缠绕行为。最后，文章考虑了赤道面上的光线偏折，并推导了偏折角表达式，表明电荷 Q 会减小偏折角，而宇宙弦参数 α 会增大偏折角。

English: In this paper, we investigate null geodesics in the spacetime of a Reissner-Nordstr\"om black hole pierced by a cosmic string. Analysis of the equations of motion reveals that null geodesics in this conical spacetime can be classified into three main categories, with the classification entirely determined by the ratio $|Q|/M$ (where $Q$ and $M$ denote the black hole charge and mass, respectively). Analytical solutions to the null geodesic equations are obtained for each category. Based on these solutions, we numerically simulate light trajectories and analyze in detail the effects of the black hole charge $Q$ and the cosmic string parameter $\alpha$. It is found that the cosmic string parameter $\alpha$ enhances the winding behavior of null geodesics across all three main categories. Finally, we consider light deflection in the equatorial plane and derive an expression for the deflection angle, revealing that the charge $Q$ decreases the deflection angle, whereas the cosmic string parameter $\alpha$ increases it.

一句话导读：研究被宇宙弦穿过的 RN 黑洞时空中零测地线的分类、解析解与光偏折，发现电荷减小偏折角而弦参数增大偏折角。

能量-动量平方引力：带统一相互作用物质的带电夸克星解

Energy-momentum-squared gravity: charged quark star solutions with unified interacting matter

Ayan Banerjee, Bobur Turimov, Javlon Rayimbaev, Faisal Javed, Gulnoza Palvanova, Sulton Usanov · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：我们在能量-动量平方引力（EMSG）框架下研究带电夸克星的平衡结构，采用统一相互作用夸克物质状态方程，并纳入微扰QCD修正、色超导和有限奇异夸克质量效应。通过在大范围EMSG耦合强度和相互作用参数下求解修改后的Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff方程，我们发现引入电荷会显著提高最大质量和半径。对于强负耦合和显著相互作用强度，星体模型质量可接近3倍太阳质量，紧致度约为0.34，落在GW190814次天体推断质量范围内。电荷使最大质量处的中心密度降低约10%–15%，同时满足因果性要求。与PSR J1614-2230、J0348+0432、J0740+6620、J0952-0607以及近期NICER半径测量等观测约束比较后，带电EMSG位形在广泛参数空间内仍与当前天体物理界限一致。这些结果表明，适度的电荷与非线性物质-几何耦合结合，可以支持比广义相对论预言显著更重的夸克星，凸显了修改引力中带电致密天体的潜在观测意义。

English: We investigate the equilibrium structure of electrically charged quark stars within the framework of energy-momentum-squared gravity (EMSG), adopting a unified interacting quark-matter equation of state that incorporates perturbative QCD corrections, color superconductivity, and finite-strange-quark-mass effects. By solving the modified Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations over a broad range of EMSG coupling strengths and interaction parameters, we show that the inclusion of electric charge substantially increases both the maximum mass and radius compared with neutral configurations. For strong negative couplings and pronounced interaction strengths, the resulting stellar models reach masses close to $3,M_{\odot}$ with compactness ratios of order $0.34$, placing them within the mass range inferred for the secondary component of GW190814, whose nature remains observationally undetermined. The presence of charge reduces the central density at maximum mass by approximately $10$--$15\%$ while maintaining full compliance with causality requirements. Furthermore, comparisons with observational constraints from PSR J1614$-$2230, J0348$+$0432, J0740$+$6620, J0952$-$0607, and recent NICER radius measurements indicate that charged EMSG configurations remain consistent with current astrophysical bounds over a wide parameter space. These results demonstrate that a moderate electric charge, when combined with nonlinear matter-geometry coupling, can support quark stars that are significantly more massive than those predicted in general relativity, underscoring the potential observational relevance of charged compact objects in modified gravity and multimessenger astrophysics.
