黑洞热力学第三定律：量子与经典考量

The third law of black hole thermodynamics: Quantum versus classical considerations

Shahar Hod, Tsvi Piran · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：Kehle 和 Unger 最近表明，在适当条件下，无质量带电经典标量场可以在有限时间内产生一个极端黑洞。该结果似乎违反热力学第三定律（TLT），因为极端黑洞温度为零。然而，由于 TLT 本质上是一条量子原理，对该问题自洽的分析必须考虑量子效应。特别地，我们指出系统的电场可能自发极化真空，从而产生无质量带电对并使黑洞放电。该机制在 |eQ|≥ℏ/2 的区间保证了 TLT 的量子有效性（这里 Q,e 分别表示黑洞和标量场的电荷）。这留下了在更低 |eQ|/ℏ 值下会发生什么的问题。最近 Schneider 推导了一个经典界，表明在 |eQ|≤ℏ/3 的小电荷区间，极端黑洞不能按 Kehle-Unger 的方式形成。他的分析留下了可能存在更强界的可能性。我们在此猜测该界确实可以被加强，使得在 |eQ|<ℏ/2 的区间，经典考量会阻止极端（零温）带电 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞动力学形成，而此时量子极化效应太弱，无法维护 TLT 的有效性。

English: Kehle and Unger have recently shown that, under suitable conditions, a massless charged classical scalar field can produce an extremal black hole in finite time. This result appears to violate the third law of thermodynamics (TLT), since extremal black holes have zero temperature. However, because the TLT is intrinsically a quantum principle, a self-consistent analysis of this problem must account for quantum effects. In particular, we point out that the electric field of the system may spontaneously polarize the vacuum, thereby creating massless charged pairs that will discharge the black hole. This mechanism guarantees the {\it quantum} validity of the TLT in the regime $|eQ|\geq\hbar/2$ (here ${Q,e}$ denote, respectively, the electric charges of the black hole and the scalar field). This leaves open the question of what happens for lower values of $|eQ|/\hbar$. Recently, Schneider derived a classical bound showing that extremal black holes cannot be formed \`a la Kehle-Unger in the small-charge regime $|eQ|\leq\hbar/3$. His analysis leaves open the possibility that a stronger bound may exist. We conjecture here that this bound can indeed be strengthened such that classical considerations would prevent extremal (zero-temperature) charged Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes from forming dynamically in the regime $|eQ|<\hbar/2$, where quantum polarization effects are too weak to preserve the validity of the TLT.

一句话导读：论文讨论无质量带电经典标量场形成极端带电黑洞是否违反黑洞热力学第三定律，指出真空极化可在 |eQ|≥ℏ/2 时通过放电量子地维护第三定律，并猜测在 |eQ|<ℏ/2 时经典效应阻止极端 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞形成。

迈向高自旋全纯零形式扇区的全阶局域性

Towards All-Order Locality in the Higher-Spin Holomorphic Zero-Form Sector

D. A. Valerev · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：本文讨论从 Vasiliev 方程得到的全纯零形式扇区中局域相互作用顶点的构造。我们关注零形式顶点的一个要求，该要求在 arXiv:2208.02004 中曾以限制较少的形式提出；它与旋量自旋局域性一起保证时空自旋局域性。我们推导了全纯一体形式扇区顶点上的充分必要条件，以确保存在满足该要求的全纯零形式顶点。作为具体演示，将所提方案应用于计算自旋局域的全纯 η^2 零形式扇区顶点，这一结果超越了此前仅建立旋量自旋局域性的工作。这些发现为高自旋理论中局域顶点的系统性全阶构造奠定了基础。

English: This work addresses the construction of local interaction vertices in the holomorphic zero-form sector obtained from Vasiliev equations. We focus on a requirement on zero-form vertices, previously proposed in a less restrictive form in arXiv:2208.02004, which, together with spinor spin-locality, guarantees space-time spin-locality. Necessary and sufficient conditions on the holomorphic one-form sector vertices are derived that ensure the existence of holomorphic zero-form vertices satisfying this requirement. As a concrete demonstration, the proposed scheme is applied to compute the spin-local holomorphic $\eta^2$ zero-form sector vertex, a result that goes beyond previous work where only spinor spin-locality was established. These findings lay the groundwork for a systematic all-order construction of local vertices in higher-spin theory.

AdS/CFT 对应中的有限时间多普勒协方差谱学

Finite-Time Doppler Covariance Spectroscopy in the AdS/CFT correspondence

Feiyi Liu, Shiyang Chen, Yang Wang · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：从全息视角，我们建立了一个精确的有限时长协方差框架，用于在 AdS/CFT 对应中分辨手性。在旋转 BTZ 黑洞时空中，两个边界控制之间的相对运动将紧致边界柱面上的和频匹配转化为由标量场角动量标记的离散速度共振。由于完整实控制协方差还包含差频部分，一个双设置正交循环可将其抵消，并从完备半正定协方差矩阵中重构共振对贡献。对于孤立角模，在相反共振速度处重构的配对响应，在半角动量与共同的控制选择频率上采样边界谱。其归一化对比度抵消反射对称的控制因子和态无关的算符归一化，给出内禀浴手性的有限线宽估计量。对于平滑浴谱，由共同中心偶窄化窗口引起的偏差从线宽的二次阶开始，从而将保护扩展到高斯采样之外。显式实投影泄漏界控制了相邻模的污染。使用精确 BTZ 谱的长脉冲计算验证了相位循环重构和二次线宽标度。使用精确截断转移振幅的浴加权计算确立了向该基线的收敛。在默认控制下，前两个非零角模支持从完整角动量求和中的提取，并以亚百分比确定性偏差重构 BTZ 旋转参数。因此，该框架将控制诱导的共振运动学与内禀浴手性分开，并将有限时间协方差数据转化为对旋转 BTZ 黑洞的定量估计。

English: From a holographic perspective, we formulate an exact finite-duration covariance framework that resolves chirality in the AdS/CFT correspondence. In a rotating BTZ black hole spacetime, relative motion between two boundary controls converts sum-frequency matching on the compact boundary cylinder into discrete velocity resonances indexed by the angular momentum of the scalar field. Because the complete real-control covariance also contains difference-frequency sectors, a two-setting quadrature cycle cancels them and reconstructs the resonant pair contribution from complete positive-semidefinite covariance matrices. For an isolated angular mode, reconstructed pair responses at opposite resonance velocities sample the boundary spectrum at opposite angular momentum and a common control-selected frequency. Their normalized contrast cancels reflection-symmetric control factors and the state-independent operator normalization, yielding a finite-linewidth estimator of intrinsic bath chirality. For a smooth bath spectrum, the bias from common centered even narrowing windows begins at quadratic order in linewidth, extending the protection beyond Gaussian sampling. An explicit real-projection leakage bound controls contamination from neighboring modes. Long-pulse calculations with the exact BTZ spectrum verify phase-cycle reconstruction and quadratic linewidth scaling. Bath-weighted calculations with exact truncated transfer amplitudes establish convergence to this baseline. Under the default controls, the first two nonzero angular modes support extraction from the complete angular sum and reconstruct the BTZ rotation parameter with subpercent deterministic bias. The framework thus separates control-induced resonance kinematics from intrinsic bath chirality and converts finite-time covariance data into a quantitative estimate of the rotating BTZ black hole.

一句话导读：提出有限时间多普勒协方差谱学，利用旋转 BTZ 边界控制从全息协方差数据中提取内禀浴手性并重构 BTZ 旋转参数。

ABJM 到 BMN 的双尺度极限：指标与气泡几何

ABJM to BMN in a Double Scale Limit: Indices and Bubbling Geometries

Zhengyuan Du · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：我们研究 U(N)_k × U(N)_{-k} ABJM 理论的双尺度极限，其中 N,k→∞ 且 N/k^2→ν∈(0,∞)，总磁单极荷 q 固定为正。在此极限下，Penrose 几何保留一个有限半径的紧致零圆，磁单极荷 q 的扇区携带 q 单位纵向动量。因此它自然关联于 rank-q BMN 矩阵模型，而 ν 固定其无量纲耦合。我们从引力和超对称指标两方面建立这一关系。在引力侧，我们取 Donos--Simón 半 BPS 几何的 Hopf 商的双尺度极限。携带增长背景通量的圆盘变成一个无限导电平面，而其余有限圆盘复现 Lin--Maldacena 静电问题。它们的量子化通量直接映射到标记 BMN 真空的划分数据。在场论侧，从有限 N、有限 k 的 ABJM 局域化公式出发，我们证明在固定正磁单极荷 q 下，ABJM 超共形指标在横向逸度中逐系数分解为一个普适中性贡献和 rank-q BMN 矩阵模型的精炼 Witten 指标，并带有纵向动量权重。中性贡献正是极限零磁单极荷指标。因此，除以这一普适因子可分离出对所有其超对称真空求和的 BMN 指标。

English: We study a double scale limit of $U(N)_k\times U(N)_{-k}$ ABJM theory, with $N,k\to\infty$ and $N/k^2\to\nu\in(0,\infty)$, at fixed positive total monopole charge $q$. In this limit, the Penrose geometry retains a compact null circle of finite radius, and the sector of monopole charge $q$ carries $q$ units of longitudinal momentum. It is therefore naturally associated with the rank-$q$ BMN matrix model, while $\nu$ fixes its dimensionless coupling. We establish this relation from both gravity and the supersymmetric index. On the gravity side, we take the double scale limit of Hopf quotients of the Donos--Sim\'on half-BPS geometries. The disk carrying the growing background flux becomes an infinite conducting plane, while the remaining finite disks reproduce the Lin--Maldacena electrostatic problem. Their quantized fluxes map directly to the partition data labeling BMN vacua. On the field-theory side, starting from the finite-$N$, finite-$k$ ABJM localization formula, we prove that, at fixed positive monopole charge $q$, the ABJM superconformal index factorizes coefficientwise in the transverse fugacities into a universal neutral contribution and the refined Witten index of the rank-$q$ BMN matrix model, together with the longitudinal momentum weight. The neutral contribution is precisely the limiting zero-monopole-charge index. Dividing by this universal factor therefore isolates the BMN index summed over all its supersymmetric vacua.

一句话导读：在 ABJM 的双尺度极限中，磁单极荷 q 扇区通过引力对偶和超对称指标分解联系到 rank-q BMN 矩阵模型，引力侧对应半 BPS 气泡几何与 Lin-Maldacena 静电问题。

论 Lovelock 引力中 de Sitter 熵与全息纠缠熵的（非）等价性

On the (In)equivalence of de Sitter and Holographic Entanglement Entropies in Lovelock Gravity

Takamasa Kanai · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-22

中文摘要：我们研究高曲率引力及其膜世界实现中 de Sitter 熵与全息纠缠熵之间的关系。利用引力作用量的正则表述和欧几里得引力路径积分，我们推导了 de Sitter 熵，包括来自高曲率表面项的贡献，并将其与由相应熵泛函得到的全息纠缠熵进行比较。我们首先考虑 Gauss-Bonnet 引力，并表明在 RS II 模型的静态渐近 de Sitter 膜世界时空中，两种熵一致，而在稳态时空中通常不同。稳态情形的不一致来自与等时面相关的外曲率贡献，该贡献对静态位形为零，但对稳态几何一般非零。随后我们将分析推广到一般 Lovelock 引力，并表明在 Gauss-Bonnet 情形之外，de Sitter 熵与全息纠缠熵之间的这种一致性对于 RS II 模型中静态渐近 de Sitter 膜世界时空仍然成立。我们还评论说，静态与稳态位形之间的同样区别适用于膜世界黑洞：在静态情形下黑洞熵与全息纠缠熵一致，而对稳态膜世界黑洞两者通常不同。我们的结果阐明了高曲率引力中引力熵与全息熵之间的关系，并为 Lovelock 理论及其膜世界实现中的全息对应提供了更广阔的视角。

English: We investigate the relation between de Sitter entropy and holographic entanglement entropy in higher-curvature gravity and its braneworld realization. Using the canonical formulation of the gravitational action and the Euclidean gravitational path integral, we derive the de Sitter entropy, including contributions from higher-curvature surface terms, and compare it with the holographic entanglement entropy obtained from the corresponding entropy functional. We first consider Gauss-Bonnet gravity and show that the two entropies coincide for static asymptotically de Sitter braneworld spacetimes on the RS II model, while they generally differ for stationary spacetimes. The mismatch in the stationary case arises from an extrinsic-curvature contribution associated with the constant-time surface, which vanishes for static configurations but is generally nonzero for stationary geometries. We then extend the analysis to general Lovelock gravity and show that the agreement between the de Sitter entropy and holographic entanglement entropy persists for static asymptotically de Sitter braneworld spacetimes in the RS II model beyond the Gauss-Bonnet case. We also comment that the same distinction between static and stationary configurations applies to braneworld black holes: the black hole entropy agrees with the holographic entanglement entropy in the static case, while the two generally differ for stationary braneworld black holes. Our results clarify the relation between gravitational and holographic entropies in higher-curvature gravity and provide a broader perspective on holographic correspondence in Lovelock theories and their braneworld realizations.

At $O(a^2)$ the first law persists, but the dilaton source shifts the Stefan-Boltzmann exponent to $p_{\rm eff}=p+a^2/2$, breaking the clean power law $s\propto T_H^p$ while the normalizable dilaton hair decouples from the entropy.

English: To elucidate the meaning of holographic entropy inequalities (beyond subadditivity) which characterize the entanglement structure of geometric states in holography, arXiv:2309.06296 proposed the "tripartite form" for these inequalities, consisting of tripartite information and conditional tripartite information terms with unit coefficients. While this provides a compact and useful packaging of the inequalities, it is not a priori guaranteed that all inequalities can be recast in this form. Here we conjecture that they can, and present substantial evidence, by proving that the two known infinite families of holographic entropy inequalities found in arXiv:2309.15145 can indeed be written in the tripartite form. This is significant because such recasting is particularly nontrivial for these families. Apart from providing the explicit tripartite form expressions for every member of these two infinite families, we detail how we arrived at them, in the process deriving several useful identities which may serve as stepping stones to formulate further repackaging of the corresponding information quantities. We also illustrate the power of the tripartite form by proving a number of structural properties satisfied by any holographic entropy inequality.

中文摘要：致密物质的状态方程（EoS）通常以表格形式给出压强-能量密度关系，这会使数值实现复杂化，并可能损害热力学一致性。在本工作中，我们提出一种分段连续解析形式，具有共同参数化，能够表示广泛类别的致密物质EoS。我们利用CompOSE和LALSimulation库中的表格EoS对该参数化进行了验证。在初步确定性拟合之后，我们采用了两种不同的贝叶斯方法：一种基于通过在拟合EoS上添加噪声生成的合成EoS，另一种基于中子星质量和潮汐形变的多信使测量。在两种方法中，初始最佳拟合参数被用作参考值。对于所考虑从非常软到非常硬的EoS，所得拟合能以足够精度再现库中的表格EoS及相关的宏观中子星可观测量。推断出的参数表现出强相关性，这些相关性源自分段边界处施加的连续性条件。这些相关性在多信使推断下在低密度和中密度段持续存在，但在核心处变弱，反映出当前观测对高密度约束能力有限。单一函数形式能够描述源自不同微观框架的EoS，并且相似参数相关性的重复出现，表明多种致密物质EoS可能共享一个共同的基础结构。

English: Equations of state (EoS) for dense matter are commonly provided in tabulated pressure-energy density relations, complicating numerical implementation and potentially compromising thermodynamic consistency. In this work, we propose a piecewise-continuous analytical form with a common parametrization capable of representing a broad class of dense matter EoSs. We validate this parametrization against tabulated EoSs from the CompOSE and LALSimulation repositories. Following the initial deterministic fitting, we employed two distinct Bayesian approaches: one based on synthetic EoSs generated by adding noise to the fitted EoS and another based on multi-messenger measurements of neutron-star masses and tidal deformabilities. In both approaches, the initial best-fit parameters are used as reference values. For the considered EoSs, spanning from very soft to very stiff, the resulting fits reproduce the tabulated EoSs and the associated macroscopic neutron-star observables in the repositories with sufficient accuracy. The inferred parameters exhibit strong correlations arising from the continuity conditions imposed at the segment boundaries. These correlations persist in the low- and intermediate-density segments under multi-messenger inference but become weak in the core, reflecting the limited constraining power of current observations at high densities. The ability of a single functional form to describe EoSs derived from different microscopic frameworks, together with the recurrence of similar parameter correlations, suggests that diverse dense matter EoSs may share a common underlying structure.

中文摘要：我们综述致密星内部物理的若干方面，重点关注自旋、磁场以及核子超流与超导的微观和宏观表现。费米子的自旋统计使量子简并压决定中子星的稳定性和整体性质，而其结构敏感依赖于稠密物质中重子间的强相互作用。使用基于在等旋对称和饱和密度极限附近展开核能量密度的一般元建模框架，我们强调该展开中各种较少被关注的项如何影响致密星可观测量，并综述对质量、半径和转动惯量的多信使约束。我们考察磁场对稠密物质的影响，表明要在结构中产生显著效应需要极强磁场，而较低磁场就足以影响其超流相。在介观尺度上，超流与超导组分的共存表现为涡旋和磁通管晶格，钉扎和互摩擦过程在中子星转动动力学中起核心作用。我们讨论关于涡旋结构、磁通管构型以及脉冲星glitch和后glitch弛豫起源的未解决问题。我们还简要讨论致密星核心中可能出现的去禁闭夸克相，包括其色超导性质，以及此类相中相关的涡旋结构和磁场响应。

English: We review selected aspects of the interior physics of compact stars, focusing on the microscopic and macroscopic manifestations of spin, magnetic fields, and nucleonic superfluidity and superconductivity. Spin statistics of fermions allow quantum degeneracy pressure to determine the stability and global properties of neutron stars, whose structure depends sensitively on the strong interactions among baryons in dense matter. Using a generic metamodeling framework based on an expansion of the nuclear energy density around the isospin-symmetric and saturation-density limits, we highlight how various lesser-known terms in this expansion affect compact-star observables and review multimessenger constraints on mass, radius, and moment of inertia. The influence of magnetic fields on dense matter is examined, showing that substantial effects in their structure require extremely strong fields, whereas lower fields are sufficient to affect their superfluid phases. At the mesoscopic scale, the coexistence of superfluid and superconducting components features vortex and flux-tube lattices, with pinning and mutual friction processes playing central roles in neutron-star rotational dynamics. We discuss unresolved issues concerning vortex structure, flux-tube configurations, and the origin of pulsar glitches and postglitch relaxation. We also briefly address the possible emergence of deconfined quark phases in compact-star cores, including their color-superconducting properties, as well as the associated vortex structures and magnetic-field responses in such phases.

中文摘要：谱警笛宇宙学利用致密双星并合的引力波观测来限制哈勃常数 H0。该方法把波形给出的光度距离与源框架质量谱族群特征中统计编码的红移信息结合起来。由于探测器测量的是红移后的质量，内禀质量分布中的结构充当内部“标尺”，使推断对族群模型假设敏感。特别是，质量谱的红移演化被广泛视为 H0 测量的潜在系统误差。我们利用 GWTC-4.0 双黑洞目录重新审视谱警笛约束，显式允许标准参数化质量模型的主要质量尺度随红移演化。我们发现当前灵敏度下没有令人信服的演化证据。允许演化会使 H0 后验向较低值产生适度、统计上不显著的移动，我们用有针对性的后验和事件级诊断加以解释。重要的是，相关系统不确定度小于替代的红移无关质量谱描述（如谱特征数目及其函数形式）所引入的不确定度。结果表明，在当前灵敏度下，谱警笛对 H0 的约束在本文探索的灵活性范围内对质量谱红移演化是稳健的。通过注入研究，我们表明当用演化模型分析非演化 underlying population 时，可以重现这一轻微 H0 移动，这与当前信噪比下族群描述过于灵活一致。然而，随着族群特征越来越直接受数据约束，该移动的符号和幅度可能依赖于探测器灵敏度和红移覆盖范围。

English: Spectral-siren cosmology constrains the Hubble constant $H_0$ using gravitational-wave observations of compact-binary coalescences. The method combines luminosity distances inferred from the waveform with redshift information statistically encoded in population features of the source-frame mass spectrum. Because the detector measures redshifted masses, structure in the intrinsic mass distribution acts as an internal ``ruler,'' making the inference sensitive to assumptions about the population model. In particular, redshift evolution of the mass spectrum is widely discussed as a potential systematic for $H_0$ measurements. We revisit spectral-siren constraints with the GWTC-4.0 binary black hole catalog, explicitly allowing the main mass scales of a standard parametric mass model to evolve with redshift. We find no compelling evidence for evolution at current sensitivity. Allowing evolution produces a modest, nonstatistically significant shift of the $H_0$ posterior toward lower values, which we interpret with targeted posterior and event-level diagnostics. Importantly, the associated systematic uncertainty is subdominant to that induced by alternative redshift-independent descriptions of the mass spectrum, such as the number of spectral features and the functional form used to model them. Our results indicate that, at current sensitivity, spectral-siren constraints on $H_0$ are robust to redshift evolution of the mass spectrum within the flexibility explored here. Using injection studies, we show that this mild $H_0$ shift is reproduced when a nonevolving underlying population is analyzed with an evolving model, consistent with an overflexible population description at the present signal-to-noise. The sign and magnitude of the shift can, however, depend on detector sensitivity and redshift reach as the population features become increasingly constrained directly by the data.

Lorentzian Cheeger-Gromov convergence and temporal functions

Sa\'ul Burgos, Jos\'e L. Flores, Miguel S\'anchez · math.DG, gr-qc · v5 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：研究时空 Cheeger-Gromov 收敛背景下的唯一性（至等距）与极限存在性。为处理半黎曼情形中线性等距群的非紧性，将标准的带基点收敛加强为锚定收敛；在洛伦兹情形，这要求一个类时方向的收敛。由此可在基点邻域之间构造局部等距，并且当其中一个极限对某一因果类型的测地线测地完备、而另一个极限不可延拓时，可将其整体延拓；一个 Misner 型例子表明，两个极限都不可延拓并不足够。在时空中，通过把 Cauchy 时间函数同时用作锚的加强和“Wick 旋转”度规的工具，引入了一种针对全局双曲时空（包括带类时边界者）的特殊收敛概念。在回顾与时间函数相关的工具并研究其与 Sormani-Vega 零距离的联系之后，黎曼 Cheeger-Gromov 理论的机器变得可用。特别地，获得若干具有独立兴趣的结果，包括 h-steep 函数的整体与局部刻画、时间函数的 steepness 与 h-steepness 的独立性、Cauchy 时间函数两条件的相容性，以及后者的稳定性。

English: Uniqueness (up to isometries) and existence of limits are studied in the context of Cheeger-Gromov convergence of spacetimes. To address the non-compactness of the linear isometry group in the semi-Riemannian setting, standard pointed convergence is strengthened to anchored convergence, which in the Lorentzian case requires the convergence of a timelike direction. This allows one to construct a local isometry between the neighborhoods of the basepoints, which can be extended globally when one of the limits is geodesically complete for a single causal type of geodesics and the other one is inextensible; a Misner-type example shows that inextensibility of both limits is not enough. In spacetimes, by using Cauchy temporal functions both as a strengthening of the anchors and as a tool to ``Wick rotate'' metrics, a special notion of convergence for globally hyperbolic spacetimes (including those with timelike boundaries) is introduced. After revisiting the tools related to time functions and studying their connections with the Sormani-Vega null distance, the machinery of Riemannian Cheeger-Gromov theory becomes applicable. In particular, several results of independent interest are obtained, including global and local characterizations of $h$-steep functions, independence of steepness and $h$-steepness for temporal functions, compatibility of both conditions for Cauchy temporal functions, and the stability of the latter.

用无碰撞矩和耗散双流体磁流体力学建模广义相对论等离子体

Modeling general-relativistic plasmas with collisionless moments and dissipative two-fluid magnetohydrodynamics

Elias R. Most, Jorge Noronha, Alexander A. Philippov · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc, nucl-th · v3 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：相对论等离子体是黑洞吸积、喷流物理、中子星并合以及致密天体磁层研究的核心。尽管需要准确捕捉这些等离子体的动力学及其对相对论暂现现象的影响，但对它们的流体建模通常采用若干（过度）简化的假设，而这些假设一般并不成立。当等离子体中的平均自由程大于系统尺度、动理学效应开始变得重要时，尤其如此。超越文献中常用方法，我们描述一个完全相对论性协变的、基于14矩的双流体系统，适用于电子-离子或电子-正电子等离子体研究。这个广义的 Israel-Stewart 型运动方程组直接由相对论 Boltzmann-Vlasov 方程得到。关键的是，这一新表述可以计入非理想效应，如各向异性压强和热流。我们表明，相对论性双流体等离子体可重写为一种与电磁场耦合的单流体，并带有（可能很大的）非平衡修正。特别地，我们保留所有电子自由度，为电子温度和动量提供自洽演化方程。本文列出的方程能够刻画黑洞吸积和致密天体周围耀发过程中无碰撞等离子体的完整双流体特性，以及适用于吸积盘内弱碰撞等离子体的类 Braginskii 双流体磁流体力学。这一新表述将有助于构建一大类关于黑洞和中子星周围产生的相对论性暂现现象的下一代模拟。

English: Relativistic plasmas are central to the study of black hole accretion, jet physics, neutron star mergers, and compact object magnetospheres. Despite the need to accurately capture the dynamics of these plasmas and the implications for relativistic transients, their fluid modeling is typically done using a number of (overly) simplifying assumptions, which do not hold in general. This is especially true when the mean free path in the plasma is large compared to the system size, and kinetic effects start to become important. Going beyond common approaches used in the literature, we describe a fully relativistic covariant 14-moment based two-fluid system appropriate for the study of electron-ion or electron-positron plasmas. This generalized Israel-Stewart-like system of equations of motion is obtained directly from the relativistic Boltzmann-Vlasov equation. Crucially, this new formulation can account for non-ideal effects, such as anisotropic pressures and heat fluxes. We show that a relativistic two-fluid plasma can be recast as a single fluid coupled to electromagnetic fields with (potentially large) out-of-equilibrium corrections. In particular, we keep all electron degrees of freedom, which provide self-consistent evolution equations for electron temperature and momentum. The equations outlined in this paper are able to capture the full two-fluid character of collisionless plasmas found in black hole accretion and flaring processes around compact objects, as well Braginskii-like two-fluid magnetohydrodynamics applicable to weakly collisional plasmas inside accretion disks. This new formulation will be instrumental in the construction of a large class of next-generation simulations of relativistic transient phenomena produced around black holes and neutron stars.

E. Maciel · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：在本工作中，我研究了 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet (EGB) 引力中自旋-1/2 粒子的非相对论量子动力学，并建立了高阶曲率修正、费米子动力学与致密天体现象学之间的直接联系。从静态球对称 EGB 时空中的 Dirac 哈密顿量出发，我们执行 Fold-Wouthuysen 变换并推导出有效哈密顿量，其中包括相对论动能、引力、自旋-轨道以及高阶曲率贡献。随后使用 Heisenberg 方程得到速度、力和自旋的动力学，揭示了对平动和自旋输运的显式 EGB 修正。特别地，自旋-轨道部分诱导出一个修正的进动频率，其相对广义相对论的分数偏差按 δΩ = -4(ξ/M²)(M/ρ)³ 标度，给出了 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合的清晰无量纲特征。通过 Ehrenfest 定理，我们还建立了量子算符动力学与其半经典引力极限之间的对应关系。作为一个天体物理应用，我们考虑恒星质量黑洞 A0620-00，并表明自旋进动中预期达到 10⁻³ 至 10⁻⁴ 量级的相对灵敏度可以探测约 10⁶ 至 10⁸ m² 范围内的 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合，具体取决于轨道半径。这一结果将费米子自旋进动认定为检验具高阶曲率修正引力的一个互补通道，并提供了一个连接修正引力动力学与强引力区精密现象学的量子力学框架。

English: In this work, I investigate the non-relativistic quantum dynamics of spin-1/2 particles in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet (EGB) gravity and establish a direct connection between higher-curvature corrections, fermionic dynamics, and the phenomenology of compact objects. Starting from the Dirac Hamiltonian in a static, spherically symmetric EGB spacetime, we perform a Fold-Wouthuysen transformation and derive the effective Hamiltonian, including relativistic kinetic, gravitational, spin-orbit, and higher-curvature contributions. Heisenberg equations are then used to obtain the dynamics of velocity, force, and spin, revealing explicit EGB corrections for both translational motion and spin transport. In particular, the spin-orbit sector induces a modified precession frequency whose fractional deviation from general relativity scales as $\delta_{\Omega}=-4(\xi/M^{2})(M/\rho)^{3}$, providing a clear dimensionless signature of the Gauss-Bonnet coupling. Through Ehrenfest's theorem, we also establish the correspondence between the dynamics of quantum operators and their semiclassical gravitational limit. As an astrophysical application, we consider the stellar-mass black hole A0620-00 and show that prospective relative sensitivities in spin precession on the order of $10^{-3}$ to $10^{-4}$ can probe Gauss-Bonnet couplings in the range of approximately $10^{6}$ to $10^{8}\,{\rm m}^{2}$, depending on the orbital radius. This result identifies fermionic spin precession as a complementary channel for testing gravity with higher-curvature corrections and provides a quantum-mechanical framework connecting modified gravitational dynamics to precision phenomenology in strong-gravity regimes.

一句话导读：在 EGB 引力中对自旋-1/2 粒子作非相对论展开，导出修正自旋进动并给出黑洞 A0620-00 的探测灵敏度。

双星系统中未知中子星的宽参数空间 O3 连续引力波搜索

Wide parameter-space O3 search for continuous gravitational waves from unknown neutron stars in binary systems

P. B. Covas, M. A. Papa, R. Prix · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v2 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：连续引力波，即非对称自转中子星发出的持续且近乎单色的信号，至今仍未被探测到。对未知双星系统中这类信号的搜索在计算上最具挑战性，但它们至关重要，因为双星吸积提供了产生所需非对称性的自然机制，而且已知自转频率高于 25 Hz 的脉冲星中约有一半位于双星系统中。本文报告了对一大片未探索参数空间区域的搜索：我们首次覆盖了 520 Hz 以上的引力波频率（搜索频段为 50 至 1000 Hz），并且首次用先进探测器探索了短于 3 天的轨道周期。未探测到信号，我们给出了迄今对这类信号振幅最严格的限制。我们的结果以 95% 置信度排除了距离 100 pc 以内、自转快于约 495 Hz 的中子星具有高于 5.2×10^{-8} 的椭率。在同一距离内，我们的结果还排除了自转快于约 740 Hz 的星体具有高于 1.5×10^{-6} 的 r 模振幅。

English: Continuous gravitational waves, i.e., persistent and nearly-monochromatic signals emitted by asymmetric spinning neutron stars, remain elusive. Searches for these signals from unknown binary systems are the most computationally challenging, but they are essential, given that binary accretion provides a natural mechanism for creating the required asymmetry, and around half of the known pulsars rotating above 25 Hz are part of a binary system. Here we report on a search of a large uncharted parameter-space region: for the first time we cover gravitational-wave frequencies above 520 Hz (from 50 to 1000 Hz), and, for the first time with advanced detectors, orbital periods lower than 3 days are explored. No signal is detected, and we set the most stringent constraints to date on the amplitude of signals of this kind. Our results exclude with $95\%$ confidence neutron stars within 100 pc and rotating faster than $\sim$ 495 Hz from having ellipticities above $5.2 \times 10^{-8}$. Within the same distance our results also exclude r-mode amplitudes above $1.5 \times 10^{-6}$ for stars rotating faster than $\sim$ 740 Hz.

一句话导读：O3 数据首次在 50–1000 Hz 和轨道周期小于 3 天的大参数空间搜索未知双星中子星连续引力波，未探测到信号并给出迄今最严格的椭率与 r 模限制。

时间延迟作为多光子球的探针

Time delay as a probe of multiple photon spheres

Kajol Paithankar, Sanved Kolekar · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：黑洞阴影图像主要由光子球性质决定，并且在不同球对称时空几何之间可能出现简并。我们表明，瞬变源高阶像对应的时间延迟观测量，为在允许多个光子球的时空中打破这种简并提供了稳健探针。采用一个与理论无关、参数化、静态球对称的框架，该框架捕捉双峰有效势的一般特征，我们研究光子测地线，并用角偏转、旅行时间和像的阶数量化它们。我们识别出探测两个不稳定光子球之间区域的轨迹的独特特征。特别地，我们发现这些轨迹具有非平凡的时间行为，包括最小旅行时间、最小角偏转，以及高阶像具有特定到达顺序的特征性三重态结构。我们进一步表明，两个光子球之间势阱深度对观测时间延迟的影响，为探测原本不可及的时空区域提供了直接手段。尽管我们考虑的是参数化框架，这些识别出的特征主要受势结构影响，因此会出现在任何具有类似双峰有效势的时空中。我们的结果强调，时域透镜观测量编码了静态阴影图像之外的信息，并为探测致密天体结构和引力强场区域提供了有前景的途径。

English: Black hole shadow images are primarily determined by the properties of photon spheres and can exhibit degeneracies across different spherically symmetric spacetime geometries. We show that time delay observables associated with higher-order images of transient sources provide a robust probe to break such degeneracies in spacetimes admitting multiple photon spheres. Adopting a theory-agnostic, parametrized, static, spherically symmetric framework that captures the generic features of double-peak effective potentials, we investigate photon geodesics and quantify them in terms of angular deflection, travel time, and the order of the image. We identify distinctive signatures of trajectories probing the region between the unstable photon spheres. In particular, we find that these trajectories are characterized by the nontrivial temporal behavior, including a minimum travel time, a minimum angular deflection, and a characteristic triplet structure of higher-order images with a specific arrival sequence. We further show that the influence of the depth of the potential well, between the two photon spheres, on the observed time delays provides a direct handle on otherwise inaccessible regions of the spacetime. Although we consider a parametrized framework, these identified signatures are primarily influenced by the potential structure and will therefore occur in any spacetime with a similar double-peak effective potential. Our results highlight that time-domain lensing observables encode information beyond static shadow images and offer a promising avenue for probing the structure of compact objects and the strong-field regime of gravity.

一句话导读：时间延迟可打破多光子球时空的黑洞阴影简并，并揭示双峰有效势之间的光子轨迹特征。

引力磁偶极子时空中的光线偏折

Light deflection in the gravimagnetic dipole spacetime

Cl\'ementine Dassy, Jan Govaerts · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：引力磁偶极子是爱因斯坦广义相对论的一个渐近平坦、稳态、轴对称真空解，描述两个质量相等、NUT 荷相反、由 Misner 弦连接的非极端黑洞。通过相应选择黑洞间距，可将弦张力设为零，从而得到一个稳定、以固定距离彼此反向旋转的黑洞系统。对无质量粒子测地线的数值模拟揭示了赤道面或竖直轴上来自无穷远延展源的引力透镜效应。

English: The gravimagnetic dipole is an asymptotically flat, stationary, axisymmetric vacuum solution to Einstein's General Relativity describing two non-extreme black holes with equal masses and opposite NUT charges connected by a Misner string. The string tension's can be set to zero by choosing the black hole separation accordingly, yielding a stable system of oppositely rotating black holes at a fixed distance. Numerical simulations of massless particle geodesics reveal gravitational lensing effects for extended sources at infinity on the equatorial plane or on the vertical axis.

一句话导读：研究引力磁偶极子精确解中无质量粒子测地线与引力透镜，并讨论通过选取间距消除 Misner 弦张力的稳定双黑洞构型。

利用LISA在暗物质环境中的EMRI测量中子星状态方程

Measuring the neutron star equation of state from EMRIs in dark matter environments with LISA

Theophanes K. Karydas, Gianfranco Bertone · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.HE, hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：在真空中的极端质量比旋进（EMRI）引力波观测在很大程度上对小型致密伴星的内部结构不敏感。我们表明，当中心黑洞被致密暗物质环境包围时，这一结论可能改变。我们首次计算了中子星在无碰撞介质中运动时受到相对论动力学摩擦力，以及它对嵌入致密暗物质尖峰中的EMRI演化的影响。随后，我们对模拟LISA观测进行贝叶斯参数估计分析，以评估暗物质尖峰性质和伴星内部结构的可测量性。我们发现，在我们的基准暗物质尖峰模型中，信噪比（SNR）≳120 的 EMRI 已能够区分中子星伴星和黑洞伴星。在可比的信噪比下，不同中子星状态方程之间的区分开始显现，并在高信噪比端变得显著更强。

English: Gravitational-wave observations of extreme mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) in vacuum are largely insensitive to the internal structure of the small compact companion. We show that this conclusion can change when the central black hole is surrounded by a dense dark matter environment. We compute, for the first time, the relativistic dynamical-friction force on a neutron star moving through a collisionless medium and its impact on the evolution of EMRIs embedded in dense dark matter spikes. We then perform a Bayesian parameter-estimation analysis of simulated LISA observations to assess the measurability of both spike properties and the companion's internal structure.We find that, in our fiducial dark matter spike models, EMRIs with signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) $\gtrsim 120$ can already distinguish neutron star from black hole companions. At comparable signal-to-noise ratios, discrimination among neutron star equations of state begins to emerge and becomes significantly stronger toward the high-SNR tail.

一句话导读：在含暗物质尖峰的EMRI中，相对论动力学摩擦使LISA观测能够区分中子星与黑洞伴星，并开始测量中子星状态方程。

非线性因果的广义相对论双流体耗散磁流体力学

Nonlinearly Causal General-Relativistic Two-Fluid Dissipative Magnetohydrodynamics

Elias R. Most, Samuel J. Dunham · astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM, gr-qc, nucl-th, physics.plasm-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：我们提出广义相对论（GR）19矩耗散磁流体力学（MHD）的一种表述，能够处理GR天体物理双流体等离子体中的所有一阶耗散项（黏滞、热导、电阻率和霍尔项），以及所有理想电子自由度（数密度、动量和能量）。我们推导了约束一阶19矩系统的必要且充分的非线性因果性条件，以及强双曲性的必要且充分条件。为对该表述进行数值评估，我们发展了高分辨率激波捕获格式，以性能可移植的方式求解这些方程。该格式将所有演化方程，包括耗散和电子部分，写成通量-散度形式，使我们能在网格上不处处解析动理学尺度的情况下模拟尺度相差数量级的系统。此外，我们使用隐式积分方法在MHD区域系统性地跨越动理学尺度，如回旋频率和等离子体频率。为使格式像GRMHD代码一样稳健，我们构造了守恒态物理可容许性的必要且充分条件，并基于此构造了一种新的物理性强制方案。作为精确验证比较，我们建立并推导了广义相对论中耗散双流体Bondi吸积的完整解。随后，我们针对黑洞吸积和磁层动力学的动理学PIC模型的一系列结果验证了方程，表明我们的表述和格式能够正确捕捉这些解在全局尺度上反馈相关的主要特征，包括约0.1的无量纲重联率和类Braginskii各向异性压强与热流。

English: We present a formulation of general-relativistic (GR) 19-moment dissipative magnetohydrodynamics (MHD), capable of handling all first-order dissipative terms (viscosity, heat conductivity, resistivity and Hall terms), as well as all ideal electron degrees of freedom (number density, momentum and energy) in a GR astrophysical two-fluid plasma. We derive necessary and sufficient nonlinear causality conditions for the constrained first-order 19-moment system, as well as both necessary and sufficient conditions for strong hyperbolicity. To assess the formulation numerically, we develop a high-resolution shock-capturing scheme that solves these equations in a performance-portable fashion. The scheme expresses all evolution equations, including the dissipative and electron sectors, in flux-divergence form, allowing us to model systems with scales separated by orders of magnitude without resolving kinetic scales everywhere on the grid. In addition, we use implicit integration methods to systematically overstep kinetic scales in MHD regions, such as cyclotron and plasma frequencies. To make the scheme as robust as GRMHD codes, we construct necessary and sufficient conditions for a conserved state to be physically admissible, and based on these construct a new physicality-enforcement scheme. As an exact validation comparison, we formulate and derive a full solution to dissipative two-fluid Bondi accretion in general relativity. We then validate the equations against a series of results from kinetic particle-in-cell models of black hole accretion and magnetospheric dynamics, demonstrating that our formulation and scheme can correctly capture major features relevant for feedback on global scales of these solutions, including dimensionless reconnection rates of order $0.1$ and Braginskii-like anisotropic pressures and heat fluxes.

一句话导读：建立广义相对论19矩耗散双流体磁流体力学，给出非线性因果性与强双曲性条件，并发展数值格式及验证。

结合天体测量与脉冲星计时：首次对甚低频引力波的联合分析

Combining astrometry with pulsar timing: the first joint analysis of very low frequency gravitational waves

Lorenzo Filipello, William Beordo, Volodymyr Akhmetov, Mariateresa Crosta, Mario Gilberto Lattanzi · astro-ph.IM, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：pHz 至亚 nHz 的引力波频段在很大程度上仍未被探索，但它对于描绘超大质量双黑洞（SMBHB）早期旋进阶段和探测早期宇宙物理至关重要。天体测量与脉冲星计时提供了正交且高度互补的长期观测量，可用于研究该频段。我们旨在给出首次将真实天体测量自行与双脉冲星计时相结合的联合数据分析，以搜寻并限制由 SMBHB 产生的超低频连续引力波（CWs，10^{-12}≤f_GW≤10^{-9} Hz）。我们采用贝叶斯模型选择与上限估计框架，将 Gaia CRF3 星表中约 1.5×10^6 个类星体的视自行位移与 11 颗高精度双脉冲星的视线轨道周期导数（\dot{P}_b）结合起来。为防止虚假探测，我们大量建模仪器和天体物理系统误差：通过蒙特卡洛模拟传播脉冲星的银河系势不确定性，并对类星体进行直到八极阶（l=3）的矢量球谐（VSH）分解。我们在联合分析中未发现连续引力波信号的统计显著证据（ln B_joint=-0.42±0.03）。在未探测到信号的情况下，我们给出了迄今对 pHz 频段连续引力波应变的最严格限制，在参考频率 f_ref=4×10^{-10} Hz 处 95% 上限为 h_0≤6.4×10^{-11}。联合数据集实现了全天覆盖，并将单数据集上限改进了 20%-30%。结合正交观测量成功打破了单独搜寻中固有的空间简并。此外，注入-回收（inj.-rec.）预报表明，随着即将到来的 Gaia DR4 具有更长的时间基线和更小的不确定性，该联合框架有望突破亚 nHz 连续引力波的 h_0<10^{-11} 上限壁垒。

English: The pHz to sub-nHz GW regime remains largely unexplored but is crucial for mapping the early inspiral stage of SMBHBs and probing early-Universe physics. Astrometry and pulsar timing offer orthogonal and deeply complementary secular observables to investigate this frequency band. We aim to present the first joint data analysis combining real astrometric proper motions with binary pulsar timing, to search for and constrain continuous gravitational waves (CWs) sourced by SMBHBs in the ultra-low-frequency regime ($10^{-12} \le f_{GW} \le10^{-9} Hz$). We employ a Bayesian model selection and upper limit estimation framework to combine apparent proper motion displacements of $\sim 1.5 \times 10^6$ quasars from the Gaia CRF3 catalog with the line-of-sight orbital period derivatives ($\dot{P}_b$) of 11 high-precision binary pulsars. To prevent spurious detections, we heavily model instrumental and astrophysical systematics: we propagate the Galactic potential uncertainty for pulsars via Monte Carlo simulations and perform a Vector Spherical Harmonics (VSH) decomposition up to the octupole order (l=3) for quasars. We find no statistically significant evidence for a CWs signal in the joint analysis ($\ln B_{joint} = -0.42 \pm 0.03$). In the absence of detection, we set the tightest constraints to date on CW strain in the pHz band, yielding a 95% upper limit of $h_0\le6.4x10^{-11}$ at a reference frequency of $f_{ref} = 4 \times 10^{-10}$ Hz. The combined dataset achieves full sky coverage and improves single-dataset upper limits by 20%-30%. Combining orthogonal observables successfully breaks spatial degeneracies intrinsic to isolated searches. Furthermore, forecasts from inj.-rec. indicate that with the extended temporal baseline and reduced uncertainties of the upcoming Gaia DR4, this joint framework is poised to break the $h_0 < 10^{-11}$ upper limit barrier for sub-nHz CWs.

一句话导读：首次联合 Gaia 类星体天体测量与脉冲星计时，在 pHz 波段未发现连续引力波并给出迄今最严格上限。

关于振荡子的注记：预加热期间不可忽略的度规涨落

A note on oscillons: non-negligible metric fluctuations during preheating

Daniel del-Corral, Paolo Gondolo, K. Sravan Kumar, Jo\~ao Marto · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：后暴胀预加热与振荡子形成的主流格点方法是在空间均匀的 Friedmann-Lemaître-Robertson-Walker 背景上演化非均匀暴胀子场；该背景的膨胀由体积平均能量密度驱动，而度规微扰被忽略。我们检验该近似与广义相对论的一致性。利用线性化 Einstein 约束，我们表明，慢滚暴胀中 Bardeen 势被抑制的特征在预加热期间消失：一旦第一慢滚参数达到 1 的量级，度规与暴胀子涨落进入同一微扰阶。我们进一步表明，固定 FLRW 方案中演化的标量场方程遗漏了由度规涨落产生的领头阶贡献。随后我们推导 ADM Hamilton 约束的固有体积平均，并表明它并不约化为格点模拟中所用的 Friedmann 方程：精确平均约束包含来自空间曲率、局域膨胀的方差、剪切以及度规对局域能量密度修正的额外贡献。最后，我们针对 Starobinsky 和 α-attractor 模型数值展示，在放大阶段度规贡献与标量场贡献相当。这些结果直接影响振荡子形成的标准格点描述，并促使将数值相对论作为非线性预加热问题的一致框架。

English: The dominant lattice approach to post-inflationary preheating and oscillon formation evolves an inhomogeneous inflaton field on a spatially homogeneous Friedmann-Lema\^itre-Robertson-Walker background, whose expansion is sourced by a volume-averaged energy density, while metric perturbations are neglected. We examine the consistency of this approximation with General Relativity. Using the linearized Einstein constraints, we show that the suppression of the Bardeen potential, characteristic of slow-roll inflation, disappears during preheating: once the first slow-roll parameter becomes of order unity, the metric and inflaton fluctuations enter at the same perturbative order. We further show that the scalar-field equation evolved in the fixed-FLRW prescription omits leading-order contributions generated by metric fluctuations. We then derive the proper-volume average of the ADM Hamiltonian constraint and show that it does not reduce to the Friedmann equation used in lattice simulations: the exact averaged constraint contains additional contributions from the spatial curvature, the variance of the local expansion, the shear, and metric corrections to the local energy density. Finally, we illustrate numerically, for Starobinsky and $\alpha$-attractor models, that the metric contribution becomes comparable to the scalar-field contribution during the amplification stage. These results directly affect the standard lattice description of oscillon formation and motivate numerical relativity as a consistent framework for the nonlinear preheating problem.

一句话导读：预加热/振荡子格点模拟若忽略度规涨落，会遗漏与标量场同阶的领头贡献，需用数值相对论处理。

旋转中子星迁移作为3+1数值相对论的标准化检验

Rotating Neutron Star Migrations as a Standardized Test for 3+1 Numerical Relativity

\'Oscar H. Petit, Jos\'e A. Font, Nikolaos Stergioulas · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：在模拟动力学不稳定的中子星时，截断误差会引入扰动，促使星体构型要么引力坍缩成黑洞，要么迁移到动力学稳定的低密度构型。对于球对称中子星模型，这一机制已成为验证广义相对论流体力学代码的标准基准。在本工作中，我们将分析推广到在三维空间中演化的均匀旋转中子星这一更一般情形。我们使用两种状态方程研究这些转变：冷多方状态方程和混合状态方程方案，从而区分正压响应与激波产生的热压效应。我们发现迁移后的残余星体在转变后仍接近均匀旋转，并通过中心密度、旋转剖面和轴对称引力波通道等互补诊断追踪其准径向脉动。我们研究这些转变的性质，并提出一个标准化检验，要求迁移行为与本文报告的动力学一致，以用于验证数值相对论代码。

English: When simulating dynamically unstable neutron stars, truncation errors can introduce perturbations that drive the stellar configuration either toward gravitational collapse into a black hole or toward migration to a dynamically stable, lower-density configuration. This mechanism has become a standard benchmark for validating general-relativistic hydrodynamics codes in the case of spherically symmetric neutron-star models. In this work, we extend the analysis to the more general case of uniformly rotating neutron stars evolved in three spatial dimensions. We investigate these transitions using two equations of state: a cold polytrope and a hybrid prescription, which allow us to distinguish the barotropic response from the effects of shock-generated thermal pressure. We find that the migrated remnant remains close to uniform rotation after the transition, and we trace its quasi-radial pulsations through complementary diagnostics involving the central density, the rotation profile, and the axisymmetric gravitational-wave channel. We investigate the properties of these transitions and propose a standardized test for validating numerical-relativity codes by requiring the migration behavior to be consistent with the dynamics reported here.

一句话导读：将旋转中子星向稳定低密度态的迁移行为扩展为3+1数值相对论的标准化检验。

暗能量混合中子星的结构与天体物理性质

Structure and astrophysical properties of dark energy admixed neutron stars

Juan M. Z. Pretel, Sergio B. Duarte, Mariana Dutra, Odilon Louren\c{c}o · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, nucl-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：由 Chaplygin 暗流体构成的暗能量（DE）核心能够影响中子星（NSs）的各种可观测性质。然而，中子星也有可能包含普通核物质与暗能量的混合物。在此视角下，我们提出一个同时包含普通物质和暗能量的状态方程（EoS），其中自由参数 f 量化暗能量密度占总能量密度的比例。正如预期，在 f → 0 的极限下，我们恢复与纯核物质对应的已知结果。值得注意的是，增大该比例 f 会导致更软的状态方程，从而强烈有利于满足因果性条件。根据我们的质量—半径结果，HESS J1731-347 中的中心致密天体可以被满意地描述为一颗暗能量混合中子星。对于足够高的恒星质量，我们的计算进一步表明，随着暗能量比例增加，引力红移和基本非径向振荡频率都显著增大，而总引力质量和潮汐形变则呈现相反趋势。正如纯普通物质组成的致密星的典型情况，我们发现在我们的暗能量混合恒星模型中，最大质量构型对应的中心密度与径向振动频率平方消失的点重合。此外，更高的暗能量浓度导致这些构型稳定性增强。

English: The presence of a dark energy (DE) core, made of a Chaplygin dark fluid, is capable of influencing the diverse observable properties of neutron stars (NSs). However, there is also the possibility that NSs could contain a mixture of ordinary nuclear matter and DE. In this perspective, we propose an equation of state (EoS) that includes both normal matter and DE, where a free parameter $f$ quantifies the ratio of DE density with respect to the total energy density. As expected, in the limit $f \rightarrow 0$ we recover the already known results corresponding to pure nuclear matter. Remarkably, increasing this fraction $f$ leads to a softer EoS and thus strongly favors the fulfillment of the causality condition. As a consequence of our mass--radius results, the central compact object in HESS J1731-347 can be satisfactorily described as a DE admixed NS. For sufficiently high stellar masses, our calculations further indicate that both the gravitational redshift and the fundamental nonradial oscillation frequency increase significantly with an increasing DE fraction, whereas the opposite trend is observed for the total gravitational mass and tidal deformability. As is typical for compact stars composed purely of ordinary matter, we find that in our DE admixed stellar models the central density corresponding to the maximum-mass configuration coincides with the point at which the squared radial vibration frequency vanishes. Moreover, higher DE concentrations lead to enhanced stability of these configurations.

一句话导读：提出含 Chaplygin 暗流体的暗能量—核物质混合状态方程，计算中子星质量半径、潮汐形变与振荡性质，并讨论 HESS J1731-347 的暗能量混合中子星解释。

相关度：medium — 论文为经典引力/致密星物理，研究暗能量混合中子星的状态方程与可观测性质；与全息无关，但与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论相关。

重新审视纠缠相对论引力框架

Revisiting the Entangled Relativity gravity framework

Bertrand Chauvineau · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：本文重新审视纠缠相对论理论框架，并将其嵌入一个更大的理论集合中。通过它们的标量-张量重构，这些理论在物质满足“内禀解耦”条件时，允许广义相对论时空解作为具有相同物质内容的解。文章表明，满足该条件的一组物质拉格朗日量完全由它们对度规张量的依赖方式刻画。随后表明，可以定义一个满足内禀解耦条件至1PN阶的理想流体拉格朗日量。具体到弱场球对称恒星，结果表明纠缠相对论及其提出的推广是广义相对论的有价值替代方案。事实上，所得到的Eddington参数数值突然满足已知观测约束。然而，该理论对守恒律的非严格遵循要求重新考虑观测数据与参数之间的联系，以最终澄清这一点。

English: One revisits the Entangled Relativity theory framework, embedding it in a larger set of theories. From their scalar-tensor reformulation, these theories admit General Relativity spacetime solutions as solutions with the same matter content, if this matter obeys an "intrinsic decoupling" condition. One shows that a set of matter Lagrangians satisfying this condition is completely characterized by the way they depend on the metric tensor. One then shows that it is possible to define a perfect fluid Lagrangian fulfilling the intrinsic decoupling condition up to 1PN order. Specifying to weak field spherical stars suggests that Entangled Relativity and its proposed generalization are worthy alternatives to General Relativity. Indeed, the obtained numerical values of the Eddington parameters abruptly satisfy the known observational constraints. However, the non strict compliance of the theory with conservation laws demands to reconsider the link between observational data and the parameters for a definitive clarification of this point.

一句话导读：重新审视纠缠相对论，将其嵌入标量-张量理论集合，并研究弱场球对称恒星与Eddington参数观测约束。

紧凑天体质量壳模型中的非保守力学及其波形结构

Non-Conservative Mechanics in the Compact-Body Mass-Shell Model and its Waveform Structuring

Noah M. MacKay · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：此前曾考虑对紧凑双星并合的有效单体（EOB）映射作一种新解释。不同于传统 EOB 的“漏斗中的弹珠”描述，这里将紧凑双星并合建模为一个具有恒定约化质量测度的空心壳的同步旋转与收缩。因此，当壳半径达到总质量半径时并合发生。既往工作分析了该模型的能量部分以及辐射的引力波（GW），本工作考虑几何波形建模方面。更具体地，我们通过引入必要的非保守力学，使最初在玩具模型条件下讨论的质量壳波形分析趋于成熟，从而得到可用的质量壳建模引力波波形的解析表达式。这是为最终的计算工作奠定基础，以便将这里给出的解析波形与当前及最先进的模型进行比较。

English: A novel reinterpretation on the effective one-body (EOB) mapping of compact-body binary (CBB) coalescence was previously considered. Instead of the conventional ``marble in a funnel" description of EOB, CBB coalescence is modeled as the concurrent rotation and contraction of a hollow shell with a constant reduced mass measure. Merger is achieved, therefore, when the shell radius reaches the total mass radius. While past works analyzed the energetics sector of the model and the radiated gravitational waves (GWs), this work considers the geometric waveform modeling aspect. More specifically, we mature the mass-shell waveform analysis initially discussed with toy-model conditions by imposing necessary non-conservative mechanics, leading to the analytical expression of usable mass-shell modeled GW-forms. This is to set the foundation for eventual computational endeavors with the analytical waveforms presented here, enabling a comparison against current and state-of-the-art models.

一句话导读：在紧凑双星并合的质量壳EOB模型中引入非保守力学，推导可用的解析引力波波形。

f(R,T) 引力中的慢转虫洞：粒子动力学与弱场透镜效应

Slowly Rotating Wormholes in f(R,T) Gravity: Particle Dynamics and Weak-field Lensing

M. Sharif, Tayyab Naseer, Rida Batool · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：在所有引力解中，可穿越虫洞尤为引人注目，但在广义相对论中，它们几乎总是需要违反零能量条件的奇异物质。在修改引力理论中引入物质-几何耦合，提供了一个可行平台，使虫洞可由有效引力场支撑而保持开放。因此，我们利用 f(R,T) 框架考察慢转可穿越虫洞的结构与性质。我们构建了与各向异性流体耦合的静态虫洞模型，并表明它们是正则的、无事件视界、在大距离上趋近平直时空几何，并在喉部满足 flare-out 要求。我们的结果表明，所需物质满足零能量条件和强能量条件，说明转动虫洞不一定需要非常规源。我们进一步研究了粒子轨迹、参考系拖曳现象、由物质-几何耦合导致的非测地行为，以及转动引起的弱场和透镜效应。我们的结果确立了 f(R,T) 引力中转动虫洞在天体物理上的潜在可行性。

English: Among all gravitational solutions, traversable wormholes stand out as truly fascinating, yet within general relativity, they almost always demand exotic matter that necessarily violate null energy requirement. The inclusion of matter-geometry coupling in modified gravity theories provides a viable platform where wormholes remain open which are supported by effective gravitational field. We therefore examine the structure and properties of slowly rotating traversable wormholes using the $f(R,T)$ framework. We formulate stationary wormhole models coupled with the anisotropic fluid and show that they are regular, horizon-free, approach a flat spacetime geometry at large distances, and satisfy the flare-out requirement at the throat. Our results indicate that the required matter meets both the null and strong energy conditions, demonstrating that rotating wormholes do not necessarily require unconventional sources. We further study particle trajectories, frame dragging phenomena, and non-geodesic behavior resulting from matter-geometry coupling, alongside the weak-field and lensing effects caused by the rotation. Our results establish the potential astrophysical viability of rotating wormholes in $f(R,T)$ gravity.

一句话导读：在 f(R,T) 引力中构建慢转可穿越虫洞，并分析其能量条件、粒子动力学与弱场透镜效应。

用于稠密核物质和中子星的全息孤子晶体

Holographic Soliton Crystals for Dense Nuclear Matter and Neutron Stars

Lorenzo Bartolini, Sven Bjarke Gudnason, Jonas Mager, Anton Rebhan · hep-ph, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：我们从 Witten-Sakai-Sugimoto (WSS) 模型中的全息 QCD 构建核物质状态方程 (EOS)，超越均匀拟设，更直接地从全息重子的孤子描述构建稠密重子物质。利用由点状（核心）瞬子在弯曲背景中源出的线性化孤子尾部得到的两重子相互作用势，我们组装一个无限面心立方 (FCC) 晶体，其最近邻处于最具吸引力的通道，作为重子量子液体的近似，并计算能量密度 E(n_B)、化学势 μ_B 和压强 P。我们通过将 't Hooft 耦合 λ 和 WSS 标度 M_KK 固定到饱和密度和起始化学势性质，并加入夸克质量项以再现物理 π 介子质量 m_π=135 MeV，来校准对称物质 EOS。该拟合结果与真空介子扇区所需的参数保持相当接近，而它们的修正与稠密介质中的 Brown-Rho 标度一致，且饱和点的不可压缩性处于正确数量级，这两点均与均匀近似形成鲜明对比。随后我们扩展到 β 平衡物质，使用对称能的唯象输入，并获得与 NICER 约束兼容的混合 EOS 和中子星可观测值。

English: We construct a nuclear-matter equation of state (EOS) from holographic QCD in the Witten-Sakai-Sugimoto (WSS) model, going beyond the homogeneous ansatz by building dense baryonic matter more directly from the solitonic description of holographic baryons. Employing the two-baryon interaction potential obtained from the linearized soliton tails sourced in the curved background by point-like (core) instantons, we assemble an infinite face-centered cubic (FCC) crystal with nearest neighbors in the most attractive channel as an approximation to the quantum liquid of baryons and compute the energy density $\mathcal{E}(n_B)$, the chemical potential $\mu_B$, and the pressure $P$. We calibrate the symmetric-matter EOS by fixing the 't Hooft coupling $\lambda$ and the WSS scale $M_{\rm KK}$ to saturation-density and onset-chemical-potential properties, and by including a quark-mass term to reproduce the physical pion mass $m_\pi=135\,\mathrm{MeV}$. This fit turns out to remain reasonably close to the parameters required by the vacuum meson sector, while their modification is consistent with Brown-Rho scaling in a dense medium, and the incompressibility at saturation is of the correct order of magnitude, both in clear contrast to the homogeneous approximation. We then extend to beta-equilibrated matter, using phenomenological input for the symmetry energy, and obtain hybrid EOS and neutron-star observables that are compatible with the NICER constraints.

一句话导读：在 WSS 全息 QCD 中构建稠密重子的 FCC 孤子晶体，得到核物质 EOS 并给出与 NICER 兼容的中子星预言。

高阶曲率有效理论中偏振依赖的光子传播、准正规模与引力透镜

Polarization-Dependent Photon Propagation, Quasinormal Modes, and Gravitational Lensing in Higher-Curvature Effective Theories

Takamasa Kanai · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：我们在有效场论框架下研究高阶曲率修正对光子传播的影响及其在强引力场中的观测后果。我们考虑静态球对称时空中光子轨迹的偏振依赖修正，重点关注 Schwarzschild 和 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞背景。利用几何光学近似，我们推导支配光子传播的有效度规，并研究由此产生的光子球偏振依赖移动。我们计算 eikonal 极限下相应的准正规模，并分析其偏振依赖性。我们进一步研究引力透镜，重点关注弱场和强场区域中偏折角的偏振依赖修正。在强偏折区域，我们发现即使微扰小的高阶曲率 EFT 修正也会改变偏折角对数发散部分的系数，从而可能产生与未修正情形可观测的差异。这表明强引力透镜可能为小的高阶曲率修正提供敏感探针。虽然直接从 QNM 频率提取 EFT 信息更为微妙，但 QNM 可能在未来研究中为引力透镜提供补充信息。我们的结果建立了一个通过偏振依赖强场可观测量探测高阶曲率效应的框架。

English: We investigate the impact of higher-curvature corrections on photon propagation within an effective field theory framework and their observational consequences in strong gravitational fields. We consider polarization-dependent modifications to photon trajectories in static and spherically symmetric spacetimes, focusing on Schwarzschild and Reissner--Nordstr\"om black hole backgrounds. Using the geometrical optics approximation, we derive the effective metrics governing photon propagation and study the resulting polarization-dependent shifts of the photon sphere. We compute the corresponding quasinormal modes in the eikonal limit and analyze their polarization dependence. We further investigate gravitational lensing, focusing on polarization-dependent corrections to the deflection angle in both weak- and strong-field regimes. In the strong-deflection regime, we find that even perturbatively small EFT corrections modify the coefficient of the logarithmically divergent part of the deflection angle, resulting in a potentially observable difference from the uncorrected case. This suggests that strong gravitational lensing may provide a sensitive probe of small higher-curvature corrections. While extracting EFT information directly from QNM frequencies is more subtle, QNMs may provide complementary information to gravitational lensing in future studies. Our results establish a framework for probing higher-curvature effects through polarization-dependent strong-field observables.

一句话导读：在高阶曲率 EFT 中，偏振依赖修正改变光子球、eikonal QNM 与强场引力透镜偏折，强透镜可作为探测小修正的敏感探针。

Higgs-R² 暴胀中瞬态转弯产生的大原初非高斯性

Large primordial non-Gaussianity from transient turns in Higgs-$R^2$ inflation

Flavio Pineda, Luis O. Pimentel · astro-ph.CO, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：我们研究多场 Higgs–R² 暴胀中原初非高斯性的产生，重点关注双曲场空间流形中的瞬态转弯轨迹效应。我们在不依赖慢滚或局部近似的情况下计算完整双谱，并追踪曲率与等曲率扰动在超视界尺度上的完整演化。我们发现瞬态转弯能有效地将等曲率涨落转移到绝热扇区，从而产生可观的局域非高斯性。在 Higgs 非最小耦合 ξ_h=0.1、四次耦合 λ=10^-10 的基准参数下，得到 f_NL^loc≈-17.7。随着 Higgs 非最小耦合增大，转弯速率逐渐被抑制，模型趋近有效单场吸引子，并恢复 Maldacena 一致性关系 f_NL→0.0159。与当前 CMB 限制比较后，原初非高斯性为 Higgs 非最小耦合提供了灵敏探针，并能显著限制模型的可行参数空间。

English: We investigate the generation of primordial non-Gaussianities in multifield Higgs--$R^2$ inflation, focusing on the effects of transient turning trajectories in the hyperbolic field space manifold. We compute the full bispectrum without relying on slow-roll or local approximations and follow the complete superhorizon evolution of curvature and isocurvature perturbations. We show that transient turns efficiently transfer isocurvature fluctuations into the adiabatic sector, generating sizeable local non-Gaussianities. For a benchmark Higgs nonminimal coupling $\xi_h = 0.1$ and quartic coupling $\lambda = 10^{-10}$, we obtain $f_{\rm NL}^{\rm loc}\simeq -17.7$. As the Higgs nonminimal coupling increases, the turning rate is progressively suppressed and the model approaches the effective single-field attractor, recovering the Maldacena consistency relation $f_{\rm NL}\rightarrow 0.0159$. Comparing our predictions with current CMB constraints, we find that primordial non-Gaussianity provides a sensitive probe of the Higgs nonminimal coupling and can significantly restrict the viable parameter space of the model.

一句话导读：研究 Higgs-R² 暴胀中瞬态转弯如何将等曲率扰动转化为可观测的局域原初非高斯性，并用 CMB 限制 Higgs 非最小耦合。

中文摘要：在引力最一般的表述中，度规和联络是独立自由度，联络可以包含挠率和非度量性（统称为畸变）自由度，从而产生大量可能的动力学场。然而，大多数场要么是非动力学的，要么极其重，并且低能下恢复广义相对论。我们发现了一个独特的自然轻的矢量型或标量型畸变场，它可以是动力学的并具有现象学意义。特别地，一个与希格斯玻色子混合的轻标量粒子会自然地出现。

English: In the most general formulation of gravity, the metric and connection are independent degrees of freedom, and the connection may include torsion and non-metricity (or distortion, collectively) degrees of freedom, resulting in a huge number of possible dynamical fields. However, most fields are either non-dynamical or extremely heavy and the general relativity is recovered at low energy. We find a unique naturally light vector- or scalar-like distortion field, which can be dynamical and have phenomenological implications. In particular, a light scalar particle that mixes with the Higgs boson naturally appears.

量子反作用BTZ黑洞从指数电动力学中的经典涌现

Classical emergence of the quantum-backreacted BTZ black hole from exponential electrodynamics

Julio A. M\'endez-Zavaleta, Efra\'in Rojas, Jos\'e Joaqu\'in Su\'arez-Garibay · gr-qc, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：在这项工作中，我们重新审视最近报道的 Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli 黑洞的一种推广；该黑洞出现在由标量物质量子涨落作为源的新质量引力中，现在从纯经典框架的视角加以考察。我们表明，同一种以对数渐近结构为特征的几何，作为爱因斯坦引力与指数非线性电动力学耦合的唯一静态解而出现。我们追溯这种对应关系的起源，并证明该几何属于一类唯一的度规，构成两个理论的静态扇区与圆对称扇区的模空间交集，从而揭示二者之间的动力学等价性。我们建立了非线性带电黑洞的整体荷与新质量引力中控制量子反作用的参数之间的显式映射，使得量子印记可以自然地重新解释为经典荷。文中详细分析了这些时空的视界结构。此外，我们使用 Iyer-Wald 形式体系构造了更一般构型的完整热力学，并由此推导出第一定律及相关的 Smarr 关系。总之，我们的结果为半经典时空提供了一种经典实现，并指向量子引力中的高阶曲率修正与三维自引力电动力学中的非线性效应之间更广泛的对应关系。

English: In this work, we revisit a recently reported generalization of the Ba\~nados-Teitelboim-Zanelli black hole arising in New Massive Gravity sourced by the quantum fluctuations of scalar matter, now examined through the lens of a purely classical framework. We show that the same geometry, distinguished by its logarithmic asymptotic structure, emerges as the unique static solution of Einstein gravity coupled to an exponential nonlinear electrodynamics. We trace the origin of this correspondence and prove that this geometry belongs to a unique class of metrics constituting the intersection of the moduli spaces of the static and circularly symmetric sectors of the two theories, thereby revealing a dynamical equivalence between them. An explicit mapping is established between the global charges of the nonlinearly charged black holes and the parameters governing the quantum backreaction in New Massive Gravity, allowing for a natural reinterpretation of the quantum imprints in terms of classical charges. A detailed analysis of the horizon structure of these spacetimes is presented. In addition, the full thermodynamics of the more general configurations is constructed using the Iyer-Wald formalism, from which we derive the first law and the associated Smarr relation. Altogether, our results provide a classical realization of a semiclassical spacetime and point toward a broader correspondence between higher-curvature corrections in quantum gravity and nonlinear effects in self-gravitating electrodynamics in three dimensions.

一句话导读：三维中，量子反作用修正的BTZ几何可由指数非线性电动力学经典实现，并对应高阶曲率修正与非线性电动力学之间的映射。

黑洞动力学 Love 数的普适闭式

Universal Closed Form for Dynamical Love Numbers of Black Holes

Mikhail P. Solon (UCLA) · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：黑洞静态 Love 数消失，但其动力学对应量并不消失。我们给出 Schwarzschild 黑洞的完整 scheme-independent 动力学响应 \bar{F}_{\ell,s} 的闭式，对 G 的所有阶、任意自旋 s 和多极 \ell 成立。结果为 \bar{F}_{\ell,s}/4\pi R_S^{2\ell+1}=\Phi_{\ell,s}(\bar{y})-\tfrac12\eta \Phi_{\ell,s}'(\bar{y})，其中 \bar{y}=-\tfrac12\eta^2\tau，\eta=i\omega R_S。这里 \Phi_{\ell,s} 是重整化群方程的领头对数解；将跑动对数提升为 \tau=\log(R_S/R)-2\sum_{k\ge2}\zeta_k \eta^{k-1} 可将其重求和到所有阶。这一 Riemann zeta 值塔本质上是 Newtonian 相位：它来自远区长程 1/r 势，并在多极和自旋间普适。我们的结果呈现一个由三个要素决定的因子化：视界吸收强度、近区跑动率和远区修饰对数。利用壳层有效场论，我们独立验证了标量、电磁和引力扰动下的公式，达到 \mathcal{O}(G^{15})。

English: Black hole static Love numbers vanish, but their dynamical counterparts do not. We present the entire scheme-independent dynamical response $\bar{F}_{\ell,s}$ of a Schwarzschild black hole in closed form, to all orders in $G$, and for every spin $s$ and multipole $\ell$. The result is $\bar{F}_{\ell,s}/4\pi R_S^{2\ell+1}=\Phi_{\ell,s}(\bar{y})-\tfrac12\eta\,\Phi_{\ell,s}'(\bar{y})$ with $\bar{y}=-\tfrac12\eta^2\tau$ and $\eta=i\omega R_S$. Here $\Phi_{\ell,s}$ is simply the leading-log solution to the renormalization group equation, but lifting the running logarithm to $\tau=\log(R_S/R)-2\sum_{k\ge2}\zeta_k\,\eta^{k-1}$ resums it to all orders. This tower of Riemann zeta values is the Newtonian phase in disguise: it originates from the long-range $1/r$ potential in the far zone, and is universal across multipole and spin. Our result exhibits a factorization pinned to three ingredients: the strength of horizon absorption, the running rate in the near zone, and the dressed logarithm in the far zone. Using shell effective field theory, we independently verify our formula for scalar, electromagnetic, and gravitational perturbations, reaching $\mathcal O(G^{15})$.

一句话导读：以闭式给出 Schwarzschild 黑洞动力学 Love 响应的全阶普适公式，并揭示其因子化由视界吸收、近区跑动和远区修饰对数决定。

后量子经典引力中的随机模式

Stochastic modes in postquantum classical gravity

Jonathan Oppenheim, Muhammad Sajjad · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：我们研究后量子经典引力理论中度规的涨落；该理论是一个协变理论，将经典时空与量子物质场耦合起来。数学一致性要求时空随机演化。从经典-量子路径积分出发，我们在 Minkowski 空间附近线性化，并进行标量-矢量-张量分解，识别出随机模式：一个经典自旋-2 场和一个自旋-0 标量，二者都在各自波动方程附近扩散。此外还有非动力学矢量场和标量场。这些与二次引力中发现的自由度相关，但在这里被解释为对时空的随机贡献。我们证明作用量在所有动力学模式上是半正定的（PSD），这是理论能够一致地将时空作为经典量处理的一个必要条件。我们计算与牛顿势涨落对应的两点函数和功率谱密度，并将其与 LISA Pathfinder 中发现的过量噪声进行比较。这给出了对理论两个无量纲耦合常数之一组合的约束，而 FLRW 背景下随机引力波能量密度的约束则限制另一个组合。我们推导物质分布的有效作用量，并发现退相干实验的约束受到牛顿势 Φ 和曲率扰动 ψ 的涨落限制。最后，我们展示了纯引力理论的不同表述之间的一致性：Onsager-Machlup 形式的作用量、Martin-Siggia-Rose 形式，以及由随机微分方程给出的形式。

English: We study fluctuations of the metric in the postquantum theory of classical gravity, a covariant theory which couples a classical spacetime with quantum matter fields. Mathematical consistency requires spacetime to evolve stochastically. Starting from the classical-quantum path integral, we linearize around Minkowski space and perform a scalar-vector-tensor decomposition, identifying the stochastic modes: a classical spin-2 field and spin-0 scalar, both diffusing around their respective wave equations. There is also a non-dynamical vector and scalar field. These are related to the degrees of freedom found in quadratic gravity, but here interpreted as stochastic contributions to spacetime. We show that the action is positive semi-definite (PSD) on all dynamical modes, which is a necessary condition for the theory to consistently treat spacetime classically. We compute the two-point function and power spectral density corresponding to fluctuations of the Newtonian potential, and compare it to the excess noise found in LISA Pathfinder. This sets a bound on one combination of the two dimensionless coupling constants of the theory, while bounds on the stochastic gravitational wave energy density in a FLRW background constrain another combination. We derive the effective action for matter distributions, and find that bounds from decoherence experiments are constrained by fluctuations in the Newtonian potential $\Phi$ and the curvature perturbation $\psi$. Finally, we show consistency between different formulations of the pure gravity theory, the Onsager-Machlup form of the action, the Martin-Siggia-Rose form, and that given by stochastic differential equations.

一句话导读：在后量子经典引力中识别线性化随机模式，计算牛顿势噪声与随机引力波谱，并用 LISA Pathfinder、FLRW 和退相干实验约束理论耦合。

全息中的通量管剖面：有限尺寸与强耦合修正

Flux tube profile from Holography: finite size and strong coupling corrections

Tommaso Canneti · hep-th, hep-lat · v3 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：我们使用全息对偶作为工具，研究在 2+1 维强耦合大 N QCD 类理论中连接静态夸克-反夸克对的经典通量管剖面。最终结果在若干方面扩展了文献中已有发现。首先，它是两个类空边界坐标的解析函数；换言之，我们同时追踪沿夸克间轴和横向于该轴方向的行为。然后，我们考虑了夸克间距离的有限性以及强耦合展开的一阶修正。在同一阶，我们还确认了谱中最轻胶球质量与通量管剖面内禀宽度之间的关系。最后，我们尝试获得关于量子涨落的一些洞见。有趣的是，我们的提议与文献中的广泛预期一致。顺带地，我们还导出了一个半解析公式，给出强耦合展开中标量胶球质量的一阶修正。

English: We use the holographic correspondence as a tool to study the classical flux tube profile connecting a static quark-antiquark pair in a $2+1$-dimensional strongly-coupled large $N$ QCD-like theory. The final result extends already known findings in the literature in several ways. First, it is an analytical function of both the space-like boundary coordinates; in other words, we keep track of what happens both along and transversely to the inter-quark axis. Then, we take into account the finiteness of the inter-quark distance and the first correction in the strong coupling expansion. To the same order, we also confirm the relation between the mass of the lightest glueball in the spectrum and the intrinsic width of the flux tube profile. We conclude by trying to gain some insights about the quantum fluctuations. Intriguingly, our proposal is in agreement with widespread expectations in the literature. En passant, we also derive a semi-analytical formula that gives the first correction to the scalar glueball masses in the strong coupling expansion.

一句话导读：利用全息对偶计算 2+1 维强耦合 QCD 类理论中静态夸克-反夸克通量管剖面，包含有限距离与强耦合一阶修正，并联系胶球质量与通量管宽度。

双荷 Kalb-Ramond 引力中的光线偏折与观测约束

Light bending and observational bounds in dyonic Kalb-Ramond gravity

A. A. Ara\'{u}jo Filho · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：我们研究 Kalb-Ramond 引力中双荷黑洞的弱引力透镜和强引力透镜。在固定渐近归一化后，我们区分了支配局部零测地线的有效电荷与与洛伦兹对称性破缺相关的整体角度识别。在弱偏折区域，我们显式计算高斯曲率，并对具有微扰光线边界的区域应用 Gauss-Bonnet 定理，恢复了完整的二阶质量贡献。基于轨道方程、转折点积分和费马原理的独立计算给出相同的偏折角。在强偏折区域，Tsukamoto 方法给出两个强偏折系数的闭式表达式，并具有精确的电荷依赖。我们推导有限距离透镜方程及相应的像位置、放大率、通量比和差分到达时间，并保留物理的绕数条件。由 Sgr A* 和 M87* 观测推断的阴影大小给出条件性电荷界限，并由 S2 进动给出补充估计。我们进一步构造强透镜可观测量的组合，以在该模型中分离有效电荷和锥形参数：角分离和相对亮度消除显式绕数依赖，而纳入独立距离估计的时间比则分离出锥形形变。

English: We investigate the weak and strong gravitational lensing of a dyonic black hole in Kalb-Ramond gravity. After fixing the asymptotic normalization, we distinguish the effective charge governing the local null trajectories from the global angular identification associated with Lorentz-symmetry breaking. In the weak-deflection regime, we evaluate the Gaussian curvature explicitly and apply the Gauss-Bonnet theorem with a perturbed ray boundary, recovering the complete second order mass contribution. Independent calculations based on the orbit equation, the turning point integral, and Fermat's principle reproduce the same bending angle. In the strong-deflection regime, Tsukamoto's method yields closed expressions for both strong-deflection coefficients, with exact charge dependence. We derive finite-distance lens equations and the associated image positions, magnifications, flux ratios, and differential arrival times, retaining the physical winding condition. Shadow sizes inferred from observations of Sgr~A$^*$ and M87$^*$ yield conditional charge bounds, complemented by an estimate from S2 precession. We further construct combinations of strong-lensing observables that separate the effective charge from the conical parameter within the model: angular separation and relative brightness remove the explicit winding dependence, while a timing ratio incorporating an independent distance estimate isolates the conical deformation.

一句话导读：在 Kalb-Ramond 引力中计算双荷黑洞的弱/强引力透镜、阴影与观测约束，并构造分离模型参数的观测量组合。

Einstein--Weyl 引力中非 Schwarzschild 黑洞的计算机辅助存在性证明

A computer assisted existence proof for a non-Schwarzschild black hole in Einstein--Weyl gravity

Kevin Goldstein, Vishnu Jejjala · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：静态、渐近平直的四维 Einstein--Weyl 引力中的非 Schwarzschild 黑洞此前已通过数值打靶法构造，而局部场方程允许视界展开和渐近展开到任意阶。我们给出了一个非 Schwarzschild 解的计算机辅助存在性证明，其无量纲视界半径在以有质量自旋二尺度为单位时为 1，参数接近先前报道的数值分支。外部区域被分为：收敛的视界级数区域；由带定向舍入的参数依赖 Taylor 模型包围的紧致核心；以及被处理为居中稳定流形不动点问题的无穷渐近区域。核心与尾部之间的五维匹配映射在严格指定的盒子上连续。经过精确有理预条件后，相对面上的符号满足 Poincaré--Miranda 定理的假设，因此证明存在一个匹配零点。该解具有正则非退化视界、没有额外外部视界、Ricci 标量为零而非零 Ricci 张量。该证明确立了存在性，但未证明匹配零点的唯一性。

English: Static, asymptotically flat, non-Schwarzschild black holes in four-dimensional Einstein--Weyl gravity have previously been constructed by numerical shooting, while the local field equations admit horizon and asymptotic expansions to all orders. We give a computer assisted existence proof for a non-Schwarzschild solution whose dimensionless horizon radius is one in units of the massive spin-two scale, with parameters close to the previously reported numerical branch. The exterior is divided into a convergent horizon series domain, a compact core enclosed by a parameter dependent Taylor model with directed rounding, and an infinite asymptotic domain treated as a centered stable manifold fixed point problem. The resulting five-dimensional matching map between the core and tail is continuous on a rigorously specified box. After exact rational preconditioning, the signs on opposite faces satisfy the hypotheses of the Poincar\'e--Miranda theorem and therefore certify a matching zero. The solution has a regular nondegenerate horizon, no additional exterior horizon, vanishing Ricci scalar, and nonvanishing Ricci tensor. The proof establishes existence, but not uniqueness of the matching zero.

一句话导读：通过计算机辅助 Poincaré--Miranda 论证，证明四维 Einstein--Weyl 引力中存在一个非 Schwarzschild 黑洞解。

Zero Temperature, Degenerate Fermion Stars

S. Boatto, M. B. Paranjape, V. Pessanha, C. A. D. Zarro · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：我们研究一种零温度、简并的费米气体，其粒子具有静止质量 m，且只通过引力彼此相互作用。我们描述了一种自洽的新方法来理解简并量子力学星的形成。在该方法中，费米子根据泡利不相容原理占据由自洽引力相互作用决定的能级。于是，在这个新方法中，最高占据能级的大小决定了星的半径。在牛顿引力极限下，费米子感受到对应于简谐振子势的势，该势在外部平滑连接到通常的 1/r 牛顿引力势。我们解析地找到了任意半径和质量的星解，由 m 和总费米子数 N_s 参数化。在牛顿极限下，我们容易发现可以构造比 Buchdahl 界更致密、甚至小于 Schwarzschild 半径的星。显然，这类情形超出牛顿极限的适用范围。因此，我们将分析推广到广义相对论背景中的费米子，它们通过度规发生引力相互作用。我们考虑对应于内部 Schwarzschild 解并平滑连接到通常外部 Schwarzschild 度规的度规。半经典地处理物质，我们在完全独立的分析中重新得到 Buchdahl 界。我们简要讨论牛顿解的经典稳定性及其与牛顿多方流体（polytropic fluids）的关系。

English: We study a degenerate, zero temperature, fermion gas with rest mass $m$, that only interacts with itself, gravitationally. We describe a self-consistent novel approach to the formation of a degenerate, quantum mechanical, star. In this approach, the fermions occupy the energy levels that are determined by the self consistent gravitational interactions, according to the Pauli exclusion principle. Then in this novel approach, the size of the highest occupied level determines the radius of the star. In the Newtonian gravitational limit, the fermions feel a potential corresponding to a simple harmonic well that smoothly attaches in the exterior to the usual $1/r$ Newtonian gravitational potential. We find analytically, solutions for stars with any radius and mass, parametrized by $m$ and $N_s$, the total number of fermions. In the Newtonian limit, we easily find that we can construct a star that is more compact than the Buchdahl bound and indeed can even be smaller than the Schwarzschild radius. Clearly, such cases are outside of the purview of the Newtonian limit. Therefore we expand our analysis to fermions in the general relativistic context, interacting gravitationally with a metric. We consider the metric corresponding to the interior Schwarzschild solution smoothly connecting to the usual exterior Schwarzschild metric. Treating matter semi-classically, we recover the Buchdahl bound in a completely independent analysis. We briefly discuss classical stability of the Newtonian solution, and its relation to Newtonian polytropic fluids.

一句话导读：在牛顿与广义相对论框架下自洽求解零温简并费米星，并独立复现 Buchdahl 界。

相关度：medium — 非全息研究；主要属于经典引力/广义相对论，直接研究自引力简并费米星、Schwarzschild 内部解与 Buchdahl 界，因此对经典引力支线有中等相关性，但与 AdS/CFT 无直接关系。

史瓦西黑洞的二阶散射响应

Second-order scattering response of a Schwarzschild black hole

Bruno Bucciotti, Jaime Redondo-Yuste, Adrien Kuntz, Vitor Cardoso · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：引力波在黑洞附近以非线性方式耦合。黑洞微扰论可直接用于计算这种耦合的大小，以及它如何依赖 incoming 引力波的宇称内容、频率和角结构。本文完成该计算，表明引力波的非线性耦合通常在驱动频率与黑洞基频准正规模振荡频率匹配时达到峰值。作者还展示这种激发在允许的最大谐波处最强，并且仅温和依赖 incoming 模式的宇称内容。在低频下，这里计算的二次响应编码了黑洞时空本身的非线性动力学潮汐形变。数值上，作者证明二次黑洞耦合系数随驱动频率二次方标度，并从五点康普顿引力子散射振幅恢复该标度关系。

English: Gravitational waves couple in a nonlinear fashion in the vicinity of a black hole. Black hole perturbation theory can be readily applied to compute the magnitude of this coupling, its dependence on the parity content, frequencies, and angular structure of the incoming gravitational waves. In this work we carry out this calculation, showing how the nonlinear coupling of gravitational waves generically peaks when the driven frequency matches the oscillation frequency of the fundamental quasinormal mode of the black hole. We also demonstrate how this excitation is largest at the maximal harmonics allowed, and that it only depends mildly on the parity content of the incoming modes. At low frequencies, the quadratic response computed here encodes the nonlinear, dynamical tidal deformability of the black hole spacetime itself. We demonstrate numerically that the quadratic black hole coupling coefficient scales quadratically with the driving frequency, and recover this scaling from the 5-point Compton graviton scattering amplitude.

一句话导读：计算史瓦西黑洞引力的二阶非线性散射响应，揭示其与基频准正规模共振及低频非线性潮汐形变的关系。

English: We construct a new family of exact spinning black hole solutions in five-dimensional General Relativity with a negative cosmological constant, which are dual to strongly coupled spinning plasma balls on four-dimensional Minkowski spacetime. In analogy with the recent discovery of such black solutions in four bulk dimensions, the boundary Lorentz factor acts as a new coordinate in the bulk, giving rise to a new UV region that, in our case, is locally a three-dimensional de Sitter spacetime times the real line. The dual energy-momentum tensor in this region describes a conformal anisotropic fluid that satisfies the weak and strong energy conditions.

Seong-Jin Lee, Rak-Kyeong Seong · hep-th, math-ph, math.AG, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：Brane tilings 是二维环面上的二分图，编码了在探测环面Calabi-Yau 3-folds的D3-branes上产生的四维N=1超对称规范理论的拉氏量。在这些二分图中，只有满足几何一致性条件的那些才对应行为良好的量子场论。我们训练了一个卷积神经网络（CNN），直接从Kasteleyn矩阵区分几何一致与不一致的brane tilings。我们研究了一族四维N=1理论，它们通过向C^3/Z_3 x Z_3阿贝尔orbifold的brane tiling的六边形面添加对角边得到，发现CNN以高准确率识别几何不一致性。对于可以通过Higgsing单个双基本手征场而变得一致的不一致brane tilings，我们表明基于梯度的显著性分析可用于定位负责的手征场，准确率远高于匹配的随机基线。这些结果表明，可解释AI（XAI）可用于识别超对称规范理论中导致不一致性的局域缺陷。

English: Brane tilings are bipartite graphs on a 2-torus that encode the Lagrangians of 4d N=1 supersymmetric gauge theories arising on D3-branes probing toric Calabi-Yau 3-folds. Among these bipartite graphs, only those that satisfy geometric consistency conditions correspond to well-behaved quantum field theories. We train a convolutional neural network (CNN) to distinguish geometrically consistent from inconsistent brane tilings directly from their Kasteleyn matrices. We study a family of 4d N=1 theories obtained by adding diagonal edges to the hexagonal faces of the brane tiling for the abelian orbifold C^3/Z_3 x Z_3, and find that the CNN identifies geometric inconsistency with high accuracy. For inconsistent brane tilings that can be rendered consistent by Higgsing a single bifundamental chiral field, we show that gradient-based saliency analysis can be used to localize the responsible chiral fields with accuracy well above a matched random baseline. These results demonstrate that explainable AI (XAI) can be used to identify local defects responsible for inconsistencies in supersymmetric gauge theories.

一句话导读：利用CNN和显著性分析从Kasteleyn矩阵识别brane tilings的几何不一致性，并定位导致不一致的手征场。

复 AdS5 上的分裂签名 Type IIB 背景

A Split-Signature Type IIB Background on $\mathrm{AdS}_{5,\mathbb C}$

Brenno Carlini Vallilo · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：我们构造了一个在复 AdS5 的实十维流形上、签名为 (5,5) 的极大超对称 Type IIB 背景。该时空微分同胚于 T*S^5，并带有不变度规 G=i(bar q - q)，其中 q 是全纯常曲率度规。由归一化体积形式构造的实五形式 F5=(4i/L)(Ω - Ω̄) 是自对偶的，其应力张量支撑这个标量平坦但非 Einstein 的度规。我们从最一般的 SL(4,C) 不变度规与五形式 ansatz 推导这些场：自对偶性和 Einstein 方程将它们的相位固定到整体标度、取向和通量符号。这些场满足未扭曲 IIB5 理论的实条件。全纯余标架使超协变曲率抵消显式化，平坦输运给出三十二个整体实 Killing 旋量。其 Killing 超代数是 psl(4|4,C) 的因子交换实形式，我们识别出相应的超陪集。

English: We construct a maximally supersymmetric Type IIB background in signature $(5,5)$ on the real ten-manifold underlying complex $\mathrm{AdS}_5$. The spacetime is diffeomorphic to $T^*S^5$ and carries the invariant metric $G=\mathrm i(\bar q-q)$, where $q$ is the holomorphic constant-curvature metric. The real five-form $F_5=(4\mathrm i/L)(\Omega-\bar\Omega)$, built from its normalized volume form, is self-dual, and its stress tensor supports this scalar-flat, non-Einstein metric. We derive these fields from the most general $\mathrm{SL}(4,\mathbb C)$-invariant metric and five-form ansatz: self-duality and the Einstein equation fix their phases up to the overall scale, orientation, and flux sign. The fields obey the reality conditions of the untwisted $\mathrm{IIB}_5$ theory. The holomorphic coframe makes the supercovariant curvature cancellation explicit, and flat transport gives thirty-two global real Killing spinors. Their Killing superalgebra is the factor-exchanging real form of $\mathfrak{psl}(4|4,\mathbb C)$, and we identify the corresponding supercoset.

一句话导读：在复 AdS5 上构造 (5,5) 分裂签名的极大超对称 Type IIB 背景，并识别其超陪集与 Killing 超代数。

从共伴轨道上的路径积分构造 BMS$_3$ 模

BMS$_3$ modules from path integrals on the coadjoint orbits

Pujian Mao, Xin-Cheng Mao · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：本文通过单圈阶路径积分量子化，系统构造与渐近对称群共伴轨道相关的量子模。特别地，对于哈密顿量无下界的轨道，我们表明适当选择积分围道可定义收敛的欧几里得半直线路径积分。与轨道相关的参考态由相应共伴轨道上几何作用的路径积分确定。因此，共伴模由参考态及其后代张成。我们将此形式应用于 Virasoro 和 BMS$_3$ 群，并导出所有常值轨道对应的共伴模。我们还通过计数模内状态计算所有常值 Virasoro 和 BMS$_3$ 共伴轨道的特征标，结果与具有周期性欧几里得方向的几何作用路径积分的相应计算一致。

English: In this paper, we provide a systematic construction of quantum modules associated with coadjoint orbits of asymptotic symmetry groups through the path integral quantization at one-loop order. In particular, for the orbits with Hamiltonians unbounded from below, we show that an appropriate choice of integration contour defines a convergent Euclidean half-line path integral. The reference state associate with the orbit is determined by the path integral of the geometric action on the corresponding coadjoint orbit. The coadjoint module is therefore spanned by the reference state and its descendants. We apply this formalism to the Virasoro and BMS$_3$ groups and derive the coadjoint modules corresponding to all constant orbits. We also compute the characters of all constant Virasoro and BMS$_3$ coadjoint orbits by counting the states within the modules, and the results agree with the corresponding computations from the path integral of the geometric action with a periodic Euclidean direction.

一句话导读：通过单圈路径积分从共伴轨道构造 Virasoro 与 BMS$_3$ 量子模，并用态计数计算其特征标。

通向超越 AdS 全息的测地线路径：镶嵌史瓦西黑洞

A Geodesic Route toward Holography beyond AdS: Tessellating the Schwarzschild Black Hole

Shi Gu, Qiang Wen, Haocheng Zhong, Yiwei Zhong · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：在真空反 de Sitter (AdS) 空间中，几何可由一个测地线网络完美镶嵌。这种镶嵌精确刻画了背景，并可在其上定义 AdS/CFT 的部分纠缠熵 (PEE) 张量网络玩具模型。此前尚不清楚这一构造能否推广到真空 AdS 之外。本文迈出第一步：我们证明史瓦西黑洞外部区域及其爱因斯坦-罗森桥可由从边界发出的特定测地线气体完美镶嵌，从而在这些区域中 Crofton 重构成立。随后我们证明这种测地线镶嵌及其定义的 Crofton 重构可推广到更一般的黎曼流形。这使我们能在更一般的几何背景上构造全息对偶的 PEE 张量网络模型。对于史瓦西背景的 PEE 张量网络模型，我们可以具体实现 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵、Ryu-Takayanagi 公式和 ER=EPR 提议。我们的方法为超越 AdS/CFT 的全息玩具模型开辟了新路径。

English: In vacuum anti-de Sitter (AdS) space, the geometry admits a perfect tessellation by a geodesic network. This tessellation characterizes the background exactly, and a partial entanglement entropy (PEE) tensor-network toy model of AdS/CFT can be defined on it. It has so far been unclear whether this construction can be extended beyond vacuum AdS. In this paper we take the first step in this direction. We show that the exterior region of the Schwarzschild black hole and its Einstein--Rosen bridge are perfectly tessellated by a specific geodesic gas emitted from the boundary, so that Crofton reconstruction holds in these regions. We then prove that such a geodesic tessellation and the Crofton reconstruction it defines extend to more generic Riemannian manifolds. This allows us to construct a PEE tensor-network model of holographic duality on more generic geometric backgrounds. In the case of the PEE tensor-network model for the Schwarzschild background, we can concretely realize the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy, the Ryu--Takayanagi formula and the ER=EPR proposal. Our approach opens a new route towards holographic toy models beyond AdS/CFT.

一句话导读：通过用边界发射的测地线气体镶嵌史瓦西黑洞外部与 ER 桥，并推广 Crofton 重构，构造超越 AdS 的 PEE 张量网络全息玩具模型，实现黑洞熵、RT 公式与 ER=EPR。
