复标量场厚膜：线性微扰稳定性以及与引力耦合的标量 Kaluza-Klein 模式演化

Complex scalar field thick branes: stability of linear perturbation and evolution of scalar Kaluza-Klein modes coupled with gravity

Wang-Long Dong, Heng Guo, Qun Wei, Yong-Tao Lu · hep-th, gr-qc, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：我们研究了由复标量场 Φ 生成的 Minkowski、de Sitter (dS) 和 anti-de Sitter (AdS) 厚膜的稳定性与局域化性质。标量自相互作用势包含温度参数 a。当 a 趋近其临界值时，Φ 的虚部变成双扭结，能量密度分裂为两个峰，表明形成两个子膜。对标量、矢量、张量线性微扰的分析表明标量和矢量扇区没有不稳定迹象，而张量微扰方程的分解排除了快子张量模式。引力子零模局域化在 Minkowski 和 dS 膜上，但在 AdS 膜上不可归一化。我们进一步研究了实检验标量场 Ψ，其动能项与时空曲率之间存在耦合函数 F(R)。标量零模总能局域化在 Minkowski 和 dS 膜上，并具有连续无隙的标量 Kaluza-Klein (KK) 模谱。对于合适的 β 值，在 a 的临界值附近出现大质量标量共振。增大 β 会产生更多共振并延长低共振的寿命，而其时间演化表现出亚稳模式的特征衰减。对于 AdS 膜，标量零模也被局域化，而边界处发散的有效势将大质量标量 KK 模束缚为束缚态，产生离散质量谱。

English: We investigate the stability and localization properties of Minkowski, de Sitter (dS), and anti-de Sitter (AdS) thick branes generated by a complex scalar field $\Phi$. The scalar self-interaction potential contains a temperature parameter $a$. As $a$ approaches its critical value, the imaginary part of $\Phi$ becomes double-kinked and the energy density splits into two peaks, indicating the formation of two sub-branes. The analysis of linear scalar, vector, and tensor perturbations shows no signs of instability in the scalar and vector sectors, while the factorization of the tensor perturbation equation excludes tachyonic tensor modes. The graviton zero mode is localized on the Minkowski and dS branes but is not normalizable on the AdS brane. We further study a real test scalar field $\Psi$ with a coupling function $F(R)$ between its kinetic term and the spacetime curvature. The scalar zero mode can always be localized on the Minkowski and dS branes, with a continuous gapless spectrum of scalar Kaluza--Klein (KK) modes. Massive scalar resonances emerge near the critical value of $a$ for suitable values of $\beta$. Increasing $\beta$ produces more resonances and prolongs the lifetimes of the lower resonances, while their time evolution exhibits the characteristic decay of metastable modes. For the AdS brane, the scalar zero mode is also localized, whereas the divergent effective potential at the boundaries traps the massive scalar KK modes as bound states, yielding a discrete mass spectrum.

一句话导读：复标量厚膜在线性微扰下稳定；标量 KK 模在临界参数附近出现共振，AdS 膜上则形成离散束缚态。

A Differential Form Description of Partial Entanglement Entropy: Testing a Killing Vector Construction in Covariant Phase Space

Chuanjia Zhu, Dong-Hui Du, Wen-Cong Gan, Fu-Wen Shu · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：比特线表述为全息纠缠熵提供了几何描述，而部分纠缠熵（PEE）与PEE线则相对于每个边界点解析了这一结构。受PEE线流可以叠加重构常规比特线流的启发，我们引入PEE线流的微分形式描述。对于真空AdS3/CFT2中的一个区间，我们证明所得形式的通量再现了已知的纠缠轮廓，从而为该描述提供了一致性检验。随后我们研究PEE形式是否可能（最多相差一个恰当形式改进）与由协变相空间（CPS）形式构造的流相关。作为第一个检验，我们考虑Rindler-AdS3中的精确Killing矢量。Rindler参数a参数化了一族背景。在每个a值处，将相应背景的Killing矢量代入Iyer-Wald表面荷形式，并保留所得形式对a的完整依赖。我们通过对a积分该表面荷形式来定义一个有限候选流。对于中心边界点r0=0发出的反射对称PEE流，我们发现变换到Poincaré-AdS3后，没有任何Killing参数选择能同时再现已知PEE流的分量。该结果表明，这里考虑的直接Killing矢量CPS构造不足以再现中心PEE流。可能的扩展包括恰当形式改进、不同的CPS流，或更一般的生成元选择。

English: The bit thread formulation provides a geometric description of holographic entanglement entropy, while partial entanglement entropy (PEE) and PEE threads resolve this structure with respect to individual boundary points. Motivated by the fact that PEE thread flows can be superposed to reconstruct conventional bit thread flows, we introduce a differential form description of PEE thread flow. For an interval in the vacuum AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ setup, we show that the flux of the resulting form reproduces the known entanglement contour, providing a consistency check of the proposed description. We then investigate whether the PEE form can be related, possibly up to an exact form improvement, to a current constructed from the covariant phase space (CPS) formalism. As a first test, we consider exact Killing vectors in Rindler-AdS$_3$. The Rindler parameter $a$ parametrizes a one-parameter family of backgrounds. At each value of $a$, the Killing vector of the corresponding background is substituted into the Iyer-Wald surface charge form, and the full $a$-dependence of the resulting form is retained. We define a finite candidate current by integrating this surface charge form over $a$. For the reflection-symmetric PEE flow sourced at the central boundary point $r_0=0$, we find that no choice of the Killing parameters reproduces both components of the known PEE flow after transforming to Poincar\'e-AdS$_3$. This result shows that the direct Killing vector CPS construction considered here is not sufficient to reproduce the central PEE flow. Possible extensions include an exact form improvement, a different CPS current, or a more general choice of generator.

一句话导读：本文用微分形式描述部分纠缠熵线流，并在AdS3/CFT2中检验Killing矢量协变相空间构造，发现其无法再现中心PEE流。

相关度：low — 论文主要涉及全息纠缠熵、部分纠缠熵与比特线/PEE线，属于AdS/CFT量子信息方向，但不属于用户列出的重点支线；虽使用协变相空间与Killing矢量，但并非以经典引力/广义相对论现象为主要研究对象。

具有一般边界的全息CFT中的纠缠熵

Entanglement entropy in holographic CFTs with generic boundaries

Fabio Ori, Peng-Xiang Hao · hep-th, gr-qc, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：具有一般时空签名边界的全息共形场论中的纠缠熵，不能完全用标准全息对偶到一个实体时空来描述。我们证明，在静态和含时设定下，要与两个边界维度上的共形场论预言精确匹配，需要将对偶时空延拓到复坐标。因此，诸如 Ryu-Takayanagi 面和膜等相关体对象一般而言是复的，但仍锚定在实的渐近边界上，从而保留场论量的物理意义。我们还用一个二维自由高斯费米子系统给出全息预言的第三个数值检验，该系统在不同纠缠相中表现出相同的渐近区域。

English: Entanglement entropy in holographic conformal field theories with boundaries of generic spacetime signature cannot be described entirely within the standard holographic duality to a real bulk spacetime. We show, both in static and time-dependent setups, that an exact match with the conformal field theory predictions in two boundary dimensions entails an extension of the dual spacetime to complex coordinates. As a consequence, relevant bulk objects such as Ryu-Takayanagi surfaces and branes are in general complex, yet anchored on a real asymptotic boundary preserving the physical meaning of field-theoretical quantities. We also provide a third numerical check of the holographic prediction with a two-dimensional system of free Gaussian fermions exhibiting the same asymptotic regimes across different entanglement phases.

一句话导读：为匹配有边界全息CFT的纠缠熵，需将体时空复化，使RT面与膜成为复对象但仍锚定实边界。

无分离性的矢量超辐射：来自世界线有效理论的失稳率

Vector Superradiance without Separability: Instability Rates from the Worldline Effective Theory

Keegan Cove, Jingping Li, Riccardo Penco · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：我们使用点粒子有效场论研究超轻大质量矢量场在缓转黑洞周围的超辐射不稳定性率。此前的有效场论处理报告了与在固定黑洞背景上求解 Proca 方程所得速率之间存在表观 O(1) 差异，例如对于 j=1、ℓ=2 的模式。我们表明实际上没有差异：一旦正确识别退化 {ℓ=0, ℓ=2} 子空间中的领头阶态，有效理论（这里将引力子精确积掉，随后仅按 α 展开）就精确重现所有 j=1 Proca 不稳定性率，而且无需引入完整理论计算所依赖的 FKKS ansatz。由于它从不依赖可分离性，同一方法原则上可应用于缺乏该 ansatz 所依赖的隐藏对称性的转动背景和天体。远区之外的唯一额外要素是一个守恒的世界线接触项，即视界在宇称偶 j=1 Proca 扇区中的静态单极响应，我们通过匹配近区来固定它。同一项还使束缚态的精细结构分裂移动至与已发表的 Proca 谱完全一致。除了提供矢量超辐射的一个概念上直接的模型并解决文献中的一个表观矛盾外，我们展示这项工作是为了说明点粒子有效理论中涉及耗散效应的潜在技术微妙之处。

English: We use a point-particle effective field theory to study the superradiant instability rates of an ultralight massive vector around a slowly rotating black hole. Earlier effective-theory treatments reported an apparent $O(1)$ discrepancy with the rates obtained by solving the Proca equation on a fixed black-hole background, e.g. for the mode with $j=1$ and $\ell=2$. We show that there is in fact no discrepancy: once the leading-order states in the degenerate $\{\ell=0,\ell=2\}$ subspace are correctly identified, the effective theory (implemented here with the graviton integrated out exactly, and expanded in $\alpha$ only afterwards) reproduces \emph{all} of the $j=1$ Proca instability rates exactly, and it does so \emph{without} ever invoking the FKKS ansatz on which the full-theory calculation rests. Since it never relies on separability, the same approach applies, at least in principle, to rotating backgrounds and bodies that lack the hidden symmetries underlying that ansatz. The single ingredient beyond the far zone is a conservative worldline contact term, the static monopole response of the horizon in the parity-even $j=1$ Proca sector, which we fix by matching to the near zone. The same term shifts the fine-structure splitting of the bound states into exact agreement with the published Proca spectrum. In addition to providing a conceptually straightforward model of vector superradiance and resolving an apparent tension in the literature, we present this work to illustrate potential technical subtleties involving dissipative effects in point particle effective theories.

一句话导读：用点粒子世界线有效理论无需 FKKS 可分离性假设，精确重现缓转黑洞周围 j=1 Proca 矢量超辐射不稳定性率，并强调接触项与耗散效应的重要性。

关于纯电与纯磁Weyl曲率张量的Pontryagin类障碍

A Pontryagin class obstruction for purely electric and purely magnetic Weyl curvature tensors

Thijs de Kok · math.DG, math-ph, math.GT, math.MP · v3 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：是否所有容许洛伦兹度规的流形也都容许具有纯电（PE）或纯磁（PM）Weyl曲率张量的此类度规？为（部分）回答此问题，我们证明：对于4k维标量积空间上所有在定向反转等距作用下为偶或为奇的代数曲率张量，落在对偶向量空间最高次外幂中的Pontryagin形式乘积为零。我们由此推出：对于具有PE或PM Riemann或Weyl曲率张量的4k维伪黎曼流形，其所有落在最高次de Rham上同调中的Pontryagin类乘积均为零。对紧流形，这给出存在全局PE或PM Riemann或Weyl曲率张量的此类伪黎曼度规的非平凡上同调障碍。这些障碍可与若干Petrov子类型的洛伦兹度规存在性相联系，而Petrov分类在Einstein方程精确解分类中起重要作用。此外，它们可应用于非退化脐超曲面叶状结构，此类超曲面可能作为时空的时间切片出现。

English: Do all manifolds that admit Lorentzian metrics also admit such metrics that have a purely electric (PE) or purely magnetic (PM) Weyl curvature tensor? To (partially) answer this question, we show that for all algebraic curvature tensors on a $4k$-dimensional scalar product space that are even or odd under the action of a orientation-reversing isometry, the products of Pontryagin forms that land in the top-degree exterior power of the dual vector space vanish. We use this to derive the vanishing of all products of Pontryagin classes that land in the top-degree de Rham cohomology of a $4k$-dimensional pseudo-Riemannian manifold with a PE or PM Riemann or Weyl curvature tensor. For compact manifolds, this gives nontrivial cohomological obstructions to the existence of such pseudo-Riemannian metrics with globally PE or PM Riemann or Weyl curvature tensors. These obstructions can be linked to the existence of Lorentzian metrics of several Petrov subtypes, which play an important role in classifying exact solutions to the Einstein equations. Moreover, they can be applied to foliations by nondegenerate umbilic hypersurfaces, which may appear as timeslices of spacetimes.

一句话导读：该文用Pontryagin类给出伪黎曼流形上全局纯电/纯磁Riemann或Weyl曲率张量存在的上同调障碍，并联系Petrov分类与Einstein方程精确解。

软与硬状态方程对混合星的影响

Impact of soft versus hard equations of state on hybrid stars

H. G\"uven, K. Bozkurt, E. Khan, J. Margueron · nucl-th, astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.SR, hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-09-21

中文摘要：核刚度作为核对称能的主要贡献，在考虑核物理与天体物理约束下，被分析其对致密星性质的影响。致密星可以是仅由核物质构成的中子星，也可以是带有夸克核心的混合星。针对核状态方程考虑两种典型模型（软和硬），对于混合星，采用参数化的一阶相变方法，并辅以线性夸克物质状态方程。我们表明，相变降低了 GW170817 与 NICER 观测之间的张力，并说明了核刚度对于理解 GW170817 中双星系统性质的影响。还讨论了其对核对称能的启示。我们也证实了此前的发现：GW170817 的波形最好被描述为一个具有低密度起始的硬夸克物质的混合星双星。这也可以被解释为 quarkyonic 交叉。

English: The nuclear stiffness as a dominant contribution of nuclear symmetry energy is analyzed on the properties of compact stars considering constraints from nuclear physics and astrophysics. A compact star can be a neutron star composed only of nuclear matter or a hybrid star with a quark core. Two typical models (soft and stiff) are considered for the nuclear equation of state, and for the hybrid one, a parameterized first-order phase transition approach, completed with a linear quark matter equation of state, is implemented. We show that the phase transition reduces the tension between GW170817 and NICER observations, and we illustrate the impact of nuclear stiffness for the understanding of the nature of the binary system in GW170817. The implication on nuclear symmetry energy is also discussed. We also confirm our previous findings that the GW170817 waveform is best described as a binary HS with a low-density onset of stiff quark matter. This could also be interpreted as a quarkyonic cross-over.

一句话导读：通过软/硬核状态方程与一阶相变夸克核心模型，分析混合星性质及其对 GW170817 和 NICER 约束的影响。

无限程量子海森堡自旋玻璃中向 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 临界性的渡越

Crossover to Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev criticality in an infinite-range quantum Heisenberg spin glass

Hossein Hosseinabadi, Subir Sachdev, Jamir Marino · cond-mat.str-el, cond-mat.dis-nn · v3 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：阻挫量子磁体的一个核心问题是量子涨落如何破坏自旋玻璃序并促进量子自旋液体行为。我们研究具有随机耦合的无限程量子海森堡模型的平衡动力学，其中局域磁矩来自 N_f 种自旋费米子味道。我们采用 N_f 展开（它控制量子涨落强度），并自洽地包含对 Luttinger-Ward 泛函的 1/N_f 修正。在大 N_f 极限下，量子涨落较弱，高温相和低温相分别是顺磁相和自旋玻璃有序相，转变温度与 N_f 无关。然而，对于少量费米子味道，量子涨落显著抑制有序温度。我们证明这种行为反映了系统接近 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 区域，在很宽的有限频率范围内实现量子自旋液体动力学，其中费米子和自旋谱密度都显示临界行为，自旋谱密度的标度不变形式为 χ''(ω) ~ sgn(ω)。在最低能量和温度下，自旋玻璃动力学最终占主导，产生普适的亚欧姆动力学自旋磁化率 χ''(ω) ~ sgn(ω) sqrt(|ω|)。我们的结果突出了阻挫量子磁体中自旋玻璃序的抑制与 SYK 临界性出现之间的直接联系。

English: A central question in frustrated quantum magnets is how quantum fluctuations destabilize spin-glass order and promote quantum spin-liquid behavior. We study the equilibrium dynamics of an infinite-range quantum Heisenberg model with random couplings, in which local magnetic moments arise from $\mathcal{N}_f$ flavors of spinful fermions. We employ an expansion in $\mathcal{N}_f$, which controls the strength of quantum fluctuations, and self-consistently include $1/\mathcal{N}_f$ corrections to the Luttinger-Ward functional. In the large-$\mathcal{N}_f$ limit, where quantum fluctuations are weak, the high- and low-temperature phases are respectively paramagnetic and spin glass ordered, with a transition temperature independent of $\mathcal{N}_f$. For small numbers of fermionic flavors, however, quantum fluctuations substantially suppress the ordering temperature. We show that this behavior reflects the proximity of the system to a Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) regime, realizing quantum spin-liquid dynamics over a broad range of finite frequencies, where both fermionic and spin spectral densities display critical behavior over a broad range of finite frequencies, with the latter exhibiting the scale-invariant form $\chi''(\omega)\sim\operatorname{sgn}(\omega)$. At the lowest energies and temperatures, spin glass dynamics ultimately take over, producing a universal sub-Ohmic dynamical spin susceptibility $\chi''(\omega)\sim\operatorname{sgn}(\omega)\sqrt{|\omega|}$. Our results highlight a direct connection between the suppression of spin-glass order and the emergence of SYK criticality in a frustrated quantum magnet.

一句话导读：通过大 N_f 展开和 1/N_f 修正，论文表明无限程量子海森堡自旋玻璃在量子涨落增强时趋近 SYK 临界区，并在最低能量下恢复普适的亚欧姆自旋玻璃动力学。

相关度：low — 论文研究无限程量子自旋玻璃中的SYK临界性，属于 JT/SYK/AdS2/矩阵模型主题，但不直接匹配用户重点标签中列出的全息超流超导、p波序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变/气泡、QNM/非线性演化、冷原子/BEC、探针膜/Floquet 或经典引力等支线，因此 relevance 较低。

分析 GW231109_235456 及其对族群研究、核物理和多信使天文学的潜在意义

Analyzing GW231109_235456 and understanding its potential implications for population studies, nuclear physics, and multi-messenger astronomy

Thibeau Wouters, Anna Puecher, Peter T. H. Pang, Tim Dietrich · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc, hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：我们研究了引力波触发事件 GW231109_235456，这是 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 合作组第四次观测运行第一阶段观测到的亚阈值双中子星并合候选体。假设该触发事件来自天体物理起源，我们使用最先进的波形模型对其进行分析，并在贝叶斯推断中检验不同先验选择下推断源参数的稳健性。我们评估其对族群研究、核物理和多信使天文学的意义。通过分析组分质量，我们发现若 GW231109_235456 为天体物理起源，它支持中子星质量分布的双高斯模型。此外，我们发现其遗迹最可能直接坍缩为黑洞；由于距离较远，与该并合相关的可能千新星会明显比 AT2017gfo 暗，但仍处于 LSST 和 Roman 等天文台的观测能力范围内。我们还给出了仅由候选体 GW231109_235456 以及联合 GW170817 和 GW190425 对所中子星物态方程的约束。在对未来的投影中，我们使用计划中的下一代地基引力波探测器模拟了一个类似事件。结果表明，根据具体设计和所考虑的探测器网络，我们可以将 1.4 太阳质量中子星的潮汐形变约束到约 10%。

English: We study the gravitational-wave trigger GW231109_235456, a sub-threshold binary neutron star merger candidate observed in the first part of the fourth observing run of the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA collaboration. Assuming the trigger is of astrophysical origin, we analyze it using state-of-the-art waveform models and investigate the robustness of the inferred source parameters under different prior choices in Bayesian inference. We assess the implications for population studies, nuclear physics, and multi-messenger astronomy. Analyzing the component masses, we find that GW231109_235456, if astrophysical, supports the proposed double Gaussian mass distribution of neutron stars. Moreover, we find that the remnant most likely collapsed promptly to a black hole and that, because of the large distance, a possible kilonova connected to the merger was noticeably dimmer than AT2017gfo but within reach of observatories such as LSST and Roman. In addition, we provide constraints on the equation of state from the candidate GW231109_235456 alone, as well as combined with GW170817 and GW190425. In our projections for the future, we simulate a similar event using the planned next generation of ground-based gravitational-wave detectors. Our findings indicate that we can constrain the tidal deformability of a $1.4 \ M_\odot$ neutron star to about $10\%$, depending on the specific designs and network considered.

一句话导读：对亚阈值双中子星并合候选体 GW231109_235456 的波形与贝叶斯分析，及其在族群、核物理和多信使天文学中的潜在意义。

弥合啁啾质量间隙：使用 LIGO O4ab 数据搜寻旋近中的亚太阳质量超致密双星引力波

Bridging the chirp-mass gap: searching for gravitational waves from inspiraling subsolar-mass ultra-compact binaries using LIGO O4ab data

Andrew L. Miller · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v2 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：对亚太阳质量致密双星的引力波搜寻在长时搜寻可及的行星质量区间与常规致密双星分析探测的较高质量区间之间留下了一个间隙。我们通过使用统计稳健的 BinaryGFH-v2 方法，在 LIGO O4ab 数据中搜寻啁啾质量为 10^-2–10^-1 M⊙ 的超致密双星旋近，弥合了这一间隙。该方法是一种时频技术，用于搜寻持续数分钟至数小时、快速演化的旋近信号；我们以仅约 350 CPU 小时的计算成本覆盖了这一此前具有挑战性的参数空间，未发现显著候选。因此，我们对双星并合率密度给出 90% 置信度上限，首次在该啁啾质量范围内提供引力波限制。假设早期宇宙形成的原初黑洞双星没有双星抑制（f_sup=1），这些结果首次给出该质量范围内原初黑洞暗物质占比的引力波限制：对于等质量双星，其组分质量为 10^-2–10^-1 M⊙，以及主星质量 m1=2.5 M⊙、次星质量 m2=3×10^-4–10^-2 M⊙ 的非对称双星，得到 f_PBH<1 的上限。

English: Gravitational-wave searches for subsolar-mass compact binaries have left a gap between the planetary-mass regime accessible to long-duration searches and the higher masses probed by conventional compact-binary analyses. We close this gap by searching for the inspiral of ultra-compact binaries with chirp masses $10^{-2}$--$10^{-1}\,M_\odot$ in LIGO O4ab data. Using the statistically robust BinaryGFH-v2 method, a time-frequency technique to search for rapidly evolving inspirals lasting minutes to hours, we cover this previously challenging parameter space with a computational cost of only $\sim 350$ CPU-hours, and find no significant candidates. We thus set 90\% confidence upper limits on the binary merger-rate density, providing the first gravitational-wave constraints across this chirp-mass range. Assuming that primordial-black-hole binaries formed in the early Universe with no binary suppression ($f_{\rm sup}=1$), these results provide the first gravitational-wave constraints on the primordial-black-hole \dmh fraction in this mass range, yielding upper limits with $f_{\rm PBH}<1$ for equal-mass binaries with component masses $10^{-2}$--$10^{-1}\,M_\odot$ and asymmetric binaries with secondary masses $m_2=3\times10^{-4}$--$10^{-2}\,M_\odot$ for a primary mass $m_1=2.5\,M_\odot$.

一句话导读：利用 BinaryGFH-v2 在 LIGO O4ab 数据中搜寻啁啾质量 10^-2–10^-1 M⊙ 的亚太阳质量超致密双星旋近，未发现显著候选并给出首个该质量范围的引力波与原初黑洞占比上限。

相关度：medium — 论文属于经典引力/引力波观测搜寻支线，直接匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但它不涉及全息、量子引力或量子信息，因此对理论全息分类任务的相关性为中等。

f(R)引力中Kerr-Newman-anti-de Sitter黑洞的视界结构与极端构型

Horizon structure and extremal configurations of Kerr-Newman-anti-de Sitter black holes in f(R) gravity

Alikram N. Aliev · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：利用广义相对论中Kerr-Newman-(A)dS黑洞解与它们在f(R)引力中的常曲率对应解之间的对应关系，我们采用统一框架研究这些黑洞的视界结构和极端构型，主要关注anti-de Sitter情形。通过求解关于旋转参数平方a^2和逆曲率标度l^{-2}的极端性条件，我们得到闭合解析关系，从而在(a^2,l^{-2})参数空间中透明地参数化极端分支。我们确定旋转极端分支的物理允许域，并推导出相应的临界电荷q_max=M/2；此时度规变为奇异，分支达到临界旋转极限。对于零电荷，旋转参数沿极端分支单调减小且有下界，意味着存在最小旋转a_min=3√3M/8。旋转极端分支还具有一个特殊内点，在该点归一化旋转标度与曲率标度重合。引入电荷会引入额外竞争标度，拓宽旋转极端分支，并在临界电荷q_max=M/2时将最小旋转降低至a_min=M/4。与相应的de Sitter情形比较，我们表明AdS中的极端性受到几何端点约束，而dS分支结构更为丰富，具有超极端极大值以及随后向非旋转极限的衰减。最后，我们证明与四阶视界方程相关的代数质量约束完全消除实根结构，给出一类没有物理视界的解。

English: Exploiting the correspondence between Kerr--Newman--(A)dS black hole solutions in general relativity and their constant-curvature counterparts in $f(R)$ gravity, we employ a unified framework to investigate the horizon structure and extremal configurations of these black holes, focusing primarily on the anti--de Sitter case. By solving the extremality conditions with respect to the squared rotation parameter $a^2$ and the inverse curvature scale $l^{-2}$, we obtain closed analytic relations that provide a transparent parametrization of the extremal branch in the $(a^2,\, l^{-2})$ parameter space. We determine the physically admissible domain of the rotating extremal branch and derive the corresponding critical charge, $q_{\max}=M/2$, at which the metric becomes singular and the branch reaches its critical rotation limit. For vanishing electric charge, the rotation parameter decreases monotonically along the extremal branch and remains bounded from below, implying the existence of a minimal rotation, $a_{\min}=3\sqrt{3}M/8$. The rotating extremal branch also exhibits a distinguished internal point at which the normalized rotational and curvature scales coincide. The inclusion of electric charge introduces an additional competing scale, broadening the rotating extremal branch while lowering the corresponding minimal rotation to $a_{\min}=M/4$ at the critical charge $q_{\max}=M/2$. Comparing these results with the corresponding de Sitter case, we show that extremality in AdS is constrained by a geometric endpoint, whereas the dS branch exhibits a considerably richer structure characterized by an ultra-extremal maximum and a subsequent decay toward the non-rotating limit. Finally, we demonstrate that the algebraic mass constraint associated with the quartic horizon equation completely removes the real-root structure, yielding a class of solutions without physical horizons.

一句话导读：在f(R)引力框架下分析Kerr-Newman-AdS黑洞的视界结构与极端构型，给出极端分支参数域、临界电荷和最小旋转，并与dS情形对比。

相关度：high — 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究AdS/dS黑洞视界与极端构型，与用户标注的经典引力重点直接相关；不涉及全息对偶、量子信息或全息凝聚态等主题。

中文摘要：LIGO、Virgo 和 KAGRA 构成一个引力波天文台网络。该网络的数据和分析结果通过引力波开放科学中心公开发布。本文介绍该网络的开放数据，包括新增的第四次观测运行第一部分数据以及此前工程运行的选定时段数据，采集时间为2023年5月至2024年1月。公开数据集包括每台仪器的校准应变时间序列、用于噪声扣除和探测器表征的附加通道数据，以及引力波瞬变星表4.0版的分析数据产品。

English: LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA form a network of gravitational-wave observatories. Data and analysis results from this network are made publicly available through the Gravitational Wave Open Science Center. This paper describes open data from this network, including the addition of data from the first part of the fourth observing run and selected periods from the preceding engineering run, collected from 2023 May to 2024 January. The public dataset includes calibrated strain time series for each instrument, data from additional channels used for noise subtraction and detector characterization, and analysis data products from version 4.0 of the Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog.

一句话导读：介绍 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 网络第四次观测运行第一部分的公开数据与相关数据产品。

相关度：medium — 论文是 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 引力波开放数据发布，属于经典引力/引力波观测数据范畴；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力理论，但可为经典引力与引力波研究提供数据资源。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

来自原初引力坍缩的遗迹引力波

Relic gravitational waves from primordial gravitational collapses

Xiang-Xi Zeng, Zhuan Ning, Zi-Yan Yuwen, Shao-Jiang Wang, Heling Deng, Rong-Gen Cai · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-ph · v4 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：哈勃尺度的大原初密度扰动会发生引力坍缩，无论是否形成原初黑洞（PBH），都会产生一个向外传播的声壳。在这封信中，我们报告了对早期宇宙中声壳碰撞诱导的随机引力波背景的混合数值分析。引力波谱的峰值频率和振幅取决于哈勃视界和声壳丰度。丰富的密度扰动会导致未来脉冲星计时阵列和地基/空间探测器可能探测到的引力波背景。对于那些坍缩成PBH的扰动，未来对相应高频引力波背景的零探测，可以对那些已经蒸发的PBH给出新的观测约束。

English: A large primordial density perturbation of the Hubble scale will gravitationally collapse, generating an outgoing sound shell, whether or not a primordial black hole (PBH) is formed. In this Letter, we report a hybrid numerical analysis of the stochastic gravitational wave background induced by the collision of sound shells in the early Universe. The peak frequency and amplitude in the GW spectrum depend on the Hubble horizon and the abundance of sound shells. Abundant density perturbations would lead to GW backgrounds potentially detectable for future pulsar timing arrays and ground-based/space-borne detectors. For those perturbations that collapse into PBHs, future null detection of the corresponding high-frequency GW background could put new observational constraints on those PBHs that have already evaporated.

一句话导读：本文用混合数值分析研究了原初密度扰动坍缩形成声壳并碰撞产生的随机引力波背景，及其对原初黑洞的观测约束。

相关度：medium — 论文属于经典引力/宇宙学中的原初黑洞形成与随机引力波背景研究，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及AdS/CFT全息各支线，因此与全息重点方向相关性有限。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

Kasner 时空的线性不稳定性

The linear instability of Kasner spacetimes

Oliver Petersen · math.AP, gr-qc, math.DG · v1 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：我们证明 Kasner 时空在趋向大爆炸方向上的线性稳定性，允许一个显式的有限维非衰减自相似解空间。增长最快的解是 Taub 显式 Bianchi II 解的线性化，描述一次 Kasner 跃迁。所有其他非衰减解都是其非均匀类比，以及线性化 Kasner 度规。关键创新是 Kasner 时空上的准正规模概念，类似静止黑洞时空上的准正规模。所有四维宁静（相对于振荡）真空大爆炸时空，从大爆炸处单个观察者的视角看，都渐近于一个 Kasner 时空。由于 Belinski、Khalatnikov 和 Lifschitz 猜想的振荡，它们预期高度不稳定。本文在没有对称性假设下，在线性层面完整描述了这种不稳定性。

English: We prove linear stability of Kasner spacetimes in the direction of the Big Bang, up to an explicit finite dimensional space of non-decaying self-similar solutions. The fastest growing solution is the linearization of Taub's explicit Bianchi II solution, describing a Kasner transition. All other non-decaying solutions are inhomogeneous analogues of this, and the linearized Kasner metric. The key novelty is a notion of quasinormal modes on Kasner spacetimes, similar to quasinormal modes on stationary black holes spacetimes. All quiescent (as opposed to oscillatory) vacuum Big Bang spacetimes of dimension 4 are asymptotic to a Kasner spacetime from the perspective of a single observer at the Big Bang. They are expected to be highly unstable due to the oscillations conjectured by Belinski, Khalatnikov and Lifschitz. This paper provides a complete description of this instability on a linear level without symmetry assumptions.

一句话导读：论文在无对称性假设下给出 Kasner 时空大爆炸方向线性不稳定性的完整描述，并引入 Kasner 时空准正规模。

相关度：high — 论文属于经典广义相对论与宇宙学奇点分析，提出 Kasner 时空上的准正规模概念，直接匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM与非线性演化”重点标签。

经典引力/广义相对论QNM与非线性演化

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

停滞梳：重复宇宙学停滞的引力波特征

Stasis Combs: Gravitational-Wave Signatures of Recurrent Cosmological Stasis

Gabriela Barenboim, Anne-Katherine Burns · hep-ph, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：宇宙学停滞可以多次重复，每一次都会在暴胀引力波背景（IGWB）上留下特征印记。我们将单历元谱模板推广到任意 N 个连续停滞历元，推导出闭式的 N 历元分段模板；该模板可干净地因子化：每个断点处的振幅台阶完全由该历元的局域状态方程 w_s^{(i)} 决定，而历元间平台高度则编码了此前所有历元累积的谱倾斜。每一个可分辨的谱特征都提供对文献中建立的 Bessel 函数一致性关系 C^2 = C^2(α) 的独立检验；N 个此类检验被非停滞谱同时满足的概率随 N 急剧下降，因此一个得到确认的多历元梳是对常 w 替代方案的最强判别。我们将此形式应用于文献中的三重停滞情景，该情景依次串联三种两两停滞机制（物质/辐射、真空能/物质、真空能/辐射）。对每个区块，我们导出历元位于模板有效范围 w_s > -1/3 内的条件。我们表明文献中的 Fig. 3 基准落在该范围之外，并识别出既物理可实现又可用该模板处理的参数选择。我们针对代表性的两区块和三区块链数值验证了平台间比值预言，并讨论了相邻区块共享一个断点频率、且中间没有辐射主导间隔的接触历元极限。最后，我们讨论多种多历元停滞情景的可探测性，并给出最小可探测张量标量比随重复停滞历元数的函数。

English: Cosmological stasis can recur multiple times, and each occurrence imprints a characteristic feature on the inflationary gravitational wave background (IGWB). We extend the single-epoch spectral template to an arbitrary number $N$ of consecutive stasis epochs, deriving a closed-form $N$-epoch piecewise template that factorizes cleanly: the amplitude steps at each break are determined entirely by the local equation of state $w_s^{(i)}$ of that epoch, while the inter-epoch plateau levels encode the accumulated spectral tilt from all prior epochs. Each resolved spectral feature yields an independent test of the Bessel-function consistency relation $C^2 = C^2(\alpha)$ established in~\cite{BarenboimBurns:paper1}, and the probability that $N$ such tests are simultaneously satisfied by a non-stasis spectrum falls sharply with $N$, making a confirmed multi-epoch comb the strongest available discriminator against constant-$w$ alternatives. We apply the formalism to the triple-stasis scenario of~\cite{Dienes:2023ziv}, which chains three pairwise stasis mechanisms (matter/radiation, vacuum-energy/matter, vacuum-energy/radiation) sequentially. For each block we derive the conditions under which the epoch lies within the template's validity range $w_s > -1/3$. We show that the Fig.~3 benchmark of~\cite{Dienes:2023ziv} falls outside this range and identify parameter choices that are both physically realizable and accessible to the template. We validate the inter-plateau ratio predictions numerically for representative two- and three-block chains, and work out the touching-epoch limit in which consecutive blocks share a break frequency without an intervening radiation-dominated interval. Finally, we discuss the detectability of a variety of multi-epoch stasis scenarios and give the minimum detectable tensor-to-scalar ratio as a function of the number of recurrent stasis epochs.

中文摘要：我们研究了在事件视界附近放置部分反射面的 Schwarzschild-AdS 黑洞的标量准正规模（QNM）谱。相应的 QNM 问题用 Chebyshev 谱配置法数值求解。所得谱在实部足够大时呈现特征性的腔结构，其中模式形成近似等间距的序列，其间距和阻尼主要由腔长度和表面反射率控制。对于大 AdS 半径，由于离心势垒与 AdS 势墙之间的囚禁，会出现额外的弱阻尼准束缚态分支。我们表明这些谱特征可以在有限径向腔图像中理解。WKB 分析对具有高实部的谱给出了定量渐近描述。我们发现近视界边界条件的改变可导致 QNM 谱的显著变化，表明 Schwarzschild-AdS QNM 对视界修正效应具有强敏感性。

English: We investigate the scalar quasinormal mode (QNM) spectrum of Schwarzschild-AdS black holes with a partially reflective surface placed near the event horizon. The corresponding QNM problem is solved numerically using Chebyshev spectral collocation. The resulting spectra exhibit a characteristic cavity structure at sufficiently large real part, where the modes form approximately equally spaced sequences whose spacing and damping are controlled mainly by the cavity length and the surface reflectivity. For large AdS radius, an additional weakly damped quasibound-state branch appears due to trapping between the centrifugal barrier and the AdS potential wall. We show that these spectral features can be understood within a finite radial cavity picture. A WKB analysis provides a quantitative asymptotic description of the spectra which have high real parts. We find that changes in the near-horizon boundary condition can lead to substantial changes in the QNM spectrum, indicating the strong sensitivity of Schwarzschild--AdS QNMs to the effect of horizon correction.

中文摘要：双中子星并合的引力波观测通过波形中的有限尺寸效应探测中子星物态方程。这些效应包括双星相互潮汐形变，对于旋转中子星还包括自旋诱导的四极矩。通常为避免引入额外依赖物态方程的参数，波形模型通过所谓准普适关系将该四极矩与潮汐形变联系起来。这些关系在慢转近似下导出，在较大自旋（如毫秒脉冲星）下变得不可靠。我们尝试通过显式考虑自旋来扩展已有准普适关系，在一系列物态方程和自旋 0.15≤|χ|≤0.6 范围内用数值计算的四极矩进行校准，并通过构造强制 χ→0 极限。所得自旋扩展关系在该范围内将相对于慢转关系的中位绝对百分比误差降低 66%。使用自旋扩展关系进行参数估计在某些情形下减小了恢复内禀参数的偏差，不过考虑族群时，质量-自旋简并导致的偏差在很大程度上占主导。这些结果为旋转中子星双星的自旋诱导四极矩提供了更准确描述，适用于第三代引力波探测器的波形建模。

English: Gravitational-wave observations of binary neutron star mergers probe the neutron star equation of state through finite-size effects on the waveform. These include the tidal deformation of the stars due to their respective companion, but for spinning neutron stars also include the spin-induced quadrupole moment of the stars. Typically, to avoid introducing additional equation of state dependent parameters, waveform models relate this quadrupole moment to the tidal deformability through so-called quasi-universal relations. These are derived under the slow-rotation approximation, which at larger spins, i.e., for millisecond pulsars, becomes unreliable. We attempt to extend the existing quasi-universal relations by explicitly accounting for the spin, calibrating it against numerically computed quadrupole moments across a broad set of equations of state and spins $0.15 \leq |\chi| \leq 0.6$ with the $\chi\rightarrow 0$ limit enforced by construction. The resulting spin-extended relation reduces the median absolute percentage error relative to the slow-rotation relation by 66\% across this range. Parameter estimation using the spin-extended relation reduces biases in recovered intrinsic parameters in some cases, though biases from mass-spin degeneracies dominate largely when a population is considered. These results provide a more accurate description of the spin-induced quadrupole moment for spinning neutron star binaries, relevant for waveform modelling with third-generation gravitational-wave detectors.

中文摘要：引力波记忆是由一列引力波爆发引起的时空几何的永久改变。它在理论上因与渐近对称性的联系而有趣，但尚未被观测到。即将到来的激光干涉空间天线（LISA）被预测能在来自超大质量黑洞（SMBH）并合的响亮事件中直接探测到记忆。我们评估记忆贡献的累积效应作为随机引力波记忆背景（SGWMB）的前景。使用两个 SMBH 族群模型，我们复现了先前得到的单事件信噪比预测，并计算未分辨背景的功率谱，使用数值相对论波形来建模每个事件期间的记忆信号。我们发现预测谱显著小于用 Heaviside 函数建模记忆波形所得到的谱，预期信噪比量级为 O(0.1-10)。我们进一步发现我们的模型倾向于一个高度非高斯的（“爆米花”）谱，表明该背景可能不会表现为连续、重叠信号的并集，而是一系列间歇性爆发。在这两项度量中，我们证明当前任何谱预测都严重依赖于族群模型的选择。我们结合未来 LISA 任务解释这些发现，并强调它们对于在 LISA 全局拟合中正确处理记忆的重要性。

English: Gravitational-wave (GW) memory is a permanent change in spacetime geometry induced by a burst of gravitational waves. It is theoretically interesting for its connection to asymptotic symmetries, but has not yet been observed. The upcoming Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) is predicted to detect memory directly in loud events from supermassive black hole (SMBH) mergers. We assess the prospects for the cumulative effect of memory contributions as a stochastic GW memory background (SGWMB). Using two SMBH population models, we recover previously obtained single-event SNR forecasts and compute the power spectrum of the unresolved background, using numerical-relativity waveforms for modeling the memory signal during each event. We find the predicted spectrum is significantly smaller than ones found by modeling the memory waveform with a Heaviside function, with expected SNRs of order $O(0.1-10)$. We further find that our models favor a highly non-Gaussian ("popcorn") spectrum, demonstrating that the background may not appear as the union of continuous, overlapping signals, but rather as a collection of intermittent bursts. In both measures, we demonstrate that any current prediction of the spectrum is heavily dependent on the choice of population model. We interpret these findings in the light of the future LISA mission and emphasize their importance for properly handling memory within the LISA global fit.

About a mass $M$, this carries an encoding area $A_E = \lambda \varphi \ell_p^2 = \lambda R_g r \le A$ in a UV-IR consistent coupling $\ell_p^2= G\hbar/c^3$ to its Compton phase $\varphi = (mc/\hbar)r \propto 1/\hbar$. Here, $\lambda = 8\pi $ is fixed by the Newtonian limit at large distances and the saturation limit $A_E=A$ at horizon about $M$ based on the non-local extension of the equivalence principle in Rindler spacetime, without using the Einstein equations. The result shows a non-thermal origin of the scaling dimension of two of gravitational phase space, previously derived based on the second law of thermodynamics by Bekenstein (1973), with possible implications for cosmological spacetime.

Horizon--orbit scale competition underlying chaos bound violation for spinning particles

Deyou Chen, Chuang Yang, Kangqiao Liu · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：本文通过在 black-bounce--Kerr--Newman 时空中，带电自旋试验粒子在不稳定圆轨道上的局域径向不稳定性，来研究混沌界。我们的结果表明，混沌界的破坏由局域轨道不稳定性尺度与表面重力尺度之间的竞争所支配；黑洞背景的变化和粒子动力学的变化提供了两条通往同一阈值跨越的互补途径。背景变化会影响两个尺度，并且当表面重力比轨道不稳定性受到更强抑制时，可驱动系统进入破坏混沌界的区域。相比之下，在固定背景下，表面重力保持不变，跨越阈值的转变由粒子参数引起的不稳定轨道动力学变化所驱动。因此，背景控制路径和探针动力学控制路径是统一的视界—轨道尺度竞争的两种实现，而不是彼此独立的机制。

English: In this paper, we investigate the chaos bound through the local radial instability of charged spinning test particles on unstable circular orbits in the black-bounce--Kerr--Newman spacetime. Our results show that violation of the bound is governed by the competition between the local orbital-instability scale and the surface gravity scale, with variations of the black hole background and the particle dynamics providing two complementary routes to the same threshold crossing. Background variations affect both scales and can drive the system into the bound-violating regime when the surface gravity is suppressed more strongly than the orbital instability. At fixed background, by contrast, the surface gravity remains unchanged, and the transition across the threshold is driven by changes in the unstable orbit dynamics induced by the particle parameters. The background-controlled and probe-dynamics-controlled routes therefore represent two realizations of a unified horizon--orbit scale competition rather than independent mechanisms.

一句话导读：在黑反弹-Kerr-Newman 时空中，带电自旋试验粒子的混沌界破坏由视界表面重力与轨道不稳定性尺度的竞争控制。

真空环状虫洞的定态推广

Stationary generalizations for the vacuum ring wormhole

Mikhail S. Volkov · gr-qc, hep-ph, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：环状虫洞是 Kerr 度规的零质量极限。其几何局部平坦，但拓扑非平凡，喉部连接两个渐近区域，环绕喉部的环上存在分布曲率奇点。我们构造了该静态虫洞的定态推广，它们不同于 Kerr，并且在跨虫洞喉部的反射下不变。问题约化为在相应对称条件下求解真空 Ernst 方程。此前已构造慢转微扰解，现在我们详细分析在数值框架下得到的非微扰解。对于慢转，它们表现出质量与角动量之间的非相对论关系 M∼J^2；在快转区域，当 J→∞ 且环被离心力无界拉伸时，该关系转变为 Regge 关系 J=M^2。然而，如果同时令静态极限中的环尺寸趋于零，则当喉部线速度趋近于 1 时，M 和 J 保持有界。虫洞几何随后趋近于极端 Kerr 解，从而“模仿”它。这些虫洞在环上带有曲率奇点，但可以通过简单的“标量化”程序消除，该程序将真空解提升为带有幻影标量场的规则虫洞。

English: The ring wormhole is the zero-mass limit of the Kerr metric. Its geometry is locally flat, but the topology is nontrivial, with a throat connecting two asymptotic regions and a distributional curvature singularity on the ring encircling the throat. We construct stationary generalizations of this static wormhole that are different from Kerr and invariant under reflections across the wormhole throat. The problem reduces to solving the vacuum Ernst equations subject to the corresponding symmetry conditions. The slowly rotating perturbative solutions were constructed previously, while we now present a detailed analysis of non-perturbative solutions obtained within a numerical framework. For slow rotation, they exhibit the non-relativistic relation $M\sim J^2$ between the mass and angular momentum, which transforms into the Regge relation $J=M^2$ in the fast-rotation regime, when $J\to\infty$ and the ring is stretched without bound by the centrifugal force. However, if the ring size in the static limit is sent to zero at the same time, then $M$ and $J$ remain bounded as the throat linear velocity approaches unity. The wormhole geometry then approaches the extremal Kerr solution, thus ``mimicking'' it. The wormholes carry a curvature singularity at the ring, but this can be removed by via simple ``scalarization'' procedure that promotes the vacuum solutions to regular wormholes with a phantom scalar field.

一句话导读：构造真空环状虫洞的定态、反射对称推广，数值求解 Ernst 方程，发现慢转 M∼J^2 过渡到快转 Regge 关系 J=M^2，并可通过标量化消除环奇点。

相对论弹性壳：材料支撑与空腔几何

Relativistic elastic shells: material support and cavity geometry

An T. Le · gr-qc, hep-th, physics.comp-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：我们推导决定有限厚度相对论弹性壳内部领头潮汐场和转动钟移的源矩。在弱引力和慢转动下，这些矩依赖于材料的弹性响应及其两个自由真空表面。两种弹性模量选择各自在弛豫附近保持因果，并对两个可观测量给出相反的符号。两种壳的面均呈扁椭球状并获得转动质量。潮汐依赖于差分扁率、体形变以及转动应力和能量；中心钟移测量一个不同的反半径矩。单一本构作用量决定材料支撑与响应。非负各向同性压强不能支撑具有两个自由真空表面的正密度物质静态球壳，而切向弹性应力允许在弛豫附近存在平衡态。对于足够弱的引力，这些平衡态满足主能量条件且声速亚光速。它们的静态空腔局部平坦，时钟相对于无穷远红移。在领头弱引力阶，静态红移和线性参考系拖曳探测同一个反半径质量矩。能量估计确立了径向线性稳定性，并排除了弱引力球对称平衡态的指数增长奇宇称模式。然而，非线性压缩仍可产生无界梯度，而材料保持因果。非球对称偶宇称稳定性、转动稳定性以及在有限转动下的定量界限仍然开放。空腔可观测量能够区分仅靠表面形状和总质量无法确定的材料响应。

English: We derive the source moments that determine the leading tidal field and rotational clock shift inside a finite-thickness relativistic elastic shell. In weak gravity and slow rotation, these moments depend on the elastic response of the material and its two free vacuum faces. Two choices of elastic moduli, each causal near relaxation, give opposite signs for both observables. Both shells have oblate faces and gain rotational mass. The tide depends on differential flattening, bulk deformation, and rotational stress and energy; the central clock shift measures a distinct inverse-radius moment. A single constitutive action determines the material support and response. Nonnegative isotropic pressure cannot support a static spherical shell of positive-density matter with two free vacuum faces, whereas tangential elastic stress admits equilibria near relaxation. For sufficiently weak gravity these equilibria obey the dominant energy condition and have subluminal sound speeds. Their static cavities are locally flat, with clocks redshifted relative to infinity. At leading weak-gravity order, static redshift and linear frame dragging probe the same inverse-radius mass moment. Energy estimates establish radial linear stability and exclude exponentially growing odd-parity modes for weakly gravitating spherical equilibria. Nonlinear compression can nevertheless produce unbounded gradients while the material remains causal. Nonspherical even-parity and rotating stability, together with quantitative bounds at finite rotation, remain open. The cavity observables distinguish material responses that surface shape and total mass alone do not determine.

一句话导读：推导有限厚度相对论弹性壳内的领头潮汐场与转动钟移，并研究弹性支撑、空腔红移/参考系拖曳及稳定性。

暴胀中标量诱导引力波的格点模拟

Lattice simulations of scalar-induced gravitational waves from inflation

Angelo Caravano, Gabriele Franciolini, S\'ebastien Renaux-Petel · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：标量诱导引力波（SIGWs）为探测远比宇宙微波背景和大尺度结构所及尺度更小的暴胀动力学提供了有力探针。在具有瞬态超慢滚（USR）阶段的场景中，曲率功率谱可在小尺度上被强烈增强，从而可能产生可观测的随机引力波背景。在此机制下，暴胀期间的标量动力学可能变得非线性，挑战标准微扰预测的有效性。现有 SIGWs 的半解析计算依赖于暴胀扰动的线性演化。在本工作中，我们使用格点模拟计算来自 USR 暴胀的 SIGWs。我们在暴胀期间非线性地演化暴胀子场，并非微扰地提取曲率扰动，然后通过线性演化牛顿势来模拟其在再加热后重新进入视界的过程，同时在张量源中保留原初涨落初始条件的完整非高斯结构。对于中等非高斯性，半解析预测能抓住引力波信号的正确数量级，但会得到重要修正。当暴胀非高斯性很大时，无论张量功率谱的整体幅度如何，它都可能在幅度和谱形状上严重失效。我们的结果表明，在此类场景中可靠预测 SIGWs 需要对暴胀标量动力学进行非微扰控制。本工作所用代码见 https://github.com/caravangelo/inflation-easy.git。

English: Scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) provide a powerful probe of inflationary dynamics on scales far smaller than those accessible to the cosmic microwave background and large-scale structure. In scenarios with a transient ultra-slow-roll (USR) phase, the curvature power spectrum can be strongly enhanced on small scales, potentially generating an observable stochastic GW background. In this regime, scalar dynamics during inflation can become nonlinear, challenging the validity of standard perturbative predictions. Existing semi-analytical calculations of SIGWs rely on the linear evolution of inflation fluctuations. In this work, we compute SIGWs from USR inflation using lattice simulations. We evolve the inflaton field nonlinearly during inflation and extract the curvature perturbation nonperturbatively, then simulate its post-reheating horizon re-entry by evolving the Newtonian potential linearly while retaining the full non-Gaussian structure of the initial conditions for the primordial fluctuations in the tensor source. For moderate non-Gaussianity, the semi-analytical prediction captures the correct order of magnitude of the GW signal but receives important corrections. When inflationary non-Gaussianities are large, it can fail dramatically in both amplitude and spectral shape, independently of the overall size of the tensor power spectrum. Our results show that reliable predictions of SIGWs in such scenarios require nonperturbative control of the inflationary scalar dynamics. The code used for this work is available at https://github.com/caravangelo/inflation-easy.git.

一句话导读：格点模拟显示，USR 暴胀的非线性标量动力学会显著修正甚至破坏标量诱导引力波的半解析预测。

湍流引力尾迹

Turbulent gravitational wakes

Giulio Taiocchi, Christiana Pantelidou, Miguel Zilh\~ao · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：我们在渐近 AdS4 时空中通过特征形式求解完整非线性爱因斯坦方程，构造了湍流引力尾迹。具体而言，我们表明作用于一个被推进的黑膜上的局域边界形变会产生一个尾迹，其边界动力学表现出相干涡旋结构的形成，这些结构被背景流向下游输运。分析沿 x 方向传播的尾迹，我们表明它显示出经典湍流尾迹的特征自相似标度。然后我们在视界面积密度、无迹视界外曲率和体度规扰动中识别出尾迹的几何印记，发现从渐近边界延伸到视界的相干结构。这些结果提供了四维渐近 AdS 时空中湍流引力尾迹的首次研究。

English: We construct turbulent gravitational wakes in asymptotically AdS$_4$ spacetimes by solving the full non-linear Einstein equations in the characteristic formulation. Specifically, we show that a localized boundary deformation acting on a boosted black brane generates a wake whose boundary dynamics exhibit the formation of coherent vortical structures that are advected downstream by the background flow. Analysing a wake propagating along the x direction, we show that it displays the characteristic self-similar scaling of classical turbulent wakes. We then identify the geometric imprint of the wake on the horizon area density, the traceless horizon extrinsic curvature, and bulk metric perturbations, finding coherent structures that extend from the asymptotic boundary to the horizon. These results provide the first study of turbulent gravitational wakes in four-dimensional asymptotically AdS spacetimes.

一句话导读：在渐近AdS4中通过求解非线性Einstein方程构造湍流引力尾迹，发现边界动力学中的相干涡旋与自相似标度，并追踪其视界和体度规几何印记。

弦电荷密度/比特线程对应及其在 IIB 型超引力中的 S-对偶

String charge density/bit threads correspondence and its S-duality in type IIB supergravity

Houwen Wu, Shuxuan Ying · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：我们识别出守恒弦电荷密度的空间投影与比特线程流。该对应赋予比特线程一种弦世界面描述，并允许我们从由世界面导出的流的最大熵通量计算黑洞熵。我们首先重现 BTZ 熵，然后将该构造推广到十维 F1-NS5-P 和 D1-D5-P 系统。在 IIB 型 S-对偶下，F1 流映射为 D1 流。尽管局域流、度规和流范数发生变化，最大物理通量保持不变并给出相同熵。这为该对应提供了非平凡检验。最后，我们提出一个 D1-D5 边界匹配猜想。在粗粒化图像中，每根弦电荷线定义一根携带熵的管。边界 CFT 纠缠熵和体黑洞熵都固定了管数与每根管携带的最大熵的乘积。对固定管离散化，它们给每根管分配相同容量。因此，它们描述相同的守恒最大熵通量，为纠缠熵与黑洞熵相等提供了信息流解释。

English: We identify the spatial projection of a conserved string charge density with a bit-thread flow. This correspondence gives bit threads a string worldsheet description and allows us to compute black hole entropy from the maximal entropy flux of a worldsheet-derived current. We first reproduce the BTZ entropy and then extend the construction to the ten-dimensional F1-NS5-P and D1-D5-P systems. Under Type IIB S-duality, the F1 current maps to the D1 current. Although the local currents, metrics, and flow norms change, the maximal physical flux remains unchanged and gives the same entropy. This provides a nontrivial check of the correspondence. Finally, we propose a D1-D5 boundary-matching conjecture. In the coarse-grained picture, each string-charge line defines an entropy-carrying tube. The boundary CFT entanglement entropy and the bulk black hole entropy both fix the product of the number of tubes and the maximum entropy carried by each tube. For a fixed tube discretization, they assign the same capacity to each tube. They therefore describe the same conserved maximal entropy flux, providing an information-flow interpretation of the equality between entanglement entropy and black hole entropy.

一句话导读：通过将守恒弦电荷密度的空间投影对应为比特线程流，该文从世界面最大熵通量重现 BTZ 及十维 D-brane 系统黑洞熵，并用 IIB S-对偶提出 D1-D5 边界匹配猜想。

Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS 引力中洛伦兹 Taub-NUT 时空的热力学

Thermodynamics of Lorentzian Taub-NUT spacetimes in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS gravity

Borja Diez · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：我们研究任意偶数维 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS 引力中洛伦兹 Taub-NUT 时空的热力学，这些时空构造为 Einstein-Kähler 底流形上的 U(1) 纤维丛。我们由表面引力计算温度，并使用 off-shell Abbott-Deser-Tekin 形式，将能量取为与稳态 Killing 矢量相关的守恒荷。在同一框架内，我们将熵作为视界 Noether 荷获得。结果与 Iyer-Wald 公式一致，并包含对 Bekenstein-Hawking 面积律的 Gauss-Bonnet 修正。在 Misner 弦出现时保留它们，我们建立了具有完全同质性的第一定律，其中 NUT 参数独立于视界半径变化。这需要额外的热力学荷及其共轭势，我们明确确定它们。我们还简要讨论了静态极限。

English: We study the thermodynamics of Lorentzian Taub--NUT spacetimes in Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet AdS gravity in arbitrary even dimensions, constructed as $U(1)$ fibrations over Einstein--K\"ahler base manifolds. We compute the temperature from the surface gravity and the energy as the conserved charge associated with the stationary Killing vector using the off-shell Abbott--Deser--Tekin formalism. Within the same framework, we obtain the entropy as a horizon Noether charge. The result agrees with the Iyer--Wald formula and includes a Gauss--Bonnet correction to the Bekenstein--Hawking area law. Retaining the Misner strings whenever present, we formulate a first law of full cohomogeneity in which the NUT parameter varies independently of the horizon radius. This requires an additional thermodynamic charge and its conjugate potential, which we determine explicitly. We also briefly discuss the static limit.

一句话导读：在任意偶数维 EGB AdS 引力中，用 ADT/Iyer-Wald 形式研究洛伦兹 Taub-NUT 时空热力学，并给出包含 NUT 荷与 Misner 弦贡献的第一定律。

Randall-Sundrum 膜世界场景中的快子（不）稳定性

Tachyonic (In)stability in Randall-Sundrum Braneworld Scenarios

Abhirup Karmakar, Soumitra SenGupta · hep-th, gr-qc, hep-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：低能有效理论为高维几何中的四维物理提供自然描述，其中体几何的印记表现为低维理论的参数。受第一代标量-张量引力中 Damour-Esposito-Farèse (DEF) 自发标量化模型启发，我们研究膜世界场景中快子不稳定与自发标量化的可能性。我们考虑双膜 Randall-Sundrum 模型，其中任一膜上的低能有效理论具有标量-张量性质，额外维 radion 扮演标量角色。我们在三种情形下确定了任一膜上 radion 场快子（不）稳定性的可能性：具有精细调节条件因而 radion 势恒为零的 RS 模型；无精细调节且 radion 势完全来自引力部分的 RS 模型；以及具有体稳定化场、产生带有极小值 radion 势的 RS 模型。对于含体稳定化场情形，我们发现膜上 T>0 的物质会改变 radion 的 VEV，破坏规范层级问题的解决，而膜上 T<0 的物质不改变 radion 的稳定性与 VEV。我们进一步确定了膜上 dS4 与 AdS4 几何下 radion 场快子（不）稳定性的精确条件。

English: Low-energy effective theories provide a natural description of four-dimensional physics in higher-dimensional geometries, where the imprint of the bulk geometry appears as parameters of the lower-dimensional theory. Inspired by the Damour-Esposito-Far\'ese (DEF) model of spontaneous scalarization in first generation Scalar-Tensor theories of gravity, we investigate the possibility of tachyonic instability and spontaneous scalarization in braneworld scenarios. We consider the two-brane Randall-Sundrum model where the low-energy effective theory on either brane is of scalar-tensor nature with the extra-dimensional radion playing the role of the scalar. We have determined the possibilities for tachyonic (in)stability of the radion field on either brane in three scenarios: the Randall-Sundrum (RS) model with fine-tuning conditions in which the potential of the radion field vanishes identically, the RS model without fine-tunings where the radion potential arises purely from the gravity sector and the RS model with a bulk stabilizing field that generates a radion potential with a minimum. With the bulk stabilizing field, we have found that on-brane matter with $T>0$ changes the VEV of the radion, destroying the resolution of the gauge hierarchy problem, whereas on-brane matter with $T<0$ does not alter the stability and VEV of the radion. We further determined the exact condition of tachyonic (in)stability of radion field with the on-brane dS$_4$ and AdS$_4$ geometries.

一句话导读：研究双膜 Randall-Sundrum 膜世界中 radion 的快子不稳定与自发标量化条件。

带电、复合与延展探针的全息Krylov复杂度

Holographic Krylov Complexity for Charged, Composite and Extended Probes

Horatiu Nastase, Carlos Nunez, Dibakar Roychowdhury · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：我们研究具有非平凡内部结构的算符以及真正延展算符的全息展开/Krylov复杂度。首先考虑在 AdS5×S5 中携带守恒 R-荷的大质量粒子，并展示内部空间运动如何改变复杂度增长，从而给出对称性分辨 Krylov 复杂度的自然全息实现。然后转向从场论观点看有效点状但在体空间具有内在结构的探针：重子顶点位形和巨引力子。结果表明，对这一大类有结构但点状的探针，大时间领头行为保持共形理论中局域算符预期的特征形式，而内部结构和诱导荷产生有信息量的次领头效应。我们还研究一个真正延展的探针，即沿空间方向拉伸并在 AdS 中下落的基本弦，作为非局域算符展开复杂度的模型。此时，尽管领头行为仍表现出预期增长模式，次领头项和中间区域与点状探针定性不同。这提供具体证据表明延展算符携带更精细的展开复杂度概念，对其空间结构敏感。我们的结果拓宽了可显式分析全息 Krylov 复杂度的探针类别，厘清哪些特征是普适的、哪些依赖算符性质，并开辟了更精细理解带电、复合和延展激发复杂度的场论途径。

English: We study the holographic spread/Krylov complexity of operators with non-trivial internal structure and of genuinely extended operators. We first consider a massive particle in AdS$_5\times S^5$ carrying conserved $R$-charge, and show how motion in the internal space modifies the complexity growth, yielding a natural holographic realisation of symmetry-resolved Krylov complexity. We then move to probes that are effectively pointlike from the field-theory viewpoint but possess an intrinsic structure in the bulk: baryon-vertex configurations and giant gravitons. Our results indicate that, for this broad class of structured but pointlike probes, the leading large-time behaviour retains the characteristic form expected for local operators in conformal theories, while the internal structure and induced charges produce informative subleading effects. We also study a genuinely extended probe, a fundamental string falling in AdS while stretched along a spatial direction, as a model for the spread complexity of a non-local operator. In this case, although the leading behaviour still exhibits the expected growth pattern, the subleading terms and intermediate regimes differ qualitatively from those of pointlike probes. This provides concrete evidence that extended operators carry a finer notion of spread complexity, sensitive to their spatial structure. Our results broaden the class of probes for which holographic Krylov complexity can be analysed explicitly, clarify which features are universal and which depend on the nature of the operator, and open a promising route toward a sharper field-theory understanding of complexity for charged, composite and extended excitations.

一句话导读：研究 AdS5×S5 中带电粒子、重子顶点、巨引力子及延展弦的全息 Krylov/展开复杂度，比较点状与延展探针的普适和次领头特征。

相关度：medium — 属于 AdS/CFT 全息理论，并讨论探针与复杂度，但不直接落在给出的重点标签支线（如全息超流超导、p波、D3-D7/D3-D5、经典引力等）上。

Einstein-dilaton 全息 QCD 中矢量介子的电磁形状因子

Electromagnetic form factors of vector mesons in Einstein-dilaton holographic QCD

Alfonso Ballon-Bayona, Tobias Frederico, Luis A. H. Mamani, Ad\~ao S. da Silva Junior, Wayne de Paula · hep-ph, hep-lat, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：我们在基于带共形禁闭背景的 Einstein-dilaton 引力的全息 QCD 框架内研究 ρ 介子家族的电磁形状因子。我们通过三点同位旋流关联函数的谱分解，以及基于 Kaluza-Klein 展开的独立方法，得到弹性形状因子和跃迁形状因子。此外，我们建立了流矩阵元的全息字典。弹性形状因子与现有格点 QCD 结果一致，而跃迁形状因子尚未由格点 QCD 确定，是该模型的预言。对于弹性情形，ρ 介子家族的电形状因子在 q^2=6 m_{ρ^n}^2 处出现零点，对基态尤其为 q^2=3.61 GeV^2，与光前和 Dyson-Schwinger 计算一致。我们还计算了矢量介子态之间的强耦合，并发现一些近似选择定则。在弹性情形和低 q^2 区域，我们计算无量纲电半径、磁矩和四极矩，并与其他方法比较。在高 q^2 区域，形状因子遵循预期的标度行为，模型预言其渐近归一化。高 q^2 区域的结果导致超收敛关系，并建立了一个涉及质量、衰变常数和耦合的新求和规则。

English: We investigate the electromagnetic form factors of the $\rho$ meson family within a holographic QCD framework based on Einstein-dilaton gravity with confining backgrounds. We obtain the elastic and transition form factors using a spectral decomposition of the three-point isospin current correlator and an independent approach based on the Kaluza-Klein expansion. Furthermore, we establish a holographic dictionary of the current matrix element. The elastic form factors are in agreement with available lattice QCD results, whereas the transition form factors, not yet determined within lattice QCD, are predictions of the model. For the elastic case, the electric form factor for the $\rho$ meson family exhibits a zero at $q^{2} = 6\, m_{\rho^{n}}^{2}$ and in particular for the ground state $q^{2} = 3.61\,\text{GeV}^{2}$, consistent with light-front and Dyson-Schwinger calculations. We also compute strong couplings between vector meson states and find some approximate selection rules. In the elastic case and low-$q^{2}$ regime, we calculate dimensionless electric radius, magnetic and quadrupole moments and compare with other approaches. In the high-$q^{2}$ regime, the form factors follow the expected scaling behavior, and the model predicts their asymptotic normalization. The results in the high-$q^{2}$ regime lead to superconvergence relations and establish a new sum rule involving masses, decay constants and couplings.

一句话导读：在 Einstein-dilaton 全息 QCD 中计算 ρ 介子家族的电磁形状因子、强耦合与高能求和规则。

On the Extended Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson Spacetime: Two Black Holes and a Naked Singularity in Bertotti-Robinson Universe

Yu-Sen Zhou, Wen-Tao Fu, Li-Ming Cao, Rong-Gen Cai · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：我们引入新坐标，以与先前的 reciprocal continuation 一致的方式扩展 Kerr--Newman--Bertotti--Robinson 时空。在这些坐标中，Ω=0 处的两个点被解并为完整的 Bertotti--Robinson 零无穷。扩展时空描述了两个共享具有非平凡拓扑的共同外部的黑洞，以及一个裸环奇点。在规则静态极限下，新坐标将时空整体等同于平衡的 Alekseev--García 几何。

English: We introduce new coordinates that extend the Kerr--Newman--Bertotti--Robinson spacetime consistently with the previous reciprocal continuation. In these coordinates, the two points at $\Omega=0$ are resolved into complete Bertotti--Robinson null infinities. The extended spacetime describes two black holes sharing a common exterior of nontrivial topology, together with a naked ring singularity. In the regular static limit, the new coordinates globally identify the spacetime with the balanced Alekseev--Garc\'ia geometry.

从不变 Weyl-可积时空（IWIST）构造引力

Gravity from Invariant Weyl-Integrable space-time (IWIST)

Jos\'e Edgar Madriz Aguilar, A. Bernal, M. Montes, J. Zamarripa · gr-qc, hep-th, math-ph, math.MP, physics.space-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：本文提出一种在不变 Weyl-可积时空（IWIST）中具有几何动机的引力表述；其中背景几何并非先验给定，而是通过 Palatini 变分原理动力学地确定。对于非最小耦合到引力的标量场作用量，所得相容性条件定义了一个 Weyl-可积几何，该几何在度规和几何标量场的局域 Weyl 变换下保持不变。我们构造一个同时满足微分同胚不变性和 Weyl 变换不变性的作用量，并基于散度定理的不变扩展引入 Weyl 协变变分程序。针对度规、Weyl 标量和 Weyl 规范场得到相应场方程。我们进一步在 Einstein-Riemann 标架中表述该理论；在此标架中有效度规为黎曼型，标量场被重新解释为具有几何起源的物理自由度。最后，我们通过引入 Weyl 规范场与由标量部分构造的流之间的耦合，提出一种显式破缺 Weyl 对称性的几何机制。所得理论仍保持微分同胚协变性，但偏离局域 Weyl 不变性。破缺理论的 Einstein-Riemann 表示包含一个额外的广义协变相互作用，使得 Weyl 不变模型成为更一般引力理论的一个特定极限。

English: In this paper we propose a geometrically motivated formulation of gravity in an invariant Weyl--Integrable space-time (IWIST), in which the background geometry is not imposed a priori but is dynamically determined through the Palatini variational principle. For a scalar field non-minimally coupled to gravity action, the resulting compatibility condition defines a Weyl--Integrable geometry which is preserved by a local Weyl transformation of the metric and the geo\-me\-tri\-cal scalar field. We construct an action invariant under both diffeomorphisms and Weyl transformations and introduce a Weyl-covariant variational procedure based on an invariant extension of the divergence theorem. The corresponding field equations are obtained for the metric, the Weyl scalar, and the Weyl gauge field. We further formulate the theory in the Einstein--Riemann frame, where the effective metric is Riemannian and the scalar field is re\-inter\-pre\-ted as a phy\-si\-cal degree of freedom of geometric origin. Finally, we propose a geometrical mechanism for the explicit breaking of Weyl symmetry by introducing a coupling between the Weyl gauge field and a current constructed from the scalar sector. The resulting theory remains diffeomorphism covariant while departing from local Weyl invariance. The Einstein--Riemann representation of the broken theory contains an additional generally covariant interaction, making the Weyl-invariant model a particular limit of a more general gravitational theory.

一句话导读：在不变 Weyl-可积时空中用 Palatini 变分构造引力，并给出 Weyl 对称性显式破缺机制及 Einstein-Riemann 标架表述。

Casimir支撑的可穿越虫洞的高阶广义不确定原理修正

Higher-order generalized uncertainty principle corrections to Casimir-supported traversable wormholes

Jureeporn Yuennan, Allah Ditta, Thammarong Eadkhong, Kazuharu Bamba, Phongpichit Channuie · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：我们研究了由Casimir真空能支持、并带有二阶广义不确定原理（GUP）修正的可穿越虫洞。对于两个代表性GUP模型，我们推导了Casimir能量的高阶修正，并在广义相对论中构造了精确虫洞解。所得几何满足喉部、外翻和渐近平坦条件。高阶修正改变虫洞质量并减少所需的奇异物质，尽管在喉部附近零能量条件和弱能量条件仍被违反。我们进一步分析弱引力透镜和引力波回声，发现可能区分不同GUP实现方式的模型依赖信号。通过将解中使用的无量纲参数与传统的现象学GUP参数相联系，我们表明其物理解释强烈依赖于喉半径。大多数当前实验界限倾向于，对可观的GUP修正而言喉部接近普朗克尺度；而宏观喉部通常需要弱得多的修正。这些结果为用实验室约束和天体物理观测检验GUP修正的Casimir虫洞提供了一个框架。

English: We investigate traversable wormholes supported by Casimir vacuum energy with second-order generalized uncertainty principle (GUP) corrections. For two representative GUP models, we derive higher-order corrections to the Casimir energy and construct exact wormhole solutions in general relativity. The resulting geometries satisfy the throat, flare-out, and asymptotic-flatness conditions. Higher-order corrections modify the wormhole mass and reduce the exotic matter required, although the null and weak energy conditions remain violated near the throat. We further analyze weak gravitational lensing and gravitational-wave echoes, finding model-dependent signatures that may distinguish different GUP realizations. By relating the dimensionless parameter used in the solutions to the conventional phenomenological GUP parameter, we show that its physical interpretation depends strongly on the throat radius. Most current experimental bounds favor near-Planckian throats for appreciable GUP corrections, while macroscopic throats generally require much weaker corrections. These results provide a framework for confronting GUP-corrected Casimir wormholes with laboratory constraints and astrophysical observations.

一句话导读：在广义相对论中构造含二阶GUP修正的Casimir可穿越虫洞，并分析能量条件、弱引力透镜与引力波回声特征。

具有暗电弱场的玻色星

Bosonic stars with dark electroweak fields

Etevaldo dos Santos Costa Filho, Romain Gervalle · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：我们在 Einstein-Weinberg-Salam 理论，即电弱标准模型的玻色子部分与 Einstein 引力理论最小耦合，中构造玻色星。这些位形处处正则、球对称且渐近平坦，由质量来自 Higgs 机制的大质量 W 和 Z 玻色子的静态凝聚体组成。尽管相应场在自然界中存在，但在物理电弱能标下引力效应可忽略，这些位形将是微观的。因此，在保持 Newton 常数和电弱质量比为其物理值的情况下，我们将该模型解释为一个暗电弱理论的玻色子部分，其能标与通常电弱理论截然不同。选取超轻矢量玻色子质量 m_W c^2 = 8.7×10^-13 eV（由 GW190521 的 Proca 星解释所建议），我们的玻色星可以达到中等质量黑洞范围的质量。

English: We construct bosonic stars in the Einstein-Weinberg-Salam theory, namely the bosonic sector of the electroweak Standard Model minimally coupled to Einstein's theory of gravity. These configurations are everywhere regular, spherically symmetric and asymptotically flat, consisting of a static condensate of the massive $W$ and $Z$ bosons, whose masses arise from the Higgs mechanism. Although the corresponding fields exist in nature, gravitational effects are negligible at the physical electroweak scale and the configurations would be microscopic. Keeping Newton's constant and the electroweak mass ratios at their physical values, we therefore interpret the model as the bosonic sector of a \textit{dark} electroweak theory with a radically different energy scale. Choosing the ultralight vector boson mass $m_{\mathrm{W}}c^{2}=8.7\times10^{-13}\,$eV, as suggested by the Proca star interpretation of GW190521, our bosonic stars can attain masses in the intermediate-mass black hole range.

一句话导读：在 Einstein-Weinberg-Salam 理论中构造球对称玻色星，并将物理电弱能标重解释为暗电弱理论，使其质量可落在中等质量黑洞范围。

仿射 ABCD 箭图上的 M2-膜矩阵模型与费米气体

M2-brane matrix models and Fermi gas on affine ABCD quivers

Taro Kimura, Tomoki Nosaka · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：我们研究了一类新的 M2-膜矩阵模型，它们与仿射 BC 箭图以及扭曲仿射 AD 箭图相关。这些模型在大 N 极限下自由能表现出特征的 N^{3/2} 标度。我们建立费米气体形式，并证明其巨正则和由 Fredholm Pfaffian 给出，这与仿射 D 箭图矩阵模型平行。所得的费米气体密度矩阵除了标准双曲依赖外，还显示出对正则位置/动量算符的有理依赖。这导致非常规的次领头修正，阻碍了在先前研究的 M2-膜矩阵模型中观察到的自由能 1/N 展开中的 Airy 函数结构。

English: We study a new class of M2-brane matrix models associated with affine BC and twisted affine AD quivers. These models exhibit the characteristic $N^{3/2}$ scaling of the free energy in the large $N$ limit. We establish a Fermi gas formalism and demonstrate that their grand canonical sum is given by a Fredholm Pfaffian, which is in parallel with the affine D quiver matrix models. The resulting Fermi gas density matrix shows a rational dependence on the canonical position/momentum operators in addition to the standard hyperbolic dependence. This leads to unconventional sub-leading corrections, which obstruct the Airy function structure in the $1/N$ expansion of the free energy observed in the previously studied M2-brane matrix models.

一句话导读：研究仿射 BC 和扭曲仿射 AD 箭图的 M2-膜矩阵模型，建立 Fredholm Pfaffian 费米气体形式并发现阻碍 Airy 行为的次领头修正。

后闵可夫斯基动力学中的环境效应：相对论流体中致密天体的有效场论、费曼规则与 Ward 恒等式

Environmental Effects in Post-Minkowskian Dynamics: Effective Field Theory, Feynman Rules, and Ward Identities for Compact Objects in Relativistic Fluids

Zvi Bern, Samuel Degen, Enrico Herrmann, Mikhail P. Solon, Anna M. Wolz · hep-th, gr-qc, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：我们为在无粘流体环境中运动的致密天体的引力动力学发展了一个流体力学有效场论。流体由理想流体的有效理论描述，其 Goldstone 声子作为与引力耦合的显式场保留。我们为所得费曼规则建立了自洽的幂次计数，并在 D 维中推导出直到四点的传播子和相互作用顶点，以及它们满足的广义在壳 Ward 恒等式。这些恒等式将带有一个外腿引力子的振幅与将引力子替换为声子的振幅联系起来，从而为高阶计算提供非平凡检验。作为应用，我们从单声子发射的树级振幅恢复了领头阶相对论动力学摩擦力。本工作是迈向将环境效应纳入后闵可夫斯基计算所用散射振幅流程的工具箱的第一步。

English: We develop a hydrodynamic effective field theory for the gravitational dynamics of compact objects moving through an inviscid fluid environment. The fluid is described by the effective theory of perfect fluids, whose Goldstone phonons are kept as explicit fields coupled to gravity. We establish a consistent power counting for the resulting Feynman rules and derive the propagators and interaction vertices through four points in $D$ dimensions, together with the generalized on-shell Ward identities they obey. These identities relate amplitudes with an external graviton to those with the graviton replaced by a phonon, and thus provide nontrivial checks on higher-order calculations. As an application, we recover the leading-order relativistic dynamical-friction force from the tree-level amplitude for single-phonon emission. This work is a first step towards a toolkit for incorporating environmental effects into the scattering-amplitude pipeline used in post-Minkowskian calculations.

迈向引力路径积分的唯一滤波器

Toward a Unique Filter for the Gravitational Path Integral

Marc S. Klinger · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：在最近的工作中，McNamara 和 Wang 证明，引力路径积分（GPI）的因子化失败可被理解为其态谱的不完备性，方式是构造一个 GPI 可嵌入其中的幺正量子场论（QFT）。我们从代数角度考察这一构造，并借助条件期望理论验证作者关于 GPI 的幺正完成之存在性与唯一性的猜想。我们探讨如何将这种幺正 QFT 视为一个单一相干理论，其中系综平均的定量特征完全来自投影到底层的、光滑的 GPI。因此，联系这两个理论的条件期望可以解释为 Liu 意义上的滤波器。因子化理论与更标准的 QFT 不同，因为它是可约的，这意味着与空集相联系的 Hilbert 空间是非平凡的。我们解释可约 QFT 的结构如何一般地编码在弱 Hopf 代数对称性中，并展示这种弱结构如何允许广义 α-扇区和半虫洞共存于单一 Hilbert 空间。

English: In recent work, McNamara and Wang demonstrated that the failure of factorization for a gravitational path integral (GPI) can be understood as an incompleteness of its spectrum of states by constructing a unitary quantum field theory (QFT) into which the GPI embeds. We examine this construction from an algebraic point of view, and use it to verify a conjecture of the author concerning the existence and uniqueness of a unitary completion for the GPI by means of the theory of conditional expectations. We explore how the unitary QFT can be regarded as a single coherent theory in which the quantitative signatures of ensemble averaging emerge purely from projecting to the underlying, smooth GPI. The conditional expectation relating the two theories may therefore be interpreted as a filter in the sense of Liu. English: The Page curve and the island formula describe a reorganization of quantum information in Hawking radiation across the Page time. We study how this reorganization appears in correlations among emissions collected at several retarded times. The late radiation is treated as a covariant multi-time process, or process tensor, and $\chi_{\mathrm{island}}=\mathcal{N}_{\varnothing}-\mathcal{N}_{R}$ measures the temporal memory removed when the early radiation register $R$ is supplied. Operationally, this quantity is the corresponding change in the optimal distinguishability of the radiation process from a Markovian reference. We exhibit evaporation processes whose single-bin states and all process marginals below a finite order $k_\ast\geq 3$ remain fixed and coincide with a CP-divisible reference, while $\chi_{\mathrm{island}}$ changes by order one at order $k_\ast$. The Page transition can therefore appear as a transition in the Markov order of the radiation process. When the interior mediates the late-time memory, entanglement-wedge reconstruction of the predictive interior from $R$ Markovianizes the late process; conversely, when the late process has a minimal predictive memory and its future-affecting information is mediated by that memory, Markovianization by $R$ supplies a simulator of its influence. A Hayden--Preskill evaporation comb and an evaporating-JT calculation realize this mechanism. The late radiation retains temporal memory across the transition, while the early radiation becomes sufficient for predicting its future multi-time statistics.

中文摘要：我们通过将边界条件视为一般 Chern-Simons 边界相空间的约束约化，研究 AdS$_3$ 引力中的超对称边界动力学。我们关注约束结构如何控制约化后渐近对称代数的局域性和物理场内容。对于超对称 Kac--Moody 边界条件，幸存的玻色流保持局域，而费米子--费米子 Dirac 括号包含一个场依赖的一阶微分算子的逆，因此本质上是非局域的。施加额外的费米子约束会揭示进一步结构：在玻色子第二类约化之后，该约束变为第一类，并产生一个费米子规范冗余。一般而言，剩余费米子场可以被规范掉，而具有周期零模的特殊背景支持非平凡的物理费米子扇区。我们进一步采用 Batalin--Fradkin--Tyutin 形式，通过在扩大的相空间上将第二类约束转化为等价的局域第一类系统，从而消除约化对称代数的非局域性。

Imposing an additional fermionic constraint reveals a further structure: after the bosonic second-class reduction, it becomes first class and generates a fermionic gauge redundancy. Generically the remaining fermionic field can be gauged away, while special backgrounds with periodic zero modes support non-trivial physical fermionic sectors. We further employ the Batalin--Fradkin--Tyutin formalism to eliminate the non-locality of the reduced symmetry algebra by converting the second-class constraints into an equivalent local first-class system on an enlarged phase space.

中文摘要：我们考虑在 AdS3×S3×T4 上的 IIB 型弦理论，在大 AdS 半径展开下，相对 RR 和 NS-NS 通量取任意值。我们发展了一种计算该极限下对偶 CFT 中标度维度的方法，将弦场论计算（在有限量子化 NS-NS 通量下有效，但对 RR 通量微扰）与一个有限混合通量拟设相结合；该拟设受世界面宇称约束，并受经典弦解启发。我们将该方法应用于三族态。在纯 RR 极限下，我们的结果既与用世界面 bootstrap 计算的一族态一致，也与用可积性计算的另一族态一致。

English: We consider type IIB string theory on $\mathrm{AdS}_3\times \mathrm{S}^3\times \mathbb{T}^4$ in a large AdS radius expansion at arbitrary values of the relative RR and NS-NS fluxes. We develop a method for computing scaling dimensions in the dual CFT in this limit by combining a string field theory calculation, valid at finite quantized NS-NS flux but perturbative in RR flux, with a finite mixed-flux ansatz, which is constrained by worldsheet parity and motivated by classical string solutions. We apply the method to three families of states. In the pure-RR limit, our results agree both with a family of states computed using the worldsheet bootstrap and with another family computed using integrability.

Liang Ma, Peng-Yu Wu, H. Lu · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：我们通过标准解生成技术，在 Kaluza-Klein (KK) 理论中获得了处于外部均匀磁场中的 Kerr 黑洞。以此作为出发点，我们构造了精确静态解，描述在一般弦论启发的 Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton (EMD) 理论中浸没于外部均匀磁场的 Schwarzschild 黑洞，从而将静态 Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (KBR) 解嵌入 EMD 理论的一般框架。我们还构造了 EMD 理论中同时包含电场和磁场的电真空解，并将系统推广到包含多个 Maxwell 场和 dilaton 的情形。这些运动方程可约化为 Toda 型方程，使我们能够得到与所有 rank-2 Lie 群的 Toda 方程相关的解析电真空。我们进一步构造了浸没于这些电真空中的 Schwarzschild 黑洞的精确解。

English: We obtain the Kerr black hole in an external uniform magnetic field in the Kaluza-Klein (KK) theory via a standard solution-generating technique. Using this as our starting point, we construct exact static solutions describing a Schwarzschild black hole immersed in the external uniform magnetic field in general string-inspired Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton (EMD) theories, thereby embedding the static Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (KBR) solution into the general framework of EMD theories. We also construct electrovacuum solutions involving both electric and magnetic fields in EMD theories and generalize the system to include mutltiple Maxwell fields and dilatons. These equations of motion can be reduced to Toda-like equations, allowing us to obtain analytic electrovacua associated with Toda equations of all rank-2 Lie groups. We further construct exact solutions of a Schwarzschild black hole immersed in these electrovacua.

一句话导读：通过解生成技术构造 KK/EMD 理论中浸没于均匀磁场及 Toda 型电真空的 Schwarzschild 黑洞精确解。

确定性超图 SYK：无需无序平均的 melonic 主导与最大混沌

Deterministic Hypergraph SYK: Melonic Dominance and Maximal Chaos Without Disorder Averaging

Shiroman Prakash · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：我们证明，类似 SYK 的 melonic 可解性与最大混沌可以在一个稀疏确定性模型中存活，而无需无序平均。我们的确定性超图 SYK 模型（hSYK）由位于一个 q-均匀、d-正则相互作用超图上的 N 个 Majorana 费米子构成，只有 O(dN) 个相互作用项和均匀正耦合。在显式的几何与谱展开条件下，其两点函数满足标准 melonic Schwinger-Dyson 方程，精度到 O(d^{-1}) 修正；而在主导的大 d 鞍点处，领头双局域有效作用量与普通 SYK 相同。其连通四点函数分解为一个时间 SYK 梯形核与一个线图随机游走。一个有限线图谱隙控制着最大混沌均匀模在一般局域 OTOC 中的可见性，并通过对双局域谱中的非均匀空间模式打开能隙，排除了 Schwarzian 之外的额外轻涨落模式。精确对角化进一步显示了 melonic 两点标度、单实例 Wigner-Dyson 统计，以及所预言的 OTOC 图控空间衰减。因此，该模型提供了 SYK 基本 melonic 与混沌特征的一种无无序实现，其形式更适合量子模拟。

English: We show that SYK-like melonic solvability and maximal chaos survive in a sparse deterministic model, without disorder averaging. Our deterministic hypergraph SYK model (hSYK) consists of $N$ Majorana fermions on a $q$-uniform, $d$-regular interaction hypergraph with only $O(dN)$ interaction terms and uniform positive couplings. Under explicit geometric and spectral expansion conditions, its two-point function satisfies the standard melonic Schwinger-Dyson equation up to $O(d^{-1})$ corrections, while the leading bilocal effective action coincides with that of ordinary SYK at the dominant large-$d$ saddle. Its connected four-point function factorizes into a temporal SYK ladder kernel and a line-graph random walk. A finite line-graph spectral gap controls the visibility of the maximally chaotic uniform mode in generic localized OTOCs and, by gapping non-uniform spatial modes in the bilocal spectrum, excludes additional light fluctuation modes beyond the Schwarzian. Exact diagonalization further shows melonic two-point scaling, single-instance Wigner-Dyson statistics, and the predicted graph-controlled spatial decay of OTOCs. The model therefore offers a disorder-free realization of the essential melonic and chaotic features of SYK, in a form more amenable to quantum simulation.

一句话导读：确定性超图 SYK 模型无需无序平均即可保持 melonic 可解性与最大混沌，并给出可控 OTOC 空间衰减，便于量子模拟。

从散射振幅出发的宇宙学关联函数：综述

Cosmological Correlators from Scattering Amplitudes: A Review

Soner Albayrak, Savan Kharel · hep-th, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-18

中文摘要：CMB 和大尺度结构背后的原初统计信息编码在晚期宇宙学关联函数中（这些关联函数由宇宙波函数的系数构造）。它们是宇宙学中最接近 S 矩阵的类比物，然而标准 S 矩阵工具并不能直接适用。本综述解释现代散射振幅纲领（旋量螺旋度、在壳递归、双拷贝、正几何和广义幺正性）如何仍被推广到宇宙学，并通过一次解析延拓推广到欧几里得反 de Sitter 空间；在那里，同样的对象表现为全息边界关联函数，并且通常最易于计算。组织框架是晚期边界上的动量空间，在那里原初统计最简单，并且外腿的总能量（其动量模之和）控制解析结构。在总能量奇点处，平直空间散射振幅浮现。我们从波动方程出发发展这套工具，并用它计算树级标量、规范场和引力子关联函数，揭示不同自旋和维度之间的关系。随后我们展示如何利用宇宙学多胞形、在壳递归以及双拷贝的弯曲空间版本绕过体积分，然后推广到圈图、软极限、跃迁振幅和 (A)dS 切割规则。最后，我们将这些结构与暴胀可观测量以及三个相关纲领联系起来：宇宙学光学定理、宇宙学自举和宇宙学对撞机。我们以当前前沿的地图以及一组开放且有趣的问题作结。

English: The primordial statistics underlying the CMB and large-scale structure are encoded in late-time cosmological correlation functions (constructed from the coefficients of the wavefunction of the universe). They are the closest analogue cosmology has to an $S$-matrix, yet the standard $S$-matrix toolkit does not directly apply. This review explains how the modern scattering-amplitudes program (spinor helicity, on-shell recursion, the double copy, positive geometry, and generalized unitarity) has nevertheless been extended to cosmology and, through a single analytic continuation, to Euclidean anti-de Sitter space, where the same objects appear as holographic boundary correlators and are often cleanest to compute. The organizing framework is momentum space on the late-time boundary, where the primordial statistics are simplest and where the total energy of the external legs, the sum of their momentum magnitudes, controls the analytic structure. At the total-energy singularity, the flat-space scattering amplitude emerges. We develop this toolkit starting from the wave equation and use it to compute tree-level scalar, gauge-field, and graviton correlators, exposing relations across spins and dimensions. We then show how bulk integrals can be bypassed using cosmological polytopes, on-shell recursion, and curved-space versions of the double copy, before extending the discussion to loops, soft limits, transition amplitudes, and (A)dS cutting rules. Finally, we connect these structures to inflationary observables and to three allied programs: the cosmological optical theorem, the cosmological bootstrap, and the cosmological collider. We conclude with a map of the current frontier and a set of open and interesting problems.

一句话导读：综述如何将散射振幅技术推广到宇宙学关联函数，并经由解析延拓联系到欧几里得 AdS 全息边界关联函数。

English: We derive an entropy formula for a recently proposed tensor network model of states in 3D gravity which satisfy the constraint equations of diffeomorphism invariance, and including the effects of matter. 反德西特时空中聚合化真空规则黑洞的热力学

Thermodynamics of polymerized vacuum regular black holes in anti-de Sitter spacetime

Sepideh Bakhoda, Ioannis Soranidis · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-17

中文摘要：我们推导了一类受有效圈量子引力动力学启发的真空规则黑洞，并将该构造推广到渐近反德西特时空。推导基于去参数化的 Lemaitre--Tolman--Bondi 表述，其中引入辅助尘埃场仅用于定义内时，而不作为物质源。在球对称下，动力学约化为一组独立的径向壳层，产生因子化的壳层哈密顿量以及一个 Birkhoff 型性质：对于固定的重构函数和宇宙学常数，静态几何由质量唯一确定。在此框架内，我们建立了中心曲率规则性的条件，并构造了若干具有 de Sitter 核心的规则黑洞模型以及相应的具有 anti-de Sitter 核心的模型。随后我们在扩展相空间中研究其热力学，利用 Hawking--Page 相变比较 de Sitter 核心和 anti-de Sitter 核心分支，并表明它们的定量差异来自物理外视界分支的形变，而非仅来自规则性。

English: We derive a class of vacuum regular black holes inspired by effective loop quantum gravity dynamics and extend the construction to asymptotically anti-de Sitter spacetimes. The derivation is based on a deparameterized Lemaitre--Tolman--Bondi formulation, where an auxiliary dust field is introduced only to define an internal time and does not act as a matter source. In spherical symmetry, the dynamics reduces to a set of independent radial shells, giving rise to a factorized shell Hamiltonian and to a Birkhoff-type property: for a fixed reconstruction function and cosmological constant, the static geometry is uniquely determined by the mass. Within this framework, we establish the conditions for curvature regularity at the center and construct several regular black hole models with de Sitter cores and corresponding models with anti-de Sitter cores. We then study their thermodynamics in the extended phase space, using the Hawking--Page transition to compare the de Sitter- and anti-de Sitter-core branches and show that their quantitative differences arise from the deformation of the physical outer-horizon branch rather than from regularity alone.

一句话导读：构造了有效圈量子引力启发的 AdS 真空规则黑洞，并在扩展相空间中用 Hawking--Page 相变比较 dS 核与 AdS 核分支，指出热力学差异主要源于外视界分支形变而非规则性本身。

修改引力中的波光学引力波透镜

Wave-optics gravitational wave lensing in modified gravity

Alice Garoffolo, Gianmassimo Tasinato · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-17

中文摘要：我们启动了修改引力中波光学区引力波透镜的研究。我们考虑一个现象学设置，其中引力波振幅服从曲率耦合的传播方程。该框架在几何光学区再现标准广义相对论行为，同时导致定性不同的红外动力学。特别地，通常论证零频极限下放大因子趋于1不再适用。这是由于红外中曲率诱导相互作用的持续存在，改变了自然传播基本身。因此，标准菲涅耳处理在足够低频下失效。正确的红外区反而由相互作用的静态格林函数控制，有限频率完成由分波表述提供。我们证明该结构允许等价的畸变波解释，其中曲率相互作用被吸收进修饰的参考传播基，而残余透镜效应编码在有限频率相移中。我们进一步证明这些现象在散射振幅语言中有自然解释。因此，波光学透镜可以探测几何光学中完全不可见的传播层面偏离广义相对论。

English: We initiate the study of gravitational-wave lensing in the wave-optics regime within modified gravity. We consider a phenomenological setup in which the gravitational-wave amplitude obeys a curvature-coupled propagation equation. This framework reproduces the standard GR behaviour in the geometric-optics regime, while leading to qualitatively different infrared dynamics. In particular, the usual argument implying that the amplification factor approaches unity in the zero-frequency limit no longer applies. This is due to the persistence of curvature-induced interactions in the infrared, which modify the natural propagation basis itself. As a result, the standard Fresnel treatment ceases to be valid at sufficiently low frequency. The correct infrared regime is instead controlled by an interacting static Green function, with a finite-frequency completion provided by a partial-wave formulation. We show that this structure admits an equivalent distorted-wave interpretation, in which the curvature interaction is absorbed into a dressed reference propagation basis, while the residual lensing effect is encoded in finite-frequency phase shifts. We further demonstrate that these phenomena admit a natural interpretation in the language of scattering amplitudes. Wave-optics lensing can therefore probe propagation-level departures from GR that remain entirely invisible in geometric optics.

一句话导读：修改引力中波光学引力波透镜在红外区偏离广义相对论，可由静态格林函数、分波相移与散射振幅描述。
