中文摘要：轴子星的质量-半径关系常用不同阶的相对论近似计算，因此确定这些描述在何处可靠十分重要。本文对轴子星基态构型进行统一数值比较，涵盖牛顿薛定谔-泊松描述、一阶与二阶相对论有效场论，以及实标量场的完整爱因斯坦-克莱因-戈登系统。四种描述均采用相同的吸引四阶自相互作用，扫描 |\widetilde{\lambda}|=(M_{\rm Pl}/f_a)^2，并确定最大质量及相应的包含质量半径。所有描述都重现共同的大 |\widetilde{\lambda}| 稀薄星标度，但在弱与中等耦合下出现显著差异。相对论 EFT 系统地在牛顿与完整广义相对论结果之间插值。对于 max|\phi|/f_a=O(1) 的部分最大质量序列，我们在完整广义相对论中显式检验了时间谐波截断和势截断。高阶谐波展开收敛迅速，而恢复完整单余弦势仅使最大质量在百分量级变化、R_95 在几个百分量级变化。结合相对论 EFT 描述向完整广义相对论的系统收敛，这些结果表明弱耦合下相对薛定谔-泊松预测的显著偏离反映了非相对论结构描述的失效。本文结果为判断轴子星结构何时需要牛顿描述、相对论修正描述或完整广义相对论描述提供了系统基准。数值实现可在 Axion Star Solvers 仓库获取。

English: Axion-star mass-radius relations are commonly computed using different orders of relativistic approximation, making it important to determine where these descriptions remain reliable. We perform a unified numerical comparison of axion-star ground-state configurations in the Newtonian Schr\"odinger-Poisson description, first- and second-order relativistic effective field theories, and the full Einstein-Klein-Gordon system for a real scalar field. Using the same attractive quartic self-interaction in all four descriptions, we scan $|\widetilde{\lambda}|=(M_{\rm Pl}/f_a)^2$ and determine the maximum masses and corresponding enclosed-mass radii. All descriptions recover the common large-$|\widetilde{\lambda}|$ dilute-star scaling, while substantial differences appear at weak and moderate coupling. The relativistic EFTs interpolate systematically between the Newtonian and full-GR results. For part of the maximum-mass sequence where $\max|\phi|/f_a=O(1)$, we test the temporal-harmonic and potential truncations explicitly in full GR. The higher-harmonic expansion shows rapid convergence, while restoring the complete single-cosine potential changes the maximum mass only at the percent level and $R_{95}$ at the several-percent level. Together with the systematic convergence of the relativistic EFT descriptions toward full GR, these results show that the large weak-coupling departure from the Schr\"odinger-Poisson prediction reflects the breakdown of the nonrelativistic structural description. Our results provide a systematic benchmark for determining when Newtonian, relativistically corrected, or fully general-relativistic descriptions are required for axion-star structure. The numerical implementation used in this work is available in the Axion Star Solvers repository at https://github.com/Parisa-Arabameri/AxionStar.

On the Classical, Penrose, and Reverse Isoperimetric Inequalities in Black Holes: Insights From AdS to Flat Riemannian Backgrounds

Robert B. Mann, Behnam Pourhassan, Ali Dehghani · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：本文提出一系列证据，表明对渐近反德西特（AdS）以及德西特（dS）黑洞所猜想的逆等周不等式（RII），${\cal R}_\text{RII} \ge 1$，具有根本重要性；违反它（${\cal R}_\text{RII} < 1$）会导致热力学不稳定性、物理上不合理的解或裸奇点。我们证明，违反逆等周不等式的 AdS 黑洞，即超熵黑洞，既不满足力学稳定性要求 ${\kappa _T} \geqslant {\kappa _S} \geqslant 0$，也不满足热稳定性要求 ${C_P} \geqslant {C_V} \geqslant 0$。这一性质使它们在整个参数空间范围内热力学不稳定，并解释了迄今报道的所有不同行为。我们猜测这一陈述对所有超熵黑洞成立。我们确认超熵黑洞热力学不稳定性猜想没有反例，并通过给出 dS 空间中超熵性的第一个例子将其推广到 dS 空间。通过提供证据，我们随后提出另外两个猜想：1）超熵黑洞不存在渐近平直极限；2）对渐近平直黑洞存在两个更强的 Penrose 等周不等式（PII）版本；第一个是 RII 的渐近平直极限，第二个是用 ADM 质量和热力学体积表示的新不等式，我们称之为热体积不等式，它通过 AdS 中扩展黑洞热力学的 $\Lambda \to 0$ 极限的洞见得到。我们证明 Penrose 等周不等式（PII）弱于逆等周不等式（RII），并针对 $D=4,5$ 以及我们考察的所有黑洞族明确展示了这一点。

English: A collection of evidence is presented showing that the conjectured reverse isoperimetric inequality (RII) for asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS) as well as de Sitter (dS) black holes, ${\cal R}_\text{RII} \ge 1$, is of fundamental importance and its violation (${\cal R}_\text{RII} < 1$) gives rise to either thermodynamic instabilities, or physically unreasonable solutions, or naked singularities. We show that AdS black holes violating reverse isoperimetric inequality, known as superentropic black holes, satisfy neither mechanical stability requirement of ${\kappa _T} \geqslant {\kappa _S} \geqslant 0$ nor thermal stability requirement of ${C_P} \geqslant {C_V} \geqslant 0$. This property makes them thermodynamically unstable for the whole range of parameter space and explains all the diverse behaviors so far reported. We conjecture this statement holds for all superentropic black holes. We confirm that there is no counterexample to the thermodynamic instability conjecture of superentropic black holes and extend this to dS space by presenting the first example of superentropicity in dS space. By bringing evidence, we then propose two other conjectures: 1) there is no asymptotically flat limit of superentropic black holes, and 2) there exist two stronger versions of Penrose isoperimetric inequality (PII) for asymptotically flat black holes; the first is the asymptotically flat limit of the RII and the second is a new inequality in terms of the ADM mass and the thermodynamics volume, that we call thermo-volumetric inequality, obtained via insights from the $\Lambda \to 0$ limit of extended black hole thermodynamics in AdS. We show that the Penrose isoperimetric inequality (PII) is weaker than the reverse isoperimetric inequality (RII), as demonstrated explicitly for $D=4,5$ and for all black hole families we have examined.

English: We investigate primordial black hole (PBH) formation during an early matter-dominated era using fully nonlinear numerical relativity. The initial condition is set by a functional form of the curvature perturbation including ellipticity, which makes the configuration triaxial. Two kinds of matter descriptions are considered: dust fluid and collisionless particles. In the dust fluid description, numerical computation crashes associated with the appearance of a singularity at which the fluid density diverges, unless the singularity is hidden well inside the apparent horizon. We found that, for the dust fluid description, to observe the horizon formation before calculations crash, the initial amplitude must be larger than the previous analytic estimation by a factor of 2. On the other hand, with the particle system description, calculations do not crash, and we may observe black hole formation after subsequent evolution of the system. Then the threshold of black hole formation is significantly smaller than the previous analytic estimation by an order of magnitude.

Full set of scenarios of high energy collision in the Schwarzschild background and kinematic censorship

A. V. Toporensky, P. Gusin, A. Radosz, O. B. Zaslavskii · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：我们考虑在史瓦西背景中自由运动的粒子之间的碰撞。我们提出对导致质心系能量无界输出的情景的分类。尽管这在黑洞外部被禁止，但考虑到完整时空图中的白洞区域和镜像宇宙，该现象成为可能。我们还仔细研究了分岔点附近的碰撞，并揭示了视界内内部区域静止观测者的作用。在某些情景中，质心能量 E_{c.m.} 不仅发散，而且看似无限；事实上，根据所谓的运动学审查原理，这是不可能的。我们解决了相应的悖论，并论证了该原理为何仍然成立。

English: We consider collisions between particles moving freely in the Schwarzschild background. We suggest classification of scenarios that lead to unbounded energy output in the center of mass frame. Although this is forbidden in the exterior of a black hole, the phenomenon becomes possible with account of white hole region and mirror universe in the complete space-time diagram. Also, we scrutinize collisions in the vicinity of the bifurcation point and reveal the role of resting observers in the inner region beyond the horizon. In some scenarios $E_{c.m.}$ not only diverges but becomes seemingly infinite that is, as a matter of fact, impossible according to the principle of so-called kinematic censorship. We resolve a corresponding paradox and argue, why this principle remains valid.

一句话导读：在史瓦西完整时空图中分类自由粒子高能碰撞情景，并论证运动学审查如何消除表观无限质心能量。

English: In this paper, we derive the complete transformations of a generic first order perturbative metric in Schwarzschild spacetime to the Newman-Unti (NU) gauge in series expansion near null infinity. This allows us to determine the asymptotic shear, the mass aspect and the angular momentum aspect of the perturbative fields. As a direct application, we derive the corresponding asymptotic NU data for quasinormal modes (QNMs) of a Schwarzschild black hole. The total energy and angular momentum of QNMs obtained from the asymptotic NU data vanish but classical supertranslation charges are non-trivial, which can be applied to fix the BMS frame at first perturbative order.

Lower-dimensional behavior from factorized infrared geometries along holographic RG flows

Chanyong Park · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：我们研究沿全息 RG 流的重标量两点函数中有效低维行为的出现。对于带电荷的渐近 AdS 黑洞，等时空间关联子仍呈指数屏蔽，而时间关联子表现出不同的温度依赖区域。远离极端性时，受控的晚期扇区是 Schwarzschild 连接的鞍点，其衰减率需要与完整几何匹配。近极端性时，AdS2 喉部支持一个额外扇区，其领头衰减率由喉部数据固定。对于 RN-AdS4，在足够接近极端性时，如果匹配振幅非零，该喉部贡献在渐近晚期占主导。在极端性处，热喉部指数被 AdS2 幂律取代。我们还研究了从 AdS5 到 AdS3×R^2 的完整零密度磁膜流。横向重标量关联子仍呈指数屏蔽，而纵向关联子在红外趋近 AdS3/CFT2 幂律。这些结果表明，因子化红外几何可以支持有效低维共形动力学，其实现依赖于温度、方向和相关鞍点扇区，而不意味着微观 QFT 的维度约化。

English: We study the emergence of effective lower-dimensional behavior in heavy-scalar two-point functions along holographic RG flows. For charged asymptotically AdS black holes, the equal-time spatial correlator remains exponentially screened, while the temporal correlator exhibits distinct temperature-dependent regimes. Away from extremality, the controlled late-time sector is the Schwarzschild-connected saddle, whose decay rate requires matching to the full geometry. Near extremality, an AdS$_2$ throat supports an additional sector whose leading decay rate is fixed by the throat data. For RN-AdS$_4$, sufficiently near extremality, this throat contribution dominates at asymptotically late times if its matched amplitude is nonzero. At extremality, the thermal throat exponential is replaced by the AdS$_2$ power law. We also study the complete zero-density magnetic-brane flow from AdS$_5$ to AdS$_3\times \mathbb{R}^2$. The transverse heavy-scalar correlator remains exponentially screened, whereas the longitudinal correlator approaches the AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ power law in the infrared. These results show that factorized infrared geometries can support effective lower-dimensional conformal dynamics whose realization depends on temperature, direction, and the relevant saddle sector, without implying dimensional reduction of the microscopic QFT.

一句话导读：全息 RG 流中的因子化红外几何可在特定方向与温度区间产生有效低维共形关联，但不代表微观 QFT 降维。

English: Holographic thermal two-point functions can be analyzed using the operator product expansion which contains contributions from both multi-stress-tensor and double-trace operators. The former can be computed by analyzing the bulk equation of motion in a near-boundary expansion, but the latter has remained elusive-in practice, one resorts to solving a partial differential equation with limited accuracy. We show that imposing the Euclidean periodicity condition on the holographic correlator (also known as the KMS condition or thermal bootstrap), followed by Pad\'e-Borel resummation, provides an efficient method for computing double-trace thermal coefficients. The resulting series converges rapidly and yields numerical values in excellent agreement with those obtained from solving the partial differential equation.

中文摘要：我们考虑在全息量子纠错码的粗粒化，基于广义的体重整化群流概念。特别地，我们研究在该流下 Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena 公式中 A/4G 项及其 Rényi 推广的重整化。这为 Susskind 与 Uglum 的论证提供了一般的量子码视角。具体而言，给定一个具有双侧恢复和适当平坦纠缠谱的“UV”码，以及 UV 码中的一组“种子”态，我们显式构造一个具有相应性质的“IR”码，它包含给定种子态，并且在我们描述的意义下具有最小尺寸。

English: We consider the coarse-graining of holographic quantum error correcting codes under a generalized notion of bulk renormalization-group flow. In particular, we study the renormalization under this flow of the $A/4G$ term in the Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena formula and in its R\'enyi generalization. This provides a general quantum code perspective on the arguments of Susskind and Uglum. Specifically, given a 'UV' code with two-sided recovery and appropriately flat entanglement spectrum together with a set of 'seed' states in the UV code, we explicitly construct an 'IR' code with corresponding properties which contains the given seed states and is of minimal size in a sense we describe.

一句话导读：在全息量子纠错码框架下定义广义体 RG 流，并构造包含给定种子态的最小 IR 码，从而以量子码视角理解 A/4G 项及其 Rényi 推广的重整化与 Susskind-Uglum 论证。

具有两个面积的引力代数

Gravitational Algebras with Two Areas

Xuchen Cao, Thomas Faulkner, Zhencheng Wang · hep-th, math-ph, math.MP · v2 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：我们研究具有两个极值曲面的时空上的引力代数。在两个渐近 AdS 边界和两个紧致极值曲面的长虫洞例子中，我们讨论将引力代数分配到由极值曲面和/或渐近边界围成的各个区域。利用分裂性质，我们通过交叉乘积在左外部、右外部、中间“python's lunch”区域及其补区域构造类型 II 代数。我们还研究仅将面积和算符或面积差算符包含为引力代数一部分的情形。这可以通过选取适当的微正则系综实现，并且这些引力代数依区域可以是类型 II 或类型 III。在仅包含面积差模式的情况下，交叉乘积产生一个权重，该权重在中间区域上限制为迹。相对于该权重的相对熵之差给出广义熵之差。这为控制纠缠楔之间相变的序参量提供了代数理解。我们强调构造中使用的算符值权重的作用。

English: We study gravitational algebras on spacetimes with two extremal surfaces. In the example of a long wormhole with two asymptotic AdS boundaries and two compact extremal surfaces, we discuss the assignment of gravitational algebras to various regions bounded by the extremal surfaces and/or asymptotic boundaries. Using the split property, we construct type II algebras from the crossed product in the left exterior, right exterior, the middle ``python's lunch'' region, and their complement regions. We also study the case where only the area sum operator or area difference operator is included as part of the gravitational algebra. This can be achieved by picking the appropriate microcanonical ensemble, and these gravitational algebras can either be type II or type III depending on the region. In the case where we include only the area difference mode, the crossed product gives rise to a weight that restricts to a trace on the middle region. Differences of relative entropies with respect to this weight give differences in generalized entropies. This provides an algebraic understanding of the order parameter that controls the phase transitions between entanglement wedges. We emphasize the role of operator-valued weights used in our construction.

一句话导读：通过交叉乘积构造双极值面 AdS 虫洞中的类型 II/III 引力代数，并用算符值权重代数地理解纠缠楔相变的序参量。

具有近似量子纠错的大码中的 JLMS 公式

The JLMS formula in a large code with approximate error correction

Xi Dong, Donald Marolf, Pratik Rath · hep-th, quant-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：规范/引力对偶常被描述为量子纠错码。然而，如 JLMS 公式所示，具有互补恢复的精确量子纠错（因而纠缠楔重构）仅在 G→0 极限下出现。因此，控制误差项的精确论证集中于我们所谓的“小”码；当 G→0 时，它们只描述给定经典解附近的微扰激发。此类设定限制很强，尤其禁止讨论会改变经典背景的任何模流，从而禁止考虑由半经典体态生成的、模参数为量级一的模流。相反，我们为体理论提出一个单一“大”码，可以容纳这类流，并且在 G→0 极限下包含与不同经典背景相关的态的叠加。该大码由若干小码组装而成，每个小码满足近似的 Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena 公式。在此扩展设定中，我们澄清体与边界模哈密顿量之间（近似）JLMS 关系的含义，并在一类合适态中量化其有效性。

English: Gauge/gravity duality is often described as a quantum error correcting code. However, as seen in the Jafferis-Lewkowycz-Maldacena-Suh (JLMS) formula, exact quantum error correction with complementary recovery (and thus entanglement wedge reconstruction) emerges only in the limit $G \to 0$. As a result, precise arguments controlling error terms have focused on what we call `small' codes which, as $G \to 0$, describe only perturbative excitations near a given classical solution. Such settings are quite restrictive and, in particular, they prohibit discussion of any modular flow that would change the classical background. As a result, they forbid consideration of modular flows generated by semiclassical bulk states at order-one modular parameters. In contrast, we present a single `large' code for the bulk theory that can accommodate such flows and, in particular, in the $G \to 0$ limit includes superpositions of states associated with distinct classical backgrounds. This large code is assembled from small codes that each satisfy an approximate Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena formula. In this extended setting we clarify the meaning of the (approximate) JLMS relation between bulk and boundary modular Hamiltonians and quantify its validity in an appropriate class of states.

一句话导读：通过由小码组装的大码，将 JLMS 关系推广到包含不同经典背景叠加的近似量子纠错设定，并量化其有效性。

中文摘要：我们提出一种与 Vasiliev 标准框架互补的四维非线性高自旋相互作用方法，旨在确定其最小非局域形式。我们的方案在经典方程层面引入高自旋顶点的生成系统，并将其称为非规则的，以区别于 Vasiliev 所描述的规则情形。该系统扩展了近期提出的（反）全纯相互作用方程，纳入混合部分。其微扰级数在领头阶包含整个（反）全纯部分，顶点与复宇称破缺参数 η 或 \barη 的幂相关。后续修正促成两个部分的混合，顶点带有 η 与 \barη 的混合幂。自洽性依赖于非线性代数约束，我们证明至少二次和三次近似下该约束得到满足。因此，文献中先前讨论的（反）全纯相互作用可被系统扩展，以生成形式为 η^N \barη^k 及其共轭的顶点，至少对于 k ≤ 2 和任意 N。作为分析副产品，我们还识别出新的高自旋结构对偶性。

English: We present a complementary approach to the standard Vasiliev framework for nonlinear higher-spin interactions in four dimensions, aimed at identifying their minimally nonlocal form. Our proposal introduces a generating system for higher-spin vertices at the level of classical equations, which we refer to as irregular, in contrast to the regular case described by Vasiliev. This system extends the recently proposed equations for (anti)holomorphic interactions by incorporating the mixed sector. Its perturbative series encompasses the entire (anti)holomorphic sector in the leading order, with vertices related to powers of the complex parity-breaking parameter $\eta$ or $\bar\eta$. The subsequent corrections facilitate the mixing of the two sectors, with vertices carrying mixed powers of $\eta$ and $\bar\eta$. The consistency relies on the nonlinear algebraic constraint, which is shown to be satisfied at least in the quadratic and cubic approximations. As a result, the previously discussed (anti)holomorphic interactions in the literature can be systematically extended to generate vertices of the form $\eta^N \bar\eta^k$ and their conjugate, at least for $k \leq 2$ and any $N$. As a byproduct of our analysis, we also identify the new higher-spin structure dualities.

一句话导读：提出非规则高自旋生成方程，在 Vasiliev 框架之外系统构造混合（反）全纯高自旋顶点并发现新的结构对偶性。

Augustus Brown, Daniele Dorigoni, Congkao Wen · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：我们研究 SU(N) N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论在有限复化耦合 τ 下的巨引力子积分关联子。尽管所考虑算符的重性质带来了巨大复杂性，大 N 展开显著简化并展现出明显的模不变性。在 1/N 的每一阶，展开系数是非全纯 Eisenstein 级的线性组合，从而捕获 Yang-Mills 耦合中完整的微扰和非微扰效应。此外，我们发现额外贡献，它们是模函数且在 N 中指数压制。在 't Hooft 极限下，这给出任意耦合 λ 下 1/N 展开的全阶结果，超越先前领头阶结果。对于 U(N) 理论，我们得到对所有 N 和 τ 有效的闭式表达式，并证明大 N 展开中依赖耦合的部分在 SU(N) 与 U(N) 之间到所有阶是普适的。关键地，我们利用积分关联子约束，确定有限 N 下巨引力子关联子本身到两圈阶，此前仅在平面极限可及。

English: We study the giant graviton integrated correlator in SU$(N)$ $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills at finite complexified coupling $\tau$. Despite the formidable complexity arising from the heavy nature of the operators considered, the large-$N$ expansion simplifies dramatically and exhibits manifest modular invariance. At each order in $1/N$, the expansion coefficients are linear combinations of non-holomorphic Eisenstein series thus capturing the full spectrum of perturbative and non-perturbative effects in the Yang-Mills coupling. Furthermore, we find additional contributions which are modular functions exponentially suppressed in $N$. In the 't Hooft limit, this yields an all-orders result in the $1/N$ expansion at arbitrary coupling $\lambda$, extending beyond prior results of leading orders. For the U$(N)$ theory, we obtain a closed-form expression valid for all $N$ and $\tau$, and show that the coupling-dependent sector of the large-$N$ expansion is universal between SU$(N)$ and U$(N)$ to all orders. Crucially, we exploit the integrated correlator constraints and determine the giant graviton correlator itself to two-loop order at finite $N$, previously only accessible in the planar limit.

一句话导读：在 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中研究巨引力子积分关联子，得到有限耦合大 N 全阶展开及有限 N 两圈结果。

临界拓扑大质量引力中对数引力子后代的体单值性

Bulk Monodromy of Logarithmic Graviton Descendants in Critical Topologically Massive Gravity

Yannick Mvondo-She · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：我们研究了临界拓扑大质量引力中对数引力子及其整体后代的体解析结构。从 Grumiller--Johansson 模式出发，我们将径向坐标复化，并直接从对数径向因子的分支结构和绕数数据推导其单值性。然后，我们通过显式微分作用构造整体对数后代，并证明每个后代都分解为一个普适的对数贡献和一个无对数的亚纯余项。这意味着整个整体后代空间具有普适的幂幺单值性。由体解析延拓直接得到的相应幂零算子被证明与完整的整体 SL(2,R)_L × SL(2,R)_R 作用交织。这些结果为对数结构提供了直接的体解析实现，将径向单值性与整体共形对称性联系起来。

English: We study the bulk analytic structure of the logarithmic graviton and its global descendants in critical topologically massive gravity. Starting from the Grumiller--Johansson mode, we complexify the radial coordinate and derive its monodromy directly from the branch structure and winding data of the logarithmic radial factor. We then construct the global logarithmic descendants by explicit differential action and show that each descendant decomposes into a universal logarithmic contribution and a log-free meromorphic remainder. This implies a universal unipotent monodromy throughout the global descendant space. The associated nilpotent operator, obtained directly from the bulk analytic continuation, is shown to intertwine the full global $SL(2,\mathbb R)_L\times SL(2,\mathbb R)_R$ action. These results provide a direct bulk analytic realization of the logarithmic structure, linking radial monodromy and global conformal symmetry.

Evaporating Black Hole Interior and Complexity Evolution

Nicol\`o Bragagnolo, S. Prem Kumar · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：我们研究在一个带世界末端（EoW）膜的 Jackiw-Teitelboim（JT）引力简单模型中，蒸发黑洞内部的演化；其中蒸发通过将膜的内部状态与辅助辐射系统纠缠来建模。为探测黑洞内部，我们考虑从边界到膜的两点函数中提取的测地线长度，并将其重整化值解释为子系统复杂度的一种度量。我们的计算基于淬火无序平均，包含来自时空虫洞和复制虫洞的非微扰引力效应，编码了对偶随机哈密顿量以及膜态耦合的系综平均。与不蒸发黑洞（其复杂度先线性增长，后在晚期约 O(e^{S_BH}) 达到平台）不同，我们发现蒸发情形下黑洞子系统的复杂度演化显著不同，并且非平凡地依赖于发射辐射希尔伯特空间的维度。它在早期线性增长，在 Page 时间交叉之前不久达到最大值（约 O(S_BH)），随后指数衰减。我们进一步表明，内部长度的相对涨落在 Page 时间之前保持很小，但在之后变为量级为一并最终变大：这表明自平均性的丧失，系综平均复杂度由稀有构型而非典型实现主导。

English: We study the evolution of the interior of an evaporating black hole in a simple model of Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity with an end-of-the-world (EoW) brane, where evaporation is modeled by entangling the brane's internal states with an auxiliary radiation system. To probe the black hole interior, we consider a geodesic length extracted from a boundary-to-brane two-point function and interpret its renormalised value as a measure of subsystem complexity. Our computation, based on quenched disorder averaging, includes non-perturbative gravitational effects from both spacetime wormholes and replica wormholes, encoding ensemble averaging over the dual random Hamiltonian and brane-state couplings. Unlike non-evaporating black holes, for which complexity first grows linearly and then plateaus at late times $\sim{\cal O}(e^{S_{\rm BH}})$, we find that complexity evolution of the black hole subsystem in the evaporating case differs drastically, depending nontrivially on the dimension of the emitted radiation Hilbert space. It grows linearly at early times, reaches a maximum shortly before the Page-time crossover $\sim{\cal O}({S_{\rm BH}})$, and then decays exponentially. We further show that the relative fluctuations of the interior length remain small before the Page time but become of order one and eventually large at later times: this signals a loss of self-averaging, with the ensemble-averaged complexity dominated by rare configurations rather than by typical realisations.

一句话导读：在带 EoW 膜并耦合辐射的 JT 引力中，蒸发黑洞子系统的复杂度先线性增长、Page 时间前达峰后指数衰减，且晚期由稀有构型主导。

可穿越虫洞有多可穿越？

How traversable is a traversable wormhole?

Ben Freivogel, Alessandro Fumagalli, Marija Toma\v{s}evi\'c · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：为回答上述问题，我们研究了 Maldacena、Milekhin 和 Popov 四维可穿越虫洞中的低频散射。所得透射概率表明，虫洞的可穿越性强烈依赖于探针性质。对于中性及带电标量探针，可穿越性依赖时间尺度。在信号发出后约光穿越时标上，透射按参数被压低，大部分入射信号被反射或暂时困在虫洞喉部。随时间推移，被困信号逐渐泄漏，因此在晚时累积透射截面趋近相应黑洞吸收截面的一半。尽管低频下存在这种普遍压制，透射谱仍表现出使透射变为完美的共振频率。带电无质量费米子则给出非常不同的图景。与标量不同，它们在低能下以基本为单位概率穿过虫洞。同一机制也解释了它们被磁黑洞的高效吸收，并实现了一条与 Callan-Rubakov 效应密切类似的通道，揭示了与磁单极-费米子散射的意外联系。综合来看，我们得出结论：标量探针最适合揭示这些磁虫洞的独特特征，而带电无质量费米子是穿过它们传递信息的理想载体。

English: To answer the above question, we study low-frequency scattering in the four-dimensional traversable wormhole of Maldacena, Milekhin, and Popov. The resulting transmission probabilities reveal that wormhole traversability depends strongly on the nature of the probe. For scalar probes, both neutral and charged, traversability depends on the time scale. On time scales of order the light-crossing time after sending in a signal, the transmission is parametrically suppressed, with most of the incoming signal reflected or temporarily trapped inside the wormhole throat. As time progresses, the trapped signal gradually leaks out, so that at late times the accumulated transmission cross-section approaches one half of the corresponding black hole absorption cross-section. Despite this generic suppression at low frequencies, the transmission spectrum also exhibits resonant frequencies at which transmission becomes perfect. Charged massless fermions tell a very different story. Unlike scalars, they traverse the wormhole with essentially unit probability at low energies. The same mechanism underlies their efficient absorption by magnetic black holes and realizes a channel closely analogous to the Callan-Rubakov effect, revealing unexpected connections with monopole-fermion scattering. Putting everything together, we conclude that scalar probes are best suited for uncovering distinct features of these magnetic wormholes, while charged massless fermions are the ideal carriers of information through them.

一句话导读：研究四维可穿越虫洞低频散射：标量透射受时间尺度与共振影响，带电无质量费米子低能近乎全透射，类似 Callan-Rubakov 效应。

从 AdS 黑洞相空间收缩出发的大 N Carrollian 热力学

Large-$N$ Carrollian Thermodynamics from AdS Black-Hole Phase-Space Contractions

Yingnan Xu, Shuangshuang Chu · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：我们发展了有限 Carrollian 黑洞热力学的边界大秩（large-N）解释，以及其带源应力、标量谱和相互作用热观测量。时间生成元与牛顿耦合的关联标度保持扩展哈密顿微分形式，同时生成元温度消失而全息归一化增长。Brown-York 源变分固定了能量密度、动量密度和空间应力的相对权重，给出 Carrollian 与热时间尺度上的 Ward 方程。边界体积与归一化变分重现体压力功，并通过化学势刻画 Hawking-Page 穿越。源耦合固定标量算符映射和谱钟 Jacobian。四维 Schwarzschild-AdS 的数值解确定角透射和有限频率吸收。在 type IIB 族中，对数 scrambling 间隔在秩与 't Hooft 耦合之间施加额外层级。我们推出一个关联极限：弦长消失，而有限横向 Regge 核保留在归一化四点泛函中。其积分衰减与空间宽度服从共同关系。该相互作用观测量可区分具有相同领头热力学和渐近 Regge 增长速率的大秩序列。热 Fourier-Mellin 矩在收缩频率窗口中保留标量谱。时间平移改变其权重，同时角源项保留。BTZ 字典提供相应的大中心荷平衡例子。

English: We develop the boundary large-rank interpretation of finite Carrollian black-hole thermodynamics and its sourced stress, scalar spectral and interacting thermal observables. Correlated scaling of the time generator and Newton coupling preserves the extended Hamiltonian differential while the generator temperature vanishes and the holographic normalization grows. The Brown--York source variation fixes the relative weights of energy density, momentum density and spatial stress, giving Ward equations on the Carrollian and thermal time scales. Boundary volume and normalization variations reproduce the bulk pressure work and characterize the Hawking--Page crossing through a chemical potential. Source coupling fixes the scalar operator map and spectral clock Jacobian. Numerical solutions in four-dimensional Schwarzschild-AdS determine angular transmission and finite-frequency absorption. In the type IIB family, the logarithmic scrambling interval imposes an additional hierarchy between rank and 't Hooft coupling. We derive a correlated limit in which the string length vanishes while a finite transverse Regge kernel survives in the normalized four-point functional. Its integrated attenuation and spatial width obey a common relation. This interacting observable distinguishes large-rank sequences with the same leading thermodynamics and asymptotic Regge growth rate. Thermal Fourier--Mellin moments retain the scalar spectrum in a contracting frequency window. Time translations shift their weights with angular source terms retained. The BTZ dictionary supplies the corresponding large-central-charge equilibrium example.

一句话导读：从 AdS 黑洞相空间收缩构造大 N Carrollian 边界热力学，给出 Brown-York Ward 方程、标量谱与 Regge 相互作用观测量，并以 Schwarzschild-AdS 和 BTZ 为示例。

论被辐射包围的黑洞：I. 经典考量

On Black Holes Surrounded by Radiation: I. Classical Considerations

Marcos Riojas, Matthew J. Strassler · hep-th, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：我们考虑爱因斯坦方程的球对称静态解，描述一个被厚壳层轨道运动无质量粒子包裹的 Schwarzschild 黑洞，该壳层径向压强为零。轨道气体是超致密且超相对论性的，可视为稳定爱因斯坦星团（Einstein cluster）的边际稳定极限。这些解——我们称为“hillingar 黑洞”——将光子球延伸为一个任意深度的区域。我们将这些对象与由其他气体包围的黑洞进行比较，并指出它们在经典层面具有许多特殊性质；特别是，对无穷远观测者而言，它们似乎在光学上与普通黑洞不可区分。我们推测这些对象（或与之非常相似的对象）可能存在于自然界，以及尽管它们外观与普通黑洞相似，是否仍可能被观测到。我们将在配套论文中考察它们的热力学与稳定性。

English: We consider spherically symmetric static solutions to Einstein's equations describing a Schwarzschild black hole enveloped by a thick shell of orbiting massless particles with zero radial pressure. The orbiting gas is ultra-compact and ultra-relativistic, and can be viewed as the marginally stable limit of a stable Einstein cluster. These solutions, which we refer to as "hillingar black holes", extend the photon sphere into a region of arbitrary depth. We compare these objects to black holes surrounded by other gases and note they have numerous special properties at the classical level; in particular, they appear optically indistinguishable from ordinary black holes to observers at infinity. We speculate concerning the possibility that these objects (or others much like them) might exist in nature, and whether they might be observable despite their similar outward appearance to ordinary black holes. We examine their thermodynamics and stability in companion papers.

一句话导读：构建并研究被轨道无质量粒子厚壳包裹的 Schwarzschild 黑洞经典解（“hillingar 黑洞”），其光子球区域可延伸且外部光学上类似普通黑洞。

Marcos Riojas, Matthew J. Strassler · hep-th, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：在一篇姊妹论文中，我们考虑了质量为 m 的 Schwarzschild 黑洞被一层厚重的无质量粒子“海洋”包裹，将黑洞光子球延伸为有限深度区域。那里我们证明，这个 ADM 质量为 M 的“hillingar 黑洞”在光学上模仿同质量普通黑洞。这里我们发现它在热力学上也模仿普通黑洞：形式上的热平衡假设意味着该系统与质量为 M 的普通黑洞具有相同温度和熵。我们用多种方法仔细检验了这一结果；我们中的一人在姊妹论文中给出了进一步方法以及亚稳态迹象。在 AdS 空间中，这种模仿不成立，解具有更丰富结构。虽然远不清楚这些系统是否能作为更现实系统的模型，我们指出其与黑洞演化的可能联系。特别地，若热平衡能够建立并维持，位于半径 ≥3M 空腔中的 HBH 可以蒸发，可能在小有限体积中提出信息疑难。

English: In a companion paper we considered a Schwarzschild black hole of mass $m$ enveloped by a thick "ocean" of massless particles that extends the black hole's photon sphere into a region of finite depth. There we showed that this "hillingar black hole", of ADM mass $M$, optically mimics an ordinary black hole of the same mass. Here we find it also mimics the black hole thermodynamically: the formal assumption of thermal equilibrium implies the system has the same temperature and entropy as an ordinary black hole of mass $M$. We check this result carefully using multiple methods; a further method and indications of metastability are given by one of us in a companion paper. In AdS space, the mimicry does not hold, and the solutions have a richer structure. While it is far from clear that these systems are models for more realistic ones, we note possible connections with black hole evolution. In particular, assuming thermal equilibrium can be established and maintained, an HBH in a cavity of radius $\geq 3M$ can evaporate, potentially posing the information puzzle in a small finite volume.

一句话导读：被无质量粒子海洋包裹的 Schwarzschild 黑洞在热力学上模仿同质量普通黑洞，但该性质在 AdS 中失效，并可能影响蒸发与信息疑难。

Marcos Riojas · hep-th, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：人们普遍认为，在渐近平直时空中，自引力辐射无法与黑洞达到热平衡。我们描述了对标准不稳定性论证的一个边缘稳定的连续例外。我们的主要观察是：光子球控制 Israel 连接条件（IJCs）、Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff（TOV）方程以及有限半径黑洞热力学：在零径向压强下 IJCs 与 TOV 方程等价；光子球处的比热倒数正比于 -Λ；在固定总质量下增加壳层会降低渐近 Hawking 温度，当且仅当局部比热为正。利用这些结果，我们展示如何在不使用欧几里得路径积分的情况下计算热力学熵。这里描述的例外来自与 M.J. Strassler 的伴随工作，其中我们发现“hillingar black hole”（HBH）模仿质量为 M 的普通 Schwarzschild 黑洞，共享其 Hawking 温度、光子环，并在平衡时共享其粗粒化熵 S=4πM^2。在这里，我们表明这些特征并非调参所得；它们唯一地来自力学与热力学联合约束。我们找到了热力学模仿以及延展光子球形成的条件；对于自相似解，它们重合。一个单参数自相似系统族——除 HBH 外，其所有成员都需要在延展光子球边缘存在无质量壁——满足这两个条件。该族包括“最硬星”和“冻结星”。

English: It is widely believed that self-gravitating radiation cannot reach thermal equilibrium with a black hole in asymptotically flat spacetime. We describe a marginally stable continuum exception to the standard instability argument. Our main observation is that the photon sphere controls the Israel junction conditions (IJCs), the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff (TOV) equation, and finite-radius black hole thermodynamics: the IJCs and TOV equation are equivalent at zero radial pressure, the inverse specific heat at the photon sphere is proportional to $-\Lambda$, and adding shells at fixed total mass \textit{lowers} the asymptotic Hawking temperature if and only if the local specific heat is positive. Using these results, we show how to compute thermodynamic entropies without the Euclidean path integral. The exception described here results from companion work with M.J. Strassler, where we found that a "hillingar black hole" (HBH) mimics an ordinary Schwarzschild black hole of mass $M$, sharing its Hawking temperature, photon ring, and, in equilibrium, its coarse-grained entropy $S = 4 \pi M^2$. Here, we show these features are not tuned; they follow uniquely from joint mechanical and thermodynamic constraints. Conditions for thermodynamic mimicry and for the formation of extended photon spheres are found; for self-similar solutions they coincide. A one-parameter family of self-similar systems -- all of which, excepting the HBH, require massless walls at the edges of their extended photon spheres -- satisfies both conditions. This family includes "stiffest stars" and "frozen stars".

一句话导读：光子球通过 Israel 连接条件与 TOV 方程控制有限半径黑洞热力学，给出自引力辐射热平衡的连续例外和 HBH 热力学模仿。

On Integrable Structures on Non-compact Boundaries in Three-Dimensional Gravity

Hamed Adami, Kristiansen Lara, Anouchah Latifi, Ren\'e Meyer · hep-th, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：我们在 Chern-Simons 表述下研究具有负宇宙学常数的三维 Einstein 引力在非紧空间边界上的性质。利用精确的流体/引力对应，我们推导出准局域应力张量的闭合径向流方程，并表明它实现了有限截断下的全息 $\sqrt{T\bar T}$ 变形。我们进一步发展边界动力学的逆散射描述，识别相关谱数据的引力解释，并分析孤子解的有限截断变形。尽管边界演化由可积的双哈密顿族控制，我们表明径向流本身相对于正则 Poisson 结构并非哈密顿的。我们的结果建立了一个统一框架，将可积性、准局域引力可观测量、逆散射以及非紧边界上的有限截断全息联系起来。

English: We study three-dimensional Einstein gravity with negative cosmological constant on non-compact spatial boundaries within the Chern-Simons formulation. Using an exact fluid/gravity correspondence, we derive a closed radial flow equation for the quasi-local stress tensor and show that it realizes the holographic $\sqrt{T\bar T}$ deformation at finite cutoff. We further develop the inverse-scattering description of the boundary dynamics, identifying the gravitational interpretation of the associated spectral data and analyzing the finite-cutoff deformation of soliton solutions. Although the boundary evolution is governed by an integrable bi-Hamiltonian hierarchy, we show that the radial flow itself is not Hamiltonian with respect to the canonical Poisson structure. Our results establish a unified framework connecting integrability, quasi-local gravitational observables, inverse scattering, and finite-cutoff holography on non-compact boundaries.

Elastic stiffness of three-dimensional black holes and wormholes from Liouville line defects

Jeevan Chandra, Boris Post · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：我们研究 AdS3 引力中薄壳黑洞与虫洞的弹性变形。这些几何由对偶共形场论中的线缺陷提供源，其形状和质量分布定义了引力鞍点的弹性模量。我们计算配分函数对这些变形的二次响应，定义横向形状涨落和非均匀质量密度涨落的刚度核。刚度核的计算可实现为对共形焊接问题的双曲响应，在重壳极限下约化为普适 Schwarzian 响应。刚度核是 CFT 中缺陷局域算符的两点函数：位移算符，测量对形状变形的响应；质量密度算符，测量对壳层密度局域变化的响应。我们计算半经典极限下这些算符在多种黑洞和虫洞背景中的谱。谱可以是离散或连续的，取决于几何中存在横向于壳层的非紧方向。我们还利用线性响应理论给出刚度核的洛伦兹解释，并计算对偶全息 CFT 中趋向相应瞬态变形的弛豫时间尺度。最后，我们计算这些弹性变形对黑洞微态统计和黑洞熵的影响。

English: We study elastic deformations of thin-shell black holes and wormholes in AdS$_3$ gravity. These geometries are sourced by line defects in the dual conformal field theory, and their shape and mass distribution define elastic moduli of the gravitational saddle. We compute the quadratic response of the partition function to these deformations, defining stiffness kernels for both transverse shape fluctuations and inhomogeneous mass-density fluctuations. The computation of the stiffness kernels can be realized as a hyperbolic response to a conformal welding problem which reduces to the universal Schwarzian response in the heavy-shell limit. The stiffness kernels are two-point functions of defect-local operators in CFT: the displacement operator, which measures the response to shape deformations, and a mass-density operator, which measures the response to local changes in the shell density. We compute the spectrum of these operators in the semiclassical limit, in various black hole and wormhole backgrounds. The spectrum can be discrete or continuous depending on the existence of a non-compact direction transverse to the shell in the geometry. We also provide a Lorentzian interpretation for the stiffness kernels using linear response theory and compute the relaxation time scales towards the corresponding transient deformations in the dual holographic CFT. Lastly, we compute the effect of these elastic deformations on black hole microstate statistics and black hole entropy.

一句话导读：在 AdS3/CFT2 中，薄壳黑洞与虫洞的弹性刚度由线缺陷的位移与质量密度算符两点函数给出，并影响黑洞微态统计与熵。

Zhi-Hong Li, Huai-Fan Li, Hai-Qing Zhang · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：我们在全息超流环中，对约瑟夫森结的电流-相位关系进行了综合研究，其实现基于Kibble-Zurek机制所描述的随机非平衡动力学。通过采用空间调制的电荷密度来构造弱链接，我们在多种几何与热力学参数下考察了电流-相位关系。由于几何的紧致形状，电流与相位之间经典的正弦关系周期性地出现。我们还确定了临界电流与结的几何参数（宽度、陡度和深度）之间的关系。此外，我们证明临界电流随最终温度呈特征指数衰减，反映了强耦合区序参量的热退化。我们的结果建立了全息约瑟夫森器件的稳健框架，为高温超导体的非平衡动力学提供了可实验检验的预言。

English: We present a comprehensive study of the current-phase relation of the Josephson junction in a holographic superfluid ring, realized from the stochastic and non-equilibrium dynamics according to the Kibble-Zurek mechanism. By employing a spatially modulated charge density to engineer a weak link, the current-phase relation is investigated in a range of geometric and thermodynamic parameters. The seminal sinusoidal relation between the current and the phase emerges periodically due to the compact shape of the geometry. We also identify the relations between the critical current and the geometric parameters of the junction: the width, steepness and depth. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the critical current exhibits a characteristic exponential decaying against the final temperature, reflecting the thermal degradation of the order parameter in a strong-coupling regime. Our results establish a robust framework for holographic Josephson devices, offering experimentally testable predictions for the non-equilibrium dynamics of high-$T_c$ superconductors.

弦论导出的 Lovelock--Horndeski 理论的全息重整化

Holographic Renormalization of String-Derived Lovelock--Horndeski Theory

Tianhao Wu · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：弦论导出的高曲率标量-张量引力将微观耦合数据编码在边界响应中，这提出了全息可观测量能否重构底层高维参数的问题。我们针对五维弦论导出 Lovelock--Horndeski (SDLH) 理论在其精确线性伸张子渐近局部 AdS 分支上回答该问题，为任意边界度规和依赖时空的标量源构造重整化生成泛函。一个边界协变的径向层级统一了变分问题、局域反作用、对数阻碍、有限单点函数和 Ward 恒等式。两个响应行列式组织递推、共振阻碍以及度规-标量混合。Weyl 反常凝聚为 Euler 密度、Weyl 平方密度和一个曲率-标量平方，其后者的配对变分生成度规和标量阻碍。所得重整化泛函将弦选择的耦合数据带入边界几何、算符响应、反常系数以及与引力可观测量的可计算接口。在正规分支上，四个标量归一化不变的全息组合允许对连续约化耦合的全局有理逆。在固定紧化维度下，该映射具有最大秩，而曲率-反常求和可无符号歧义地重构高维 Gauss--Bonnet 系数。因此全息响应为底层弦约化提供了一个显式、超定的边界指纹。

English: String-derived higher-curvature scalar--tensor gravities encode microscopic coupling data in boundary response, raising the question of whether holographic observables can reconstruct the underlying higher-dimensional parameters. We answer this question for the five-dimensional string-derived Lovelock--Horndeski (SDLH) theory on its exact linear-dilaton asymptotically locally AdS branch, constructing the renormalized generating functional for an arbitrary boundary metric and spacetime-dependent scalar source. A boundary-covariant radial hierarchy unifies the variational problem, local backreaction, logarithmic obstruction, finite one-point functions, and Ward identities. Two response determinants organize the recursion, resonant obstructions, and metric--scalar mixing. The Weyl anomaly condenses into an Euler density, a Weyl-squared density, and a single curvature--scalar square whose paired variations generate the metric and scalar obstructions. The resulting renormalized functional carries string-selected coupling data into boundary geometry, operator response, anomaly coefficients, and a calculable interface with gravitational observables. On the regular branch, four scalar-normalization-invariant holographic combinations admit a global rational inverse to the continuous reduced couplings. At fixed compactification dimension the map has maximal rank, while the curvature-anomaly sum reconstructs the higher-dimensional Gauss--Bonnet coefficient without sign ambiguity. Holographic response thus provides an explicit, overdetermined boundary fingerprint of the underlying string reduction.

一句话导读：在五维弦论导出的 Lovelock--Horndeski 理论中构造全息重整化生成泛函，并用边界响应反推高维耦合与反常系数。

论 AdS4 黑洞的平直空间极限

On flat space limits of $AdS_4$ black holes

Pedro Vicente Marto, Shradha Ramakrishnan, Stefan Vandoren · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：为了理解平直空间全息，我们研究规范 N=2 超引力中渐近 AdS4 黑洞的平直空间极限。利用全息重整化，我们仔细分析该背景下各类黑洞壳上作用量的平直空间极限，并明确在此极限下对配分函数有贡献的态。我们发现若干特征：大黑洞导致配分函数发散，这可理解为热力学体积发散。半经典地，小黑洞重现其平直空间对应体的配分函数，我们厘清两侧 BPS、(近)极端或非极端带电与转动黑洞之间的映射。最后，通过研究 M 理论中 BPS Kerr-Newman-AdS4 黑洞的适当平直极限，我们得到平直空间中的带电 BPS 解。对偶地，我们在 large N 下确定已知 S^1×S^2 上 ABJM 配分函数的类 Carrollian 极限，并表明它重现渐近平直空间中 BPS 带电黑洞的正确熵。

English: With a view towards understanding flat space holography, we study the flat space limit of asymptotically $AdS_4$ black holes in gauged $\mathcal{N}=2$ supergravity. Using holographic renormalisation, we carefully analyse the flat space limit of the on-shell action of various black holes in this setting and make explicit the states that contribute to the partition function in this limit. We find several features: large black holes lead to a divergence in the partition function which can be understood as a thermodynamic volume divergence. Meanwhile, semiclassically, small black holes reproduce the partition function of their flat space counterparts, and we clarify the mapping between BPS, (near-)extremal or non-extremal black holes on both sides for charged and rotating solutions. Finally, by studying a suitable flat limit of the BPS Kerr-Newman-$AdS_4$ black hole in M-theory, we obtain a charged BPS solution in flat space. On the dual side, we determine a Carrollian-like limit on the known ABJM partition function on $S^1\times S^2$ at large $N$, and show that it reproduces the correct entropy of the BPS charged black hole in asymptotically flat space.

一句话导读：研究 AdS4 黑洞的平直空间极限，并通过 ABJM 配分函数的类 Carrollian 极限重现平直空间 BPS 带电黑洞熵。

Quantum Chaos and Spread of States in Krylov Subspace: A Topical Review

Hyun-Sik Jeong, Juan F. Pedraza · hep-th, nlin.CD, quant-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：Krylov态复杂度，或称扩展复杂度，已成为量子混沌、信息扩散和多体动力学的一种敏锐且通用的诊断工具。它建立在Lanczos算法之上并以最优基定理为基础，从而为量子动力学提供了稳健的光谱窗口。一个核心主题是混沌系统中观察到的特征性过冲：混沌演化使态在Krylov链上比可积系统中更深入，然后弛豫到平衡。这种行为与谱统计的随机矩阵普适类相关，并在广泛模型中得到展示，包括量子台球、量子自旋链以及SYK模型的变体。我们还讨论了在Einstein引力中对Krylov复杂度的全息描述的提议，最后概述未来方向和开放问题，包括含时系统和量子场论表述。文中提供了一个Mathematica笔记本，用于跨模型数值探索Krylov复杂度和谱统计。

English: Krylov state complexity, or spread complexity, has emerged as a sharp and versatile diagnostic of quantum chaos, information spreading, and many-body dynamics. Built from the Lanczos algorithm and grounded in the optimal-basis theorem, Krylov complexity thereby provides a robust spectroscopic window into quantum dynamics. A central theme is the characteristic overshoot observed in chaotic systems: a complexity peak in which chaotic evolution drives the state deeper into the Krylov chain than in integrable systems before relaxing to equilibrium. This behavior, tied to random-matrix universality classes of spectral statistics, is illustrated across a broad range of models, including quantum billiards, quantum spin chains, and variants of the SYK model. We also discuss proposed holographic descriptions of Krylov complexity in Einstein gravity, and conclude by outlining future directions and open problems, including time-dependent systems and quantum-field-theoretic formulations. A Mathematica notebook is provided for numerical exploration of Krylov complexity and spectral statistics across models.

一句话导读：专题综述：Krylov/spread复杂度作为量子混沌、信息扩散与多体动力学的诊断，并讨论其在Einstein引力中的全息描述。

中文摘要：我们建立了一个自下而上的模型，在引力侧研究“would-be” de-Sitter/interface CFT (dS/ICFT) 对应，使用 Coleman-De Luccia 瞬子。将暴胀子剧烈变化的区域用一个膜吸收后，时空由两个半径不同的 de Sitter 时空组成，并由一个膜连接；若 dS/CFT 猜想正确，这预期对偶于一个 interface CFT。我们的目标是分析现有的全息计算赝熵的方案，即在此类时空中的极值面，并论证其中一些方案会与 interface CFT 的普适性质所预期的结果产生矛盾；在解析延拓后，我们将结果与 Anti de Sitter/interface CFT 对应 (AdS/ICFT) 的结果进行比较。我们还从垂直于界面的子区域的纠缠熵中读出 g-函数。

English: We establish a bottom-up model for studying the `would-be' de-Sitter/interface CFT (dS/ICFT) correspondence on the gravity side, using the Coleman-De Luccia instanton. After absorbing the region where the inflaton changes dramatically by a brane, the spacetime consists of two de Sitter spacetimes with different radii joined by a brane, which is expected to be dual to an interface CFT provided that the dS/CFT conjecture is correct. Our goal is to analyze existing prescriptions for the holographic computation of pseudo-entropy, i.e. the extremal surface in such a spacetime and argue that some of them would cause parodox with the results expected the universal properties of interface CFT and compare our results with that of Anti de Sitter/interface CFT correspondence (AdS/ICFT) after analytic continuation. We also read off the $g$-function from the entanglement entropy associated with a subregion perpendicular to the interface.

CFT 中尖角杂质动力学的正性约束

Positivity constraints on the dynamics of cusped impurities in CFTs

Jeevan Chandra · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el · v2 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：尖角反常维数是带尖角的线缺陷自由能中的普适对数贡献，并为刻画缺陷动力学提供了有用的观测量。我们将其推广到存在平面共形边界或界面的带尖角线缺陷。该几何由三个角度以及尖角到边界或界面的距离刻画，后者区分短距离与长距离区域。所得自由能包含两个大对数项：一个由通常的真空尖角反常维数控制的短距离贡献，以及一个对边界或界面敏感的新长距离贡献。利用缺陷射线的横向形变的反射正性，我们导出了对这些对数项系数的若干约束，这些约束可打包为其角 Hessian 的负半定性。我们还导出了这些系数延拓到洛伦兹运动学的约束。我们计算了这些系数，并在自由标量和麦克斯韦理论以及弱耦合平面 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中，针对各种边界条件选择显式验证了约束。在强耦合下，我们在全息 D3-D5 缺陷 CFT 中计算了对数系数，并发现由尖角相对于界面的几何驱动的竞争弦世界面之间的 Gross-Ooguri 样相变。我们还观察到该设置中尖角自由能与全息角纠缠熵之间的密切联系。

English: The cusp anomalous dimension is the universal logarithmic contribution to the free energy of a line defect with a cusp, and provides a useful observable characterizing defect dynamics. We generalize this notion to cusped line defects in the presence of a planar conformal boundary or interface. The geometry is characterized by three angles, and the distance of the cusp from the boundary or interface which separates short-distance and long-distance regimes. The resulting free energy contains two large logarithmic terms: a short-distance contribution governed by the usual vacuum cusp anomalous dimension, and a new long-distance contribution sensitive to the boundary or interface. Using reflection positivity for transverse deformations of the defect rays, we derive several constraints on the coefficients of these logarithmic terms, which can be packaged into negative semi-definiteness of their angular Hessians. We also derive constraints on the continuation of these coefficients to Lorentzian kinematics. We compute these coefficients and verify the constraints explicitly in free scalar and Maxwell theories and in planar $\mathcal N=4$ super-Yang-Mills theory at weak coupling for various choices of boundary conditions. At strong coupling, we compute the logarithmic coefficients in the holographic D3-D5 defect CFT and find a Gross-Ooguri-like phase transition between competing string worldsheets driven by the geometry of the cusp relative to the interface. We also observe a close connection of the cusp free energy in this setup with holographic corner entanglement entropy.

一句话导读：该文将尖角反常维数推广到有共形边界/界面的线缺陷，并用反射正性、微扰和全息 D3-D5 计算约束其对数系数，发现弦世界面相变及与全息角纠缠熵的联系。

中文摘要：我们研究了由两个耦合的 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 系统构成的动态打开的马约拉纳结。一个含时双线性耦合驱动系统从近乎退耦区域到强杂化区域，给出了马约拉纳快门的相互作用实现。利用围绕共形 q=4 SYK 鞍点的大 N Keldysh 理论低频分析，我们发现打开过程保留了强红外记忆，相关反常响应对红外截断越来越敏感。对两个 N=8 SYK 团簇的精确有限维模拟显示，打开后部门间纠缠增强、宇称转移以及跨部门算符加扰。这些结果将共形 SYK 动力学的红外结构与有限尺寸多体加扰联系起来，并表明一个动态打开的相互作用马约拉纳系统可以在二次极限之外保留长波记忆。

English: We study a dynamically opened Majorana junction formed by two coupled Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev (SYK) systems. A time-dependent bilinear coupling drives the system from a nearly decoupled to a strongly hybridized regime, providing an interacting realization of a Majorana shutter. Using a low-frequency analysis of the large-$N$ Keldysh theory around the conformal $q=4$ SYK saddle, we find that the opening retains a strong infrared memory, with the associated anomalous response becoming increasingly sensitive to the infrared cutoff. Exact finite-dimensional simulations of two $N=8$ SYK clusters show enhanced inter-sector entanglement, parity transfer, and cross-sector operator scrambling after the opening. These results connect the infrared structure of conformal SYK dynamics with finite-size many-body scrambling and show how a dynamically opened interacting Majorana system can retain long-wavelength memory beyond the quadratic limit.

Nonlinear tails in the Kerr black hole ringdown

Siyang Ling, Sam S. C. Wong · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：由广义相对论非线性引起的幂律尾（“源化”或“非线性”尾）最近被证明主导 Schwarzschild 黑洞铃宕的晚期波形。我们通过研究 Teukolsky 方程，将此类非线性尾的解析结果从 Schwarzschild 推广到 Kerr 黑洞。利用径向 Green 函数的远场近似，我们解析推导了自旋权重 s≠0、谐波模式 (ℓm) 和源衰减 r^{-β} 下的尾幂律。具体而言，我们发现当 β≤1 或 β≥ℓ−s+2 时为 t^{-ℓ−β−s} 尾，而当 2≤β≤ℓ−s+1 时为 t^{-2ℓ−3} 的 Price 尾。我们的数值检验与这些解析结果精确一致。我们还通过数值求解 Teukolsky 方程，展示了无质量标量场此类非线性尾的动态形成。在所有数值结果中，Kerr 黑洞非线性尾与 Schwarzschild 黑洞具有相同幂律，这与远场区域时空的 Minkowski 性质相符。

English: Power law tails induced by nonlinearities of General Relativity (``sourced'' or ``nonlinear'' tails) were recently shown to dominate the late time waveform of Schwarzschild black hole ringdowns. We extend the analytical results regarding such nonlinear tails from Schwarzschild to Kerr black holes by studying the Teukolsky equation. Using a far field approximation to the radial Green's function, we analytically derived the tail power law for spin-weight $s \neq 0$, harmonic mode $(\ell m)$ and source decay $r^{-\beta}$. Specifically, we found a $t^{-\ell-\beta-s}$ tail for $\beta \leq 1$ or $\beta \geq \ell - s + 2$, and a $t^{-2\ell-3}$ Price tail for $2 \leq \beta \leq \ell - s + 1$. Our numerical tests were in exact agreement with these analytic results. We also demonstrate the dynamical formation of such nonlinear tails for a massless scalar by numerically solving the Teukolsky equation. In all numerical results, Kerr black hole nonlinear tails have the same power laws as that for Schwarzschild black holes, as expected from the Minkowski nature of the spacetime in the far field region.

Jean-Simon C\^ot\'e, Jean-Fran\c{c}ois Fortin · hep-ph, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：Gertsenshtein 效应可用于探测高频随机引力波背景，其频率远高于标准宇宙学源的范围。本文通过求解相关 Stokes 参数的演化方程，重新审视磁星磁层中电磁波与引力波之间的转化。在此过程中，我们指出文献中通常采用的绝热近似在 Gertsenshtein 效应背景下一般并不成立。为获得解析结果，我们聚焦于两种绝热近似成立的具体几何构型。由此，我们推导出由磁星电磁辐射转化为引力波所产生的随机引力波背景的下界，并通过要求背景引力波转化为电磁辐射不超过观测到的磁星 X 射线波段通量，得到其上界。我们的结果表明，通过磁星电磁辐射的 Gertsenshtein 转化产生的引力波所产生的随机背景可忽略，正如预期。

English: The Gertsenshtein effect can be used to probe the stochastic gravitational wave background at high frequencies, well above the range of standard cosmological sources. In this paper, we revisit the conversion between electromagnetic and gravitational waves in the magnetosphere of magnetars by solving the evolution equations of the associated Stokes parameters. In the process, we point out that the adiabatic approximation usually taken in the literature is not generally justified in the context of the Gertsenshtein effect. To derive analytical results, we focus our attention on two specific geometries where the adiabatic approximation is valid. From these, we derive a lower bound on the stochastic gravitational wave background from the conversion of magnetar electromagnetic emission into gravitational waves, and an upper bound by requiring that the conversion of background gravitational waves into electromagnetic radiation does not exceed the observed magnetar flux in the X-ray band. Our results demonstrate that gravitational waves generated through the Gertsenshtein conversion of magnetar electromagnetic emission produce a negligible stochastic background, as anticipated.

de Sitter 时空中的高维圈量子黑洞：准正规模与阴影特征

Higher Dimensional Loop Quantum Black hole in de Sitter Spacetime: Quasinormal Modes and Shadow Signatures

Sara Saghafi, Kourosh Nozari, Ali Mohammadpour · gr-qc, hep-ph, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：我们研究 de Sitter 背景中高维圈量子修正黑洞的动力学和光学性质。我们首先分析视界结构，并确定由极端和 Nariai 位形界定的容许非极端黑洞参数域，确保在所考虑的参数集中存在不同的内视界、事件视界和宇宙学视界。然后我们考察标量有效势，表明圈量子修正主要在强场区域使经典散射势垒发生形变，同时保持其特征单势垒结构。使用带 Prony 提取的时域演化、矩阵方法和 WKB 近似计算无质量标量扰动的准正规模，三种方法之间符合良好。时域波形及其 Prony 和矩阵频率重构为提取的铃宕谱提供了额外的直接一致性检验。我们发现圈量子修正引起准正规模谱的中等偏移，而时空维度具有更强影响，导致更高的振荡频率和阻尼率。所有模式的负虚部表明，在所探索参数范围内对无质量标量扰动是动力学稳定的。与相应的经典黑洞背景比较表明，量子修正准正规模谱保持连续连接到经典光子球分支，圈修正产生定量而非定性变化。

English: We investigate the dynamical and optical properties of a higher-dimensional loop-quantum-corrected black hole in a de Sitter background. We first analyze the horizon structure and identify the admissible nonextremal black-hole domain bounded by the extremal and Nariai configurations, ensuring the existence of distinct inner, event, and cosmological horizons for the parameter sets considered. We then examine the scalar effective potential and show that the loop-quantum correction deforms the classical scattering barrier primarily in the strong-field region while preserving its characteristic single-barrier structure. The quasinormal modes of massless scalar perturbations are computed using time-domain evolution with Prony extraction, the matrix method, and the WKB approximation, showing good agreement among the three approaches. The time-domain waveform and its Prony and matrix-frequency reconstructions provide an additional direct consistency check of the extracted ringdown spectrum. We find that loop quantum corrections induce moderate shifts in the quasinormal spectrum, whereas the spacetime dimensionality has a much stronger impact, leading to higher oscillation frequencies and damping rates. The negative imaginary parts of all modes indicate dynamical stability against massless scalar perturbations within the explored parameter range. Comparison with the corresponding classical black-hole backgrounds shows that the quantum-corrected quasinormal spectrum remains continuously connected to the classical photon-sphere branch, with the loop correction producing quantitative rather than qualitative changes.

一句话导读：研究高维 de Sitter 圈量子黑洞的视界结构、标量有效势与准正规模，发现量子修正仅定量改变谱且动力学稳定，维度效应更强。

曲速壳层的辐射操控

Radiative steering of warp shells

An T. Le · gr-qc, hep-th · v4 · 更新 2026-09-15

中文摘要：我们构造了紧致平直空腔与 Kinnersley 光子火箭外部时空之间的精确类时接合。这些壳层满足严格的表面主能量条件，并在非负辐射下以亚光速进行操控。在静态球面处接合的多段燃烧给出 m_f/m_i=e^{-3L}，其中 L 为外部速度空间路径长度；被支撑的空腔中心服从另一尖锐界限。自相似壳层需要各向异性应力，并具有在环境几何与系数固定下增长的正规模。一个独立的弹性模型允许通过向外发射实现局部自引力反冲控制。在零引力耦合下，精确无应变转向给出尖锐燃料界限和固定持续时间下的旅行极限。角集中和内发射的限制降低效率。对于平滑发射和正内表面密度，无应力反冲要求光子进入空腔。转向后的自引力沉降问题仍未解决。

English: We construct exact timelike junctions between compact flat cavities and a Kinnersley photon-rocket exterior. The shells satisfy the strict surface dominant energy condition and steer subluminally under nonnegative radiation. Burns joined at static spheres give $m_f/m_i=e^{-3L}$ for exterior velocity-space path length $L$; the supported cavity center obeys a separate sharp bound. Self-similar shells require anisotropic stress and have growing normal modes with the ambient geometry and coefficients held fixed. A separate elastic model admits local self-gravitating recoil control with outward emission. At zero gravitational coupling, exact unstrained turns yield sharp fuel bounds and travel limits at fixed duration. Limits on angular concentration and inward emission reduce efficiency. For smooth emission and positive inner-face density, stress-free recoil requires photons to enter the cavity. Self-gravitating settling after a turn remains open.

运动黑洞对硬状态方程流体的吸积

Accretion onto a moving black hole for stiff equations of state

Elliott Ewell, Peter K. Harris, Thomas W. Baumgarte, Stuart L. Shapiro · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-09-14

中文摘要：我们重新研究渐近均匀流体向运动 Schwarzschild 黑洞的吸积，这是 Bondi-Hoyle-Lyttleton 吸积的相对论类比。在已有处理的基础上，我们关注绝热指数 Γ ≥ 5/3 的硬状态方程流体，因为这特别关系到被中子星俘获的原初黑洞。我们进行数值模拟，系统探索稳态吸积率和阻力率对渐近声速 a∞ 与相对速度 v∞ 的依赖，并识别出亚声速和超声速的不同区域；在这些区域中，吸积率和阻力率相对于 v∞ = 0 的球对称吸积率可能增大或减小。我们提出简单的解析近似，以刻画吸积率和阻力率随 a∞ 与 v∞ 变化时所观察到的主要定性特征。

English: We revisit accretion of an asymptotically uniform fluid onto a moving Schwarzschild black hole, the relativistic analog of Bondi-Hoyle-Lyttleton accretion. Expanding on previous treatments, we focus on relativistic accretion of stiff fluids with adiabatic indices $\Gamma \geq 5/3$, which is particularly relevant for the treatment of primordial black holes captured by neutron stars. We perform numerical simulations to systematically explore the dependence of the steady-state accretion and drag rates on the asymptotic sound speed $a_\infty$ and relative speed $v_\infty$, and identify different regimes, both subsonic and supersonic, in which these rates either increase or decrease with respect to the spherical accretion rate for $v_\infty = 0$. We propose simple analytical approximations that capture the qualitative features observed in the dependence of the accretion and drag rates on $a_\infty$ and $v_\infty$.

一句话导读：数值研究运动 Schwarzschild 黑洞对硬状态方程流体的相对论吸积，并给出吸积率与阻力率的近似解析描述。

利用带 EFT 修正光子传播的引力透镜区分 Dymnikova 与 Schwarzschild 黑洞

Distinguishing Dymnikova and Schwarzschild Black Holes through Gravitational Lensing with EFT-Corrected Photon Propagation

Takamasa Kanai · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-14

中文摘要：我们研究在考虑光子传播的有效场论（EFT）修正后，能否通过强引力透镜将 Dymnikova 正则黑洞与 Schwarzschild 黑洞在观测上区分开。我们推导由电磁场与时空曲率之间非最小耦合诱导的修正光子传播定律，并分析 Dymnikova 时空中由此得到的光子轨迹。在强偏转极限下，我们导出对光子球以及描述偏转角对数发散行为的强偏转系数的 EFT 修正。尽管 EFT 修正参数上很小，但在强偏转区域，偏转角对临界轨道附近的光子传播高度敏感，因此这些效应可能变得重要。我们对 Dymnikova 参数 ℓ 的代表性取值计算强偏转观测量，并与相应的 Schwarzschild 结果比较。我们发现，光子传播的 EFT 修正会在强透镜观测量上留下特征印记。此外，随着 Dymnikova 参数 ℓ 趋近其临界值，EFT 修正的贡献变得更加显著，表明近临界区域提供了一个特别敏感的场合，其中依赖曲率的光子传播修正可能影响引力透镜。这些结果表明，强引力透镜连同 EFT 诱导的光子传播修改，可能提供一种区分 Dymnikova 正则黑洞与 Schwarzschild 黑洞的手段。

English: We investigate whether a Dymnikova regular black hole can be observationally distinguished from a Schwarzschild black hole through strong gravitational lensing, taking into account effective field theory (EFT) corrections to photon propagation. We derive the modified photon propagation law induced by non-minimal couplings between the electromagnetic field and spacetime curvature and analyze the resulting photon trajectories in the Dymnikova spacetime. Within the strong deflection limit, we derive the EFT corrections to the photon sphere and the strong-deflection coefficients characterizing the logarithmically divergent behavior of the deflection angle. Although the EFT corrections are parametrically small, their effects can become relevant in the strong-deflection regime, where the deflection angle is highly sensitive to photon propagation near the critical orbit. We evaluate the strong-deflection observables for representative values of the Dymnikova parameter $\ell$ and compare them with the corresponding Schwarzschild results. We find that EFT corrections to photon propagation leave characteristic imprints on the strong-lensing observables. Furthermore, the contribution of the EFT corrections becomes more pronounced as the Dymnikova parameter $\ell$ approaches its critical value, indicating that the near-critical regime provides a particularly sensitive setting in which curvature-dependent corrections to photon propagation may affect gravitational lensing. These results suggest that strong gravitational lensing, together with EFT-induced modifications of photon propagation, may provide a means of distinguishing Dymnikova regular black holes from Schwarzschild black holes.

一句话导读：研究 EFT 修正光子传播下强引力透镜能否区分 Dymnikova 正则黑洞与 Schwarzschild 黑洞。

Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中自旋-1/2 粒子的动力学 II：非相对论情形

Dynamics for Spin-$1/2$ Particles in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity II: Non-Relativistic Case

E. Maciel · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-14

中文摘要：在这项工作中，我研究 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet (EGB) 引力中自旋-1/2 粒子的非相对论量子动力学，并建立高阶曲率修正、费米子动力学与致密天体现象学之间的直接联系。从静态球对称 EGB 时空中的 Dirac 哈密顿量出发，我们执行 Fold-Wouthuysen 变换并导出有效哈密顿量，其中包括相对论动能、引力、自旋-轨道以及高阶曲率贡献。随后使用 Heisenberg 方程得到速度、力和自旋的动力学，揭示平动和自旋输运的显式 EGB 修正。特别地，自旋-轨道部分诱导修正的进动频率，其对广义相对论的分数偏差按 δΩ=-4(ξ/M^2)(M/ρ)^3 标度，为 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合提供清晰的无量纲特征。通过 Ehrenfest 定理，我们还建立量子算符动力学与其半经典引力极限之间的对应。作为天体物理应用，我们考虑恒星质量黑洞 A0620-00，并表明自旋进动约 10^-3 至 10^-4 的预期相对灵敏度可以探测约 10^6 至 10^8 m^2 范围内的 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合，具体取决于轨道半径。这一结果将费米子自旋进动确定为检验带高阶曲率修正引力的互补通道，并提供了一个连接修改引力动力学与强引力区精密现象学的量子力学框架。

English: In this work, I investigate the non-relativistic quantum dynamics of spin-1/2 particles in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet (EGB) gravity and establish a direct connection between higher-curvature corrections, fermionic dynamics, and the phenomenology of compact objects. Starting from the Dirac Hamiltonian in a static, spherically symmetric EGB spacetime, we perform a Fold-Wouthuysen transformation and derive the effective Hamiltonian, including relativistic kinetic, gravitational, spin-orbit, and higher-curvature contributions. Heisenberg equations are then used to obtain the dynamics of velocity, force, and spin, revealing explicit EGB corrections for both translational motion and spin transport. In particular, the spin-orbit sector induces a modified precession frequency whose fractional deviation from general relativity scales as $\delta_{\Omega}=-4(\xi/M^{2})(M/\rho)^{3}$, providing a clear dimensionless signature of the Gauss-Bonnet coupling. Through Ehrenfest's theorem, we also establish the correspondence between the dynamics of quantum operators and their semiclassical gravitational limit. As an astrophysical application, we consider the stellar-mass black hole A0620-00 and show that prospective relative sensitivities in spin precession on the order of $10^{-3}$ to $10^{-4}$ can probe Gauss-Bonnet couplings in the range of approximately $10^{6}$ to $10^{8}\,{\rm m}^{2}$, depending on the orbital radius. This result identifies fermionic spin precession as a complementary channel for testing gravity with higher-curvature corrections and provides a quantum-mechanical framework connecting modified gravitational dynamics to precision phenomenology in strong-gravity regimes.

一种用于长瞬态引力波搜索的半相干重采样方法及其在亚太阳质量原初黑洞双星中的应用

A semicoherent resampling method for long-transient gravitational wave searches with applications to subsolar-mass primordial black-hole binaries

Neil Lu, Cristiano Palomba, Ornella J. Piccinni, Ling Sun · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-09-14

中文摘要：重采样可去除频率演化信号的模型相位演化，将其转化为单色信号。我们提出了一种用于长瞬态引力波搜索的新实现，利用 I 型非均匀快速傅里叶变换（NUFFT）评估重采样数据的傅里叶频谱。取决于相干长度、采样率和所需精度，该实现可比先前某些实现快达两个数量级。为展示其应用，我们用半相干搜索对来自亚太阳质量原初黑洞双星的长持续旋近信号进行了基准测试。对于 40–60 Hz 频段、啁啾质量 5×10^{-4}–10^{-1} M_⊙、相干时长 30 s 且计算成本现实的情况，估计的地平距离在所有考虑的参数空间内超过银河系中心，并在啁啾质量约高于 2×10^{-2} M_⊙ 时超过仙女座星系。这些结果确立了基于 NUFFT 的重采样作为一种计算高效且广泛适用的方法，用于搜索建模的频率演化引力波信号。

English: Resampling removes the modeled phase evolution of a frequency-evolving signal, transforming it into a monochromatic one. We introduce a novel implementation for long-transient gravitational-wave searches that evaluates the Fourier spectrum of the resampled data using a type-I non-uniform fast Fourier transform (NUFFT). This implementation can be up to two orders of magnitude faster than some previous implementations, depending on coherent length, sampling rate, and desired accuracy. To demonstrate its application, we benchmark the method with a semicoherent search for long-duration inspiral signals from subsolar-mass primordial black hole binaries. For a search over $40$--$60\,\mathrm{Hz}$ and chirp masses of $5\times10^{-4}$--$10^{-1}\,M_\odot$, with a coherent duration of $30\,\mathrm{s}$ and a realistic computing cost, the estimated horizon distance exceeds the Galactic Center for all of the parameter space considered and exceeds Andromeda for chirp masses above approximately $2\times10^{-2}M_\odot$. These results establish NUFFT-based resampling as a computationally efficient and broadly applicable approach for searches for modeled, frequency-evolving gravitational-wave signals.

一句话导读：提出基于 NUFFT 的半相干重采样方法，加速长瞬态引力波搜索，并用于亚太阳质量原初黑洞双星。

旋转 Simpson-Visser 黑洞在厚盘照明下的阴影与偏振特征

Shadows and Polarimetric Signatures of Rotating Simpson-Visser Black Holes with Thick Disk Illumination

Bing-Bing Chen, Deyou Chen, Yu-Kang Wang, Muhammad Israr Aslam, Rabia Saleem, Nazek Alessa · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-14

中文摘要：本文研究了被弹道近似吸积流模型包围的 Simpson-Visser 旋转黑洞的阴影和偏振图像。通过数值求解测地线和辐射转移方程，我们讨论了正则化参数 g、自旋参数 a 和观测倾角 θ_o 对 230 GHz 下具有下落运动的结果图像的影响。结果表明，可以观察到对应高阶像的明亮圆环，并伴随一个强度降低的内部区域。g 和 a 对高阶像的大小影响很小，但会显著改变其形状和强度分布。而 θ_o 的变化会改变图像形态，在左侧产生月牙形明亮区域。最后，偏振模式追踪亮度分布，并随 g 和 a 变化，反映了时空结构。这些结果表明，厚盘模型中的强度和偏振为探测 Simpson-Visser 旋转黑洞及近视界吸积物理提供了手段。

English: In this manuscript, we investigate the shadow and polarization images of a Simpson-Visser rotating black hole surrounded by a ballistic approximation accretion flow model. Solving the numerically geodesic and radiative transfer equations, we discuss the influence of the regularization parameter $g$, spin parameter $a$, and observer inclination angle $\theta_o$ on the resulting images at $230\,\mathrm{GHz}$ with an infalling motion. The results interpret that, a bright circular ring corresponding to higher-order images is observed, accompanied by an inner region of decreased intensity. Both $g$ and $a$ has little influence on the size of the higher-order images, but significantly changes their shape and intensity distribution. Whereas, variation in $\theta_o$ modify the image morphology, producing a crescent-shaped bright region on the left side. Finally, the polarization patterns trace the brightness distribution and vary with both $g$ and $a$, reflecting the spacetime structure. These results demonstrates that the intensity and polarization in thick disk models provide probes of Simpson-Visser rotating black holes and near-horizon accretion physics.

一句话导读：数值研究旋转 Simpson-Visser 黑洞在厚盘吸积流下的阴影与偏振图像，并分析正则化参数、自旋和观测倾角的影响。

具有偏好参考系的引力理论后牛顿极限下的致密双星系统

Compact binary systems in the post-Newtonian limit of gravitational theories with preferred frames

Oliver Pitt, Timothy Clifton · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-14

中文摘要：引力波对致密双星旋近的观测为在强场和弱场检验广义相对论偏离提供了机会。此前工作建立了描述无偏好参考系度规引力理论中致密双星动力学的理论无关形式，使用参数化后牛顿（PPN）耦合以及一组额外标量敏感度参数来编码强等效原理破缺。本文将框架扩展到偏好参考系效应，例如矢量-张量引力中可能出现的效应：引入一个类时矢量场标识偏好参考系，并允许致密天体质量依赖于该场与天体四维速度构造的不变量。我们计算至一阶后牛顿（1PN）的修正运动方程，其中偏好参考系 PPN 参数 α1 和 α2 获得新矢量敏感度的贡献。进一步将标量与矢量敏感度统一形式化，并用一个标量-矢量-张量理论示例进行验证。该方法提供了轨道动力学，可将引力波对 PPN 和敏感度参数的限制扩展到允许偏好参考系以及不允许偏好参考系的引力理论。

English: Gravitational-wave observations of compact-binary inspirals offer the opportunity to test deviations from general relativity in both strong and weak-field regimes. In previous work, we developed a theory-independent formalism for describing compact-binary dynamics in metric theories of gravity without preferred frames, using the parametrised post-Newtonian (PPN) couplings together with an additional set of scalar sensitivity parameters that encode violations of the strong equivalence principle. Here, we extend this framework to include preferred-frame effects, of the type that can arise in (for example) vector-tensor theories of gravity. This is achieved by introducing a time-like vector field that identifies the preferred frame, and then by allowing compact body masses to depend on the invariant formed from this field and the body's four-velocity. We calculate the modified equation of motion up to first post-Newtonian order (1PN), where the preferred-frame PPN parameters $\alpha_1$ and $\alpha_2$ acquire contributions from our new vector sensitivities. We further combine scalar and vector sensitivities in a unified formalism, which we validate with an example scalar-vector-tensor theory. This approach provides the orbital dynamics required to extend gravitational-wave constraints on PPN and sensitivity parameters to theories of gravity that admit preferred frames, as well as those that do not.

一句话导读：将无偏好参考系的 PPN 致密双星动力学扩展到含偏好参考系效应，并给出 1PN 运动方程与矢量敏感度贡献。

小波检测滤波器：一种用于引力波瞬变的实时非模板管线，利用图神经网络对符合事件排序

The Wavelet Detection Filter: a real time unmodeled pipeline for gravitational wave transients, ranking coincidences with a graph neural network

Elena Cuoco · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-09-14

中文摘要：对于许多潜在的引力波瞬变源，精确波形模型并不可用，这促使人们开展不假设预定义模板族的搜索。小波检测滤波器（WDF）是一种非模板管线，它识别白化探测器数据小波系数中的多余能量。在此，我们将 WDF 发展为同时用于探测和重建的低延迟管线，本文描述并验证了该管线。我们使用零相位流式自回归白化滤波器，以固定延迟保持瞬变形态，并使用保留的小波系数同时提供检测统计量和信号的稀疏表示。通过组合连续分析窗口中的系数，该管线能够重建长于单个窗口的瞬变。我们用触发图表示探测器之间的候选符合，并用监督和无监督图神经网络（GNN）对其排序。我们从时移数据估计排序后符合的显著性。我们在按 Advanced LIGO 灵敏度曲线着色的高斯噪声上，以及在包含致密双星和核心坍缩超新星注入的真实 O4 应变数据上验证了该管线。应用于 GW250114 时，WDF 在不使用波形模板的情况下将该事件识别为所分析片段中最响亮的零延迟候选。我们测量了该管线的计算成本和引入的延迟。两者都与低延迟搜索兼容，因此 WDF 可以实时在流数据上运行。

English: Accurate waveform models are unavailable for many potential sources of gravitational wave transients, motivating searches that do not assume a predefined template family. The Wavelet Detection Filter (WDF) is an unmodeled pipeline that identifies excess energy in the wavelet coefficients of whitened detector data. Here, we develop WDF into a low latency pipeline for both detection and reconstruction and this paper describes and validates that pipeline. We use a zero phase streaming autoregressive whitening filter that preserves transient morphology with a fixed latency and we use the retained wavelet coefficients to provide both a detection statistic and a sparse representation of the signal. By combining coefficients across consecutive analysis windows, the pipeline reconstructs transients longer than a single window. We represent candidate coincidences between detectors with a trigger graph and rank them with supervised and unsupervised graph neural networks (GNNs). We estimate the significance of the ranked coincidences from time shifted data. We validate the pipeline on Gaussian noise colored according to the Advanced LIGO sensitivity curve and on real O4 strain containing compact binary and core collapse supernova injections. Applied to GW250114, WDF identifies the event as the loudest zero lag candidate in the analyzed segment without using waveform templates. We measure the computational cost of the pipeline and the latency it introduces. Both are compatible with a low latency search,so WDF can run on a stream in real time.

一句话导读：将小波检测滤波器发展为低延迟、可重建的引力波瞬变非模板搜索管线，并用图神经网络对符合候选排序。

\texttt{cWB-space}：面向 LISA 的时频瞬变搜索管线

\texttt{cWB-space}: A time-frequency transient-search pipeline for LISA

Shubhanshu Tiwari, Yumeng Xu, Giovanni A. Prodi · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-09-14

中文摘要：引力波观测可以揭示信号事先未知的源。因此，不要求预测波形的搜索是特定源类搜索的重要补充。对于激光干涉空间天线（LISA），挑战在于在重叠的天体物理源和仪器扰动中寻找这类信号。我们提出了 \texttt{cWB-space}，它通过跟踪信号功率在时间和频率上的分布来识别候选信号，然后在不施加源模型的情况下重建其部分波形。对大质量黑洞并合、其他暴发信号以及仪器扰动的模拟测试了候选识别和探测器响应所携带的信息。响应比较从观测数据估计其背景。对若干激光测量中扰动的测试考察了类似响应可能来自仪器起源的情况。搜索 Sangria 模拟 LISA 数据时，我们将全部六个注入的大质量黑洞双星恢复为排名最高的六个候选。在所研究的区间内，其重建波形与注入信号符合良好。结果展示了研究瞬变的另一条途径，同时将误检率和仪器扰动的一般区分留给未来验证。

English: Gravitational-wave observations can reveal sources whose signals are not known in advance. Searches that do not require a predicted waveform are therefore an important complement to searches for specific source classes. For the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA), the challenge is to find such signals among overlapping astrophysical sources and disturbances in the instrument. We present \texttt{cWB-space}, which identifies candidate signals by following how their power is distributed in time and frequency, and then reconstructs parts of their waveforms without imposing a source model. Simulations of merging massive black holes, other burst signals, and instrumental disturbances test both candidate identification and the information carried by the detector's response. The response comparison estimates its background from the observed data. Tests of disturbances in several laser measurements examine where a similar response can arise from an instrumental origin. Searching the Sangria simulated LISA data, we recover all six injected massive-black-hole binaries as the six highest-ranked candidates. Their reconstructed waveforms agree well with the injected signals over the intervals studied. The results demonstrate another route to investigating transients, while leaving the rate of false detections and general discrimination of instrumental disturbances to future validation.

一句话导读：提出面向 LISA 的无模型时频瞬变搜索管线 cWB-space，并在模拟中恢复六个大质量黑洞双星信号并重建波形。

渐近反德西特（AdS）时空中的替代边界条件

Alternative Boundary Conditions in Asymptotically Anti-de Sitter Spacetimes

Robert M. Wald, Xinkang Wang · hep-th, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-09-14

中文摘要：反德西特（AdS）时空不是整体双曲的，因此通常需要边界条件才能定义良好的动力学。Ishibashi 和 Wald（IW）利用非局域势和各个球谐模式，确定了标量场、电磁场和线性化引力场中能给出适定动力学并具有守恒正能量的边界条件。本文确定哪些 IW 条件在基本场中是局域的，哪些是 AdS 不变的。在四维时空中，标准 AdS 不变边界条件在共形边界上分别将电磁场的重标度磁场设为零、将爱因斯坦引力的重标度磁外尔张量设为零。我们通过将电场与磁场，或相应的外尔张量的任意线性组合设为零，推广了这些标准边界条件，并猜想它们穷尽了 AdS$_{1,3}$ 中局域、AdS 不变且保守的边界条件。还研究了非 AdS 不变的边界条件以及不同时空维数中的边界条件。AdS$_{1,3}$ 中的 AdS 不变条件可推广到 Yang-Mills 理论以及一般 Fefferman-Graham 设定下的非线性引力。我们为这些一般边界条件构造了相空间。一般条件的协变相空间自然与包含 Pontryagin 项的拉格朗日量相关，在引力中则包含 Gauss-Bonnet 项。在引力中，除标准边界条件外，不存在非平凡的渐近规范对称性，并且所有守恒荷（如 ADM 质量）都恒为零，如同闭合宇宙。包含 AdS 在内的具有 Killing 场的时空随后会表现出 Fischer、Marsden 和 Moncrief 意义下的线性化不稳定性。对于非标准边界条件，修改后的辛结构给出了黑洞熵公式的新表达式。

English: Anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetimes are not globally hyperbolic, so boundary conditions are generally needed for well-defined dynamics. Ishibashi and Wald (IW) determined boundary conditions yielding well-posed dynamics with conserved positive energy for scalar, electromagnetic, and linearized gravitational fields, using nonlocal potentials and individual spherical harmonic modes. In this paper, we determine which IW conditions are local in the primary fields and which are AdS-invariant. In four spacetime dimensions, the standard AdS-invariant boundary conditions set the rescaled magnetic field to zero for electromagnetism and the rescaled magnetic Weyl tensor to zero for Einstein gravity on the conformal boundary. We generalize these standard boundary conditions by setting arbitrary linear combinations of the electric and magnetic fields, or the corresponding Weyl tensors, to zero, and we conjecture that these exhaust the local, AdS-invariant, conservative boundary conditions in AdS$_{1,3}$. Boundary conditions with non-AdS-invariance and in different spacetime dimensions are also studied. The AdS-invariant conditions in AdS$_{1,3}$ extend to Yang-Mills theory and nonlinear gravity in a general Fefferman-Graham setting. We construct phase spaces for these general boundary conditions. The covariant phase spaces for general conditions are naturally associated with Lagrangians containing Pontryagin terms and, in gravity, a Gauss-Bonnet term. In gravity, except for the standard boundary condition, no nontrivial asymptotic gauge symmetries exist and all conserved charges such as ADM mass vanish identically, as in a closed universe. Spacetimes with Killing fields including AdS then exhibit linearization instability in the sense of Fischer and Marsden and Moncrief. For nonstandard boundary conditions, the modified symplectic structure yields new expressions for the entropy formula of black holes.

一句话导读：研究渐近 AdS 时空中局域且 AdS 不变的替代边界条件、相空间、守恒荷与黑洞熵修正。

利用致密天体旋近重构暗物质状态方程

Reconstructing the Dark Matter Equation of State with Compact Object Inspirals

Boris Betancourt Kamenetskaia, Qianhang Ding, Hui-Yu Zhu · hep-ph, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-14

中文摘要：我们研究嵌入处于流体静力学平衡的延展暗物质（DM）组态中的致密双星的引力波（GW）特征。若中子星被足够大质量且延展的包层包围，旋近伴星除标准GW能量损失外还会经历动力学摩擦（DF）。我们表明，这种环境效应可通过一个GW可观测量——D函数——分离出来，它直接刻画周围介质引起的附加耗散功率。由于包层密度由暗物质状态方程连同恒星边界条件直接决定，D函数的频率依赖性提供了关于暗部门宏观性质的信息。我们建立了一个基于回归的框架，以在GW旋近观测所探测的密度范围内重构密度剖面和DM状态方程。以代表性DM模型作为基准，我们证明该方法能准确恢复输入状态方程，同时基本不依赖于DM的微观实现。我们的结果表明，未来对致密双星的GW观测可以为暗物质状态方程提供探针。

English: We investigate the gravitational wave (GW) signatures of compact binaries embedded in extended dark matter (DM) configurations in hydrostatic equilibrium. If a neutron star is surrounded by a sufficiently massive and extended envelope, an inspiraling companion experiences dynamical friction (DF) in addition to the standard GW energy loss. We show that this environmental effect can be isolated through a GW observable, the $D$-function, which directly characterizes the additional dissipative power induced by the surrounding medium. Since the density of the envelope is directly determined by the DM equation of state together with the stellar boundary conditions, the frequency dependence of the $D$-function provides direct information about the macroscopic properties of the dark sector. We develop a regression-based framework to reconstruct both the density profile and the DM equation of state over the density range probed by observations of the GW inspiral. Using representative DM models as benchmarks, we demonstrate that the method accurately recovers the input equation of state while remaining largely independent of the microscopic realization of DM. Our results show that future GW observations of compact binaries can provide a probe of the equation of state of DM.

一句话导读：通过致密双星旋近中的动力学摩擦D函数，可从引力波观测重构暗物质密度剖面与状态方程。

利用 LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA O1–O4a 数据探测原初黑洞的暴胀起源

Probing Inflationary Origins of Primordial Black Holes with LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA O1--O4a data

Haipeng An, Huai-Ke Guo, Mai Qiao, Lian-Tao Wang, Chen Yang, Yue Zhao · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-14

中文摘要：大的原初曲率扰动不仅会产生原初黑洞（PBHs），在视界重新进入时还不可避免地产生标量诱导的随机引力波背景。我们分析 LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA O1–O4a 联合数据，以限制产生此类扰动的两种代表性暴胀机制：超慢滚暴胀和暴胀相变。由于没有发现任一情形的证据，我们对地面干涉仪可及频率范围内的曲率谱振幅给出了 95% 可信上限。转换到 PBH 语境中，这些限制已经超过传统限制，探测到远低于 1 的丰度份额。即使 PBH 本身太稀少而无法被直接探测，或已经蒸发，我们的结果依然稳健。这项工作表明，随机引力波观测为小尺度暴胀物理和 PBH 形成提供了一种有力且互补的探针，未来干涉仪有望将灵敏度扩展到更广泛的暴胀时期和 PBH 质量范围。

English: Large primordial curvature perturbations not only produce primordial black holes (PBHs) but also inevitably source a scalar-induced stochastic gravitational-wave background upon horizon reentry. We analyze the combined LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA O1--O4a data to constrain two representative inflationary mechanisms for generating such perturbations: ultra-slow-roll inflation and an inflationary phase transition. Detecting no evidence for either scenario, we place 95% credible upper limits on the curvature-spectrum amplitude across the frequency range accessible to ground-based interferometers. Translated into the PBH context, these limits already exceed conventional constraints, probing abundance fractions far below unity. Our results remain robust even when the PBHs themselves are too rare to be directly detected or have evaporated. This work demonstrates that stochastic gravitational-wave observations offer a powerful and complementary probe of small-scale inflationary physics and PBH formation, with upcoming interferometers promising to extend sensitivity to a wider range of inflationary epochs and PBH masses.

一句话导读：利用 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA O1-O4a 数据限制超慢滚暴胀和暴胀相变产生的标量诱导随机引力波背景，并由此约束原初黑洞形成。
