用机器学习分析解码能量-动量平方引力在中子星中的印记

Decoding the Imprints of Energy-Momentum Squared Gravity in Neutron Stars with Machine Learning Analysis

Sayantan Ghosh, Premachand Mahapatra, Dipti Deb · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc, hep-ph, nucl-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：中子星（NSs）为在强场区域检验引力以及寻找对广义相对论（GR）的偏离提供了独特实验室。在本工作中，我们研究能量-动量平方引力（EMSG）对中子星结构的影响，并利用监督机器学习（ML）考察能否从可观测恒星性质中识别其印记。我们对约 10^4 个核物态方程（EOSs）求解修正的 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程，EMSG 耦合参数取 α = {-5.01, -2.50, 0, +2.50, +5.01}×10^{-38} erg^{-1} cm^3，并计算每个恒星位形的引力质量 M、半径 R、无量纲潮汐形变 Λ 以及基本 f 模振荡频率。在施加对 M、R 和 Λ 的观测约束后，我们将数据集分为训练集和测试集，并使用随机森林（RF）、K 近邻（KNN）、支持向量机（SVM）、逻辑回归（LR）和高斯朴素贝叶斯（GNB），基于 (M, R, Λ, f) 对代表性区间 α = {-5.01, 0, +5.01}×10^{-38} erg^{-1} cm^3 进行分类。RF 分类器表现最佳，准确率约 99.85%，精确率、召回率和 F1 分数均超过 99.8%；KNN 的准确率也超过 99%。近乎对角的混淆矩阵表明，与不同 EMSG 区间对应的、在观测上可行的中子星位形在多维可观测空间中仍高度可分离。我们的结果表明，即使经过观测筛选，中子星可观测星仍保留 EMSG 的稳健印记，从而确立机器学习辅助的中子星观测为一种有前景的补充方法，可用当前和未来的多信使观测探测修改引力。

English: Neutron stars (NSs) provide a unique laboratory for testing gravity in the strong-field regime and for searching for deviations from General Relativity (GR). In this work, we investigate the effects of Energy-Momentum Squared Gravity (EMSG) on NS structure and examine whether its signatures can be identified from observable stellar properties using supervised machine learning (ML). We solve the modified Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations for approximately $10^{4}$ nuclear equations of state (EOSs) for EMSG coupling parameters $\alpha=\{-5.01,-2.50,0,+2.50,+5.01\}\times10^{-38}\,\mathrm{erg}^{-1}\mathrm{cm}^{3}$, and calculate the gravitational mass $M$, radius $R$, dimensionless tidal deformability $\Lambda$, and fundamental $f$-mode oscillation frequency for each stellar configuration. Imposing observational constraints on $M$, $R$, and $\Lambda$, we split our datasets into train and test sets, and we employ Random Forest (RF), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Logistic Regression (LR), and Gaussian Naive Bayes (GNB) to classify the representative sectors $\alpha=\{-5.01,0,+5.01\}\times10^{-38}\,\mathrm{erg}^{-1}\mathrm{cm}^{3}$ using $(M, R,\Lambda,f)$. The RF classifier performs best, achieving an accuracy of approximately $99.85\%$ with precision, recall, and F1-scores exceeding $99.8\%$, while KNN also achieves accuracy above $99\%$. The nearly diagonal confusion matrices demonstrate that the observationally viable NS configurations associated with different EMSG sectors remain highly separable in the multidimensional observable space. Our results show that NS observables retain robust signatures of EMSG even after observational filtering, establishing ML-assisted NS observations as a promising complementary approach for probing modified gravity with current and future multi-messenger observations.

一句话导读：对约万个核物态方程求解EMSG修正TOV方程并用监督学习分类，发现中子星(M,R,Λ,f)仍能高精度区分EMSG参数。

LISA 中恒星质量双黑洞的全局时频搜索

Global time-frequency search for stellar-mass binary black holes in LISA

Diganta Bandopadhyay, Christian E. A. Chapman-Bird, Alberto Vecchio · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v3 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：我们提出了一套完整流程，用于在激光干涉空间天线（LISA）数据中探测和表征由恒星质量双黑洞旋近产生的引力波。分析框架基于一种高效时频实现的自适应半相干探测统计量；我们表明该统计量对非平稳噪声以及不同持续时间和采样节奏的数据缺口具有鲁棒性。在为期两年的 LISA Data Challenge Yorsh 数据上，对于自旋与轨道角动量对齐、轨道偏心率 ≤0.01 的双黑洞全参数空间，该搜索能够探测相干信噪比低至约 11–14 的信号。使用约 40 个 GPU，该搜索可在一天内完成。这里提出的技术还可广泛用于引力波天文学，特别是 LISA 数据中极端质量比旋近的搜索。

English: We present a complete pipeline for detecting and characterizing gravitational waves (GWs) produced by the inspiral of stellar-mass binary black holes in data from the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). The analysis framework relies on an efficient time-frequency implementation of an adaptive semi-coherent detection statistic, which we show to be robust against non-stationary noise and the presence of gaps of varying duration and cadence. The search is able to detect signals with coherent signal-to-noise ratios as low as $\approx 11-14$ over the full parameter space of binary black holes with spins aligned to the orbital angular momentum and orbital eccentricity $\le 0.01$ when deployed on the 2-year-long LISA Data Challenge Yorsh. The search can be run within a day using $\approx 40$ GPUs. The techniques presented here have wider applications in GW astronomy, in particular the search for extreme-mass-ratio inspirals in LISA data.

一句话导读：为 LISA 中恒星质量双黑洞旋近提出全局时频半相干搜索流程，可在非平稳噪声与数据缺口下探测低信噪比信号。

Gravitational and kinematic redshifts of black holes in nonlinear electrodynamics

Marco A. A. de Paula, Mustapha Azreg-A\"inou · gr-qc, astro-ph.GA, astro-ph.HE · v2 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：由非线性电动力学（NED）产生的时空是研究正则黑洞（RBH）解的性质以及非线性电磁场在此背景下印记的良好实验室。过去几十年中，NED 源黑洞（BH）时空引起了广泛关注，但在所谓的 F 框架下获得的带电 RBH 在文献中较少被讨论。我们考虑两个带电的、完全正则的 h 族成员，它们是广义相对论与 NED 最小耦合的解。由于它们潜在的天体物理和天文学应用，我们主要关注光子的运动及其对引力红移和运动学红移以及阴影半径的影响，同时考虑 NED 中光子遵循的有效几何。此外，我们考虑人马座 A* 和 M87* 黑洞的观测数据，以对完全 RBH 的荷质比施加一些约束。我们获得了支配 NED 源黑洞时空的引力红移和运动学红移的一般方程。特别地，对于荷质比高于某个中等值的完全 RBH，我们观察到其物理和几何性质与 Reissner–Nordström (RN) 黑洞存在差异。因此，我们的结果表明，从引力红移和运动学红移的角度，有可能区分基于 NED 的 RBH 解与 RN 黑洞，这暗示了潜在的天体物理相关性。

English: Spacetimes arising from nonlinear electrodynamics (NED) are a good laboratory for studying both the nature of regular black hole (RBH) solutions and the imprints of nonlinear electromagnetic fields within this context. Over the past few decades, NED-sourced black hole (BH) spacetimes have attracted considerable attention, but electrically charged RBHs obtained in the so-called $F$ framework have been less addressed in the literature. We consider two electrically charged, fully regular members of the h-family that are solutions to general relativity minimally coupled to NED. Because of their potential astrophysical and astronomical applications, we mainly focus our investigation on the motion of photons and its implications for the gravitational and kinematic redshifts, as well as for the shadow radius, considering the effective geometry followed by photons in NED. Moreover, we consider the observational data for Sagittarius A$^{\star}$ and Messier 87$^{\star}$ BHs to impose some constraints on the charge-to-mass ratio of the fully RBHs. We obtain the general equations that govern the gravitational and kinematic redshifts of NED-sourced BH spacetimes. In particular, for fully RBHs with BH charge-to-mass ratios above some moderate value, we observe discrepancies in their physical and geometrical properties compared to those of the Reissner--Nordstr\"om (RN) BH. Therefore, our results indicate that it is possible to distinguish NED-based RBH solutions from RN BHs, from the perspective of gravitational and kinematic redshifts, suggesting potential astrophysical relevance.

一句话导读：研究非线性电动力学中带电正则黑洞的光子运动与红移，并利用观测数据约束荷质比，表明可与 RN 黑洞区分。

从近期到下一代探测器连续引力波的多信使可探测性

Multi-messenger detectability of continuous gravitational waves from the near future to next generation detectors

Benjamin J. Owen (Texas Tech University, University of Maryland Baltimore County), Binod Rajbhandari (Texas Tech University, University of Maryland Baltimore County, Rochester Institute of Technology) · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v3 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：连续引力波有潜力改变引力波天文学，并为天体物理、核与粒子物理以及凝聚态物理带来新见解。我们通过结合文献中的各种理论与观测论据，并将这些论据系统地应用于已知天体和未来引力波探测器，评估其可探测性。我们详细说明并更新了此前为支持 Cosmic Explorer 所作的估计 [M. Evans et al., arXiv:2306.13745; I. Gupta et al., Class. Quantum Grav. 41, 245001 (2024)]。通常认为，吸积中子星的自转由引力波辐射调节，并且毫秒脉冲星在被吸积物质掩埋下保留着年轻脉冲星的磁场。如果其中任一论据成立，连续引力波的首次探测很可能通过当前探测器的近期升级实现，而下一代探测器（如 Cosmic Explorer 和 Einstein Telescope）则可能实现大量探测。未来几年内若仍无探测，将开始对当前毫秒脉冲星形成理论提出严重质疑。

English: Continuous gravitational waves have the potential to transform gravitational wave astronomy and yield fresh insights into astrophysics, nuclear and particle physics, and condensed matter physics. We evaluate their detectability by combining various theoretical and observational arguments from the literature and systematically applying those arguments to known astronomical objects and future gravitational wave detectors. We detail and update previous estimates made in support of Cosmic Explorer [M. Evans et al., arXiv:2306.13745; I. Gupta et al., Class. Quantum Grav. 41, 245001 (2024)]. It is commonly argued that the spins of accreting neutron stars are regulated by gravitational wave emission and that millisecond pulsars contain a young pulsar's magnetic field buried under accreted material. If either of these arguments holds, the first detection of continuous gravitational waves is likely with near future upgrades of current detectors, and many detections are likely with next generation detectors such as Cosmic Explorer and the Einstein Telescope. A lack of detections in the next several years would begin to raise serious doubts about current theories of millisecond pulsar formation.

一句话导读：结合理论与观测论据，评估连续引力波在近期升级与下一代探测器中的可探测性及其对毫秒脉冲星形成理论的检验。

大质量自旋-2场对引力波传播的影响

Effects of massive spin-2 fields on gravitational wave propagation

Jose A. R. Cembranos, \'Alvaro Cendal, Hector Villarrubia-Rojo · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：在广义相对论的扩展中，例如大质量双引力或额外维度模型，除标准无质量引力子外，会自然出现大质量自旋-2场。本文探讨这些场对引力波传播的观测印记。我们采用与这类理论一致的现象学框架，在极端相对论极限下推导出解析转移函数，并为旋近源建立可探测性界限。最后，我们利用当前和未来引力波探测器给出可及参数空间的预言。

English: Massive spin-2 fields in addition to the standard massless graviton arise naturally in extensions of general relativity, such as massive bigravity or models with extra dimensions. This work explores the observational signatures of these fields on the propagation of gravitational waves. Adopting a phenomenological framework consistent with such theories, we derive an analytical transfer function in the ultrarelativistic limit and establish detectability bounds for inspiral sources. Finally, we provide forecasts for the accessible parameter space using current and future gravitational wave detectors.

一句话导读：研究大质量自旋-2场在极端相对论极限下对引力波传播的修正，并预测当前与未来引力波探测器的可及参数空间。

噪声表征对毫赫兹随机引力波探测的影响

Effect of noise characterization on the detection of mHz stochastic gravitational waves

Nikolaos Karnesis, Quentin Baghi, Jean-Baptiste Bayle, Nikiforos Galanis · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO · v3 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：脉冲星计时阵列对随机引力波背景（SGWB）的暗示，增强了对毫赫兹频段未来探测的预期，尤其是借助 LISA 空间任务。然而，用单个轨道探测器发现 SGWB 具有挑战性：这要求对仪器噪声进行谨慎建模，而仪器噪声也主要是随机的。已有研究表明，不可知论式噪声重构方法能在探测过程中提供稳健性。我们在先前工作基础上，纳入更真实的仪器模拟和噪声推断模型中更多自由度，并分析 LISA 对 SGWB 灵敏度的受影响情况。特别地，我们用独立的传递函数和功率谱密度样条拟合来建模两类主要噪声源。我们评估可探测性界限及其对噪声模型灵活性和先验概率的依赖，从而改进此前报道的结果。

English: Pulsar timing arrays' hint for a stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) leverages the expectations of a future detection in the millihertz band, particularly with the LISA space mission. However, finding an SGWB with a single orbiting detector is challenging: It calls for cautious modelling of instrumental noise, which is also mainly stochastic. It was shown that agnostic noise reconstruction methods provide robustness in the detection process. We build on previous work to include more realistic instrumental simulations and additional degrees of freedom in the noise inference model and analyze the impact of LISA's sensitivity to SGWBs. Particularly, we model the two main types of noise sources with separate transfer functions and power spectral density spline fitting. We assess the detectability bounds and their dependence on the flexibility of the noise model and on the prior probability, allowing us to refine previously reported results.

一句话导读：研究更真实的仪器模拟与噪声推断自由度如何影响 LISA 对毫赫兹随机引力波背景的可探测性。

有效场论中快速旋转黑洞的振铃

Ringing of rapidly rotating black holes in effective field theory

Tom van der Steen, Simon Maenaut, Stef J. B. Husken, Pedro G. S. Fernandes, Maxim D. Jockwer, Vitor Cardoso, Thomas Hertog, Tjonnie G. F. Li · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：在引力的有效场论方法中，对广义相对论的偏离可由高阶曲率算符系统描述。然而，在快速旋转区域，计算由此产生的黑洞准正规模谱修正仍然困难，因为自旋微扰展开在此失效。我们使用近期构造的数值旋转黑洞解，计算有效场论领头阶的准正规模频率修正。聚焦标量扰动，我们评估三次曲率修正，它们构成领头修正。我们采用伪谱配置法在这些背景上求解所得扰动方程，从而在广泛参数范围内实现精确计算。我们得到 l≤5 的所有 m 基本模频率修正，以及 2≤l≤5 的所有 m 一阶泛音频率修正，自旋达到 a=0.99M，相对误差低于 10^{-4}。我们观察到某些模式的修正随着自旋接近近极端区域而显著增长。

English: Within the effective field theory approach to gravity, deviations from general relativity can be systematically described by higher-curvature operators. However, computing the resulting corrections to black hole quasinormal mode spectra remains challenging in the rapidly rotating regime, where perturbative expansions in the spin break down. We use recently constructed numerical rotating black hole solutions to compute quasinormal mode frequency corrections at leading order in the effective field theory. Focusing on scalar perturbations, we evaluate cubic-curvature corrections, which constitute the leading modifications. We employ a pseudo-spectral collocation method to solve the resulting perturbation equations on these backgrounds, enabling accurate computation across a broad parameter range. We obtain frequency corrections for fundamental modes with $l\le5$ for all $m$, and the first overtone of $2 \le l \le 5$ modes for all $m$ for spins up to $a=0.99M$, with relative errors below $10^{-4}$. We observe that corrections to certain modes grow significantly as the spin approaches the near-extremal regime.

一句话导读：利用数值旋转黑洞背景和伪谱法计算高阶曲率有效场论对标量准正规模频率的领头修正，覆盖近极端自旋。

光速 Horndeski 引力中屏蔽的主方程

A Master Equation for Screening in Luminal Horndeski Gravity

Sergi Sirera, Tessa Baker, James Hallam, Krishna Naidoo · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：从一般的标量-张量拉格朗日量确定活跃的屏蔽机制仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。作为诊断工具，我们系统研究了光速 Horndeski 理论中的非线性宇宙学扰动。在平直 FLRW 背景上采用 α-基，我们推导并整理了完整的未近似二阶扰动方程，并系统地应用准静态和弱场极限。我们发现二阶效应只修正标量场方程。对于静态球对称位形，我们推导出一个主屏蔽方程，对驱动屏蔽的非线性算符进行分类，重现 Vainshtein 机制和 chameleon 屏蔽的开端。我们还识别出一个新的候选区域，称为 Phaedrus 屏蔽，其特征是屏蔽半径随源质量线性标度。对于每种机制，我们推导解析和数值解，并阐明其激活条件。引入两个新的公开软件包：(i) xAlpha，一个用于计算和整理标量-张量理论中扰动方程的 Mathematica 包；(ii) escut，一个用于求解非线性标量方程的 Python 模块。在许多情况下，这些工具能够直接从光速 Horndeski 拉格朗日量识别活跃的屏蔽类型。

English: Determining the active screening mechanism from a general scalar-tensor Lagrangian remains a challenging problem. As a diagnostic tool, we present a systematic study of nonlinear cosmological perturbations in luminal Horndeski theories. Working in the $\alpha$-basis on a flat FLRW background, we derive and organise the full set of unapproximated second-order perturbation equations and systematically apply the quasistatic and weak-field limits. We find that second-order effects modify only the scalar-field equation. We derive, for static and spherically symmetric configurations, a master screening equation that classifies the nonlinear operators driving screening, recovering the Vainshtein mechanism and the onset of chameleon screening. We also identify a novel candidate regime, which we term Phaedrus screening, characterised by a screening radius that scales linearly with the source mass. For each mechanism, we derive analytical and numerical solutions and clarify the conditions under which they activate. Two new publicly available software packages are introduced: (i) xAlpha, a Mathematica package to compute and organize perturbation equations in scalar-tensor theories, and (ii) escut, a python module to solve the nonlinear scalar equation. In many cases, these tools enable the identification of the active screening type directly from a luminal Horndeski Lagrangian.

一句话导读：在光速 Horndeski 理论中推导静态球对称主屏蔽方程，统一分类 Vainshtein、chameleon 及新提出的 Phaedrus 屏蔽并发布配套计算工具。

验证连续引力波计时模型的精度：LALSuite 与 PINT 的比较

Validating Timing-Model Accuracy for Continuous Gravitational Waves: A Comparison of LALSuite and PINT

Kartikey Sharma, Reinhard Prix, Maria Alessandra Papa, Curt Cutler · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：我们报告了对连续引力波 LALSuite 计时模型进行系统性验证的结果，并以高精度现代脉冲星计时软件包 PINT 作为对照。精确的计时模型对于跟踪信号相位，从而探测并准确刻画连续引力波至关重要。为量化计时不准确性的影响，我们推导并验证了领头阶关系 μ ≈ (2π f)^2 stdτ^2，其中 μ 是信号功率的分数损失，f 是信号频率，stdτ^2 是计时误差的方差。随后，我们将 LALSuite 计时模型的太阳系分量和双星分量与 PINT 中对应模型进行比较。使用原始 LALSuite Einstein 延迟实现时，总不一致由该分量主导，stdτ ≈ 2.3 μs（在 f=1000 Hz 对应 μ≈0.02%）。使用较新的 Einstein 延迟实现后，总不一致（一年内）降至 stdτ ≲31 ns（在 f=1000 Hz 对应 μ≲4×10^-8），并由 Roemer 延迟中天文台贡献主导，这是由于 LALSuite 使用了近似地球自转模型。我们还使用来自 474 颗编目双星脉冲星的轨道参数测试双星延迟，并验证 LALSuite 源时导数的自洽性。最后，我们推导并讨论 LALSuite 对穿过太阳内部信号的 Shapiro 延迟，这种情况仅与引力波相关。

English: We present results of a systematic validation of the \lalsuite{} timing model for continuous gravitational waves against \pint{}, a modern high-accuracy pulsar-timing package. An accurate timing model is essential for tracking the signal phase, and hence for detecting and accurately characterizing continuous gravitational waves. In order to quantify the impact of timing inaccuracies, we derive and validate the leading-order relation $\mu \approx (2\pi f)^2\stddtau^2$, where $\mu$ is the fractional loss of signal power, $f$ is the signal frequency, and $\stddtau^2$ is the variance of the timing errors. We then compare the solar-system and binary components of the \lalsuite{} timing model against the corresponding models in \pint{}. With the original \lalsuite{} Einstein-delay implementation, the total disagreement is dominated by that component and has $\stddtau\simeq\SI{2.3}{\micro\second}$ (corresponding to $\mu\simeq\SI{0.02}{\percent}$ at $f=\SI{1000}{\hertz}$). With the newer Einstein-delay implementation, the total disagreement (over one year) drops to $\stddtau\lesssim\SI{31}{\nano\second}$ (or $\mu\lesssim\num{4e-8}$ at $f=\SI{1000}{\hertz}$) and is dominated by the observatory contribution to the \Romer{} delay, owing to the approximate Earth-rotation model used by \lalsuite{}. We additionally test binary delays using orbital parameters from \num{474} catalogued binary pulsars and verify the self-consistency of the \lalsuite{} source-time derivatives. Finally, we derive and discuss the \lalsuite{} Shapiro delay for signals passing through the solar interior, a case only relevant to gravitational waves.

一句话导读：系统比较 LALSuite 与 PINT 对连续引力波的计时模型，量化相位误差导致的功率损失，并评估太阳系与双星延迟项差异。

引力波基础数据处理

Basic Data Processing of Gravitational Waves

Jingxu Wu, YuWei Yin, Chenjia Li, Yan Wang · astro-ph.IM, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：本文提供了引力波数据处理的综合指南，特别关注信号生成、噪声建模和优化技术。首先介绍引力波以及 LIGO 和 Virgo 使用的探测技术，随后涵盖信号处理基础，包括傅里叶分析、滤波和二次啁啾信号的生成。文中详细探讨了有色高斯噪声及其对 LIGO 等干涉探测器的影响，以及广义似然比检验 (GLRT) 等信号检测方法。本文还深入研究了粒子群优化 (PSO) 等优化技术，这些技术可用于提高信号估计精度。通过提供基于 MATLAB 的实现，本手册为引力波天文学领域的研究人员提供了兼具理论和实践价值的资源。

English: This paper provides a comprehensive guide to gravitational wave data processing, with a particular focus on signal generation, noise modeling, and optimization techniques. Beginning with an introduction to gravitational waves and the detection techniques used by LIGO and Virgo, the manual covers the essentials of signal processing, including Fourier analysis, filtering, and the generation of quadratic chirp signals. The analysis of colored Gaussian noise and its impact on interferometric detectors like LIGO is explored in detail, alongside signal detection methods such as the Generalized Likelihood Ratio Test (GLRT). The paper also delves into optimization techniques like Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), which can be applied to improve signal estimation accuracy. By providing MATLAB-based implementations, this manual serves as both a theoretical and practical resource for researchers in the field of gravitational wave astronomy.

一句话导读：一本关于引力波数据处理的手册，涵盖信号生成、噪声建模与优化技术，并提供 MATLAB 实现。

用解析近似模型限制旋进主导引力波事件的初始轨道偏心率

Constraining initial orbital eccentricity of inspiral-dominated gravitational-wave events with an analytic approximant

Hemantakumar Phurailatpam, Gopakumar Achamveedu, Maria Haney, Tjonnie Li, Srishti Tiwari · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v4 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA合作组已零星探测到GW170817和GW190425等旋进主导的引力波事件。这些事件提供了利用旋进模板族限制可能初始（残余）轨道偏心率的机会。我们详细介绍一个LALSuite近似模型TaylorF2Ecck，它在后牛顿（PN）精度下解析建模非自旋致密双星在偏心轨道上的旋进引力波，并将初始偏心率贡献限制在领头阶。具体而言，我们的频率域近似模型一致地纳入至3PN阶的轨道、近星点进动和引力波辐射效应。我们在进行全面合理性检验以验证模型性能并研究相关参数空间中偏心率与近星点进动影响后，使用TaylorF2Ecck对GW170817和GW190425进行参数估计研究。结果表明，在90%可信区间内，20 Hz处的初始偏心率可忽略（GW170817小于0.016，GW190425小于0.023，两个后验分布均趋向零），贝叶斯因子没有显示出强证据支持偏心波形优于准圆波形。在如此可忽略的初始偏心率下，包含与不包含近星点进动的偏心模型比较未显示该效应的清晰特征，后验分布没有显著依赖模型的移动，也没有强贝叶斯因子证据支持一个模型优于另一个。此外，这些详细研究揭示了至少纳入至3.5PN阶初始偏心率贡献的重要性，并讨论了其意义。我们使用包含超出传统3.5PN阶傅里叶相位贡献的准圆TaylorF2近似模型版本来证实这一推断。

English: The LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA consortium has sporadically detected inspiral-dominated gravitational-wave events such as GW170817 and GW190425. These events offer an opportunity to constrain possible initial (residual) orbital eccentricities using inspiral template families. We detail an LALSuite approximant, TaylorF2Ecck, which analytically models inspiral gravitational waves from nonspinning compact binaries in post-Newtonian (PN)-accurate eccentric orbits and restricts initial-eccentricity contributions to leading order. Specifically, our frequency-domain approximant consistently incorporates orbital, advance of periastron, and gravitational-wave emission effects up to 3PN order. We conduct parameter-estimation studies of GW170817 and GW190425 using TaylorF2Ecck, following comprehensive sanity checks to validate model performance and investigate the influence of eccentricity and periastron advance in the relevant parameter space. The results indicate that the initial eccentricity at 20 Hz is negligible within the 90 percent credible intervals (less than 0.016 for GW170817 and less than 0.023 for GW190425, with both posterior distributions railing toward zero), and Bayes factors show no strong evidence favoring the eccentric waveform over the quasicircular waveform. At such negligible initial eccentricities, comparisons between eccentric models with and without periastron advance show no clear signature of this effect, with no significant model-dependent shifts in the posterior distributions and no strong Bayes-factor evidence favoring one model over the other. Additionally, these detailed studies reveal the importance of incorporating initial-eccentricity contributions at least up to 3.5PN order and discuss its implications. We substantiate this inference using versions of the quasicircular TaylorF2 approximant that incorporate Fourier phase contributions beyond the conventional 3.5PN order.

一句话导读：构建TaylorF2Ecck解析近似并用于GW170817/GW190425参数估计，发现初始偏心率在90%可信区间内可忽略。

合并超大质量双黑洞中的吸积、喷流与反冲：LISA 的瞬发电磁并合后对应体

Accretion, Jets, and Recoil in a Merging Supermassive Black Hole Binary: A Prompt Electromagnetic Postmerger Counterpart for LISA

Maria Chiara de Simone (RIT), Manuela Campanelli (RIT), Lorenzo Ennoggi (RIT), Carlos O. Lousto (RIT), Yosef Zlochower (RIT) · astro-ph.GA, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：我们报告了首个三维广义相对论磁流体动力学模拟，该模拟在动态时空中自洽地追踪了一个自旋错位超大质量双黑洞周围的磁化气体，从晚期旋近经过并合到引力波反冲遗迹的过程。等质量双黑洞处于“悬挂踢出”构型，嵌入在已弛豫的环双星盘中，在演化最后约40个轨道之前已弛豫了165个双星轨道。在旋近期间，每个黑洞都拥有一个强烈扭曲的迷你盘，其喷流在视界附近沿局部自旋轴方向，随后在更远处与双星角动量方向对齐。并合使遗迹获得约1032 km/s的反冲速度，但遗迹仍保留其引力束缚的环双星盘，且重新发射的喷流保持并合前的取向。热光度增亮约2.2倍，由集中在r ≲ 15M范围内的并合驱动激波提供能量，且这种增强在反冲过程中持续存在。我们识别出一个独特的并合后电磁特征：在并合时产生的磁化结构驱动视界磁通量、坡印廷通量和热输出的相关准周期调制，且与吸积率解耦。并合后辐射效率L_EM/Ṁc²在吸积率几乎不变的情况下上升约2.6倍，表明这一辐射由并合而非吸积提供能量。对于10^6倍太阳质量的LISA源，该瞬变现象在几分钟内开启并至少持续数小时，确立了反冲遗迹作为大质量黑洞并合的瞬发并合后对应体，并为解释如3C186这类候选体提供了第一性原理框架。

English: We report the first three-dimensional general relativistic magnetohydrodynamic simulation to follow, self-consistently in a dynamical spacetime, the magnetized gas around a misaligned-spin supermassive binary black hole, from late inspiral through merger to the gravitational-wave recoil of the remnant. The equal-mass binary, in a $\textit{hang-up kick}$ configuration, is embedded in an equilibrated circumbinary disk (CBD), relaxed for 165 binary orbits before we evolve the final $\sim\!40$ orbits. During the inspiral, each black hole hosts a strongly warped minidisk whose jet follows the local spin axis near the horizon before aligning with the binary's angular momentum farther out. The merger imparts a recoil of $\simeq\!1032$ $km\,s$$^{-1}$ to the remnant, which nonetheless retains its gravitationally bound CBD, and the relaunched jet preserves its pre-merger orientation. The bolometric luminosity brightens by a factor $\sim\!2.2$, powered by merger-driven shocks concentrated within $r \lesssim 15\,M$, and the enhancement persists through the recoil. We identify a distinctive postmerger electromagnetic signature: magnetized structures, generated at coalescence, drive correlated quasi-periodic modulations of the horizon magnetic flux, the Poynting flux, and the thermal output, decoupled from the accretion rate. The postmerger radiative efficiency $L_{\rm EM}/\dot{M}c^2$ rises by a factor $\simeq 2.6$ at nearly constant accretion rate, showing that this emission is powered by the merger rather than accretion. The transient turns on within minutes and lasts at least several hours for a $10^6 \ M_{\odot}$ LISA source, establishing recoiling remnants as prompt postmerger counterparts to massive black hole mergers and a first-principles framework for interpreting candidates such as 3C186.

一句话导读：首次三维广义相对论磁流体模拟显示超大质量双黑洞并合反冲后喷流保持方向，产生由并合而非吸积驱动的瞬发准周期电磁对应体。

玻色-费米星的轴向准正规模

Axial Quasi-normal Modes of Boson-Fermion Stars

Hamza Boumaza, Boris Betancourt Kamenetskaia · hep-ph, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：我们研究由普通核物质和自相互作用玻色暗物质成分构成的玻色-费米星的轴向准正规模。平衡位形通过求解耦合的双流体 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程获得，其中中子部分使用若干现实状态方程建模，玻色部分由强耦合区域中具有排斥自相互作用的复标量场描述。我们分析由 Regge-Wheeler 型方程支配的线性轴向微扰，其有效势反映组合物质分布。使用连分式方法，我们计算基频和泛音 w 模的复本征频率。我们得到准正规模谱，并针对若干现实中子星状态方程研究其对暗物质粒子质量、自耦合以及两种流体中心密度的依赖。我们发现，增加暗物质占比会移动振荡频率和阻尼时间。它还可以通过交叉重新排列模式层级，并驱动从中子星型到玻色星型铃宕行为的连续转变。我们的结果表明，后并合致密天体的铃宕引力波信号可以编码暗物质成分的清晰印记，为未来引力波天文台探测暗部门提供新探针。

English: We study axial quasi-normal modes of boson-fermion stars composed of ordinary nuclear matter and a self-interacting bosonic dark matter component. The equilibrium configurations are obtained by solving the coupled two-fluid Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations, where the neutron sector is modeled with several realistic equations of state and the bosonic sector is described by a repulsively self-interacting complex scalar field in the strong-coupling regime. We analyze linear axial perturbations governed by a Regge-Wheeler type equation whose effective potential reflects the combined matter distribution. Using a continued-fraction method, we compute the complex eigenfrequencies of the fundamental and overtone $w$ modes. We obtain the quasi-normal mode spectrum and investigate its dependence on the dark matter particle mass, self-coupling, and the central densities of both fluids for several realistic neutron star equations of state. We find that increasing the dark matter fraction shifts the oscillation frequencies and damping times. It can also reorder the mode hierarchy through crossings, and it drives a continuous transition from neutron star-like to boson star-like ringdown behavior. Our results demonstrate that the ringdown gravitational-wave signal from post-merger compact objects could encode clear imprints of a dark matter component, offering a new probe of the dark sector with future gravitational-wave observatories.

一句话导读：通过双流体TOV与Regge-Wheeler扰动计算玻色-费米星轴向准正规模，显示暗物质占比改变铃宕频率、阻尼及模式层级。

因果集的 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率

Ollivier-Ricci curvature for causal sets

Joe Barton, Samu\"el Borza, Jona R\"ohrig · math.DG, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MG, math.MP · v2 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：我们利用洛伦兹最优传输为因果集引入了一种新的 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率概念。该构造由一个本身具有独立意义的新洛伦兹渐近公式驱动；该公式从邻近因果菱形上概率测度之间的传输距离出发，在更高阶项意义下恢复类时 Ricci 曲率。转到离散情形后，这导向一种沿最大链定义、并由因果菱形上的概率测度构建的细观 Ricci 曲率概念。我们研究若干变体，包括 idle 型和 Lin-Lu-Yau 型曲率，证明局部到整体的传播结果以及类时 Bonnet-Myers 定理，并计算一系列显式因果集的曲率。我们设计高密度 Poisson 撒点数值实验，恢复了 Minkowski、de Sitter 和 anti-de Sitter 空间预期的常曲率特征。这些结果提供了证据，表明该构造从序论数据中捕捉到了类时 Ricci 曲率。

English: We introduce a novel notion of Ollivier-Ricci curvature for causal sets using Lorentzian optimal transport. The construction is motivated by a new Lorentzian asymptotic formula of independent interest, which recovers timelike Ricci curvature, up to higher-order terms, from the transport distance between probability measures on nearby causal diamonds. Passing to the discrete setting, this leads to a mesoscopic notion of Ricci curvature defined along maximal chains and built from probability measures on causal diamonds. We study several variants, including idle and Lin-Lu-Yau type curvatures, prove local-to-global propagation results and timelike Bonnet-Myers theorems, and compute the curvature for a range of explicit causal sets. We design high-density Poisson sprinkling numerical experiments recovering the expected constant-curvature signatures of Minkowski, de Sitter, and anti-de Sitter space. These results provide evidence that the construction captures timelike Ricci curvature from order-theoretic data.

一句话导读：为因果集引入基于洛伦兹最优传输的 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率，并在高密度 Poisson 撒点中恢复 Minkowski、dS、AdS 的常曲率特征。

Cauchy 面叶状结构的 Lorentz 距离族局部等 Lipschitz 性失效

Failure of local equi-Lipschitzness for families of Lorentz distances to Cauchy surface foliations

Gregory J. Galloway, Robert J. McCann, Argam Ohanyan · math.DG, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：已知在时空中，沿一条完备类时线到其上的点以及从这些点出发的 Lorentz 距离函数族，在该线邻域内局部等 Lipschitz 连续。这是经典 Lorentz 分裂定理证明中的关键要素。我们证明，对于给定 Cauchy 时间函数的水平集，到其以及从其出发的 Lorentz 距离函数族，这一性质一般而言会失效。此外，我们基于宇宙学且类时测地完备的时空上存在 Cauchy 时间函数，使得到其水平集的 Lorentz 距离等 Lipschitz，提出若干猜想；这些猜想等价于 Bartnik 分裂猜想。

English: The families of Lorentzian distance functions to and from points along a complete timelike line in a spacetime are known to be locally equi-Lipschitz continuous in a neighborhood of the line. This is an essential component in the proof of the classical Lorentzian splitting theorems. We show that this property fails in general for families of Lorentzian distances to and from the level sets of a given Cauchy temporal function. Moreover, we formulate conjectures based on the existence of Cauchy temporal functions in cosmological and timelike geodesically complete spacetimes such that the Lorentz distances to its level sets are equi-Lipschitz, which are equivalent to Bartnik's splitting conjecture.

一句话导读：证明到 Cauchy 时间函数水平集的 Lorentz 距离族一般不局部等 Lipschitz，并给出与 Bartnik 分裂猜想等价的猜想。

利用GFH-v2流程搜寻来自超新星SN2023ixf的长暂现引力波

Search for Long-Transient Gravitational Waves from Supernova SN2023ixf using GFH-v2 Pipeline

Sandhya Sajith Menon, Lorenzo Pierini, Pia Astone, Cristiano Palomba, Francesco Safai Tehrani, Lorenzo Silvestri, Ornella Juliana Piccinni, Simone Dall'Osso, Stefano Dal Pra, Sabrina D'Antonio, Sergio Frasca, Dafne Guetta, Paola Leaci, Michal Bejger, Alicia Calafat, Evan Goetz, Rafel Jaume Amengual, Ian Jones, David Keitel, Andrzej Krolak, Iuri La Rosa, Andrew Melatos, Joan-Rene Merou, Lorenzo Mirasola, Claudio Salvadore, Alicia M. Sintes, Karl Wette · astro-ph.IM, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：我们展示了对来自SN2023ixf可能新生磁星遗迹的长暂现引力波的有向搜索，SN2023ixf是M101星系中附近的II型核心坍缩超新星。分析使用LIGO Hanford和Livingston在Engineering Run 15期间的数据，使用与超新星相关的on-source窗口内的符合数据。我们针对快速旋转、非轴对称中子星的信号，其自转减慢由引力波辐射主导，产生频率的幂律下降以及相应的应变振幅下降。搜索使用基于广义频率Hough变换的GFH-v2流程进行。没有候选者通过符合和后续分析。因此，我们设定了最大可探测距离作为初始频率和椭率函数的上限。对于最高椭率区间，90%上限在分析频带大部分达到约1-2.5 Mpc的距离。尽管这些限制低于M101的距离，该搜索提供了GFH-v2对附近核心坍缩超新星的首次应用，并刻画了其在真实探测器数据上的性能。

English: We present a directed search for long-transient gravitational waves from the possible newborn magnetar remnant of SN2023ixf, a nearby Type II core-collapse supernova in the M101 galaxy. The analysis uses LIGO Hanford and Livingston data from Engineering Run 15, using coincident data lying within the on-source window associated with the supernova. We target signals from a rapidly rotating, non-axisymmetric neutron star whose spin-down is dominated by gravitational-wave emission, producing a power-law decrease in frequency and a corresponding decrease in strain amplitude. The search is performed with the GFH-v2 pipeline, based on the Generalized Frequency Hough transform. No candidate survives the coincidence and follow-up analysis. We therefore set upper limits on the maximum detectable distance as a function of initial frequency and ellipticity. For the highest ellipticity interval, the 90% upper limits reach distances of about 1-2.5~Mpc across most of the analysed band. Although these limits are below the distance to M101, the search provides the first application of GFH-v2 to a nearby core-collapse supernova and characterizes its performance on real detector data.

一句话导读：利用GFH-v2对SN2023ixf磁星遗迹进行长暂现引力波搜索，未发现候选并给出距离上限。

通过将 Bilby 集成到 PyFstat 实现连续波分析的新采样策略

Enabling new sampling strategies for continuous-wave analyses by integrating Bilby into PyFstat

Maria-Antonia Ferrer-Martinez, David Keitel · astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：对旋转中子星的连续波搜索通常覆盖宽广参数空间并产生大量候选信号，因此随机采样方法在候选后续跟踪与参数估计中发挥重要作用。我们介绍了将贝叶斯推断库 BILBY 集成到开源连续波分析软件包 PyFstat 中，从而在保留现有 PyFstat 分析基础设施的同时，能够使用 BILBY 提供的广泛随机采样器。我们通过高斯噪声中的注入研究，对两种代表性的单阶段后续跟踪配置（定向搜索候选和全天搜索候选）验证了该实现。使用嵌套采样器 DYNESTY，我们获得了与理论灵敏度预测一致的探测效率。在此设置下，DYNESTY 在定向情形中与 PyFstat 现有的基于 PTEMCEE 的实现表现相当，并且对于此处考虑的全天候选后续跟踪也提供了一种有效的单阶段方法，而我们未找到具有类似恢复性能的 PTEMCEE 设置。DYNESTY 的百分位-百分位检验进一步显示出校准良好的可信区间，表明参数估计可靠。虽然对 DYNESTY 设置、多阶段设置和其他采样器的完整探索留待未来工作，但这些结果表明，这一灵活且公开可用的框架为贝叶斯连续波分析开辟了有用的新可能性。

English: Continuous-wave searches for rotating neutron stars usually cover wide parameter spaces and produce a large number of candidate signals. Stochastic sampling methods therefore play an important role in candidate follow-up and parameter estimation. We present the integration of the Bayesian inference library BILBY into the open-source continuous-wave analysis package PyFstat, enabling access to the broad range of stochastic samplers available through BILBY while preserving the existing PyFstat analysis infrastructure. The implementation is validated through injection studies in Gaussian noise for two representative single-stage follow-up configurations: candidates from a directed search and candidates from an all-sky search. Using the nested sampler DYNESTY, we obtain detection efficiencies consistent with the theoretical sensitivity predictions. In this setup, DYNESTY performs comparably to the existing PTEMCEE-based implementation of PyFstat for the directed case, and also provides an effective single-stage approach for the all-sky candidate follow-up considered here, where we did not identify a PTEMCEE setup with similar recovery performance. Percentile-percentile tests for DYNESTY further show well-calibrated credible intervals, demonstrating reliable parameter estimation. While a full exploration of DYNESTY settings, multi-stage setups, and other samplers is left for future work, these results demonstrate that this flexible and publicly available framework opens useful new possibilities for Bayesian continuous-wave analyses.

一句话导读：将 Bilby 集成进 PyFstat，用 Dynesty 等采样器改进连续引力波候选的贝叶斯后续跟踪与参数估计。

The properties of strange quark matter and evolution of strange quark stars

Huai-Min Chen, Cheng-Jun Xia, Guang-Xiong Peng · hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：在这项工作中，我们采用自洽热力学处理研究了奇异夸克物质的性质，并揭示了奇异夸克星的演化过程。我们为研究从原初奇异夸克星到零温稳定奇异星的动力学演化提供了全面而可靠的热力学基础。讨论了恒星演化各阶段的粒子相对丰度、物态方程、温度和质量-半径关系，其中冷奇异夸克星与 Hess J1731-347、PSR J1231-1411、PSR J0030+0451、PSR J0348+0432 和 PSR J0740+6620 的观测质量和半径一致，而这些可能难以用标准中子星模型解释。还给出了示意图，说明固定重子质量下恒星演化不同阶段的状态。

English: In this work, we study the properties of strange quark matter and reveal the evolution process of strange quark stars employing a self consistent thermodynamic treatment. A comprehensive and reliable thermodynamic basis for the study of the dynamic evolution from proto-strange quark stars to stable strange stars at a zero temperature is provided. The relative abundance of particles, equation of state, temperature, and mass-radius relationship at each stage of the evolution of stars are discussed, where the cold strange quark star are consistent with the observational mass and radius of Hess J1731-347, PSR J1231-1411, PSR J0030+0451, PSR J0348+0432, and PSR J0740+6620, which could be difficult to be explained by the standard neutron star model. A schematic diagram is provided as well, illustrating the state of different stages along the evolution of stars at a fixed baryon-mass.

一句话导读：采用自洽热力学处理研究奇异夸克物质性质，并刻画从原初奇异夸克星到稳定奇异星的演化及质量-半径关系。

多信使时代的中子星与夸克星

Neutron Star vs Quark Star in the Multimessenger Era

Zheng Cao, Lie-Wen Chen · astro-ph.HE, hep-ph, nucl-ex, nucl-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：中子星（NS）和自束缚夸克星（QS）仍是脉冲星观测以及双星并合引力波（GW）事件中致密天体的两个主要候选。我们使用通过非参数高斯过程回归构建的、对物理模型不敏感的致密星（CS）物质状态方程（EOS），结合GW170817、PSR J0740+6620、PSR J0030+0451、PSR J0437-4715和PSR J0614-3329的多信使观测，以及来自微扰量子色动力学和手征有效场论的第一性原理计算，对中子星和夸克星的性质进行贝叶斯推断。我们考虑三种情景下的竞争情况：NS情景，即所有致密星均为中子星；udQS情景，即所有致密星均为上-下夸克星；以及双家族情景，即中子星与奇异夸克星（SQS）共存。基于系统贝叶斯模型选择的结果表明，最受青睐的情况属于双家族情景，相对于udQS情况的贝叶斯因子为6.1。在该情况下，PSR J0740+6620被倾向于认为是SQS，而其他五颗致密星（包括GW170817中的两颗）被倾向于认为是NS。相应的静态致密星最大质量为：NS的M_TOV=1.72_{-0.16}^{+0.18} M_sun，SQS的M_TOV=2.63_{-0.31}^{+0.36} M_sun（68%置信区间）。此外，推断出的NS和QS物质中的声速都随密度单调增加并在高密度处饱和，而在NS情景中发现一个显著的峰结构。我们的工作为识别单个致密星的性质以及约束NS和QS中致密物质性质提供了新框架。特别地，最受青睐的情况为根据Witten假说奇异夸克物质的绝对稳定性提供了潜在的天体物理支持。

English: Neutron stars (NSs) and self-bound quark stars (QSs) remain the two primary candidates for the compact objects observed as pulsars and in gravitational-wave (GW) events from binary mergers. Using a physics-agnostic equation of state (EOS) for compact star (CS) matter constructed via nonparametric Gaussian process regression, we perform Bayesian inference of the properties of NSs and QSs by analyzing multimessenger observations from GW170817, PSR J0740+6620, PSR J0030+0451, PSR J0437$-$4715, and PSR J0614$-$3329 together with {\it ab initio} calculations from perturbative quantum chromodynamics and chiral effective field theory. We consider competing cases arising from three scenarios: the NS scenario, in which all CSs are NSs; the udQS scenario, in which all CSs are up-down QSs; and the two-family scenario, in which NSs and strange QSs (SQSs) coexist. Our results based on systematic Bayesian model selection indicate that the most favored case belongs to the two-family scenario, with a Bayes factor of $6.1$ relative to the udQS case. In this case, PSR J0740+6620 is favored as an SQS, while the other five CSs, including the two in GW170817, are favored as NSs. The corresponding maximum mass of a static CS is $M_\text{TOV} = 1.72_{-0.16}^{+0.18} M_\odot$ for NSs and $M_\text{TOV} = 2.63_{-0.31}^{+0.36} M_\odot$ for SQSs at the $68\%$ confidence interval. Moreover, the inferred sound speed in both NS and QS matter increases monotonically and saturates at high densities, whereas a pronounced peak structure is found in the NS scenario. Our work provides a new framework for identifying the nature of individual CSs and constraining the properties of dense matter in both NSs and QSs. In particular, the most favored case provides potential astrophysical support for the absolute stability of strange quark matter according to the Witten hypothesis.

一句话导读：利用多信使观测和贝叶斯模型选择，双家族情景（中子星与奇异夸克星共存）最受青睐，并为奇异夸克物质绝对稳定性提供潜在支持。

ABJM Bethe 可观测量中的常量映射与指数小扇区

Constant Maps and Exponentially Small Sectors in ABJM Bethe Observables

Seyed Morteza Hosseini · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：ABJM 理论的拓扑扭曲指数刻画了带磁荷的超对称 AdS4 黑洞的微观熵。基于伴随论文 arXiv:2608.04107（其重构了 universal twist 处的有限秩扭曲超势），我们利用高精度 Bethe 真空数据、物理启发的符号回归和整数关系确定有限秩指数。Hessian、有效膨胀子和单圈因子编码了超出在壳扭曲超势的信息。两个可观测量共享相同的移位秩。在一个明确声明的有限类中，我们由第 k 阶和第 k/2 阶的 ABJM S^3 常数映射、扭曲超势的常数映射以及初等项重构出指数的常数映射。我们证明对于实数 k>0，它等于一个收敛的单核积分，从而重求和了大 k 展开，固定了此前为数值的常数，并给出任意亏格的 type-IIA 系数。我们还证明 arXiv:2608.04107 中的 Clausen 表达式等于一个交错 Euler 和以及一个绝对收敛积分，从而给出两个有理参数 Euler 和族的闭式求值。在 k=1,2,4 时，指数压制扇区展现出算术结构。扭曲超势的重构系数满足一个除数和公式，并带有一个与权四 Eisenstein 形式相关的、猜想性的全阶 Eichler 积分级数。指数系数约化为两个有理生成元；其中一个具有模积公式，能重现每一个可获得的系数，并暗示一个全阶完成。在此延续条件下，模变换确定了最近的对数奇点、收敛半径和主导系数增长。这些结果为量子引力块和体黑洞量子熵提供了一个有限 N 基准。

English: The topologically twisted index of ABJM theory captures the microscopic entropy of magnetically charged supersymmetric $\mathrm{AdS}_4$ black holes. Building on the companion Letter arXiv:2608.04107, which reconstructed the finite-rank twisted superpotential at the universal twist, we determine the finite-rank index using high-precision Bethe-vacuum data, physics-informed symbolic regression, and integer relations. The Hessian, effective dilaton, and one-loop factors encode information beyond the on-shell twisted superpotential. The two observables share the same shifted rank. Within a declared finite class, we reconstruct the index constant map from the ABJM $S^3$ constant maps at levels $k$ and $k/2$, the constant map of the twisted superpotential, and elementary terms. We prove that it equals a convergent one-kernel integral for real $k>0$, resumming the large-$k$ expansion, fixing a previously numerical constant, and yielding type-IIA coefficients at arbitrary genus. We also prove that the Clausen expression in arXiv:2608.04107 equals an alternating Euler sum and an absolutely convergent integral, giving closed evaluations for two rational-argument Euler-sum families. At $k=1,2,4$, the exponentially suppressed sectors exhibit arithmetic structure. The reconstructed coefficients of the twisted superpotential obey a divisor-sum formula with a conjectural all-order Eichler-integral series associated with a weight-four Eisenstein form. The index coefficients reduce to two rational generators; one admits modular-product formulas reproducing every available coefficient and suggesting an all-order completion. Conditional on this continuation, modular transformations determine the nearest logarithmic singularity, radius of convergence, and leading coefficient growth. These results provide a finite-$N$ benchmark for quantum gravitational blocks and bulk black hole quantum entropy.

一句话导读：通过 Bethe 真空数据与符号回归重构 ABJM 有限秩拓扑扭曲指数，揭示其常数映射和指数小扇区的算术结构，并为 AdS4 黑洞量子熵提供有限 N 基准。

带边界、缺陷和界面的 N=4 SYM 中拉格朗日量的单点函数

One-point functions of the Lagrangian in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM with boundaries, defects and interfaces

Dongming He, Christoph F. Uhlemann, Paolo Vallarino · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：我们获得了 N=4 SYM 中环境拉格朗日量 O_L 的单点函数，其中包含由 Gaiotto 和 Witten 分类的 1/2-BPS 边界、缺陷和界面，这些包括最大超对称 Janus 界面和与双全息相关的 BCFT，以及超对称性降低的 Janus 界面。对于 Janus 界面，我们将最近在某些极限下捕获 <O_L> 的结果推广到对 N 和 λ 的精确依赖，并证实了一个非重整化猜想。我们还澄清了最近关于保持较少超对称性的 Janus 变体的结果。对于具有真实缺陷自由度的通用 1/2-BPS Gaiotto-Witten 理论，我们使用超对称局域化推导单点函数，确认结果在适当极限下与全息预测一致，并表明这些单点函数一般表现出非平凡的耦合依赖性。

English: We obtain one-point functions of the ambient Lagrangian $\mathcal{O}_{\mathcal{L}}$ in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM with $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS boundaries, defects and interfaces classified by Gaiotto and Witten, which include maximally supersymmetric Janus interfaces and BCFTs relevant for double holography, as well as for Janus interfaces with reduced supersymmetry. For Janus interfaces we extend recent results capturing $\langle \mathcal{O}_{\mathcal{L}}\rangle$ in certain limits to exact dependence on $N$ and $\lambda$, and confirm a non-renormalization conjecture. We also clarify recent results for Janus variants preserving less supersymmetry. For general $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS Gaiotto-Witten theories with genuine defect degrees of freedom we derive one-point functions using supersymmetric localization, confirm that the results agree with holographic predictions in the appropriate limits, and show that the one-point functions in general exhibit non-trivial coupling dependence.

一句话导读：计算 N=4 SYM 中带边界/缺陷/界面的拉格朗日量单点函数，验证全息预言和非重整化猜想。

引力辐射的几何

The Geometry of Gravitational Radiation

Jelle Hartong · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：我们考虑四维渐近平直真空时空在未来零无穷附近的几何，并赋予其最一般的允许 Carroll 几何。我们证明，近边界径向展开（到某一阶）可以用通过对共形 Carroll 代数做规范得到的联络来组织。这个规范过程中唯一非零的曲率是与特殊共形生成元相关的曲率，我们称之为 K-曲率。这些 K-曲率的消失定义了一个渐近真空时空，并用它构造真空（软）剪切在边界（即 Carroll）协变形式下由两个边界 Carroll 标量场表示的表达式。K-曲率在 Carroll boost 下以层级方式相互转化。这导致对四类时空的分类：真空、强非辐射、弱非辐射和辐射时空。文章表明，K-曲率对应于在 1/r 展开领头阶的 10 个 Weyl 张量分量中的 5 个。我们还观察到其中一个 K-曲率等于最近发现的 Carroll boost 反常。最后，我们证明边界能量-动量-news 复形的 Bondi 损失方程可以改写为涉及另一个能量-动量张量的形式，该张量具有消失的能量通量、无迹，并且其非守恒完全由 K-曲率捕获。BMS 流可以通过将后一个能量-动量张量与 Carroll 共形 Killing 矢量缩并得到。

English: We consider 4-dimensional asymptotically flat vacuum spacetimes near future null infinity endowed with the most general allowable Carroll geometry. We show that the near-boundary radial expansion (to a certain order) can be organised in terms of connections that can be obtained by gauging the conformal Carroll algebra. The only non-vanishing curvatures in this gauging procedure are those that are associated with the special conformal generators and we will refer to these as the $K$-curvatures. The vanishing of these $K$-curvatures defines an asymptotic vacuum spacetime and we use this to construct a boundary (i.e. Carroll) covariant expression for the vacuum (soft) shear in terms of two boundary Carroll scalar fields. The $K$-curvatures transform in a hierarchical fashion into one another under Carroll boosts. This leads to a classification of 4 types of spacetimes: vacuum, strongly and weakly non-radiative, and radiative spacetimes. It is shown that the $K$-curvatures correspond to 5 of the 10 Weyl tensor components at leading order in their $1/r$ expansion. We furthermore observe that one of the $K$-curvatures is equal to the recently found Carroll boost anomaly. Finally, we show that the Bondi loss equations for the boundary energy-momentum-news complex can be cast into a form involving another energy-momentum tensor with vanishing energy flux that is traceless and whose non-conservation is entirely captured by the $K$-curvatures. The BMS currents can be obtained by contracting this latter energy-momentum tensor with a Carroll conformal Killing vector.

一句话导读：用共形 Carroll 规范几何组织渐近平直时空的引力辐射，并用 K-曲率分类真空/非辐射/辐射时空及 BMS 流。

黑洞并合低频波形的有效 S-矩阵方法

An Effective $S$-Matrix Approach to Low-Frequency Waveforms from Black Hole Mergers

Katsuki Aoki, Feng-Yin Cheng, Andrea Cristofoli, Yu-tin Huang, Hyun Jeong · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：我们发展了一种在壳描述，用于超出领头阶的黑洞并合低频引力波形。将强耦合并合视为有效硬 S-矩阵数据，我们利用软定理和 KMOC 形式组织其长波响应。在次领头阶，量子软定理包含经典软定理中没有的对数项。我们表明，这些额外项在一圈辐射振幅与相应引力子割线之间的完整 KMOC in-in 可观测量中相消，只留下与引力拖曳和早期加速相关的经典对数贡献。我们还识别了来自残余反冲和 Christodoulou 非线性记忆的 1/ω 修正。这些结果揭示了在低频可及的并合信息层级：对数尾仅依赖于渐近硬数据，反冲探测总辐射动量，而非线性记忆探测发射辐射的角分布。

English: We develop an on-shell description of low-frequency gravitational waveforms from black-hole mergers beyond leading order. Treating the strongly coupled merger as effective hard $S$-matrix data, we organize its long-wavelength response using soft theorems and the KMOC formalism. At next-to-leading order, the quantum soft theorem contains logarithmic terms absent from the classical soft theorem. We show that these extra terms cancel in the full KMOC in-in observable between the one-loop radiative amplitude and the corresponding graviton cut, leaving precisely the classical logarithmic contributions associated with gravitational drag and early-time acceleration. We also identify the $1/\omega$ corrections from remnant recoil and Christodoulou non-linear memory. These results reveal a hierarchy of merger information accessible at low frequency: logarithmic tails depend only on asymptotic hard data, recoil probes total radiated momentum, while non-linear memory probes the angular distribution of the emitted radiation.

一句话导读：用有效 S-矩阵、软定理与 KMOC 研究黑洞并合低频引力波波形，并揭示对数尾、反冲与非线性记忆的信息层级。

零弦全息：零弦探测其目标空间的射影边界

Null String Holography, Null Strings Probe Projective Boundary of Their Target Spaces

M. M. Sheikh-Jabbari, H. Yavartanoo · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：我们证明，背景流形 M 上的最小零弦理论在经典意义上等价于其射影边界 ∂_P M 上的 ILST 理论。我们猜想该等价性在量子层面也成立，并将其称为零弦全息。特别地，我们表明 D 维反 de Sitter（AdS_D）的 Poincaré 片上的经典零弦理论由 D-1 维 Minkowski 背景上的 ILST 描述，与著名的 AdS/CFT 相对应。dS_D 宇宙学片上的零弦由 D-1 维平坦欧几里得空间上的 ILST 支配。对于 D 维 Minkowski 空间中的零弦，根据所用坐标片，其“对偶”ILST 理论所在的射影边界可以分别是 dS_{D-1}、D-1 维 Carroll 空间和 D-1 维双曲面，分别包括类空渐近边界 ι^0、渐近零边界 I^± 和类时无穷 ι^±。我们评论零弦全息对黑洞背景的物理意义，这些背景的射影边界包含视界。

English: We prove that the \textit{minimal null string theory} on background manifold ${\cal M}$ is classically equivalent to the ILST theory on the projective boundary of $\mathcal M$, ${\mathcal B}_{_{\text{P}}}={\partial_{_{\text{P}}}\mathcal{M}}$. We conjecture that this equivalence also holds as quantum level, which we dub \textit{null string holography}. In particular, we show classical null string theory on Poincar\'e patch of $D$ dimensional Anti de Sitter (AdS$_D$) background is described by ILST on $D-1$ dimensional Minkowski background, paralleling the celebrated AdS/CFT. Null strings on cosmological patch of dS$_D$ is governed by ILST on $D-1$ dimensional flat Euclidean space. For null strings on $D$ dimensional Minkowski space, depending on the coordinate patch used, the projective boundary where the ``dual'' ILST theory resides, can by dS$_{D-1}$, $D-1$ dimensional Carrollian space and $D-1$ dimensional hyperboloid, respectively including spacelike asymptotic boundary $\iota^0$, asymptotic null boundaries ${\cal I}^\pm$ and timelike infinities $\iota^\pm$. We comment on physical implications of the null string holography on black hole backgrounds whose projective boundary includes horizons.

一句话导读：证明最小零弦理论与其目标空间射影边界上的 ILST 理论经典等价，并将该对应猜想为量子零弦全息。

Reissner-Nordström 黑洞时空中大质量标量场的长寿命共振：大质量区间的解析处理

Long-lived resonances of massive scalar fields in the Reissner-Nordstr\"om black-hole spacetime: Analytic treatment in the large-mass regime

Shahar Hod · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：在无量纲大质量 Mμ≫1 区间（其中 M 和 μ 分别为中心黑洞质量和标量场固有质量），对 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞-大质量标量场复合系统的物理与数学性质进行了解析研究。结果证明，对于中心黑洞无量纲电荷参数 ar Q≡Q/M 的给定值，该系统具有准共振特征，即寿命任意长的线性化扰动模式。特别地，利用解析技术，我们确定了刻画该复合物理系统长寿命共振的黑洞-场临界质量谱 {Mμ_crit(ar Q)}。

English: The physical and mathematical properties of the composed Reissner-Nordstr\"om-black-hole-massive-scalar-field system are studied {\it analytically} in the dimensionless large-mass $M\mu\gg1$ regime [here $\{M,\mu\}$ are respectively the mass of the central black hole and the proper mass of the scalar field]. It is proved that, for a given value ${\bar Q}\equiv Q/M$ of the dimensionless charge parameter of the central black hole, the system is characterized by the presence of quasi-resonances, linearized perturbation modes with arbitrarily long lifetimes. In particular, using analytical techniques, we determine the black-hole-field critical mass spectrum $\{M\mu_{\text{crit}}({\bar Q})\}$ which characterizes the long-lived resonances of the composed physical system.

中文摘要：我们研究根-Kerr天体的标量与电磁扰动。其无源外部携带由Kerr-Newman黑洞零质量极限得到的电磁场，而其物理源是一个带有本质性分布边缘贡献的旋转圆盘。对于无质量带电标量，最小耦合Klein-Gordon方程分离为共流Heun（CHE）径向方程，且标量与背景电荷之间存在直接耦合。我们给出相应的Nekrasov-Shatashvili（NS）字典，并表明圆盘是一个普通径向点。对于电磁扰动，我们直接推导辐射Newman-Penrose Maxwell标量的方程。它们具有相同的共流Heun结构，但Maxwell扰动与背景势没有体耦合。因此，依赖电荷的光子散射数据不能仅由外部方程确定。我们表述圆盘/边缘边界数据问题，识别将精确CHE/NS连接系数转换为物理散射矩阵所需的响应数据，并说明全自旋螺旋度翻转Compton信息如何约束辐射子空间上的响应。该分析将精确外部传播与振幅匹配同微观响应所需的额外源动力学分离开来。

English: We study scalar and electromagnetic perturbations of the root--Kerr object. We give the associated Nekrasov--Shatashvili (NS) dictionary and show that the disk is an ordinary radial point. For electromagnetic pertubations, we derive the equations for the radiative Newman--Penrose Maxwell scalars directly. They have the same confluent-Heun structure, but a Maxwell perturbation has no bulk coupling to the background potential. Charge-dependent photon scattering data therefore cannot be fixed by the exterior equation alone. The analysis separates exact exterior propagation and amplitude matching from the additional source dynamics required for a microscopic response.

中文摘要：在广义熵背景下，对引力理论的有效推导和热力学推导可能产生多个、且可能变化的引力耦合，这引发了一个问题：哪一个量应被认定为物理上测量的牛顿常数。受此歧义启发，我们提出了视界引力磁化率的概念。在包含多个视界的时空中，如果熵是多视界状态空间上的函数 S=S(A_1,A_2,\cdots,A_n)，那么熵对各个视界面积的导数定义了视界引力响应系数。不同视界可以具有不同的引力响应，而不需要多个基本引力耦合，这类似于宏观介质中方向依赖的响应系数。这一框架自然提示，视界熵（例如宇宙学表观视界和黑洞视界）可以相互影响，这可能解释文献中先前讨论过的黑洞-宇宙学耦合的“黑洞质量增长”。

English: Effective and thermodynamic derivations of gravity theory in the context of generalized entropy can give rise to multiple, and potentially varying, gravitational couplings, raising the question of which quantity should be identified with the physically measured Newton constant. In spacetimes containing multiple horizons, if the entropy is a function on a multi-horizon state space, $S=S(A_1,A_2,\cdots,A_n)$, then the derivatives of the entropy with respect to individual horizon areas define the horizon gravitational response coefficients. Different horizons may possess distinct gravitational responses without requiring multiple fundamental gravitational couplings, analogous to direction-dependent response coefficients in macroscopic media. This framework naturally suggests the possibility that horizon entropies (such as the cosmological apparent horizon and a black hole horizon) can influence one another, which could explain the black hole-cosmology coupled "black hole mass growth" previously discussed in the literature.

All traversability conditions are verified. 中文摘要：我们研究标量-张量-矢量引力（STVG）静态带电解中中性测试粒子的圆轨道，并使用十二个吸积致密天体的双千赫兹准周期振荡（QPO）来限制其参数。从有效势出发，我们得到比能、比角动量和开普勒角速度的闭式表达式，并由此得到径向和垂向的 epicyclic 频率。视界、光子球、阴影半径和最内稳定圆轨道也以闭式给出，并且各自在适当极限下退化为 RN 和 Schwarzschild 值。数值积分零测地线，表明增强的耦合加宽捕获截面，同时保留光子球处偏折角的对数发散。随后在 RP 模型中，我们对八颗中子星和四个微类星体的 QPO 对运行 Metropolis--Hastings MCMC 模拟，比较 Schwarzschild 时空、RN 时空、电荷消失的 STVG 以及完整 STVG 解。最佳拟合主要在中子星样本的带电解中获得，而四个模型对黑洞样本描述得同样好。我们表明轨道动力学仅通过两个组合 Meff=(1+α)M 和 Qeff^2=(1+α)(αM^2+Q^2) 依赖于质量 M、耦合 α 和电荷 Q，这解释了在中子星样本中发现的多峰后验，并对仅凭 QPO 计时所能测量的量给出了模型无关限制。详细讨论了这些界限的天体物理意义，特别是对推断质量高于 Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff 极限的情况。

English: We study circular geodesics of neutral test particles in the static charged solution of Scalar--Tensor--Vector Gravity (STVG), and we use the twin kilohertz quasiperiodic oscillations (QPOs) of twelve accreting compact objects to bound its parameters. Starting from the effective potential we obtain closed forms for the specific energy, the specific angular momentum and the Keplerian angular velocity, and from these the radial and vertical epicyclic frequencies. The horizon, photon sphere, shadow radius and innermost stable circular orbit are given in closed form as well, and each one reduces to the RN and Schwarzschild value in the appropriate limit. Null geodesics are integrated numerically and show how the enhanced coupling widens the capture cross section while leaving the logarithmic divergence of the deflection angle at the photon sphere intact. Within the RP model we then run Metropolis--Hastings MCMC simulations on the QPO pairs of eight neutron stars and four microquasars, comparing the Schwarzschild spacetime, the RN spacetime, STVG with vanishing charge and the full STVG solution. The best fits are obtained mainly for the charged solutions in the neutron star sample, while all four models describe the black hole sample equally well. We show that the orbital dynamics depends on the mass $M$, the coupling $\alpha$ and the charge $Q$ only through the two combinations $\Meff=(1+\alpha)M$ and $\Qeff^{2}=(1+\alpha)(\alpha M^{2}+Q^{2})$, which accounts for the multimodal posteriors found in the neutron star sample and sets a model-independent limit on what QPO timing alone can measure. The astrophysical implications of these bounds, in particular for inferred masses above the Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff limit, are discussed in detail.

English: We investigate the high-energy collision of two spinless bodies within the Self-Force Effective Field Theory, taking one of the two bodies to be massless and highly energetic, such that it generates a gravitational shockwave (GSW) background. The waveform is computed to all orders in the Post-Minkowskian expansion, and its resummed form proved to vanish at the leading order in the super-Planckian regime. We use this result to prove the UV finiteness of the angular spectrum of radiated energy in the region collinear to the shockwave with energy $E_1$.

At late times, the source approaches a sum of damped oscillations at the third and higher horizon frequencies. The corresponding zeros in the Green's function cancel these source-frequency components in the coherent waveform, while the continuing drive generates oscillations at QNM frequencies. Thus, for the parameter set considered here, the interaction does not generate the acceleration; rather, the transition is already present in the noninteracting Kaniadakis model and the interaction produces only a small shift in its timing. The adiabatic squared sound speed is also examined as a diagnostic of the effective-fluid stability, while statefinder variables are used to characterize deviations from $\Lambda$CDM. English: Black hole spacetimes contain several geometrically distinguished hypersurfaces, including event and Cauchy horizons, stationary-limit surfaces, and curvature singularities. These structures are usually identified by different geometric or causal criteria. Its zeros occur at the outer and inner horizons, its poles occur at the outer and inner stationary-limit surfaces, its higher-order divergence contains the ring-singularity factor, and its large-$r$ behavior records the asymptotic decay of the scalar. The construction is not proposed as a new invariant characterization of the spacetime, nor as a physical extension of the membrane fluid into the black-hole interior. Rather, it gives a compact membrane-pressure-based diagnostic whose analytic structure reorganizes several familiar surfaces of the Kerr--Newman geometry. We also note a secondary, purely algebraic analogy with generalized multi-component van der Waals-type equations of state.

中文摘要：费曼曾短暂考虑过平直时空中的非线性引力理论，通过要求物质能量—动量张量与引力场能量—动量张量之和满足能量—动量守恒来实现。他将对称化的正则能量—动量张量用作引力场的能量—动量张量。他报告说，由此得到的构造给出了水星近日点进动的错误值，并因此放弃了这条路线，转而采用基于动力学一致性的变分论证。我们重新考虑这条被放弃的路线。关键步骤是将引力能量—动量张量不认同为传统的 Belinfante 张量——它在使用场方程后变得对称——而是认同为其离壳 Belinfante-Rosenfeld 张量，其中包含显式的 Euler-Lagrange 项。如果我们把能量和动量守恒定律应用于该张量与物质能量—动量张量之和，就得到费曼的一致性条件。因此，费曼的动力学一致性论证与重构的能量—动量论证，虽然基于不同的物理假设，却给出相同的恒等式。Euler-Lagrange 项对这一结果至关重要。

English: Feynman briefly considered a nonlinear theory of gravity in flat spacetime by imposing energy--momentum conservation on the sum of the energy--momentum tensor of matter and that of the gravitational field. He used the symmetrized canonical energy-momentum tensor as the energy--momentum tensor of the gravitational field.He reported that the resulting construction gave an incorrect value for Mercury's perihelion precession and abandoned this route in favor of a variational argument based on dynamical consistency. We reconsider the abandoned route. The key step is to identify the gravitational energy--momentum tensor not with the conventional Belinfante tensor, which becomes symmetric upon use of the field equations, but with its off--shell Belinfante--Rosenfeld tensor, which contains explicit Euler--Lagrange terms. If we apply the law of conservation of energy and momentum to the sum of this tensor and the matter energy-momentum tensor, we obtain Feynman's consistency condition.Thus Feynman's dynamical-consistency argument and the reconstructed energy--momentum argument, although based on different physical assumptions, yield the same identity. The Euler--Lagrange terms are essential to this result.

一句话导读：重新审视费曼放弃的平直时空非线性引力能量—动量方法，并证明其与动力学一致性条件等价。

Ji-Yu Song, Ya-Nan Du, Yue-Yan Dong, Jing-Fei Zhang, Xin Zhang · astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc, hep-ph, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-10

中文摘要：多波段引力波（GW）观测结合空间与地面探测器、覆盖不同频段，可将致密双星源的天区定位相比单波段探测提高两到三个数量级。这一提升对互相关暗标准汽笛分析至关重要，因为天区定位不确定性直接决定引力波角功率谱的噪声水平。本文首次给出利用多波段GW观测进行互相关暗标准汽笛宇宙学的Fisher预报，将来自爱因斯坦望远镜（ET）、宇宙探索者（CE）和B-DECIGO的GW事件与中国空间站巡天望远镜测光星系巡天进行互相关。我们比较三种网络构型：多波段B-DECIGO+ET+2CE（BDET2CE）、仅地面ET+2CE（ET2CE）以及单独B-DECIGO。在ΛCDM模型中，BDET2CE达到σ(h)/h = 0.35%，比仅地面ET2CE（0.55%）改善37%，比单独B-DECIGO（2.45%）改善86%。扩展到w0waCDM框架时，多波段对宇宙学参数的优势变得较温和，BDET2CE对σ(h)/h的改善比ET2CE约4%，比B-DECIGO约22%。多波段观测最显著的优势在于对GW成团偏置b_GW(z)的分箱测量：在z∼1-2，BDET2CE将偏置约束到约3%精度，而ET2CE为约8-60%，B-DECIGO为约20-33%。这些精确的、按红移分辨的偏置测量为探测致密双星并合天体物理开辟了新途径，使人们能够限制孤立双星演化与动力学组装等形成通道，这些通道预言不同的成团信号。

English: Multi-band gravitational-wave (GW) observation, combining space-borne and ground-based detectors across different frequency bands, can improve the sky localization of compact binary sources by two to three orders of magnitude compared to single-band detection. This enhancement is crucial for cross-correlation dark siren analyses, since the sky localization uncertainty directly determines the noise level of the GW angular power spectrum. In this work, we present the first Fisher forecast for cross-correlation dark siren cosmology with multi-band GW observations, cross-correlating GW events from the Einstein Telescope (ET), Cosmic Explorer (CE), and B-DECIGO with the Chinese Space-station Survey Telescope photometric galaxy survey. We compare three network configurations: the multi-band B-DECIGO+ET+2CE (BDET2CE), the ground-only ET+2CE (ET2CE), and B-DECIGO alone. In the $\Lambda$CDM model, BDET2CE achieves $\sigma(h)/h = 0.35\%$, improving by $37\%$ over the ground-only ET2CE ($0.55\%$) and by $86\%$ over B-DECIGO alone ($2.45\%$). Extending to the $w_0w_a$CDM framework, the multi-band advantage on cosmological parameters becomes more moderate, with BDET2CE improving $\sigma(h)/h$ by $\sim 4\%$ over ET2CE and $\sim 22\%$ over B-DECIGO. The most striking advantage of multi-band observation lies in the per-bin measurement of the GW clustering bias $b_{\rm GW}(z)$: at $z \sim 1-2$, BDET2CE constrains the bias to $\sim 3\%$ precision, compared to $\sim 8-60\%$ for ET2CE and $\sim 20-33\%$ for B-DECIGO. These precise, redshift-resolved bias measurements open a new avenue for probing the astrophysics of compact binary mergers, enabling constraints on formation channels such as isolated binary evolution and dynamical assembly that predict distinct clustering signatures.

English: Do all manifolds that admit Lorentzian metrics also admit such metrics that have a purely electric (PE) or purely magnetic (PM) Weyl curvature tensor? We use this to derive the vanishing of all products of Pontryagin classes that land in the top-degree de Rham cohomology of a $4k$-dimensional pseudo-Riemannian manifold with a PE or PM Riemann or Weyl curvature tensor. For compact manifolds, this gives nontrivial cohomological obstructions to the existence of such pseudo-Riemannian metrics with globally PE or PM Riemann or Weyl curvature tensors. These obstructions can be linked to the existence of Lorentzian metrics of several Petrov subtypes, which play an important role in classifying exact solutions to the Einstein equations. Moreover, they can be applied to foliations by nondegenerate umbilic hypersurfaces, which may appear as timeslices of spacetimes.

全息导出的带自旋强耦合完美流体状态方程

Equation of State of a Strongly Coupled Perfect Fluid with Spin from Holography

Andres Anabalon, Horatiu Nastase · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-09

中文摘要：我们利用全息方法推导了2+1维有限自旋的强耦合相对论完美流体的状态方程。对偶引力描述由一个AdS4旋转黑洞提供，其霍金温度、角速度和贝肯斯坦-霍金熵决定了边界流体的热力学性质。我们得到了状态方程并分析了其局部热力学稳定性，发现存在一个临界旋转角速度，超过该值时流体将变得热力学不稳定，从而给出了温度为T、角速度为ω的强耦合夸克胶子等离子体的旋转约束：4πT/ω > 2.77239。值得注意的是，同一个引力解还包含与第二个边界关联的第二个黑洞。尽管第二个黑洞不旋转，其对偶流体却旋转并拥有一个独特的“奇异”状态方程。我们的结果为有限自旋强耦合物质提供了全息状态方程，并建立了黑洞旋转、内禀角动量与相对论流体热力学稳定性之间的直接联系。

English: We derive the equation of state of a strongly coupled relativistic perfect fluid with finite spin in $2+1$ dimensions using holography. The dual gravitational description is provided by a spinning black hole in $AdS_4$, whose Hawking temperature, angular velocity, and Bekenstein-Hawking entropy determine the thermodynamic properties of the boundary fluid. We obtain the equation of state and analyze its local thermodynamic stability, finding a critical rotation above which the fluid becomes thermodynamically unstable providing a bound for the rotation of a strongly coupled quark gluon plasma at temperature $T$ and angular velocity $\omega$ given by $\frac{4\pi T}{\omega}> 2.77239$. Remarkably, the same gravitational solution contains a second black hole associated with a second boundary. Although this black hole is non-spinning, its dual fluid rotates and possesses a distinct, ``exotic'' equation of state. Our results provide a holographic equation of state for strongly coupled matter with finite spin and establish a direct connection between black-hole rotation, intrinsic angular momentum, and the thermodynamic stability of relativistic fluids.

一句话导读：利用AdS4旋转黑洞对偶推导带自旋强耦合流体的状态方程，并得到热力学稳定性对旋转的约束。

二色 ABJM 中的生与灭

Birth and Death in Two-color ABJM

Marco S. Bianchi · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-09

中文摘要：我们精确求解了有限秩 U(2)×U(2) ABJM 理论中 half-BPS 算符两点度量的前导量子形变。在自然且与耦合无关的 Schur 标架中，其树级归一化的两圈修正成为双行 Young 图链上的 Jacobi 算符。一个基态变换将其映射为可逆生灭过程，其平稳分布是限制在至多两行图上的 Plancherel 测度。其本征模为 Racah 多项式，大 n 极限趋近径向 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 动力学，而等价的二自旋描述将 Jacobi 算符识别为受限 SU(2) Casimir 算符。

English: We solve exactly the leading quantum deformation of the two-point metric of half-BPS operators in $U(2)\times U(2)$ ABJM theory at finite rank. In the natural coupling-independent Schur frame, its tree-normalized two-loop correction is a Jacobi operator on the chain of two-row Young diagrams. A ground-state transform maps it to a reversible birth--death process whose stationary distribution is the Plancherel measure conditioned on diagrams with at most two rows. Its eigenmodes are Racah polynomials, its large-$n$ limit approaches radial Ornstein--Uhlenbeck dynamics, and an equivalent two-spin description identifies the Jacobi operator with a restricted $SU(2)$ Casimir.

边界引力子相干性的有限应力张量矩层析

Finite stress-tensor moment tomography of boundary-graviton coherences

Dyuman Bhattacharya, Robert B. Mann · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-09

中文摘要：2+1维的爱因斯坦引力是一种拓扑理论，不允许存在局域体引力子。然而，具有Brown-Henneaux边界条件的AdS3引力确实允许边界引力子的存在，它们被描述为Virasoro后代。生活在渐近边界上的观察者可以使用边界应力张量的有限阶矩作为这些态的探针。我们固定一个最高权模块，并假设Shapovalov形式非退化。我们还假设观察者探测的未知态具有已知的有限后代支撑，并且层间相干性是未知数据的一部分。我们发现，对于级别N≥2的一个后代，N阶应力矩层析（即N次应力矩插入）在信息上是不完备的，而N+1阶应力矩层析则是信息完备的。也就是说，在酉正则点集上，正交纯态可以具有相同的完整N阶记录。同样，对于精确的有限窗口结果，当级别直到L≥2时，L阶层析是不完备的，而L+1阶层析则恢复每一个密度矩阵块。相应的精确阈值在左右全理论中成立。在具有半经典体解释的重扇区中，这些阈值说明了有限支撑的边界引力子态何时首次变得可区分。

English: Einstein gravity in 2+1 dimensions is a topological theory that does not admit the existence of local bulk gravitons. However, $\mathrm{AdS}_3$ gravity with Brown-Henneaux boundary conditions does admit the existence of boundary gravitons, which are described by Virasoro descendants. An observer living on the asymptotic boundary can use finite order moments of the boundary stress tensor as a probe of these states. We fix one highest-weight module and assume that the Shapovalov forms are nondegenerate. We also assume that the unknown state the observer is probing has a known finite descendant support and that interlevel coherence is part of the unknown data. We find that, given a descendant at level $N\geq2$, stress moment tomography at order $N$ (meaning $N$ stress moment insertions) is informationally incomplete, while tomography with stress moments of order $N+1$ is informationally complete. This is to say that, on the unitary regular locus, orthogonal pure states can have the same complete order-$N$ record. Likewise, for exact finite-window result for levels through $L\geq2$, tomography of order $L$ is incomplete while tomography of order $L+1$ recovers every density-matrix block. Corresponding exact thresholds hold in the full left-right theory. In heavy sectors for which a semiclassical bulk interpretation exists, these thresholds say when finite-support boundary-graviton states first become distinguishable.

一句话导读：研究AdS3/CFT2中边界应力张量矩层析对边界引力子态的信息完备性，发现N阶矩不足以区分N级以上态，而N+1阶则信息完备。

能听到黑洞奇点的形状吗？

Can one hear the shape of a black hole singularity?

Sean A. Hartnoll, Alexander Zhiboedov · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-09

中文摘要：我们计算了具有内部近奇点Kasner时代的渐近AdS黑洞的大过振准正则频率ω_n。我们表明，在边界动量k=0处，色散∂ω_n/∂k^2的大n行为可以干净地提取Kasner指数。我们证明，正如BKL近奇点混沌中发生的Kasner跃迁在准正则频率中是“可听的”，并揭示出过振数n与到奇点的固有时之间的映射。我们的结果是通过WKB分析获得的，该分析将非解析指数（由近奇点时空决定）与非普适数据（如从边界到奇点的光学距离）分离开来。我们在几个数值模型中检验了我们的公式。

English: We compute the large overtone quasinormal frequencies $\omega_n$ of asymptotically AdS black holes with interior near-singularity Kasner epochs. We show that the Kasner exponents can be extracted cleanly from the large $n$ behaviour of the dispersion $\partial \omega_n/\partial k^2$ at $k=0$, where $k$ is a boundary momentum. We show that Kasner transitions, as occur in BKL near-singularity chaos, are audible in the quasinormal frequencies and reveal a map between overtone number $n$ and proper time to the singularity. Our results are obtained using a WKB analysis that isolates non-analytic exponents, determined by the near-singularity spacetime, from non-universal data such as the optical distance from the boundary to the singularity. We check our formulae in several numerical models.

一句话导读：通过WKB分析，证明从AdS黑洞准正则频率的大过振色散中可提取内部Kasner奇点指数，使奇点几何“可听”。

幺正量子共形 Bondi-Metzner-Sachs 场论

Unitary quantum conformal Bondi-Metzner-Sachs field theories

Daniel Grumiller, Iva Lovrekovic · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-09

中文摘要：我们对二维场论施加幺正性约束，这些场论的对称性构成量子共形BMS代数，该代数结合了共形对称性与渐近平坦时空的渐近对称性。正性约束给中心荷限定范围 0<c<2.053。相关顶点代数的正性仅允许四个中心荷：c = 1, 3/2, 13/7, 2。因而只剩下四个幺正场论候选者。我们计算了它们的原初谱，并表明其与 BPS-like 及全息不等式兼容。

English: We impose unitarity constraints on two-dimensional field theories whose symmetries form the quantum conformal Bondi-Metzner-Sachs algebra, which combines conformal symmetries with asymptotic symmetries of asymptotically flat spacetimes. Positivity constraints put bounds on the central charge, 0<c<2.053. Positivity of the associated vertex algebra allows only four central charges, c = 1, 3/2, 13/7, 2. Thus, only four candidates for unitary field theories remain. We calculate their spectra of primaries and show that they are compatible with BPS-like and holographic inequalities.

超越大 N 极限的纠缠楔重建：基于扭缠 Petz 映射

Entanglement Wedge Reconstruction Beyond the Large N Limit via the Twirled Petz Map

Arash Alipour Shahmiri, Maryam Sharifian, Niloofar Vardian · hep-th, gr-qc, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-09

中文摘要：纠缠楔重建提供了 AdS/CFT 中体局域性的最精确表述，将纠缠楔识别为可从边界子区域重建的最大体区域。虽然这一陈述在大 N 展开的首阶已通过模流和 Petz 映射重建被充分理解，但其在半经典区域之外的外推仍不清晰。在这项工作中，我们证明量子纠错为解决该问题提供了自然框架。在首阶，我们复现了已知的首阶重建公式，并利用扭缠 Petz 映射，获得了一种系统且显式的方法来纳入次领头 1/N 修正。在领头近似之外，我们得到了由次领头 Petz 核控制的显式双局域修正。我们的结果为超越大 N 的体重建建立了受控方法，并强化了量子纠错在全息中的作用。该框架为在完全量子引力场景中理解体重建提供了可控路径。

English: Entanglement wedge reconstruction provides the sharpest formulation of bulk locality in AdS/CFT, identifying the entanglement wedge as the largest bulk region reconstructible from a boundary subregion. While this statement is well understood at leading order in the large N expansion through both modular flow and Petz map reconstruction, its extension beyond the semiclassical regime has remained unclear. In this work, we show that quantum error correction provides the natural framework for addressing this problem. At leading order, we reproduce the known leading-order reconstruction formulas, and by employing the twirled Petz map, we obtain a systematic and explicit method for incorporating subleading 1/N corrections. Beyond the leading approximation, we have obtained an explicit bi-local correction controlled by a subleading Petz kernel. Our results establish a controlled approach to bulk reconstruction beyond large N and sharpening the role of quantum error correction in holography. This framework provides a controlled path toward understanding bulk reconstruction in fully quantum gravitational settings.

一句话导读：利用扭缠 Petz 映射系统地推广纠缠楔重建至大 N 极限之外，获得次领头双局域修正。

平面波极限下 ABJM/BMN 指标匹配

ABJM/BMN Index Matching in the Plane-Wave Limit

Chi-Ming Chang, Kangning Liu · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-09

中文摘要：我们确立了在平面波极限中，对于每个固定正陈-西蒙斯水平 k，ABJM 理论的精化超对称指标与 BMN 矩阵模型指标之间的逐系数相等性。对于固定重数（从而固定的有限 ABJM 规范秩）的多膜族，当所有纵向动量趋于无穷且其成对差值固定时，该相等性成立。标量修饰的等通量 ABJM 磁单极对应 BMN 模糊球膜真空：重数标志重合膜数，而通量大小给出每个膜沿 M 理论圆的动量。在指标层面，相关的 Higgs 极点给出了 ABJM 平面波贡献的对角和乐积分，其磁单极-调和核与 BMN 矩阵-调和核在有限的 BMN 上自旋截断之上一致。在有限动量下，完整指标差分为非平面波余项与该截断之上的调和尾部之和。增大 k 将前者移至更高的逸度阶，而不改变存活的核或截断贡献。这给出了之前单膜指标关系的逐系数、多膜推广。

English: We establish coefficientwise equality between the refined supersymmetric indices of ABJM theory and the BMN matrix model in the plane-wave limit at every fixed positive Chern-Simons level k. For multi-membrane families with fixed multiplicities, and hence fixed finite ABJM gauge rank, the equality holds as all longitudinal momenta tend to infinity with their pairwise differences fixed. Scalar-dressed equal-flux ABJM monopoles correspond to BMN vacua of fuzzy-sphere membranes: multiplicities count coincident membranes, whereas flux magnitudes give the momentum per membrane along the M-theory circle. At the index level, the associated Higgs residues yield a diagonal-holonomy integral for the ABJM plane-wave contribution, whose monopole-harmonic kernel agrees with the BMN matrix-harmonic kernel up to the finite BMN upper-spin cutoff. At finite momentum, the full index difference splits into the non-plane-wave remainder and the harmonic tail above this cutoff. Increasing k shifts the former to higher fugacity grade without changing the surviving kernel or the cutoff contribution. This gives a coefficientwise, multi-membrane extension of the earlier single-membrane index relation.

一句话导读：本文证明了在平面波极限下 ABJM 理论与 BMN 矩阵模型的精化超对称指标逐系数相等，并将单膜关系推广到多膜情形。

Wilson圈、M2膜与弦

Wilson loops, M2-branes and strings

Alexia Nix · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-09

中文摘要：我们建立了一种普适方法，用于研究渐近AdS₄背景中探针M2膜和基本弦的半经典量子化。在场论一侧，它们的配分函数对偶于一类三维N≥2 Chern-Simons-物质理论中半BPS Wilson圈的真空期望值。利用这一普适方法，我们得到了Wilson圈半经典行为的新预言，并在可用时将我们的结果与通过超对称局域化获得的表达式相匹配。我们还表明，正确的全息系综选择意味着探针M2膜的半经典量子化可给出对偶Wilson圈关于规范群秩N的全阶微扰答案。本文是2025年12月17-19日在雅典国立卡波季斯特里安大学举行的“雅典理论物理研讨会：十周年”会议投稿。

English: We establish a universal approach for studying the semiclassical quantization of both probe M2-branes and fundamental strings in asymptotically AdS$_{4}$ backgrounds. On the field theory side, their partition functions are dual to the vacuum expectation value of half-BPS Wilson loops of a class of three-dimensional $\mathcal{N}\geq 2$ Chern-Simons-matter theories. Utilizing this universal approach we arrive at novel predictions for the semiclassical behaviour of the Wilson loop or upon availability match our results with the previously obtained expressions via supersymmetric localization. We also show that the correct choice of holographic ensemble suggests that the semiclassical quantization of probe M2-branes yields the full perturbative answer in the rank of the gauge group $N$ for the dual Wilson loop. This is a proceedings contribution to the ''Athens Workshop in Theoretical Physics: 10th Anniversary'', held at the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens on December 17-19 2025.

偶然ABJM算子作为黑洞

Fortuitous ABJM Operators as Black Holes

Connor Behan, Leonardo Pipolo de Gioia · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-09

中文摘要：给定一个固定圈阶的超共形规范理论，BPS态可以通过两种方式研究：枚举幂零超荷的上同调类，或对角化反常维度矩阵。第二种方式可以更深入地理解全息理论如何根据算子是对偶于无地平线几何还是黑洞来区分它们。为此，我们在U(N)_k × U(N)_{-k} ABJM理论中将对角化形式化为N的参数。这使得定义算子轨迹并关注那些“偶然”算子成为可能，其特征是仅在有限个N值处是BPS的。与数值上难以研究多个这类轨迹的N=4超杨-米尔斯相比，ABJM使我们能够访问16条这样的轨迹及其后裔。我们证明在大N下它们采取特别简单的形式，并与可积性预言一致。我们还表明，它们中的许多（如同黑洞）只能被某些类型的引力子所修饰，并评述了这一上同调练习对完整算子性质的影响。最后，我们展示了ABJM理论中到第一个非BPS态的能隙，其定性差异与N=4超杨-米尔斯理论的预期方式一致。

English: Given a superconformal gauge theory at a fixed loop order, BPS states can be studied in two ways --- by enumerating cohomology classes of a nilpotent supercharge or by diagonalizing the anomalous dimension matrix. The second one allows for a deeper look at how holographic theories distinguish between operators based on whether they are dual to horizonless geometries or black holes. To this end, we carry out the diagonalization in $\mathrm{U}(N)_k \times \mathrm{U}(N)_{-k}$ ABJM theory with $N$ as a formal parameter. This makes it possible to define trajectories of operators and focus on the fortuitous ones which are characterized by being BPS at only finitely many values of $N$. In contrast to $\mathcal{N} = 4$ Super Yang-Mills, where it has been numerically prohibitive to study more than one of these, ABJM gives us access to 16 such trajectories along with their descendants. We show that they take an especially simple form at large $N$ where they agree with the predictions of integrability. We also show that many of them, as with black holes, can only be dressed by certain types of gravitons and comment on how this exercise in cohomology also has implications for properties of the full operators. Finally, we show that the gap to the first non-BPS state in ABJM theory qualitatively differs from that of $\mathcal{N} = 4$ Super Yang-Mills in the expected way.

一句话导读：研究了ABJM理论中偶然BPS算子的轨迹，发现大N极限下与可积性一致，且许多算子像黑洞一样只能被特定引力子修饰。

有限温度全息超流体中多量子涡旋的劈裂动力学

Splitting Dynamics of Multiply Quantized Vortices in Holographic Superfluid of Finite Temperature

Shanquan Lan, Xin Li, Jiexiong Mo, Yu Tian, Yu-Kun Yan, Hongbao Zhang · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-09

中文摘要：我们结合准正规模的线性扰动分析与完全非线性实时数值模拟，研究了有限温度二维全息超流体中具有绕数n=5,6,7,8的多量子涡旋的劈裂动力学。揭示了三个新的物理现象。第一，随着n增加，不稳定模的数目不再严格遵循2n-3公式。对于n=8的涡旋，p=2(n-1)的不稳定模在整个温度范围内缺失，因此只存在2n-4个不稳定模。第二，主导不稳定模随温度升高发生的转变表现出新的特征。对于n≤6的涡旋，主导模按p=2,3,…,n的顺序依次改变，而对于n≥7发生跳跃式转变——例如，对于n=7，主导模在T=0.325Tc处从p=2跳至p=4，然后在T=0.359Tc处直接跳到p=7；对于n=8，在T=0.302Tc处直接从p=2跳到p=8。第三，高绕数涡旋的单一分裂图案可包含多个具有不同拓扑结构的子分裂图案，如n=8涡旋的l=4图案在低温、中温和高温下表现出的三个子图案。非线性模拟证实了线性稳定性分析的预言，并讨论了对冷原子实验的启示。

English: We study the splitting dynamics of multiply quantized vortices with winding numbers $n=5,6,7$ and $8$ in a two-dimensional holographic superfluid at finite temperature, by combining linear perturbation analysis of quasinormal modes with fully nonlinear real-time numerical simulations. Three new physical phenomena are revealed. First, the number of unstable modes no longer strictly follows the $2n-3$ formula as $n$ increases. For the vortex with $n=8$, the unstable mode with $p=2(n-1)$ is absent throughout the entire temperature range, so that only $2n-4$ unstable modes exist. Second, the transition of the dominant unstable mode with increasing temperature exhibits new characteristics. For vortices with $n\le 6$, the dominant mode changes sequentially as $p=2,3,\dots,n$, whereas for $n\ge 7$ jump-like transitions occur-for instance, for $n=7$ the dominant mode jumps from $p=2$ to $p=4$ at $T=0.325T_c$ and then directly to $p=7$ at $T=0.359T_c$, and for $n=8$ it jumps directly from $p=2$ to $p=8$ at $T=0.302T_c$. Third, a single splitting pattern of high-winding-number vortices can contain multiple sub-splitting patterns with distinct topological structures, as exemplified by the $l=4$ pattern of the $n=8$ vortex, which exhibits three sub-patterns at low, intermediate and high temperatures. The nonlinear simulations confirm the predictions of the linear stability analysis, and the implications of our results for cold-atom experiments are discussed.

Quantum-gravity-inspired Alcubierre warp-drive geometries
